-- Cache the real game Lighting state once, before any La Peak theme/effect
-- is allowed to touch it. Sky Theme = Off restores this exact state.
if not _G.__LaPeakDefaultLightingState then
    _G.__LaPeakDefaultLightingState = {
        ClockTime = Lighting.ClockTime,
        Brightness = Lighting.Brightness,
        OutdoorAmbient = Lighting.OutdoorAmbient,
        Ambient = Lighting.Ambient,
        GlobalShadows = Lighting.GlobalShadows,
        FogStart = Lighting.FogStart,
        FogEnd = Lighting.FogEnd,
        FogColor = Lighting.FogColor,
        ColorShift_Top = Lighting.ColorShift_Top,
        ColorShift_Bottom = Lighting.ColorShift_Bottom,
        ExposureCompensation = Lighting.ExposureCompensation,
        EnvironmentDiffuseScale = Lighting.EnvironmentDiffuseScale,
        EnvironmentSpecularScale = Lighting.EnvironmentSpecularScale,
        ShadowSoftness = Lighting.ShadowSoftness,
    }
end
_G.__LaPeakRestoreDefaultLighting = function()
    local state = _G.__LaPeakDefaultLightingState
    if not state then return end
    for property, value in pairs(state) do
        pcall(function()
            Lighting[property] = value
        end)
    end
end

--Leaked By Xlu0 AndPrime--
function _xluCompatGuiParent()
    if type(gethui) == "function" then
        local ok, parent = pcall(gethui)
        if ok and parent then return parent end
    end
    local okCore, core = pcall(function() return CoreGui end)
    if okCore and core then return core end
    return nil
end

LP = Players.LocalPlayer
PlayerGui = LP:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
--Leaked By Xlu0 AndPrime--
function getUndetectedGuiParent()
    --Leaked By Xlu0 AndPrime--
    if type(gethui) == "function" then
        local ok, parent = pcall(gethui)
        if ok and parent then return parent end
    end
    --Leaked By Xlu0 AndPrime--
    if protectgui then
        return game:GetService("CoreGui")
    end
    --Leaked By Xlu0 AndPrime--
    local cg = game:GetService("CoreGui")
    if cg then return cg end
    --Leaked By Xlu0 AndPrime--
    return PlayerGui
end

function safeParentGui(gui)
    pcall(function()
        if type(gethui) == "function" then
            local ok, parent = pcall(gethui)
            if ok and parent then
                gui.Parent = parent
                return
            end
        end
        if protectgui then
            gui.Parent = game:GetService("CoreGui")
            pcall(function() protectgui(gui) end)
            return
        end
        gui.Parent = game:GetService("CoreGui")
    end)
    --Leaked By Xlu0 AndPrime--
    if not gui.Parent then
        pcall(function() gui.Parent = PlayerGui end)
    end
end

function _G.AmbitiousSlowFallDown(targetY, zig)
    if _G._AmbitiousSlowFallActive then return end
    _G._AmbitiousSlowFallActive = true
    _G._AmbitiousTPDownJumpLocked = true
    local zigVec=nil
    _G._AmbitiousZigZagFalling=false
    if zig then
        _G._AmbitiousZigZagSide = (_G._AmbitiousZigZagSide == -1) and 1 or -1
        local ch=LP.Character; local hr=ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if hr then
            local rv=hr.CFrame.RightVector; local flat=Vector3.new(rv.X,0,rv.Z)
            if flat.Magnitude>0.001 then
                local spd=16
                if _G.AdaptGetCurrentSpeedValue then pcall(function() spd=_G.AdaptGetCurrentSpeedValue() end) end
                zigVec=flat.Unit*tonumber(spd or 16)*_G._AmbitiousZigZagSide
                _G._AmbitiousZigZagFalling=true
            end
        end
    end
    task.spawn(function()
        local POWER=zigVec and 50 or 115
        local deadline=os.clock()+6; local landed=false
        while os.clock()<deadline do
            local char=LP.Character; local hrp=char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"); local hum=char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if not hrp or not hum or hum.Health<=0 then break end
            if hum.FloorMaterial~=Enum.Material.Air then landed=true; break end
            local part=(_G._jumpEnsureProxy and _G._jumpEnsureProxy()) or hrp
            local v=part.Velocity
            if zigVec then part.Velocity=Vector3.new(zigVec.X,-POWER,zigVec.Z) else part.Velocity=Vector3.new(v.X,-POWER,v.Z) end
            RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
        end
        if not landed then
            local char=LP.Character; local hrp=char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"); local part=(_G._jumpEnsureProxy and _G._jumpEnsureProxy()) or hrp
            if part then local v=part.Velocity; pcall(function() part.Velocity=Vector3.new(v.X,0,v.Z) end) end
        end
        _G._AmbitiousSlowFallActive=false; _G._AmbitiousZigZagFalling=false
        local groundDeadline=os.clock()+8
        while os.clock()<groundDeadline do
            local c=LP.Character; local h=c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if not h or h.Health<=0 or h.FloorMaterial~=Enum.Material.Air then break end
            RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
        end
        _G._AmbitiousTPDownJumpLocked=false
    end)
end

function doAutoTPDown(force)
    local char = LP.Character
    if not char then return end
    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hrp then return end
    local hum2 = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum2 then return end
    if not force then
        if hum2.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air then return end
        if not (hrp.Position.Y >= (tonumber(autoTPHeight) or 20)) then return end
    end
    local targetY = -7.00
    local mode = _G._AmbitiousTPDownMethod or "NORMAL"
    if mode == "SLOW" or mode == "ZIGZAG" then
        _G.AmbitiousSlowFallDown(targetY, mode == "ZIGZAG")
        return
    end
    local yaw = select(2, hrp.CFrame:ToEulerAnglesYXZ())
    hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(hrp.Position.X, targetY, hrp.Position.Z) * CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0)
    hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
    hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
    pcall(function() hrp.Velocity = Vector3.zero end)
    pcall(function() hrp.RotVelocity = Vector3.zero end)
end
local function _clearAutoTPConnection()
if autoTPConn then
pcall(function() autoTPConn:Disconnect() end)
pcall(function() task.cancel(autoTPConn) end)
autoTPConn = nil
end
end
local function startAutoTP()
autoTPEnabled = true
_clearAutoTPConnection()
autoTPLastRun = 0
autoTPConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
if not autoTPEnabled then
_clearAutoTPConnection()
return
end
local now = tick()
if now - autoTPLastRun < 0.1 then return end
autoTPLastRun = now
pcall(function() doAutoTPDown(false) end)
end)
if setAutoTPVisual then setAutoTPVisual(true) end
end
local function stopAutoTP()
autoTPEnabled = false
_clearAutoTPConnection()
if setAutoTPVisual then setAutoTPVisual(false) end
end
local function runTPFloor()
pcall(function() doAutoTPDown(true) end)
end
local function toggleAutoTP(on)
if on then
startAutoTP()
else
stopAutoTP()
end
if saveAdaptConfig then pcall(saveAdaptConfig) end
end
function _G.AdaptStopAutoTPForAction()
if autoTPEnabled then
stopAutoTP()
pcall(function() if setAutoTPVisual then setAutoTPVisual(false) end end)
if saveAdaptConfig then pcall(saveAdaptConfig) end
end
end
local infJumpEnabled = false
local antiRagdollEnabled = false
local antiRagdollConn = nil
_G.AdaptAntiRagdollMode = "Zombie Hub"

-- ============================================================
-- ANTI VOID: Ambitious logic (0.07s teleport detection + ghost origin)
-- ============================================================
do
    local MAP_BOUNDS = {MinX=-535.7, MaxX=-422.0, MinY=-7.9, MaxY=115.0, MinZ=-72.0, MaxZ=193.3}
    local TP_TOTAL, TP_DELTA_Y, WINDOW, WALK_CLEAR, STEP_MAX = 150, 100, 0.07, 15, 50
    local ghost = setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"})
    local ghostCF = setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"})
    local isOutOf = setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"})
    -- Separate detector used by Anti Anti TP / Anti Anti Denysc.
    -- It is intentionally independent from the Anti Void toggle so the
    -- saved enemy position remains available to the remaining Aimbot logic.
    local antiAntiActive = setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"})
    local antiAntiPos = setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"})
    local antiAntiCF = setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"})
    local antiAntiLastSeen = setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"})
    local tracked = setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"})
    local function within(pos)
        return typeof(pos)=="Vector3" and pos.X>=MAP_BOUNDS.MinX and pos.X<=MAP_BOUNDS.MaxX and pos.Y>=MAP_BOUNDS.MinY and pos.Y<=MAP_BOUNDS.MaxY and pos.Z>=MAP_BOUNDS.MinZ and pos.Z<=MAP_BOUNDS.MaxZ
    end
    local function enabled() return _G.AdaptAntiVoidEnabled == true end
    local function trackPlayer(plr)
        if tracked[plr] then return end
        tracked[plr]=true
        task.spawn(function()
            local history, walkedXZ, lastCheckPos = {}, 0, nil
            while plr and plr.Parent do
                local char=plr.Character
                local root=char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local hum=char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if root and hum and hum.Health>0 then
                    local now=os.clock(); local pos=root.Position
                    if not lastCheckPos then lastCheckPos=pos end
                    local step=(pos-lastCheckPos).Magnitude
                    if step<=STEP_MAX then walkedXZ=walkedXZ+Vector3.new(pos.X-lastCheckPos.X,0,pos.Z-lastCheckPos.Z).Magnitude end
                    lastCheckPos=pos
                    history[#history+1]={t=now,p=pos,cf=root.CFrame}
                    while history[1] and now-history[1].t>WINDOW do table.remove(history,1) end
                    local old=history[1]
                    local delta=old and (pos-old.p) or Vector3.zero
                    local tp=old and (delta.Magnitude>=TP_TOTAL or math.abs(delta.Y)>=TP_DELTA_Y)
                    -- Detect the same replicated teleport/desync signature even
                    -- when Anti Void itself is OFF. This is the shared "save player"
                    -- point used by Anti Anti TP / Anti Anti Denysc.
                    if not antiAntiActive[plr] and tp and within(old.p) then
                        antiAntiActive[plr]=true
                        antiAntiPos[plr]=old.p
                        antiAntiCF[plr]=old.cf
                        antiAntiLastSeen[plr]=now
                        walkedXZ=0
                    elseif antiAntiActive[plr] then
                        antiAntiLastSeen[plr]=now
                        if within(pos) and walkedXZ>=WALK_CLEAR then
                            antiAntiActive[plr]=false
                            antiAntiPos[plr]=nil
                            antiAntiCF[plr]=nil
                            antiAntiLastSeen[plr]=nil
                            walkedXZ=0
                            history={}
                        end
                    end

                    if enabled() and not isOutOf[plr] and tp and within(old.p) then
                        isOutOf[plr]=true; ghost[plr]=old.p; ghostCF[plr]=old.cf; walkedXZ=0
                    elseif isOutOf[plr] and within(pos) and walkedXZ>=WALK_CLEAR then
                        isOutOf[plr]=false; ghost[plr]=nil; ghostCF[plr]=nil; walkedXZ=0; history={}
                    elseif not enabled() then
                        isOutOf[plr]=false; ghost[plr]=nil; ghostCF[plr]=nil
                    end
                else
                    isOutOf[plr]=false; ghost[plr]=nil; ghostCF[plr]=nil
                    antiAntiActive[plr]=false; antiAntiPos[plr]=nil; antiAntiCF[plr]=nil; antiAntiLastSeen[plr]=nil
                    history={}; walkedXZ=0; lastCheckPos=nil
                end
                RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
            end
            tracked[plr]=nil
        end)
    end
    for _,plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do if plr~=LP then trackPlayer(plr) end end
    Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(plr) if plr~=LP then trackPlayer(plr) end end)
    Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(plr)
        isOutOf[plr]=nil; ghost[plr]=nil; ghostCF[plr]=nil
        antiAntiActive[plr]=nil; antiAntiPos[plr]=nil; antiAntiCF[plr]=nil; antiAntiLastSeen[plr]=nil
        tracked[plr]=nil
    end)

    -- Circular "saved player" marker. It follows the saved origin, not the
    -- enemy's replicated/hidden position. It is removed only after the same
    -- player has returned to normal replicated movement (or leaves/dies).
    local antiAntiMarkers = setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"})
    local function clearAntiAntiMarker(plr)
        local m=antiAntiMarkers[plr]
        if m then pcall(function() m:Destroy() end) end
        antiAntiMarkers[plr]=nil
    end
    local function ensureAntiAntiMarker(plr, pos)
        local m=antiAntiMarkers[plr]
        if not m or not m.Parent then
            m=Instance.new("Part")
            m.Name="AntiAntiSavedMarker_"..tostring(plr.UserId)
            m.Shape=Enum.PartType.Cylinder
            m.Size=Vector3.new(0.18,5.5,5.5)
            m.Anchored=true
            m.CanCollide=false
            m.CanTouch=false
            m.CanQuery=false
            m.Material=Enum.Material.Neon
            m.Transparency=0.18
            m.Color=Color3.fromRGB(255,80,80)
            m.CastShadow=false
            m.Parent=workspace
            antiAntiMarkers[plr]=m
            local ring=Instance.new("Part")
            ring.Name="Ring"
            ring.Shape=Enum.PartType.Cylinder
            ring.Size=Vector3.new(0.10,6.6,6.6)
            ring.Anchored=true
            ring.CanCollide=false
            ring.CanTouch=false
            ring.CanQuery=false
            ring.Material=Enum.Material.Neon
            ring.Transparency=0.48
            ring.Color=Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
            ring.CastShadow=false
            ring.Parent=m
        end
        pcall(function() m.CFrame=CFrame.new(pos+Vector3.new(0,0.12,0)) * CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.rad(90)) end)
        local ring=m:FindFirstChild("Ring")
        if ring then pcall(function() ring.CFrame=m.CFrame * CFrame.new(0,0.03,0) end) end
    end
    RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        for _,plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if plr~=LP and antiAntiActive[plr] and antiAntiPos[plr] then
                ensureAntiAntiMarker(plr,antiAntiPos[plr])
            else
                clearAntiAntiMarker(plr)
            end
        end
    end)

    _G.AdaptAntiAntiIsActive=function(player) return player and antiAntiActive[player]==true end
    _G.AdaptAntiAntiGetSavedPosition=function(player) return player and antiAntiPos[player] or nil end
    _G.AdaptAntiAntiGetSavedCFrame=function(player) return player and antiAntiCF[player] or nil end
    _G.AdaptAntiAntiPosFor=function(player,rawPos)
        if player and antiAntiActive[player] and antiAntiPos[player] then
            return antiAntiPos[player],true
        end
        return rawPos,false
    end

    _G.AdaptAntiVoidEnabled = _G.AdaptAntiVoidEnabled == true
    _G.AdaptAntiVoid = {
        setEnabled=function(on) _G.AdaptAntiVoidEnabled=on==true; if _G.AdaptAntiVoidEnabled then for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do if p~=LP then trackPlayer(p) end end else for p in pairs(isOutOf) do isOutOf[p]=false end end end,
        isEnabled=function() return _G.AdaptAntiVoidEnabled==true end,
        bounds=MAP_BOUNDS,
        posFor=function(player,rawPos)
            if player and antiAntiActive[player] and antiAntiPos[player] then return antiAntiPos[player],true end
            if not player or not enabled() then return rawPos,false end
            if isOutOf[player] and ghost[player] then return ghost[player],true end
            return rawPos,false
        end,
        posForPart=function(part,rawPos)
            if not part then return rawPos,false end
            local model=part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
            local plr=model and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)
            if plr and antiAntiActive[plr] and antiAntiPos[plr] then return antiAntiPos[plr],true end
            return _G.AdaptAntiVoid.posFor(plr,rawPos or part.Position)
        end,
        isOut=function(player) return player and isOutOf[player]==true end,
        ghostOf=function(player) return player and ghost[player] or nil end,
    }
    _G.AdaptAntiVoidSet=function(on) _G.AdaptAntiVoid.setEnabled(on); if _G.AdaptAntiVoidVisual then _G.AdaptAntiVoidVisual(on==true) end; if saveAdaptConfig then pcall(saveAdaptConfig) end end
    _G.AdaptAntiVoidSaveSafe=function() end
    _G.AdaptAntiVoidStop=function() _G.AdaptAntiVoid.setEnabled(false) end
end

local AnimationPackList = {"OFF","Zombie","Ninja","Knight","Elder","Levitate","Astronaut","Pirate","Toy","Vampire","Werewolf","Rthro","Stylish"}
local AnimationPackIndex = 1
local OriginalAnims = {}

_G.AdaptAnimationSystem = _G.AdaptAnimationSystem or {
    conn = nil,
    original = nil,
    activePack = "OFF",
}

function _G.AdaptAnimGetAnimate(char)
    char = char or LP.Character
    return char and char:FindFirstChild("Animate") or nil
end

function _G.AdaptAnimReadOriginal(char)
    if _G.AdaptAnimationSystem.original then return end
    local animate = _G.AdaptAnimGetAnimate(char)
    if not animate then return end

    local function g(obj)
        return obj and obj.AnimationId or nil
    end

    _G.AdaptAnimationSystem.original = {
        idle1 = g(animate.idle and animate.idle:FindFirstChild("Animation1")),
        idle2 = g(animate.idle and animate.idle:FindFirstChild("Animation2")),
        walk = g(animate.walk and animate.walk:FindFirstChild("WalkAnim")),
        run = g(animate.run and animate.run:FindFirstChild("RunAnim")),
        jump = g(animate.jump and animate.jump:FindFirstChild("JumpAnim")),
        fall = g(animate.fall and animate.fall:FindFirstChild("FallAnim")),
        climb = g(animate.climb and animate.climb:FindFirstChild("ClimbAnim")),
        swim = g(animate.swim and animate.swim:FindFirstChild("Swim")),
        swimidle = g(animate.swimidle and animate.swimidle:FindFirstChild("SwimIdle")),
    }
end

function _G.AdaptAnimGetPack(packName)
    return AnimationPacks[packName]
end

function _G.AdaptAnimApplyPack(char, packName)
    local animate = _G.AdaptAnimGetAnimate(char)
    local pack = _G.AdaptAnimGetPack(packName)
    if not animate or not pack then return false end

    local function s(obj, id)
        if obj and id then
            obj.AnimationId = tostring(id)
        end
    end

    s(animate.idle and animate.idle:FindFirstChild("Animation1"), pack.idle and pack.idle[1] and pack.idle[1][1])
    s(animate.idle and animate.idle:FindFirstChild("Animation2"), pack.idle and pack.idle[2] and pack.idle[2][1])
    s(animate.walk and animate.walk:FindFirstChild("WalkAnim"), pack.walk)
    s(animate.run and animate.run:FindFirstChild("RunAnim"), pack.run)
    s(animate.jump and animate.jump:FindFirstChild("JumpAnim"), pack.jump)
    s(animate.fall and animate.fall:FindFirstChild("FallAnim"), pack.fall)
    s(animate.climb and animate.climb:FindFirstChild("ClimbAnim"), pack.climb)
    s(animate.swim and animate.swim:FindFirstChild("Swim"), pack.swim)
    s(animate.swimidle and animate.swimidle:FindFirstChild("SwimIdle"), pack.swimidle)

    return true
end

function _G.AdaptAnimRestore(char)
    local animate = _G.AdaptAnimGetAnimate(char)
    local o = _G.AdaptAnimationSystem.original
    if not animate or not o then return end

    local function s(obj,id)
        if obj and id then obj.AnimationId = id end
    end

    s(animate.idle and animate.idle:FindFirstChild("Animation1"), o.idle1)
    s(animate.idle and animate.idle:FindFirstChild("Animation2"), o.idle2)
    s(animate.walk and animate.walk:FindFirstChild("WalkAnim"), o.walk)
    s(animate.run and animate.run:FindFirstChild("RunAnim"), o.run)
    s(animate.jump and animate.jump:FindFirstChild("JumpAnim"), o.jump)
    s(animate.fall and animate.fall:FindFirstChild("FallAnim"), o.fall)
    s(animate.climb and animate.climb:FindFirstChild("ClimbAnim"), o.climb)
    s(animate.swim and animate.swim:FindFirstChild("Swim"), o.swim)
    s(animate.swimidle and animate.swimidle:FindFirstChild("SwimIdle"), o.swimidle)
end

function _G.AdaptAnimStop()
    if _G.AdaptAnimationSystem.conn then
        pcall(function() _G.AdaptAnimationSystem.conn:Disconnect() end)
        _G.AdaptAnimationSystem.conn = nil
    end

    _G.AdaptAnimRestore(LP.Character)
    _G.AdaptAnimationSystem.activePack = "OFF"
end

function _G.AdaptAnimStart(packName)
    if packName == "OFF" then
        _G.AdaptAnimStop()
        return
    end

    if _G.AdaptAnimationSystem.conn then
        pcall(function() _G.AdaptAnimationSystem.conn:Disconnect() end)
        _G.AdaptAnimationSystem.conn = nil
    end

    local char = LP.Character
    if not char then return end

    local pack = _G.AdaptAnimGetPack(packName)
    if not pack then return end

    _G.AdaptAnimReadOriginal(char)
    _G.AdaptAnimationSystem.activePack = packName

    --Leaked By Xlu0 AndPrime--
    task.spawn(function()
        local list = {}
        for _, v in pairs(pack) do
            if type(v) == "string" then
                table.insert(list, v)
            elseif type(v) == "table" then
                for _, a in ipairs(v) do
                    if type(a) == "table" and a[1] then
                        table.insert(list, tostring(a[1]))
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        pcall(function()
            game:GetService("ContentProvider"):PreloadAsync(list)
        end)
    end)

    _G.AdaptAnimApplyPack(char, packName)

    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if hum then
        for _, track in ipairs(hum:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
            pcall(function() track:Stop(0) end)
        end
        pcall(function()
            hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running)
        end)
    end

    --Leaked By Xlu0 AndPrime--
    _G.AdaptAnimationSystem.conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if selectedAnimationPack == "OFF" then return end
        local c = LP.Character
        if c then
            _G.AdaptAnimApplyPack(c, selectedAnimationPack)
        end
    end)
end

function syncAnimationPackIndex()
    local found = 1
    for i, name in ipairs(AnimationPackList) do
        if name == selectedAnimationPack then
            found = i
            break
        end
    end
    AnimationPackIndex = found
end

function applyAnimationPack(packName)
    selectedAnimationPack = packName or "OFF"
    syncAnimationPackIndex()

    if selectedAnimationPack == "OFF" then
        _G.AdaptAnimStop()
    else
        _G.AdaptAnimStart(selectedAnimationPack)
    end

    if refreshAnimationPackRow then
        pcall(refreshAnimationPackRow)
    end
end

--Leaked By Xlu0 AndPrime--
-- ===== UNWALK V1 / V2 =====
-- V1 = Lonely: stop all tracks + disable Animate + Heartbeat enforcement.
-- V2 = Vynx: keep Animate alive, but replace Walk/Run with the Vynx IDs.
local _LonelyUnwalkLoopConnection = nil
local _LonelyUnwalkCharacterConnection = nil

local function _LonelyUnwalkKillAllAnimations(char)
    if not char then return end
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum then return end
    local animator = hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
    if animator then
        for _, track in pairs(animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
            pcall(function() track:Stop() end)
        end
    end
    local animate = char:FindFirstChild("Animate")
    if animate and animate:IsA("LocalScript") then
        animate.Disabled = true
    end
    if hum:GetState() ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running then
        pcall(function() hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running) end)
    end
end

local function _LonelyUnwalkRestoreAnimations(char)
    if not char then return end
    local animate = char:FindFirstChild("Animate")
    if animate and animate:IsA("LocalScript") then
        animate.Disabled = false
    end
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if hum then
        task.wait()
        pcall(function() hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp) end)
    end
end

local function _LonelyUnwalkWaitForVynxAnimate(char)
    if not char then return nil end
    for _ = 1, 40 do
        local animate = char:FindFirstChild("Animate")
        if animate and animate:FindFirstChild("idle")
            and animate:FindFirstChild("run")
            and animate:FindFirstChild("walk") then
            return animate
        end
        task.wait(0.1)
    end
    return nil
end

local function _LonelyUnwalkVynxSetAnim(animObj, id)
    if animObj and id then
        pcall(function()
            animObj.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://" .. tostring(id)
        end)
    end
end

local function _LonelyUnwalkVynxApply(char)
    if not char then return end
    local animate = _LonelyUnwalkWaitForVynxAnimate(char)
    if not animate then return end
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum then return end

    -- Full Vynx V2 logic: stop current tracks, then set only Walk/Run.
    for _, track in ipairs(hum:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
        pcall(function() track:Stop(0) end)
    end

    local walkObj = animate:FindFirstChild("walk")
    local runObj = animate:FindFirstChild("run")
    if walkObj then
        local a = walkObj:FindFirstChild("WalkAnim")
        if not a then
            a = Instance.new("Animation")
            a.Name = "WalkAnim"
            a.Parent = walkObj
        end
        _LonelyUnwalkVynxSetAnim(a, 180436148)
    end
    if runObj then
        local a = runObj:FindFirstChild("RunAnim")
        if not a then
            a = Instance.new("Animation")
            a.Name = "RunAnim"
            a.Parent = runObj
        end
        _LonelyUnwalkVynxSetAnim(a, 180426354)
    end
end

local function _LonelyUnwalkStartLoop()
    if _LonelyUnwalkLoopConnection then return end
    -- V2 does not need the V1 freeze loop; Animate must remain enabled.
    if unwalkVersion == "V2" then
        local char = LP.Character
        if char then _LonelyUnwalkVynxApply(char) end
        return
    end

    _LonelyUnwalkLoopConnection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not unwalkEnabled or unwalkVersion ~= "V1" then return end
        local char = LP.Character
        if not char then return end
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not hum then return end
        local hasAnim = false
        local animator = hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
        if animator then
            local tracks = animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()
            if #tracks > 0 then
                hasAnim = true
                for _, t in pairs(tracks) do pcall(function() t:Stop() end) end
            end
        end
        local animate = char:FindFirstChild("Animate")
        if animate and animate:IsA("LocalScript") and not animate.Disabled then
            animate.Disabled = true
            hasAnim = true
        end
        if hasAnim then
            pcall(function() hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running) end)
        end
    end)
end

local function _LonelyUnwalkStopLoop()
    if _LonelyUnwalkLoopConnection then
        pcall(function() _LonelyUnwalkLoopConnection:Disconnect() end)
        _LonelyUnwalkLoopConnection = nil
    end
end

local function _LonelyUnwalkApplyCurrent(char)
    if not char or not unwalkEnabled then return end
    if unwalkVersion == "V2" then
        -- V2 = Vynx logic: Animate ON, custom Walk/Run.
        local animate = char:FindFirstChild("Animate")
        if animate and animate:IsA("LocalScript") then animate.Disabled = false end
        _LonelyUnwalkVynxApply(char)
    else
        -- V1 = original Lonely logic.
        _LonelyUnwalkKillAllAnimations(char)
        _LonelyUnwalkStartLoop()
    end
end

enableUnwalk = function()
    if unwalkEnabled then
        _LonelyUnwalkStopLoop()
        _LonelyUnwalkApplyCurrent(LP.Character)
        return
    end
    unwalkEnabled = true
    _LonelyUnwalkStopLoop()
    _LonelyUnwalkApplyCurrent(LP.Character)
end

disableUnwalk = function()
    unwalkEnabled = false
    _LonelyUnwalkStopLoop()
    local char = LP.Character
    if char then _LonelyUnwalkRestoreAnimations(char) end
end

setUnwalkVersion = function(version)
    version = tostring(version or "V1")
    if version ~= "V2" then version = "V1" end
    unwalkVersion = version
    if unwalkEnabled then
        _LonelyUnwalkStopLoop()
        _LonelyUnwalkApplyCurrent(LP.Character)
    end
    pcall(saveAdaptConfig)
end

if _LonelyUnwalkCharacterConnection then
    pcall(function() _LonelyUnwalkCharacterConnection:Disconnect() end)
end
_LonelyUnwalkCharacterConnection = LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
    pcall(function() if _G._AdaptWaitCharReady then _G._AdaptWaitCharReady(char, 10) end end)
    pcall(function() char:WaitForChild("Animate", 3) end)
    task.defer(function()
        if unwalkEnabled then
            _LonelyUnwalkStopLoop()
            _LonelyUnwalkApplyCurrent(char)
        else
            _LonelyUnwalkRestoreAnimations(char)
        end
    end)
end)

_G.AmbitiousStopUnwalk = _G.AdaptStopUnwalk

-- VX7 Anti Ragdoll V1 / V2 FULL CORE
-- Replaced the previous La Peak Anti Ragdoll implementation.
_G.AdaptAntiRagdollMode = (_G.AdaptAntiRagdollMode == "V2") and "V2" or "V1"
_G.__LaPeakVX7AR = _G.__LaPeakVX7AR or {
    conn = nil,
    character = nil,
    humanoid = nil,
    root = nil,
    lastFalling = nil,
}

local function _vx7ARCacheCharacter()
    local char = LP.Character
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not char or not hum or not root then
        return false
    end
    local S = _G.__LaPeakVX7AR
    S.character, S.humanoid, S.root = char, hum, root
    pcall(function()
        if workspace.CurrentCamera then
            workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject = hum
        end
    end)
    return true
end

local function _vx7ARIsRagdolled()
    local S = _G.__LaPeakVX7AR
    local hum = S.humanoid
    if not hum or not hum.Parent then
        return false
    end
    local state = hum:GetState()
    if state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics
        or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll
        or hum.PlatformStand then
        S.lastFalling = nil
        return true
    end
    if state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown then
        S.lastFalling = S.lastFalling or os.clock()
        return os.clock() - S.lastFalling >= 0.18
    end
    S.lastFalling = nil
    local et = LP:GetAttribute("RagdollEndTime")
    return et ~= nil and (et - workspace:GetServerTimeNow()) > 0
end

local function _vx7ARRemoveConstraints()
    local char = _G.__LaPeakVX7AR.character
    if not char then return end
    for _, descendant in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
        if descendant:IsA("BallSocketConstraint")
            or (descendant:IsA("Attachment") and descendant.Name:find("RagdollAttachment")) then
            pcall(function() descendant:Destroy() end)
        end
    end
end

local function _vx7ARForceExit()
    local S = _G.__LaPeakVX7AR
    local hum, root = S.humanoid, S.root
    if not hum or not root or not hum.Parent or not root.Parent then return end
    local batTpEnabled = false
    pcall(function()
        batTpEnabled = Config and (Config.batTpEnabled or Config._smartBatTpDriving) or false
    end)
    pcall(function()
        LP:SetAttribute("RagdollEndTime", workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
    end)
    if hum.Health > 0 then
        pcall(function() hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running) end)
    end
    root.Anchored = false
    if not batTpEnabled then
        root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
        root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
        if Config and Config._vxSyncSpoof then
            pcall(Config._vxSyncSpoof, Vector3.zero)
        end
    end
    if not batTpEnabled and not (Config and Config.batAimbotToggled) then
        pcall(function()
            root.CFrame = CFrame.new(root.Position) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(root.Orientation.Y), 0)
        end)
    end
    pcall(function()
        if workspace.CurrentCamera then workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject = hum end
    end)
end

local function _vx7ARRecoverV2()
    local S = _G.__LaPeakVX7AR
    local char, hum, root = S.character, S.humanoid, S.root
    if not char or not hum or not root then return end
    pcall(function()
        hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
        root.Velocity = Vector3.zero
        root.RotVelocity = Vector3.zero
        root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
        root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
        for _, descendant in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
            if descendant:IsA("Motor6D") or descendant:IsA("Constraint") then
                descendant.Enabled = true
            end
        end
        if workspace.CurrentCamera then workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject = hum end
        local playerScripts = LP:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts")
        local playerModule = playerScripts and playerScripts:FindFirstChild("PlayerModule")
        local controlModule = playerModule and playerModule:FindFirstChild("ControlModule")
        if controlModule then
            local ok, module = pcall(require, controlModule)
            if ok and module and module.Enable then pcall(module.Enable, module) end
        end
        hum.AutoRotate = true
        hum.PlatformStand = false
        hum.Sit = false
    end)
end

local function _vx7ARStartV1()
    local S = _G.__LaPeakVX7AR
    if S.conn and S.conn.Connected then return end
    if S.conn then pcall(function() S.conn:Disconnect() end); S.conn = nil end
    if not _vx7ARCacheCharacter() then return end
    S.conn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not antiRagdollEnabled or _G.AdaptAntiRagdollMode ~= "V1" then return end
        if Config and Config._instaResetInProgress then return end
        if not S.humanoid or not S.humanoid.Parent or not S.root or not S.root.Parent then
            _vx7ARCacheCharacter()
            return
        end
        if _vx7ARIsRagdolled() then
            _vx7ARRemoveConstraints()
            _vx7ARForceExit()
        end
    end)
end

local function _vx7ARStartV2()
    local S = _G.__LaPeakVX7AR
    if S.conn and S.conn.Connected then return end
    if S.conn then pcall(function() S.conn:Disconnect() end); S.conn = nil end
    if not _vx7ARCacheCharacter() then return end
    S.conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not antiRagdollEnabled or _G.AdaptAntiRagdollMode ~= "V2" then return end
        if Config and Config._instaResetInProgress then return end
        local char = LP.Character
        if not char then return end
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hum or not root or hum.Health <= 0 then return end
        if _G.dropActive then return end
        local state = hum:GetState()
        if state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics
            or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll
            or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown then
            local now = os.clock()
            local S2 = _G.__LaPeakVX7AR
            if state ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown or now - (S2.lastFalling or now) >= 0.15 then
                S2.lastFalling = now
                pcall(function()
                    hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
                    root.Velocity = Vector3.zero
                    root.RotVelocity = Vector3.zero
                    root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                    root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                    for _, descendant in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
                        if descendant:IsA("Motor6D") or descendant:IsA("Constraint") then
                            descendant.Enabled = true
                        end
                    end
                    if workspace.CurrentCamera then workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject = hum end
                    local playerScripts = LP:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts")
                    local playerModule = playerScripts and playerScripts:FindFirstChild("PlayerModule")
                    local controlModule = playerModule and playerModule:FindFirstChild("ControlModule")
                    if controlModule then
                        local ok, module = pcall(require, controlModule)
                        if ok and module and module.Enable then pcall(module.Enable, module) end
                    end
                    hum.AutoRotate = true
                    hum.PlatformStand = false
                    hum.Sit = false
                end)
            end
        end
    end)
end

local function startAntiRagdoll()
    antiRagdollEnabled = true
    local S = _G.__LaPeakVX7AR
    if S.conn then pcall(function() S.conn:Disconnect() end); S.conn = nil end
    if _G.AdaptAntiRagdollMode == "V2" then
        _vx7ARStartV2()
    else
        _vx7ARStartV1()
    end
end

local function stopAntiRagdoll()
    antiRagdollEnabled = false
    local S = _G.__LaPeakVX7AR
    if S.conn then pcall(function() S.conn:Disconnect() end); S.conn = nil end
    S.character, S.humanoid, S.root, S.lastFalling = nil, nil, nil, nil
end

local function setAntiRagdoll(on)
    antiRagdollEnabled = on == true
    if antiRagdollEnabled then startAntiRagdoll() else stopAntiRagdoll() end
    if type(saveAdaptConfig) == "function" then
        task.defer(function() pcall(saveAdaptConfig) end)
    elseif type(saveConfig) == "function" then
        task.defer(function() pcall(saveConfig) end)
    end
end

-- Keep Anti Ragdoll alive across respawns and transient runtime disconnects.
local _adaptAntiRagdollCharacterConn
local _adaptAntiRagdollWatchdogStarted = false
local function _adaptAntiRagdollRuntimeAlive()
    if not antiRagdollEnabled then return true end
    local S = _G.__LaPeakVX7AR
    return S and S.conn and S.conn.Connected == true
end

if not _adaptAntiRagdollCharacterConn then
    _adaptAntiRagdollCharacterConn = LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
        if not antiRagdollEnabled then return end
        task.delay(0.35, function()
            if antiRagdollEnabled then
                pcall(startAntiRagdoll)
                if setAntiRagdollVisual then
                    pcall(setAntiRagdollVisual, true)
                end
            end
        end)
    end)
end

if not _adaptAntiRagdollWatchdogStarted then
    _adaptAntiRagdollWatchdogStarted = true
    task.spawn(function()
        while task.wait(0.25) do
            if antiRagdollEnabled and not _adaptAntiRagdollRuntimeAlive() then
                pcall(startAntiRagdoll)
            end
            if antiRagdollEnabled and setAntiRagdollVisual then
                pcall(setAntiRagdollVisual, true)
            end
        end
    end)
end

_G.AdaptInfJumpMode = (_G.AdaptInfJumpMode == "Hold") and "Hold" or "Tap"

-- BUBBLE FULL INFINITE JUMP CORE.
-- Tap = Bubble manual input path; Hold = Bubble continuous held-input path.
-- Uses the original Bubble timing/velocity behavior (55 Y velocity / 0.08s gate / 0.14s manual lock).
local InfiniteJump = {
    enabled = false,
    mode = (_G.AdaptInfJumpMode == "Hold") and "hold" or "manual",
    jumpPower = 55,
    conn = nil,
    lastJumpTime = 0,
    manualLock = false,
    characterConn = nil,
    inputConn = nil,
}

local function bubbleInfJumpSuppressed()
    return false
end

local function bubbleManualJump()
    if not InfiniteJump.enabled then return end
    if InfiniteJump.mode ~= "manual" or InfiniteJump.manualLock then return end

    InfiniteJump.manualLock = true
    local char = LP.Character
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hum or not root then
        InfiniteJump.manualLock = false
        return
    end

    local now = tick()
    if now - InfiniteJump.lastJumpTime < 0.08 then
        InfiniteJump.manualLock = false
        return
    end

    InfiniteJump.lastJumpTime = now
    local velocity = root.Velocity
    root.Velocity = Vector3.new(velocity.X, 55, velocity.Z)

    task.delay(0.14, function()
        InfiniteJump.manualLock = false
    end)
end

-- Bubble keeps one persistent input path for Tap/manual mode and also uses it to reset
-- the hold timer. It supports keyboard Space and controller ButtonA.
if not InfiniteJump.inputConn then
    InfiniteJump.inputConn = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
        if gameProcessed then return end
        if input.KeyCode ~= Enum.KeyCode.Space and input.KeyCode ~= Enum.KeyCode.ButtonA then
            return
        end

        if InfiniteJump.mode == "manual" then
            bubbleManualJump()
            return
        end

        if not bubbleInfJumpSuppressed() then
            InfiniteJump.lastJumpTime = tick() - 0.08
        end
    end)
end

local function startBubbleHoldInfJump()
    if InfiniteJump.conn then
        InfiniteJump.conn:Disconnect()
        InfiniteJump.conn = nil
    end

    InfiniteJump.conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not InfiniteJump.enabled then return end
        if InfiniteJump.mode ~= "hold" then return end
        if bubbleInfJumpSuppressed() then return end

        pcall(function()
            local char = LP.Character
            if not char then return end
            local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if not hum then return end
            local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not root then return end

            local now = tick()
            if (UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space)
                or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.ButtonA)
                or hum.Jump == true)
                and now - InfiniteJump.lastJumpTime >= 0.08 then

                InfiniteJump.lastJumpTime = now
                local velocity = root.Velocity
                root.Velocity = Vector3.new(velocity.X, 55, velocity.Z)
            end
        end)
    end)
end

local function stopBubbleHoldInfJump()
    if InfiniteJump.conn then
        InfiniteJump.conn:Disconnect()
        InfiniteJump.conn = nil
    end
end

_G.AdaptStopNormalInfJumpHoldState = stopBubbleHoldInfJump

function InfiniteJump.start()
    InfiniteJump.enabled = true
    InfiniteJump.manualLock = false
    if InfiniteJump.mode == "hold" then
        startBubbleHoldInfJump()
    else
        stopBubbleHoldInfJump()
    end
end

function InfiniteJump.stop()
    InfiniteJump.enabled = false
    InfiniteJump.manualLock = false
    stopBubbleHoldInfJump()
end

function InfiniteJump.setJumpPower(power)
    -- Bubble uses a fixed Y velocity of 55; retain the field for compatibility.
    InfiniteJump.jumpPower = 55
end

function InfiniteJump.setMode(mode)
    InfiniteJump.mode = (mode == "manual" or mode == "Tap") and "manual" or "hold"
    _G.AdaptInfJumpMode = InfiniteJump.mode == "hold" and "Hold" or "Tap"

    if InfiniteJump.enabled then
        if InfiniteJump.mode == "hold" then
            startBubbleHoldInfJump()
        else
            stopBubbleHoldInfJump()
        end
    end
end

function InfiniteJump.isRunning()
    return InfiniteJump.enabled == true
end

setInfJumpInternal = function(on)
    infJumpEnabled = on == true
    if infJumpEnabled then
        InfiniteJump.start()
    else
        InfiniteJump.stop()
    end
end

InfiniteJump.characterConn = LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    if not InfiniteJump.enabled then return end
    if InfiniteJump.mode ~= "hold" then return end
    task.wait(0.5)
    if not InfiniteJump.enabled or InfiniteJump.mode ~= "hold" then return end
    stopBubbleHoldInfJump()
    startBubbleHoldInfJump()
end)

InfiniteJump.stop()



_G.AdaptAntiResetEnabled = _G.AdaptAntiResetEnabled == true

-- ============================================================
-- ANTI DIE (full god-mode from Green Duels V3)
-- SetStateEnabled Dead false + heal on HealthChanged + death
-- revival via Died event + BreakJoints=false hook
-- ============================================================
_G.AdaptAntiDie = { enabled = false, conns = {} }

function _G.AdaptApplyAntiReset()
    pcall(function()
        StarterGui:SetCore("ResetButtonCallback", false)
    end)
end

function _G.AdaptRestoreReset()
    pcall(function()
        StarterGui:SetCore("ResetButtonCallback", true)
    end)
end

local function adaptApplyGodMode(character)
    if not character or not character.Parent then return end
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
    if not humanoid then return end

    -- Weekly Anti Die: keep the humanoid alive while the feature is active.
    pcall(function()
        humanoid.MaxHealth = math.huge
        humanoid.Health = math.huge
        humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead, false)
    end)

    local healConn
    healConn = humanoid:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Health"):Connect(function()
        if not _G.AdaptAntiDie.enabled then return end
        if humanoid.Health < humanoid.MaxHealth then
            humanoid.Health = humanoid.MaxHealth
        end
    end)
    table.insert(_G.AdaptAntiDie.conns, healConn)

    local deathConn
    deathConn = humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
        if not _G.AdaptAntiDie.enabled then return end
        deathConn:Disconnect()
        task.wait(0.05)
        if humanoid and humanoid.Parent then
            humanoid.Health = humanoid.MaxHealth
            humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running)
            deathConn = humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
                if not _G.AdaptAntiDie.enabled then return end
                task.wait(0.05)
                if humanoid and humanoid.Parent then
                    humanoid.Health = humanoid.MaxHealth
                    humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running)
                end
            end)
        end
    end)
    table.insert(_G.AdaptAntiDie.conns, deathConn)

    local breakConn
    pcall(function()
        breakConn = character:GetPropertyChangedSignal("BreakJoints"):Connect(function()
            if not _G.AdaptAntiDie.enabled then return end
            if character.BreakJoints then character.BreakJoints = false end
        end)
    end)
    if breakConn then table.insert(_G.AdaptAntiDie.conns, breakConn) end
end

function _G.AdaptHookAntiDieCharacter(char)
    if not _G.AdaptAntiDie.enabled then return end
    adaptApplyGodMode(char)
end

function _G.AdaptSetAntiReset(on)
    _G.AdaptAntiResetEnabled = on == true
    _G.AdaptAntiDie.enabled = on == true

    if _G.AdaptAntiResetEnabled then
        --Leaked By Xlu0 AndPrime--
        task.spawn(function()
            for _ = 1, 12 do
                if not _G.AdaptAntiResetEnabled then return end
                _G.AdaptApplyAntiReset()
                task.wait(0.25)
            end
        end)

        for _, c in ipairs(_G.AdaptAntiDie.conns) do
            pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end)
        end
        _G.AdaptAntiDie.conns = {}

        if LP.Character then
            task.spawn(function()
                task.wait(0.1)
                adaptApplyGodMode(LP.Character)
            end)
        end
    else
        for _, c in ipairs(_G.AdaptAntiDie.conns) do
            pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end)
        end
        _G.AdaptAntiDie.conns = {}

        -- Fully restore normal reset/death behavior when Anti Die is disabled.
        pcall(function()
            local char = LP.Character
            local humanoid = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if humanoid then
                humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead, true)
                humanoid.MaxHealth = 100
                humanoid.Health = math.min(humanoid.Health, 100)
            end
        end)
        _G.AdaptRestoreReset()
    end
end

--Leaked By Xlu0 AndPrime--
if _G.AdaptAntiDieCharConn then
    pcall(function() _G.AdaptAntiDieCharConn:Disconnect() end)
end
_G.AdaptAntiDieCharConn = LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
    task.wait(0.3)
    if _G.AdaptAntiDie.enabled then
        adaptApplyGodMode(char)
    end

    if _G.AdaptRestoreAntiDieAfterReset then
        _G.AdaptRestoreAntiDieAfterReset = false
        task.wait(0.35)
        _G.AdaptSetAntiReset(true)
        if _G.AdaptAntiResetVisual then
            pcall(function() _G.AdaptAntiResetVisual(true) end)
        end
        if saveAdaptConfig then pcall(saveAdaptConfig) end
    end
end)

if LP.Character and _G.AdaptAntiResetEnabled then
    task.defer(function()
        _G.AdaptAntiDie.enabled = true
        adaptApplyGodMode(LP.Character)
    end)
end


_G.AdaptHeadlessEnabled = _G.AdaptHeadlessEnabled == true
_G.AdaptKorbloxEnabled = _G.AdaptKorbloxEnabled == true
_G.AdaptHeadlessMeshId = "rbxassetid://1095708"
_G.AdaptKorbloxMeshId = "rbxassetid://101851696"
_G.AdaptKorbloxTextureId = "rbxassetid://101851254"

function _G.AdaptApplyHeadless(char, enabled)
    if not char then return end
    local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
    if not head then return end

    if enabled then
        head.Transparency = 1
        head.CanCollide = false
        local face = head:FindFirstChild("face")
        if face then face:Destroy() end

        local old = head:FindFirstChild("AdaptHeadlessMesh")
        if old then old:Destroy() end

        local mesh = Instance.new("SpecialMesh")
        mesh.Name = "AdaptHeadlessMesh"
        mesh.MeshType = Enum.MeshType.FileMesh
        mesh.MeshId = _G.AdaptHeadlessMeshId
        mesh.Scale = Vector3.new(0.001, 0.001, 0.001)
        mesh.Parent = head
    else
        head.Transparency = 0
        head.CanCollide = true
        local old = head:FindFirstChild("AdaptHeadlessMesh")
        if old then old:Destroy() end
    end
end

function _G.AdaptApplyKorblox(char, enabled)
    if not char then return end
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum then return end

    if hum.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6 then
        local leg = char:FindFirstChild("Right Leg")
        if not leg then return end

        local old = leg:FindFirstChild("AdaptKorbloxMesh")
        if old then old:Destroy() end

        if enabled then
            leg.Color = Color3.fromRGB(64,64,64)
            local mesh = Instance.new("SpecialMesh")
            mesh.Name = "AdaptKorbloxMesh"
            mesh.MeshType = Enum.MeshType.FileMesh
            mesh.MeshId = _G.AdaptKorbloxMeshId
            mesh.TextureId = _G.AdaptKorbloxTextureId
            mesh.Scale = Vector3.new(1,1,1)
            mesh.Parent = leg
        else
            leg.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
        end
    else
        local upper = char:FindFirstChild("RightUpperLeg")
        local lower = char:FindFirstChild("RightLowerLeg")
        local foot = char:FindFirstChild("RightFoot")
        if not upper then return end

        local oldLeg = char:FindFirstChild("AdaptKorbloxLeg")
        if oldLeg then oldLeg:Destroy() end

        if enabled then
            upper.Transparency = 1
            if lower then lower.Transparency = 1 end
            if foot then foot.Transparency = 1 end

            local kleg = Instance.new("Part")
            kleg.Name = "AdaptKorbloxLeg"
            kleg.Size = Vector3.new(1,2,1)
            kleg.Anchored = false
            kleg.CanCollide = false
            kleg.Massless = true
            kleg.Color = Color3.fromRGB(64,64,64)
            kleg.Parent = char

            local mesh = Instance.new("SpecialMesh")
            mesh.Name = "AdaptKorbloxMesh"
            mesh.MeshType = Enum.MeshType.FileMesh
            mesh.MeshId = _G.AdaptKorbloxMeshId
            mesh.TextureId = _G.AdaptKorbloxTextureId
            mesh.Scale = Vector3.new(1,1,1)
            mesh.Parent = kleg

            local weld = Instance.new("Weld")
            weld.Name = "AdaptKorbloxWeld"
            weld.Part0 = upper
            weld.Part1 = kleg
            weld.C0 = CFrame.new(0,-0.8,0)
            weld.Parent = kleg
        else
            upper.Transparency = 0
            if lower then lower.Transparency = 0 end
            if foot then foot.Transparency = 0 end
        end
    end
end

function _G.AdaptApplyCharacterVisuals(char)
    char = char or LP.Character
    if not char then return end
    pcall(function() _G.AdaptApplyHeadless(char, _G.AdaptHeadlessEnabled) end)
    pcall(function() _G.AdaptApplyKorblox(char, _G.AdaptKorbloxEnabled) end)
end

selectedMusicSong = selectedMusicSong or 1

-- Velocita' di riproduzione: 1 = normale, passo 0.1, da 0.1 a 2.
musicPlayerSpeed = musicPlayerSpeed or 1
musicAutoPlayNext = musicAutoPlayNext == true
musicShuffleEnabled = musicShuffleEnabled == true
musicLoopEnabled = musicLoopEnabled == true

musicSongDownloading = musicSongDownloading or {}
-- Revisioni gia' ripulite in questa esecuzione, per non ricontrollare
-- il disco a ogni canzone caricata.

_G.AmbitiousMusicCloseUI = nil

function getMusicSongName()
  local opt = MUSIC_PLAYER_OPTIONS[selectedMusicSong]
  return opt and opt.name or "No Song"
end

-- Indice casuale garantito diverso da quello corrente
function musicRandomIndex()
  local total = #MUSIC_PLAYER_OPTIONS
  if total <= 1 then return 1 end
  local r = math.random(1, total - 1)
  if r >= selectedMusicSong then r = r + 1 end
  return r
end

function _musicRefreshUI()
  if _G.AmbitiousMusicRefreshUI then pcall(_G.AmbitiousMusicRefreshUI) end
end

function cacheMusicSong(option, allowDownload)
  if not option or not option.url or option.url == "" then return nil end
  if not (writefile and getcustomasset) then return nil end
  local baseName = option.file or ("AmbitiousHubMusic_" .. tostring(option.name or "song") .. ".mp3")
  -- REVISIONE DEL FILE.
  -- Se cambia il link di una canzone, chi ha gia' scaricato la vecchia se
  -- la ritrova in cache per sempre: il nome del file e' lo stesso e non c'e'
  -- modo di accorgersi che il contenuto non e' piu' quello giusto.
  -- Invece di storpiare il nome (o di scrivere una cancellazione una-tantum
  -- per quella singola canzone, che resterebbe li' come codice morto), la
  -- voce porta un campo "rev": alzarlo di 1 basta e avanza.
  --   rev assente o 1 -> AmbitiousHubMusic45.mp3
  --   rev = 2         -> AmbitiousHubMusic45_r2.mp3
  -- La prima volta che si tocca una canzone con rev > 1 si cancellano dal
  -- disco tutte le revisioni precedenti, quindi non si accumula niente.
  -- E' generico: la prossima volta che cambi un link non serve altro codice.
  local rev = math.max(math.floor(tonumber(option.rev) or 1), 1)
  local stem = baseName:gsub("%.mp3$", "")
  local fileName = (rev > 1) and (stem .. "_r" .. rev .. ".mp3") or baseName

  if rev > 1 and not musicRevCleaned[baseName] then
    musicRevCleaned[baseName] = true
    for r = 1, rev - 1 do
      local oldName = (r > 1) and (stem .. "_r" .. r .. ".mp3") or baseName
      musicSongCache[oldName] = nil
      pcall(function()
        if isfile and isfile(oldName) and delfile then delfile(oldName) end
      end)
    end
  end
  local function loadExisting()
    if musicSongCache[fileName] then return musicSongCache[fileName] end
    local hasFile = false
    pcall(function() hasFile = isfile and isfile(fileName) end)
    if hasFile then
      local ok = pcall(function() musicSongCache[fileName] = getcustomasset(fileName) end)
      if ok and musicSongCache[fileName] then return musicSongCache[fileName] end
    end
    return nil
  end
  local cached = loadExisting()
  if cached then return cached end
  if allowDownload == false then return nil end
  if musicSongDownloading[fileName] then
    local waitStart = tick()
    while musicSongDownloading[fileName] and tick() - waitStart < 15 do task.wait(0.05) end
    cached = loadExisting()
    if cached then return cached end
  end
  musicSongDownloading[fileName] = true
  local ok = pcall(function()
    local data = game:HttpGet(option.url)
    if data and #data > 0 then
      writefile(fileName, data)
      musicSongCache[fileName] = getcustomasset(fileName)
    end
  end)
  musicSongDownloading[fileName] = nil
  if ok and musicSongCache[fileName] then return musicSongCache[fileName] end
  return loadExisting()
end

function createMusicSound(option, name)
  if not option then return nil end
  local soundId = cacheMusicSong(option, true)
  if not soundId then return nil end
  local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
  sound.Name = name or "AmbitiousHubMusicPlayer"
  sound.Volume = musicPlayerVolume
  sound.PlaybackSpeed = musicPlayerSpeed
  sound.Looped = false
  sound.SoundId = soundId
  sound.Parent = SoundService
  return sound
end

-- Fade away identico a quello dell'intro
function fadeOutMusicSound(sound, dur)
  if not sound then return end
  dur = dur or 1.5
  pcall(function()
    TweenService:Create(sound, TweenInfo.new(dur, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {Volume = 0}):Play()
  end)
  task.delay(dur + 0.1, function()
    pcall(function()
      if sound and sound.Parent then
        sound:Stop()
        sound:Destroy()
      end
    end)
  end)
end

function stopMusicPlayback(fade)
  _musicPlayerToken = _musicPlayerToken + 1
  local sound = _musicPlayerSound
  _musicPlayerSound = nil
  if sound then
    if fade == false then
      pcall(function() sound:Stop(); sound:Destroy() end)
    else
      fadeOutMusicSound(sound, 1.5)
    end
  end
  _musicRefreshUI()
end

function playMusicSong(index)
  index = tonumber(index) or selectedMusicSong
  local total = #MUSIC_PLAYER_OPTIONS
  if total <= 0 then return end
  if index < 1 then index = total end
  if index > total then index = 1 end
  if not MUSIC_PLAYER_OPTIONS[index] then return end
  selectedMusicSong = index
  stopMusicPlayback(true)
  local token = _musicPlayerToken
  _musicRefreshUI()
  task.spawn(function()
    local option = MUSIC_PLAYER_OPTIONS[index]
    local sound = createMusicSound(option, "AmbitiousHubMusicPlayer_" .. tostring(token))
    if token ~= _musicPlayerToken then
      if sound then pcall(function() sound:Destroy() end) end
      return
    end
    if not sound then warn("[Lonely] SONG FAILED"); return end
    sound.Volume = musicPlayerVolume
    sound.PlaybackSpeed = musicPlayerSpeed
    sound.TimePosition = 0
    _musicPlayerSound = sound
    local loadStart = tick()
    while sound and sound.Parent and not sound.IsLoaded and tick() - loadStart < 15 do task.wait(0.05) end
    if token ~= _musicPlayerToken then
      pcall(function() if sound and sound.Parent then sound:Destroy() end end)
      return
    end
    pcall(function() sound:Play() end)
    _musicRefreshUI()

    local endedConn
    endedConn = sound.Ended:Connect(function()
      if endedConn then pcall(function() endedConn:Disconnect() end) end
      if token ~= _musicPlayerToken then return end
      if musicLoopEnabled then
        playMusicSong(selectedMusicSong)
      elseif musicShuffleEnabled then
        playMusicSong(musicRandomIndex())
      elseif musicAutoPlayNext then
        playMusicSong(selectedMusicSong + 1)
      else
        stopMusicPlayback(false)
      end
    end)

    -- Fade away sul finale della traccia (come l'intro)
    task.spawn(function()
      while token == _musicPlayerToken and sound and sound.Parent do
        local len = sound.TimeLength
        if len and len > 1 then
          local remaining = len - sound.TimePosition
          if remaining <= 1.6 and sound.IsPlaying and sound:GetAttribute("_amFaded") ~= true then
            sound:SetAttribute("_amFaded", true)
            local d = math.clamp(remaining - 0.05, 0.2, 1.5)
            pcall(function()
              TweenService:Create(sound, TweenInfo.new(d, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {Volume = 0}):Play()
            end)
          end
        end
        task.wait(0.1)
      end
    end)
  end)
end

function toggleMusicPause()
  local sound = _musicPlayerSound
  if not sound or not sound.Parent then
    playMusicSong(selectedMusicSong)
    return
  end
  if sound.IsPlaying then
    pcall(function() sound:Pause() end)
  else
    pcall(function() sound:Resume() end)
  end
  _musicRefreshUI()
end

function musicNextSong()
  -- Nút > luôn chuyển đúng 1 bài kế tiếp; Shuffle chỉ áp dụng khi
  -- Auto Play Next tự chuyển bài sau khi bài hiện tại kết thúc.
  playMusicSong(selectedMusicSong + 1)
  saveAmbitiousConfig()
end

function musicPrevSong()
  -- Nút < luôn chuyển đúng 1 bài trước đó, không random.
  playMusicSong(selectedMusicSong - 1)
  saveAmbitiousConfig()
end

function musicSeek(delta)
  local sound = _musicPlayerSound
  if not sound or not sound.Parent then return end
  local len = sound.TimeLength or 0
  -- Il delta arriva in secondi "di ascolto": va convertito in secondi di
  -- traccia, altrimenti a 2x un salto di 10s ne farebbe 10 sul display ma
  -- 10 sulla traccia, cioe' 5 percepiti.
  local sp = tonumber(musicPlayerSpeed) or 1
  if sp <= 0 then sp = 1 end
  local newPos = sound.TimePosition + ((tonumber(delta) or 0) * sp)
  if newPos < 0 then newPos = 0 end
  if len > 0 and newPos > (len - 0.2) then newPos = math.max(len - 0.2, 0) end
  pcall(function() sound.TimePosition = newPos end)
  if len > 0 and (len - newPos) > 1.8 then
    pcall(function()
      sound:SetAttribute("_amFaded", false)
      sound.Volume = musicPlayerVolume
    end)
  end
  _musicRefreshUI()
end

-- Velocita': stesso schema del volume. Si arrotonda al decimo cosi' i
-- click di < e > non accumulano errore in virgola mobile (0.1 + 0.2 ...).
function setMusicSpeed(v)
  v = math.clamp(math.floor((tonumber(v) or 1) * 10 + 0.5) / 10, 0.1, 2)
  musicPlayerSpeed = v
  local sound = _musicPlayerSound
  if sound and sound.Parent then
    pcall(function() sound.PlaybackSpeed = v end)
  end
  if saveAmbitiousConfig then pcall(saveAmbitiousConfig) end
  _musicRefreshUI()
end

function setMusicVolume(v)
  v = math.clamp(math.floor((tonumber(v) or 1) * 100 + 0.5) / 100, 0, 2)
  musicPlayerVolume = v
  local sound = _musicPlayerSound
  if sound and sound.Parent and sound:GetAttribute("_amFaded") ~= true then
    pcall(function() sound.Volume = v end)
  end
  if saveAmbitiousConfig then pcall(saveAmbitiousConfig) end
  _musicRefreshUI()
end

function udim2ToTable(u)
return {xs = u.X.Scale, xo = u.X.Offset, ys = u.Y.Scale, yo = u.Y.Offset}
end
function tableToUDim2(t, fallback)
if type(t) == "table" then
return UDim2.new(tonumber(t.xs) or 0, tonumber(t.xo) or 0, tonumber(t.ys) or 0, tonumber(t.yo) or 0)
end
return fallback
end
function collectAdaptMobileButtonPositions()
local out = {}
for key, entry in pairs(_G.AdaptMobileButtonRefs or {}) do
local holder = entry and entry.holder
if holder then out[key] = udim2ToTable(holder.Position) end
end
if next(out) == nil and type(_G.AdaptMobileButtonPositions) == "table" then
return _G.AdaptMobileButtonPositions
end
_G.AdaptMobileButtonPositions = out
return out
end
function getSavedMobileButtonPosition(key, fallback)
if type(_G.AdaptMobileButtonPositions) == "table" then
local t = _G.AdaptMobileButtonPositions[key]
if type(t) == "table" then
return tableToUDim2(t, fallback)
end
end
return fallback
end

-- Mobile button positions are shared across all shapes and persisted immediately on drag release, VX7-style.
-- Shape selection is persisted separately; changing shape never creates a separate position set.
function saveCurrentMobileButtonPositionsOnLock()
    local refs = _G.AdaptMobileButtonRefs or {}
    local out = {}
    for key, entry in pairs(refs) do
        -- holder is the object that actually moves; never read a stale saved value.
        local frame = entry and (entry.holder or entry.frame)
        if frame and frame.Parent then
            out[tostring(key)] = udim2ToTable(frame.Position)
        end
    end
    if next(out) ~= nil then
        _G.AdaptMobileButtonPositions = out
    end
    -- One atomic persistence point: Lock GUI remembers every button's current position
    -- together with the already-persisted selected mobile-button shape.
    if type(saveAdaptConfig) == "function" then pcall(saveAdaptConfig) end
end
_G.AdaptSaveMobileButtonPositionsOnLock = saveCurrentMobileButtonPositionsOnLock
function saveMobileButtonPosition(key, pos)
    if not key or not pos then return end
    -- Keep the shared live position cache updated; the mobile runtime also persists on drag release.
    _G.AdaptMobileButtonPositions = _G.AdaptMobileButtonPositions or {}
    _G.AdaptMobileButtonPositions[tostring(key)] = udim2ToTable(pos)
end
function keyToString(key)
if not key then return "None" end
return tostring(key):gsub("Enum.KeyCode.", "")
end
function stringToKeyCode(value)
if type(value) ~= "string" or value == "" or value == "None" then return nil end
return Enum.KeyCode[value]
end
function keybindsToTable()
local out = {}
for keyId in pairs(DEFAULT_SPEED_KEYBINDS) do
out[keyId] = keyToString(speedKeybinds[keyId])
end
for keyId, key in pairs(speedKeybinds) do
out[keyId] = keyToString(key)
end
return out
end
function collectAdaptKeybindConfig()
return {
keybinds = keybindsToTable(),
tpDownKeybind = keyToString(tpDownKeybind),
    tpDownMethod = _G._AmbitiousTPDownMethod or "NORMAL",
externalKeybinds = (function() local o={} for k,v in pairs(externalKeybinds) do o[k]=keyToString(v) end return o end)(),
controllerKeybinds = (function() local o={} for k,v in pairs(controllerKeybinds) do o[k]=keyToString(v) end return o end)(),
}
end
function applySavedKeybinds(t)
if type(t) ~= "table" then return end
for keyId in pairs(speedKeybinds) do
if t[keyId] ~= nil then
speedKeybinds[keyId] = stringToKeyCode(t[keyId])
end
end
end

end
tpDownKeybind = DEFAULT_TP_DOWN_KEYBIND
end

-- ===== CONFIG AUTO-SAVE / ALL SETTINGS =====
-- Performance-safe persistence. The old 0.75s polling loop is intentionally
-- disabled because re-running the script could leave multiple polling loops
-- alive and repeatedly JSON-encode the whole configuration. UI/keybind routes
-- already call saveAdaptConfig(), so persistence is now debounced instead.
canSaveConfig = false -- disables any legacy polling loop left by an older run
_G.__LaPeakConfigWriterV2 = _G.__LaPeakConfigWriterV2 or { pending = false, generation = 0 }

local function _LaPeakWriteConfigDebounced()
    local state = _G.__LaPeakConfigWriterV2
    if state.pending then return end
    state.pending = true
    state.generation = (state.generation or 0) + 1
    local generation = state.generation
    task.delay(0.35, function()
        if state.generation ~= generation then return end
        state.pending = false
        pcall(function()
            if type(_ace_writefile) ~= "function" then return end
            local cfg = collectAdaptConfig()
            local keys = collectAdaptKeybindConfig()
            _ace_writefile(CONFIG_FILE, HttpService:JSONEncode(cfg))
            _ace_writefile(KEYBINDS_CONFIG_FILE, HttpService:JSONEncode(keys))
        end)
    end)
end

saveAdaptConfig = function()
    _LaPeakWriteConfigDebounced()
end
_G.AdaptManualSaveConfig = saveAdaptConfig

for i, name in ipairs(AnimationPackList) do
if name == selectedAnimationPack then
AnimationPackIndex = i
return
end
end
selectedAnimationPack = "OFF"
AnimationPackIndex = 1
end

if not char then char = LP.Character end

local animate = char:FindFirstChild("Animate") or char:WaitForChild("Animate", 6)

task.wait(0.2)

    pcall(function() applyAnimationPack(selectedAnimationPack) end)

    task.wait(0.15)
    pcall(function()
        applyFullAnimationBundle(_G.AdaptSelectedMoreAnimationBundle)
    end)
else
    pcall(function() resetAnimations() end)
end
end
syncAnimationPackIndex()

end)

_G.AdaptAutoResetOnMed = _G.AdaptAutoResetOnMed or {}

_G.AdaptAutoResetOnMed.medTriggered = false
_G.AdaptAutoResetOnMed.lastFire = _G.AdaptAutoResetOnMed.lastFire or 0
_G.AdaptAutoResetOnMed.cooldown = 2.25
_G.AdaptAutoResetOnMed.charAddedConn = _G.AdaptAutoResetOnMed.charAddedConn

function _G.AdaptAutoResetShouldFire(part)
local state = _G.AdaptAutoResetOnMed
if not state or not state.enabled then return false end
if state.medTriggered then return false end
if tick() - (state.lastFire or 0) < (state.cooldown or 2.25) then return false end
if not part or not part.Parent then return false end
if part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Tool") or part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Accessory") then
return false
end
return part.Anchored and part.Transparency == 1
end
function _G.AdaptAutoResetFireOnce(part)
if not _G.AdaptAutoResetShouldFire(part) then return end
local state = _G.AdaptAutoResetOnMed
state.medTriggered = true
state.lastFire = tick()
task.delay(2.3, function()
if state.enabled then
end
end)
end
function _G.AdaptAutoResetOnAnchorChanged(part)
return part:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Anchored"):Connect(function()
_G.AdaptAutoResetFireOnce(part)
end)
end
function _G.AdaptStopAutoResetOnMed()
local state = _G.AdaptAutoResetOnMed
if not state then return end
for _, conn in ipairs(state.conns or {}) do
pcall(function()
conn:Disconnect()
end)
end
state.conns = {}
state.medTriggered = false
end
function _G.AdaptStartAutoResetOnMed(char)
local state = _G.AdaptAutoResetOnMed
if not state then return end
_G.AdaptStopAutoResetOnMed()
state.medTriggered = false
char = char or LP.Character
if not char then return end
for _, part in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
if part:IsA("BasePart") then
table.insert(state.conns, _G.AdaptAutoResetOnAnchorChanged(part))
_G.AdaptAutoResetFireOnce(part)
end
end
table.insert(state.conns, char.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(part)
if part:IsA("BasePart") then
table.insert(state.conns, _G.AdaptAutoResetOnAnchorChanged(part))
_G.AdaptAutoResetFireOnce(part)
end
end))
table.insert(state.conns, char.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
if not parent then
state.medTriggered = false
end
end))
end
function _G.AdaptEnableAutoResetOnMed()
autoResetOnMedEnabled = true
_G.AdaptAutoResetOnMed.enabled = true
_G.AdaptStartAutoResetOnMed(LP.Character)
end
function _G.AdaptDisableAutoResetOnMed()
autoResetOnMedEnabled = false
_G.AdaptAutoResetOnMed.enabled = false
_G.AdaptStopAutoResetOnMed()
end
function _G.AdaptSetAutoResetOnMed(state, noSave)
autoResetOnMedEnabled = state == true
if autoResetOnMedEnabled then
_G.AdaptEnableAutoResetOnMed()
else
_G.AdaptDisableAutoResetOnMed()
end
if setAutoResetOnMedVisual then
setAutoResetOnMedVisual(autoResetOnMedEnabled)
end
if not noSave and saveAdaptConfig then do end end
end

_G.AdaptSetAutoResetOnMed(true)
end
function disableAutoResetOnMed()
_G.AdaptSetAutoResetOnMed(false)
end

_G.AdaptSetAutoResetOnMed(on == true)
end

task.wait(0.25)
_G.AdaptStartAutoResetOnMed(char)
end

end
_G.AdaptCounterState = _G.AdaptCounterState or {}
_G.AdaptCounterState.batConn = nil
_G.AdaptCounterState.batDebounce = false
_G.AdaptCounterState.medConns = _G.AdaptCounterState.medConns or {}
_G.AdaptCounterState.medDebounce = false
_G.AdaptCounterState.medLastUsed = _G.AdaptCounterState.medLastUsed or 0
_G.AdaptBatCounterV2On = _G.AdaptBatCounterV2On == true
_G.AdaptBatCounterRagdollSeconds = _G.AdaptBatCounterRagdollSeconds or 2.6
