_G.AdaptMedusaCooldown = 25
function _G.AdaptFindMedusa()
local c = LP.Character
if not c then return nil end
for _, t in ipairs(c:GetChildren()) do
if t:IsA("Tool") then
local n = t.Name:lower()
if n:find("medusa") or n:find("head") or n:find("stone") then return t end
end
end
local bp = LP:FindFirstChild("Backpack") or LP:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
if bp then
for _, t in ipairs(bp:GetChildren()) do
if t:IsA("Tool") then
local n = t.Name:lower()
if n:find("medusa") or n:find("head") or n:find("stone") then return t end
end
end
end
return nil
end
function _G.AdaptUseMedusaCounter()
if not medCounterEnabled then return end
if _G.AdaptCounterState.medDebounce then return end
if tick() - (_G.AdaptCounterState.medLastUsed or 0) < _G.AdaptMedusaCooldown then return end
local c = LP.Character
if not c then return end
_G.AdaptCounterState.medDebounce = true
local med = _G.AdaptFindMedusa()
if not med then
_G.AdaptCounterState.medDebounce = false
return
end
if med.Parent ~= c then
local hum = c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if hum then pcall(function() hum:EquipTool(med) end) end
task.wait(0.05)
end
pcall(function() med:Activate() end)
_G.AdaptCounterState.medLastUsed = tick()
_G.AdaptCounterState.medDebounce = false
end
function _G.AdaptOnMedusaAnchorChanged(part)
return part:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Anchored"):Connect(function()
if medCounterEnabled and part.Anchored and part.Transparency == 1 then
_G.AdaptUseMedusaCounter()
end
end)
end
function _G.AdaptStartMedCounter(char)
_G.AdaptStopMedCounter()
char = char or LP.Character
if not char then return end
for _, part in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
if part:IsA("BasePart") then
table.insert(_G.AdaptCounterState.medConns, _G.AdaptOnMedusaAnchorChanged(part))
end
end
table.insert(_G.AdaptCounterState.medConns, char.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(part)
if part:IsA("BasePart") then
table.insert(_G.AdaptCounterState.medConns, _G.AdaptOnMedusaAnchorChanged(part))
end
end))
end
function _G.AdaptStopMedCounter()
for _, c in pairs(_G.AdaptCounterState.medConns or {}) do
pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end)
end
_G.AdaptCounterState.medConns = {}
_G.AdaptCounterState.medDebounce = false
end
_G.AdaptBatCounterSlapList = {"Bat", "Slap", "Iron Slap", "Gold Slap", "Diamond Slap", "Emerald Slap", "Ruby Slap", "Dark Matter Slap", "Flame Slap", "Nuclear Slap", "Galaxy Slap", "Glitched Slap"}
function _G.AdaptFindBatForCounter()
local c = LP.Character
if not c then return nil end
local bp = LP:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack") or LP:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
for _, name in ipairs(_G.AdaptBatCounterSlapList) do
local t = c:FindFirstChild(name) or (bp and bp:FindFirstChild(name))
if t then return t end
end
for _, ch in ipairs(c:GetChildren()) do
if ch:IsA("Tool") and ch.Name:lower():find("bat") then return ch end
end
if bp then
for _, ch in ipairs(bp:GetChildren()) do
if ch:IsA("Tool") and ch.Name:lower():find("bat") then return ch end
end
end
return nil
end
function _G.AdaptSwingBatForCounter(bat, char)
if not bat or not char then return end
local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if bat.Parent ~= char then
if hum then pcall(function() hum:EquipTool(bat) end) end
task.wait(0.05)
end
local remote = bat:FindFirstChildOfClass("RemoteEvent") or bat:FindFirstChildOfClass("RemoteFunction")
if remote and remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
pcall(function() remote:FireServer() end)
task.wait(0.15)
pcall(function() remote:FireServer() end)
else
pcall(function() bat:Activate() end)
task.wait(0.15)
pcall(function() bat:Activate() end)
end
end
function _G.AdaptCounterIsRagdoll(hum)
if not hum then return false end
local st = hum:GetState()
return st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics
or st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll
or st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown
or hum.PlatformStand == true
end
function _G.AdaptBCMarkEnemyRagdoll(plr)
if not plr or plr == LP then return end
local secs = tonumber(_G.AdaptBatCounterRagdollSeconds) or 2.6
_G.AdaptBatCounterEnemyLock[plr] = tick() + secs
end

function _G.AdaptStopBatCounterWatcher()
local conns = _G.AdaptBatCounterWatchConns or {}
for k, c in pairs(conns) do
pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end)
_G.AdaptBatCounterWatchConns[k] = nil
end
for k in pairs(_G.AdaptBatCounterEnemyLock or {}) do
_G.AdaptBatCounterEnemyLock[k] = nil
end
end

function _G.AdaptStartBatCounterWatcher()
_G.AdaptStopBatCounterWatcher()
local conns = _G.AdaptBatCounterWatchConns
local function hookChar(plr, char)
if not char then return end
local key = tostring(plr.UserId) .. "_char"
if conns[key] then pcall(function() conns[key]:Disconnect() end) end
conns[key] = char.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)
if d:IsA("BallSocketConstraint") then
_G.AdaptBCMarkEnemyRagdoll(plr)
end
end)
end
local function watchPlayer(plr)
if plr == LP then return end
local key = tostring(plr.UserId) .. "_added"
if conns[key] then pcall(function() conns[key]:Disconnect() end) end
conns[key] = plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
hookChar(plr, char)
end)
if plr.Character then hookChar(plr, plr.Character) end
end
conns["_playerAdded"] = Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(watchPlayer)
conns["_playerRemoving"] = Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(plr)
_G.AdaptBatCounterEnemyLock[plr] = nil
local ka = tostring(plr.UserId) .. "_added"
local kc = tostring(plr.UserId) .. "_char"
if conns[ka] then pcall(function() conns[ka]:Disconnect() end) conns[ka] = nil end
if conns[kc] then pcall(function() conns[kc]:Disconnect() end) conns[kc] = nil end
end)
for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do watchPlayer(plr) end
end

function _G.AdaptGetNearestEnemy()
local char = LP.Character
local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
if not hrp then return nil end
local myPos = hrp.Position
local best, bestDist = nil, math.huge
for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
if plr ~= LP then
local ec = plr.Character
local ehrp = ec and ec:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local ehum = ec and ec:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if ehrp and ehum and ehum.Health > 0 then
local d = (ehrp.Position - myPos).Magnitude
if d < bestDist then bestDist = d; best = plr end
end
end
end
return best
end

function _G.AdaptIsNearestEnemyRagdolled()
local plr = _G.AdaptGetNearestEnemy()
if not plr then return false end
local lockUntil = _G.AdaptBatCounterEnemyLock[plr]
return lockUntil ~= nil and lockUntil > tick()
end

function _G.AdaptCounterIsRagdollForBat(hum)
if not hum then return false end
local st = hum:GetState()
return st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics
or st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll
or hum.PlatformStand == true
end

function _G.AdaptStartBatCounter()
if _G.AdaptCounterState.batConn then return end
_G.AdaptCounterState.batDebounce = false
if _G.AdaptStartBatCounterWatcher then pcall(_G.AdaptStartBatCounterWatcher) end
_G.AdaptCounterState.batConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
if not batCounterEnabled then return end
if _G.AdaptCounterState.batDebounce then return end
local char = LP.Character
if not char then return end
local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return end
if _G._AdaptInstantResetBusy then return end
if not _G.AdaptCounterIsRagdollForBat(hum) then return end

_G.AdaptCounterState.batDebounce = true
if _G.AdaptAntiDieArmNow then pcall(_G.AdaptAntiDieArmNow) end

if _G.AdaptBatCounterMode == "V2" then
if _G.AdaptIsNearestEnemyRagdolled and _G.AdaptIsNearestEnemyRagdolled() then
 task.spawn(function()
  local t0=tick()
  while tick()-t0 < 10 do
   local c2=LP.Character; local h2=c2 and c2:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
   if not h2 or not _G.AdaptCounterIsRagdollForBat(h2) then break end
   task.wait(0.1)
  end
  task.wait(0.2)
  _G.AdaptCounterState.batDebounce=false
 end)
 return
end


task.spawn(function()
 task.wait(0.05)
 local wasTP = _G.AdaptAntiDesyncAimbotOn == true
 local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
 local savedCF = root and root.CFrame or nil
 _G.AdaptBatCounterV2On = true
 if _G.AdaptAntiDieAutoSync then _G.AdaptAntiDieAutoSync() end
 if not wasTP then
  if _G.AdaptStartAntiDesyncAimbot then pcall(_G.AdaptStartAntiDesyncAimbot) end
 end
 local bat = _G.AdaptFindBatForCounter and _G.AdaptFindBatForCounter()
 if bat then task.spawn(function() _G.AdaptSwingBatForCounter(bat, char) end) end
 local snapConn
 snapConn=RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
  local c2=LP.Character
  local h2=c2 and c2:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
  local hum2=c2 and c2:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
  if not h2 or not hum2 or hum2.Health<=0 then return end
  local t2=_G.AdaptGetNearestEnemy and _G.AdaptGetNearestEnemy() or nil
  local tc=t2 and t2.Character
  local tr2=tc and tc:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
  if not tr2 then return end
  local pos=tr2.Position
  if _G.AdaptAntiVoid and _G.AdaptAntiVoid.posForPart then
   local safePos=_G.AdaptAntiVoid.posForPart(tr2,pos)
   if safePos then pos=safePos end
  end
  pcall(function()
   h2.CFrame=CFrame.new(pos+Vector3.new(0,0.9,0))
   h2.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero
   h2.AssemblyAngularVelocity=Vector3.zero
  end)
 end)
 task.wait(0.4)
 if snapConn then pcall(function() snapConn:Disconnect() end) end
 _G.AdaptBatCounterV2On=false
 if _G.AdaptAntiDieAutoSync then _G.AdaptAntiDieAutoSync() end
 if not wasTP then
  if _G.AdaptStopAntiDesyncAimbot then pcall(_G.AdaptStopAntiDesyncAimbot) end
 end
 if savedCF then
  local rb=char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
  if rb then pcall(function() rb.CFrame=savedCF; rb.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero end) end
 end
 task.wait(0.5)
 _G.AdaptCounterState.batDebounce=false
end)
else
-- Ambitious V1: look at nearest enemy + double swing, restore after 0.7s.
task.spawn(function()
 local root=char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
 local savedCF=root and root.CFrame or nil
 local enemy=_G.AdaptGetNearestEnemy and _G.AdaptGetNearestEnemy() or nil
 local er=enemy and enemy.Character and enemy.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
 if root and er then
  pcall(function() root.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(root.Position, er.Position) end)
 end
 local bat=_G.AdaptFindBatForCounter and _G.AdaptFindBatForCounter()
 if bat then task.spawn(function() _G.AdaptSwingBatForCounter(bat,char) end) end
 task.wait(0.7)
 if savedCF then
  local rb=char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
  if rb then pcall(function() rb.CFrame=savedCF end) end
 end
 task.wait(0.5)
 _G.AdaptCounterState.batDebounce=false
end)
end
end)
end

-- Ambitious-compatible V1/V2 mode bridge. The actual counter engine above
-- reads this same mode on every ragdoll event; this hook makes mode changes
-- immediate even while Bat Counter is already enabled.
_G.AdaptBatCounterV1V2Apply = function(mode)
    _G.AdaptBatCounterMode = (mode == "V2") and "V2" or "V1"
    if batCounterEnabled then
        _G.AdaptCounterState.batDebounce = false
        if _G.AdaptStopBatCounter then
            pcall(_G.AdaptStopBatCounter)
        end
        task.defer(function()
            if batCounterEnabled and _G.AdaptStartBatCounter then
                pcall(_G.AdaptStartBatCounter)
            end
        end)
    end
end

if _G.AdaptCounterState.batConn then
_G.AdaptCounterState.batConn:Disconnect()
_G.AdaptCounterState.batConn=nil
end
_G.AdaptCounterState.batDebounce=false
_G.AdaptBatCounterV2On=false
if _G.AdaptStopBatCounterWatcher then pcall(_G.AdaptStopBatCounterWatcher) end
end

stopMedusaCounter = _G.AdaptStopMedCounter

-- Perfect Hit / Perfect Hit Range removed by user request.
perfectHitEnabled = false
_G.AdaptPerfectHitEnabled = false
-- Lonely v14: full Ambitious No Player Collision v3
_G.AmbitiousNoPlayerCollisionEnabled = (_G.AdaptNoPlayerCollisionEnabled == true) or (_G.AmbitiousNoPlayerCollisionEnabled == true)
-- NO PLAYER COLLISION v3 (event-driven)
-- Sostituisce il vecchio blocco a polling. Differenze:
--   1. ZERO loop. Ogni BasePart e' registrata una volta con
--      GetPropertyChangedSignal("CanCollide"): se qualcosa la riaccende
--      torna a false nello STESSO frame, non dopo 0.2s.
--   2. DescendantAdded sul character: accessori, tool equipaggiati e
--      arti che arrivano tardi al respawn vengono presi subito.
--   3. Copre anche l'assembly esterna (brainrot trasportato, hitbox
--      weldate ma parented in workspace), che prima era ignorata.
--   4. Spegne anche le TUE parti: sono le uniche di cui hai il network
--      ownership, quindi replicano davvero sul client dell'altro.

--      senza pestarsi i piedi (AmbitiousNoCollisionAcquire/Release).
-- Tutto dentro un do-end: non consuma slot locals nel main chunk.
-- ============================================================
_G.AmbitiousNoPlayerCollisionState = _G.AmbitiousNoPlayerCollisionState or {}

do
  local NPC = _G.AmbitiousNoPlayerCollisionState
  NPC.connections = NPC.connections or {}
  NPC.parts       = NPC.parts or {}       -- part -> {conn, destroy, cc, ct}
  NPC.charConns   = NPC.charConns or {}   -- character -> {conns}
  NPC.holders     = NPC.holders or {}     -- tag -> true
  NPC.running     = NPC.running or false

  -- Parti del corpo R6 + R15
  local BODY = {
    HumanoidRootPart = true, Head = true, Torso = true, UpperTorso = true, LowerTorso = true,
    ["Left Arm"] = true, ["Right Arm"] = true, ["Left Leg"] = true, ["Right Leg"] = true,
    LeftUpperArm = true, LeftLowerArm = true, LeftHand = true,
    RightUpperArm = true, RightLowerArm = true, RightHand = true,
    LeftUpperLeg = true, LeftLowerLeg = true, LeftFoot = true,
    RightUpperLeg = true, RightLowerLeg = true, RightFoot = true,
  }

  local function isOn() return NPC.running == true end

  -- Rete di sicurezza per le scritture interne del motore che non emettono
  -- GetPropertyChangedSignal. Passa su tutti i giocatori, ma UNA VOLTA AL

  -- Abbassalo a 0.25 se vedi ancora micro-spinte entrando nei nemici;
  -- mettilo a 0 per restare puramente event-driven.
  local SELF_VERIFY_INTERVAL = 1

  -- ---------- registro parti ----------
  local function lockPart(part, killTouch)
    if not part or not part:IsA("BasePart") then return end
    if NPC.parts[part] then return end

    local e = {cc = part.CanCollide, ct = part.CanTouch}
    NPC.parts[part] = e

    pcall(function() part.CanCollide = false end)
    if killTouch then pcall(function() part.CanTouch = false end) end

    -- Cuore del fix: reazione immediata, non ogni 0.2s.
    e.conn = part:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CanCollide"):Connect(function()
      if not isOn() then return end
      if part.CanCollide then pcall(function() part.CanCollide = false end) end
    end)

    e.destroy = part.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
      if part:IsDescendantOf(game) then return end
      if e.conn then pcall(function() e.conn:Disconnect() end) end
      if e.destroy then pcall(function() e.destroy:Disconnect() end) end
      NPC.parts[part] = nil
    end)
  end

  local function unlockPart(part)
    local e = NPC.parts[part]
    if not e then return end
    if e.conn then pcall(function() e.conn:Disconnect() end) end
    if e.destroy then pcall(function() e.destroy:Disconnect() end) end
    NPC.parts[part] = nil
    if part and part.Parent then
      pcall(function() part.CanCollide = e.cc end)
      pcall(function() part.CanTouch = e.ct end)
    end
  end

  local hookHumanoid

  -- Riscrive CanCollide = false sulle parti gia' registrate di un character.
  -- Serve quando il motore le rimette a true senza emettere il segnale.
  local function reassert(char, isSelf)
    if not char then return end
    for _, obj in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
      if obj:IsA("BasePart") and NPC.parts[obj] then
        if not (isSelf and obj.Name == "HumanoidRootPart") then
          if obj.CanCollide then pcall(function() obj.CanCollide = false end) end
        end
      end
    end
  end

  hookHumanoid = function(hum, char, isSelf)
    if not NPC.charConns[char] then NPC.charConns[char] = {} end
    table.insert(NPC.charConns[char], hum.StateChanged:Connect(function()
      if not isOn() then return end
      -- differita di un frame: l'Humanoid scrive dopo il cambio di stato
      task.defer(function()
        if isOn() and char.Parent then reassert(char, isSelf) end
      end)
    end))
    table.insert(NPC.charConns[char], hum:GetPropertyChangedSignal("FloorMaterial"):Connect(function()
      if not isOn() then return end
      task.defer(function()
        if isOn() and char.Parent then reassert(char, isSelf) end
      end)
    end))
  end

  -- ---------- aggancio character ----------
  -- isSelf: sul tuo character l'HRP resta collidibile o l'Humanoid sprofonda.
  local function hookCharacter(char, isSelf)
    if not char then return end
    if NPC.charConns[char] then return end
    NPC.charConns[char] = {}

    local function handle(obj)
      if not isOn() then return end
      if not obj:IsA("BasePart") then return end
      if isSelf and obj.Name == "HumanoidRootPart" then return end
      lockPart(obj, not isSelf)
    end

    for _, obj in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do handle(obj) end
    table.insert(NPC.charConns[char], char.DescendantAdded:Connect(handle))

    -- Salto, caduta, atterraggio, ragdoll: l'Humanoid rimette mano alle
    -- collisioni. Qui le riportiamo giu' subito dopo, senza polling.
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum then
      local hc
      hc = char.ChildAdded:Connect(function(c)
        if c:IsA("Humanoid") then
          hc:Disconnect()
          hookHumanoid(c, char, isSelf)
        end
      end)
      table.insert(NPC.charConns[char], hc)
    else
      hookHumanoid(hum, char, isSelf)
    end
    table.insert(NPC.charConns[char], char.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
      if parent == nil then
        for _, c in ipairs(NPC.charConns[char] or {}) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
        NPC.charConns[char] = nil
      end
    end))
  end

  -- ---------- assembly esterne (brainrot trasportato, hitbox) ----------
  local function ownedByOtherPlayer(part)
    local root = part.AssemblyRootPart
    if not root then return false end
    local model = root:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
    if not model then return false end
    local plr = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)
    return plr ~= nil and plr ~= LP
  end

  local function hookWorkspacePart(obj)
    if not isOn() then return end
    if not obj:IsA("BasePart") then return end
    if NPC.parts[obj] then return end
    -- il weld arriva un frame dopo il parenting
    task.defer(function()
      if not isOn() then return end
      if not obj.Parent then return end
      if ownedByOtherPlayer(obj) then lockPart(obj, true) end
    end)
  end

  -- ---------- start / stop interni ----------
  local function startCore()
    if NPC.running then return end
    NPC.running = true

    for _, c in ipairs(NPC.connections or {}) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
    NPC.connections = {}
    local function track(c) table.insert(NPC.connections, c) end

    local function watchPlayer(plr)
      if plr == LP then return end
      if plr.Character then hookCharacter(plr.Character, false) end
      track(plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
        if isOn() then hookCharacter(char, false) end
      end))
    end
    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do watchPlayer(plr) end
    track(Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(watchPlayer))

    if LP.Character then hookCharacter(LP.Character, true) end
    track(LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
      if isOn() then hookCharacter(char, true) end
    end))

    for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetChildren()) do hookWorkspacePart(obj) end
    track(Workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(hookWorkspacePart))

    if SELF_VERIFY_INTERVAL > 0 then
      local acc = 0
      track(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
        if not isOn() then return end
        acc = acc + (dt or 0)
        if acc < SELF_VERIFY_INTERVAL then return end
        acc = 0
        for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
          local char = plr.Character
          if char then
            local isSelf = (plr == LP)
            reassert(char, isSelf)
            -- parti mai registrate (comparse in una finestra scoperta)
            for _, obj in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
              if obj:IsA("BasePart") and not NPC.parts[obj] then
                if not (isSelf and obj.Name == "HumanoidRootPart") then
                  lockPart(obj, not isSelf)
                end
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end))
    end
  end

  local function stopCore()
    if not NPC.running then return end
    NPC.running = false

    for _, c in ipairs(NPC.connections or {}) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
    NPC.connections = {}

    for char, conns in pairs(NPC.charConns) do
      for _, c in ipairs(conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
      NPC.charConns[char] = nil
    end

    for part in pairs(NPC.parts) do unlockPart(part) end
    NPC.parts = {}
  end

  -- Ripassata completa: riaggancia character e parti gia' presenti.
  -- Serve dopo un cambio di holder, per non restare in attesa del
  -- prossimo DescendantAdded.
  local function rescan()
    if not isOn() then return end
    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
      local char = plr.Character
      if char then
        if plr == LP then
          for _, obj in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
            if obj:IsA("BasePart") and obj.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then lockPart(obj, false) end
          end
        else
          for _, obj in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
            if obj:IsA("BasePart") then lockPart(obj, true) end
          end
        end
        hookCharacter(char, plr == LP)
      end
    end
  end

  -- ---------- API ref-count ----------

  function _G.AmbitiousNoCollisionAcquire(tag)
    NPC.holders[tag or "default"] = true
    startCore()
  end

  function _G.AmbitiousNoCollisionRelease(tag)
    NPC.holders[tag or "default"] = nil
    -- Il toggle utente vince sempre: finche' e' acceso non si spegne nulla,
    -- anche se il tag "user" si fosse perso per strada.
    if _G.AmbitiousNoPlayerCollisionEnabled == true then
      NPC.holders["user"] = true
      rescan()
      return
    end
    if next(NPC.holders) == nil then stopCore() end
  end
end

-- Toggle utente (chiamato dalla UI e da applyAmbitiousConfig)
function enableNoPlayerCollision()
  _G.AmbitiousNoPlayerCollisionEnabled = true
  _G.AdaptNoPlayerCollisionEnabled = true
  _G.AmbitiousNoCollisionAcquire("user")
end

function disableNoPlayerCollision()
  _G.AmbitiousNoPlayerCollisionEnabled = false
  _G.AdaptNoPlayerCollisionEnabled = false
  _G.AmbitiousNoCollisionRelease("user")
end

-- Compatibilita' con il vecchio nome usato altrove nello script
function _G.AmbitiousSetOtherPlayerCollision(state)
  if state == false then
    _G.AmbitiousNoCollisionAcquire("legacy")
  else
    _G.AmbitiousNoCollisionRelease("legacy")
  end
end


-- VX7 Safety System: full brainrot/carry detection + Safe Mode guard.
-- Safe Mode blocks combat/Auto Left/Auto Right while the player is in the
-- duel countdown or is carrying a brainrot. This replaces the older
-- carry-name-only safety checks.
_G.AdaptSafeModeBlockedTools = {
    bat=true, slap=true, sword=true, gun=true, pistol=true, rifle=true,
    medusa=true, hammer=true, axe=true, knife=true, katana=true, blade=true,
    fist=true, head=true, stone=true,
}

local function _vx7SafeToolBlocked(name)
    local n = tostring(name or ""):lower()
    for word in pairs(_G.AdaptSafeModeBlockedTools) do
        if n:find(word, 1, true) then return true end
    end
    return false
end

local function _vx7SafeModelIgnored(obj)
    local n = tostring(obj and obj.Name or ""):lower()
    if _vx7SafeToolBlocked(n) then return true end
    if obj and obj:IsA("Model") and obj:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then return true end
    if obj and obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Accoutrement", true) then return true end
    return false
end

function _G.AdaptSafeModeGetCountdownLabel()
    local ok, label = pcall(function()
        return LP.PlayerGui
            and LP.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("DuelsMachineTopFrame")
            and LP.PlayerGui.DuelsMachineTopFrame:FindFirstChild("DuelsMachineTopFrame")
            and LP.PlayerGui.DuelsMachineTopFrame.DuelsMachineTopFrame:FindFirstChild("Timer")
            and LP.PlayerGui.DuelsMachineTopFrame.DuelsMachineTopFrame.Timer:FindFirstChild("Label")
    end)
    return (ok and label) or nil
end

function _G.AdaptSafeModeCountdownNumber(text)
    local t = tostring(text or ""):upper():gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    if t == "GO" or t == "START" or t == "READY" then return true end
    local n = tonumber(t)
    return n ~= nil and n >= 0 and n <= 10
end

function _G.AdaptSafeModeInDuelCountdown()
    local label = _G.AdaptSafeModeGetCountdownLabel()
    return label and _G.AdaptSafeModeCountdownNumber(label.Text) or false
end

function _G.AdaptSafeModeHoldingBrainrot()
    local character = LP.Character
    if not character then return false end

    -- VX7: real held tool detection, excluding combat tools.
    for _, child in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("Tool") and not _vx7SafeToolBlocked(child.Name) then
            return true
        end
    end

    -- VX7: carried model detection.
    for _, child in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("Model")
            and not _vx7SafeModelIgnored(child)
            and child:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart") then
            return true
        end
    end

    -- Existing attribute/value compatibility checks.
    for _, name in ipairs({"Carrying","IsCarrying","Grabbed","Holding","StealHold","HasGrab"}) do
        local v = character:FindFirstChild(name, true)
        if v then
            if v:IsA("BoolValue") and v.Value then return true end
            if v:IsA("ObjectValue") and v.Value then return true end
            if v:IsA("StringValue") and v.Value ~= "" then return true end
        end
    end
    if LP:GetAttribute("Stealing") == true or LP:GetAttribute("Carrying") == true then
        return true
    end
    if character:GetAttribute("Stealing") == true or character:GetAttribute("Carrying") == true then
        return true
    end

    -- VX7 connected-parts/weld detection.
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or character.PrimaryPart
    local sitting = humanoid and (humanoid.Sit or humanoid.SeatPart ~= nil)
    if root and not sitting then
        local ok, connected = pcall(function()
            return root:GetConnectedParts(true)
        end)
        if ok and connected then
            for _, part in ipairs(connected) do
                if not part:IsDescendantOf(character)
                    and not part:IsA("Seat")
                    and not part:IsA("VehicleSeat") then
                    local tool = part:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("Tool")
                    local partName = tool and tool.Name or part.Name
                    if not _vx7SafeToolBlocked(partName) then
                        local model = part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
                        if not (model and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)) then
                            return true
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return false
end

function _G.AdaptSafeModeIsLocked()
    if not antiKickEnabled then return false end
    return _G.AdaptSafeModeInDuelCountdown() or _G.AdaptSafeModeHoldingBrainrot()
end

function _G.AdaptSafeModeForceStop(reason)
    local stopped = false
    if _G.AdaptNormalAimbotOn and _G.AdaptStopNormalAimbot then
        pcall(_G.AdaptStopNormalAimbot); stopped = true
    end
    if _G.AdaptAntiDesyncAimbotOn and _G.AdaptStopAntiDesyncAimbot then
        pcall(_G.AdaptStopAntiDesyncAimbot); stopped = true
    end
    if autoLeftEnabled then
        autoLeftEnabled = false
        if _G.AdaptSetAutoLeftVisual then pcall(_G.AdaptSetAutoLeftVisual, false) end
        if _G.AdaptStopAutoLeft then pcall(_G.AdaptStopAutoLeft) end
        stopped = true
    end
    if autoRightEnabled then
        autoRightEnabled = false
        if _G.AdaptSetAutoRightVisual then pcall(_G.AdaptSetAutoRightVisual, false) end
        if _G.AdaptStopAutoRight then pcall(_G.AdaptStopAutoRight) end
        stopped = true
    end
    if stopped and showActionNotification then
        pcall(function() showActionNotification(reason or "SAFE MODE LOCK") end)
    end
end

function _G.AdaptSafeModeTryStart()
    if _G.AdaptSafeModeIsLocked and _G.AdaptSafeModeIsLocked() then
        _G.AdaptSafeModeForceStop("SAFE MODE LOCK")
        return false
    end
    return true
end

_G.AdaptSafeModeMonitorStarted = _G.AdaptSafeModeMonitorStarted or false
if not _G.AdaptSafeModeMonitorStarted then
    _G.AdaptSafeModeMonitorStarted = true
    RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if antiKickEnabled and _G.AdaptSafeModeIsLocked and _G.AdaptSafeModeIsLocked() then
            _G.AdaptSafeModeForceStop("SAFE MODE LOCK")
        end
    end)
end

-- VX7 WARNING E01 — shown when carrying starts.
do
    local warningState = {
        wasCarrying = false,
        lastTriggered = -math.huge,
        elapsed = 0,
        generation = 0,
        board = nil,
        scale = nil,
        timer = nil,
        monitor = nil,
        respawn = nil,
    }

    local function clearWarning()
        warningState.generation = warningState.generation + 1
        if warningState.timer then
            warningState.timer:Disconnect()
            warningState.timer = nil
        end
        if warningState.board then
            warningState.board:Destroy()
            warningState.board = nil
        end
        warningState.scale = nil
    end

    local function showWarning()
        local character = LP.Character
        local head = character and character:FindFirstChild("Head")
        if not head then return end

        clearWarning()
        local generation = warningState.generation
        local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
        billboard.Name = "VX7_WARNING_E01"
        billboard.Adornee = head
        billboard.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(252, 56)
        billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 4.95, 0)
        billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
        billboard.LightInfluence = 0
        billboard.MaxDistance = 150
        billboard.Parent = head
        warningState.board = billboard

        local frame = Instance.new("Frame", billboard)
        frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(252, 56)
        frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 2, 7)
        frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.35
        frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
        warningState.scale = Instance.new("UIScale", frame)
        _G.AdaptSetWarningE01Scale(warningE01Scale)
        corner(frame, 10)
        local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", frame)
        stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(232, 31, 58)
        stroke.Thickness = 1.15
        stroke.Transparency = 0.28

        local title = Instance.new("TextLabel", frame)
        title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22)
        title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        title.Text = "WARNING E01"
        title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        title.TextSize = 13
        title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 100)

        local body = Instance.new("TextLabel", frame)
        body.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
        body.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 23)
        body.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        body.Text = "SAFE IN 3.00s"
        body.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
        body.TextSize = 18
        body.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 110)

        local started = os.clock()
        warningState.timer = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
            if generation ~= warningState.generation then return end
            if not billboard.Parent then
                clearWarning()
                return
            end
            local remaining = math.max(0, 3 - (os.clock() - started))
            if remaining > 0 then
                body.Text = string.format("SAFE IN %.2fs", remaining)
                if remaining < 1 then
                    body.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 203, 72)
                    stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(240, 145, 40)
                else
                    body.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 110)
                    stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(232, 31, 58)
                end
                return
            end
            warningState.timer:Disconnect()
            warningState.timer = nil
            body.Text = "SAFE TO STEAL"
            body.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(73, 255, 145)
            stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(42, 218, 112)
            task.delay(1.5, function()
                if generation == warningState.generation then clearWarning() end
            end)
        end)
    end

    function _G.AdaptSetWarningE01Scale(value)
        warningE01Scale = math.clamp(tonumber(value) or 1, 0.5, 2.5)
        if warningState.board and warningState.board.Parent then
            warningState.board.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(252 * warningE01Scale, 56 * warningE01Scale)
            if warningState.scale then
                warningState.scale.Scale = warningE01Scale
            end
        end
    end

    function _G.AdaptWarningE01Stop()
        if warningState.monitor then warningState.monitor:Disconnect(); warningState.monitor=nil end
        if warningState.respawn then warningState.respawn:Disconnect(); warningState.respawn=nil end
        warningState.wasCarrying=false
        warningState.lastTriggered=-math.huge
        warningState.elapsed=0
        clearWarning()
    end

    function _G.AdaptWarningE01Start()
        if warningState.monitor then return end

        -- WARNING E01 is a background monitor. It is intentionally always ON.
        -- The warning itself is only allowed to activate below WalkSpeed 25.
        warningE01Enabled = true
        warningState.wasCarrying = false
        warningState.lastTriggered = -math.huge
        warningState.elapsed = 0

        warningState.monitor = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
            warningState.elapsed = warningState.elapsed + dt
            if warningState.elapsed < 0.08 then return end
            warningState.elapsed = 0

            warningE01Enabled = true

            local character = LP.Character
            local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local walkSpeed = humanoid and tonumber(humanoid.WalkSpeed) or 16
            local belowThreshold = walkSpeed > 0 and walkSpeed < 25

            if not belowThreshold then
                warningState.wasCarrying = false
                warningState.lastTriggered = -math.huge
                if warningState.board then
                    clearWarning()
                end
                return
            end

            if not warningState.wasCarrying and os.clock() - warningState.lastTriggered > 3.25 then
                warningState.lastTriggered = os.clock()
                showWarning()
            end

            warningState.wasCarrying = true
        end)

        warningState.respawn = LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
            warningState.wasCarrying = false
            warningState.lastTriggered = -math.huge
            clearWarning()
        end)
    end

    function _G.AdaptSetWarningE01Enabled(on)
        -- Kept for compatibility with old UI/config callers.
        -- E01 itself remains permanently monitored in the background.
        warningE01Enabled = true
        _G.AdaptWarningE01Start()
        if saveAdaptConfig then pcall(saveAdaptConfig) end
    end

    _G.AdaptSetWarningE01Scale(warningE01Scale)
    _G.AdaptSetWarningE01Enabled(warningE01Enabled)
end

LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
task.wait(0.5)
if medCounterEnabled then _G.AdaptStartMedCounter(char) end
if batCounterEnabled then _G.AdaptStartBatCounter() end
if hardHitEnabled then _G.AdaptStartHardHit() end
perfectHitEnabled = false
end)
-- Ambitious-style aimbot pathfinding, renamed for LonelyOpduels.
_G.LonelyOpduelsPathfind = _G.LonelyOpduelsPathfind or {paths={}}
_G.LonelyOpduelsPathfind.cfg = {PROBE=14, ANGLES={18,36,54,72,90}, WALL_Y=0.6, WP_REACH=4, RECOMPUTE=1.25, GOAL_DRIFT=6}
function _G.LonelyOpduelsPathfind.rayParams()
    local p=RaycastParams.new(); local ignore={}; local ch=LP.Character
    if ch then ignore[#ignore+1]=ch end
    for _,plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do if plr~=LP and plr.Character then ignore[#ignore+1]=plr.Character end end
    p.FilterDescendantsInstances=ignore; p.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude; p.IgnoreWater=true; return p
end
function _G.LonelyOpduelsPathfind.blocked(origin,dir,dist,params)
    local r=workspace:Raycast(origin,dir*dist,params); if not r then return false end
    return math.abs(r.Normal.Y)<=_G.LonelyOpduelsPathfind.cfg.WALL_Y
end
function _G.LonelyOpduelsPathfind.steer(origin,dir,dist)
    if dir.Magnitude<0.01 then return dir end; dir=dir.Unit; local C=_G.LonelyOpduelsPathfind.cfg; dist=dist or C.PROBE; local p=_G.LonelyOpduelsPathfind.rayParams()
    local low=origin-Vector3.new(0,2,0)
    if not _G.LonelyOpduelsPathfind.blocked(origin,dir,dist,p) and not _G.LonelyOpduelsPathfind.blocked(low,dir,dist,p) then return dir end
    for _,deg in ipairs(C.ANGLES) do for _,sign in ipairs({1,-1}) do
        local cand=CFrame.Angles(0,math.rad(deg*sign),0):VectorToWorldSpace(dir); cand=Vector3.new(cand.X,0,cand.Z)
        if cand.Magnitude>0.01 then cand=cand.Unit; if not _G.LonelyOpduelsPathfind.blocked(origin,cand,dist,p) and not _G.LonelyOpduelsPathfind.blocked(low,cand,dist,p) then return cand end end
    end end
    return dir
end
function _G.LonelyOpduelsPathfind.reset(key) _G.LonelyOpduelsPathfind.paths[key]=nil end
function _G.LonelyOpduelsPathfind.dirTo(key,from,goal,opts)
    local C=_G.LonelyOpduelsPathfind.cfg; local st=_G.LonelyOpduelsPathfind.paths[key]; local now=os.clock()
    local recompute=(opts and tonumber(opts.recompute)) or C.RECOMPUTE; local drift=(opts and tonumber(opts.drift)) or C.GOAL_DRIFT
    if st and st.goal and (st.goal-goal).Magnitude>drift then st=nil end
    if not st then st={goal=goal,wp=nil,i=1,computing=false,last=0}; _G.LonelyOpduelsPathfind.paths[key]=st end
    if not st.computing and (not st.wp or now-st.last>recompute) then
        st.computing=true; st.last=now; st.goal=goal; local origin=from
        task.spawn(function()
            local ok,path=pcall(function()
                local svc=_G.LonelyOpduelsPathfind.svc or game:GetService("PathfindingService"); _G.LonelyOpduelsPathfind.svc=svc
                local pth=svc:CreatePath({AgentRadius=2.5,AgentHeight=5,AgentCanJump=true,WaypointSpacing=6}); pth:ComputeAsync(origin,goal); return pth
            end)
            local cur=_G.LonelyOpduelsPathfind.paths[key]; if cur~=st then return end; st.computing=false
            if ok and path and path.Status==Enum.PathStatus.Success then local pts=path:GetWaypoints(); st.wp=pts; st.i=math.min(2,#pts) else st.wp=nil end
        end)
    end
    local wp=st.wp; if not wp or #wp==0 then return nil end
    while st.i<=#wp do
        local pos=wp[st.i].Position; local d=Vector3.new(pos.X-from.X,0,pos.Z-from.Z)
        if d.Magnitude>C.WP_REACH then return d.Magnitude>0.01 and d.Unit or nil end; st.i=st.i+1
    end
    return nil
end

-- ============================================================
-- BUBBLE NORMAL BAT AIMBOT
-- Full standalone port of Bubble's predictive Aimbot engine.
-- This engine is independent from the Clean Bat Bypass runtime.
-- A generation token prevents a disconnected mode from running one stale frame.
_G.__AdaptAimbotEngineGeneration = tonumber(_G.__AdaptAimbotEngineGeneration) or 0
do
    local BubbleNormal = _G.__BubbleAceNormalAimbot or {}
    -- Disconnect any prior copy before replacing public state on script reload.
    if BubbleNormal.conn then
        pcall(function() BubbleNormal.conn:Disconnect() end)
        BubbleNormal.conn = nil
    end
    if _G.AdaptNormalAimbot and _G.AdaptNormalAimbot.conn then
        pcall(function() _G.AdaptNormalAimbot.conn:Disconnect() end)
        _G.AdaptNormalAimbot.conn = nil
    end
    _G.AdaptNormalAimbotOn = false
    BubbleNormal.target = nil
    BubbleNormal.swingCooldown = false
    BubbleNormal.nextSwingAt = 0
    BubbleNormal.nextPingSampleAt = 0
    BubbleNormal.state = BubbleNormal.state or {
        targetPlayer = nil,
        lastTargetPos = nil,
        targetVelocity = Vector3.zero,
        smoothedVelocity = Vector3.zero,
        velocityHistory = {},
        accelerationHistory = {},
        aerialVelocityHistory = {},
        verticalVelocityHistory = {},
        previousDirection = nil,
        lastDirectionChangeTime = 0,
        airborneTime = 0,
        lastYVelocity = 0,
        lastJumpTime = 0,
        lastActivationTime = 0,
        currentPing = 0.1,
        realPingMs = 0,
    }
    BubbleNormal.config = BubbleNormal.config or {
        FOLLOW_SPEED = 58,
        ACTIVATE_DISTANCE = 13,
        MIN_FOLLOW_DISTANCE = 1,
        PREDICTION_TIME = 0.22,
        PREDICT_AHEAD = 3,
        MAX_VELOCITY_CHANGE = 150,
        VELOCITY_SMOOTHING = 0.2,
        MAX_HORIZONTAL_VELOCITY = 80,
        SERVER_TICKRATE = 1 / 60,
        MIN_PING_COMPENSATION = 0.03,
        MAX_PING_COMPENSATION = 0.25,
        ACCELERATION_PREDICTION_WEIGHT = 0.3,
        DIRECTION_CHANGE_DETECTION_TIME = 0.12,
        QUICK_DIRECTION_CHANGE_MULTIPLIER = 1.5,
        GRAVITY = 196.2,
        AIR_CONTROL_FACTOR = 0.8,
        MIN_AIRBORNE_TIME = 0.08,
    }
    _G.__BubbleAceNormalAimbot = BubbleNormal
    _G.AdaptNormalAimbot = _G.AdaptNormalAimbot or {
        conn = nil,
        target = nil,
        swingCooldown = false,
    }

    local function bubbleFindBat(character)
        character = character or LP.Character
        if character then
            local equipped = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
            if equipped then
                local loweredName = string.lower(equipped.Name)
                if string.find(loweredName, "bat", 1, true)
                    or string.find(loweredName, "slap", 1, true) then
                    return equipped
                end
            end
        end
        local backpack = LP:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
        if backpack then
            for _, tool in ipairs(backpack:GetChildren()) do
                if tool:IsA("Tool") then
                    local loweredName = string.lower(tool.Name)
                    if string.find(loweredName, "bat", 1, true)
                        or string.find(loweredName, "slap", 1, true) then
                        return tool
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return nil
    end

    local function bubbleRenderCFrame(part)
        if not part then return nil end
        local fallbackCFrame = part.CFrame
        local ok, renderedCFrame = pcall(part.GetRenderCFrame, part)
        if ok and typeof(renderedCFrame) == "CFrame" then
            return renderedCFrame
        end
        return fallbackCFrame
    end

    local function bubblePushHistory(history, value, maximum)
        history[#history + 1] = value
        if #history > maximum then
            table.remove(history, 1)
        end
    end

    local function bubbleAverageVector(history)
        if not history or #history == 0 then
            return Vector3.zero
        end
        local total = Vector3.zero
        for _, value in ipairs(history) do
            total += value
        end
        return total / #history
    end

    local function bubbleAverageNumber(history)
        if not history or #history == 0 then
            return 0
        end
        local total = 0
        for _, value in ipairs(history) do
            total += tonumber(value) or 0
        end
        return total / #history
    end

    local function bubbleResetTarget()
        local state = BubbleNormal.state
        state.targetPlayer = nil
        state.lastTargetPos = nil
        state.targetVelocity = Vector3.zero
        state.smoothedVelocity = Vector3.zero
        state.velocityHistory = {}
        state.accelerationHistory = {}
        state.aerialVelocityHistory = {}
        state.verticalVelocityHistory = {}
        state.previousDirection = nil
        state.lastDirectionChangeTime = 0
        state.airborneTime = 0
        state.lastYVelocity = 0
        state.lastJumpTime = 0
        BubbleNormal.target = nil
        BubbleNormal.swingCooldown = false
        if _G.AdaptNormalAimbot then
            _G.AdaptNormalAimbot.target = nil
            _G.AdaptNormalAimbot.swingCooldown = false
        end
    end

    local function bubbleFindNearestTarget(rootPart)
        if not rootPart then return nil end

        -- Use Bubble's selected visual enemy when it returns a valid player.
        -- If no valid selection is available, preserve Bubble's nearest-player fallback.
        if type(_G.__BubbleGetVisualEnemy) == "function" then
            local ok, candidate = pcall(_G.__BubbleGetVisualEnemy)
            if ok and candidate and candidate ~= LP and candidate.Parent == Players then
                local candidateCharacter = candidate.Character
                local candidateRoot = candidateCharacter
                    and candidateCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local candidateHumanoid = candidateCharacter
                    and candidateCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if candidateRoot and candidateHumanoid and candidateHumanoid.Health > 0 then
                    return candidate
                end
            end
        end

        local nearestPlayer = nil
        local nearestDistance = math.huge
        for _, candidate in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if candidate ~= LP and candidate.Character then
                local targetCharacter = candidate.Character
                local targetRoot = targetCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local targetHumanoid = targetCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if targetRoot and targetHumanoid and targetHumanoid.Health > 0 then
                    local distance = (rootPart.Position - targetRoot.Position).Magnitude
                    if distance < nearestDistance then
                        nearestPlayer = candidate
                        nearestDistance = distance
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return nearestPlayer
    end

    local function bubbleRotateRoot(rootPart, direction)
        if not rootPart or not direction or direction.Magnitude < 0.01 then
            return
        end
        local axis = rootPart.CFrame.LookVector:Cross(direction.Unit)
        local angle = math.asin(math.clamp(axis.Magnitude, -1, 1))
        if axis.Magnitude > 0.01 then
            rootPart.AssemblyAngularVelocity = axis.Unit * angle * 80
        else
            rootPart.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
        end
    end

    local function bubbleSamplePing(now)
        now = tonumber(now) or tick()
        if now < (BubbleNormal.nextPingSampleAt or 0) then return end
        BubbleNormal.nextPingSampleAt = now + 0.5
        local ok, pingValue = pcall(function()
            return game:GetService("Stats").Network.ServerStatsItem["Data Ping"]:GetValue()
        end)
        local state = BubbleNormal.state
        if ok and type(pingValue) == "number" then
            state.realPingMs = math.floor(pingValue)
        end
        local config = BubbleNormal.config
        state.currentPing = math.clamp(
            (tonumber(state.realPingMs) or 0) / 1000,
            config.MIN_PING_COMPENSATION,
            config.MAX_PING_COMPENSATION
        )
    end

    local function bubbleSelectedSpeed()
        local mode = tostring(currentSpeedMode or "Normal")
        local speed
        if mode == "Lagger" or mode == "Lagger Carry" then
            speed = tonumber(LAGGER_AIMBOT_SPEED) or 40
        else
            speed = tonumber(AIMBOT_SPEED) or 58
        end
        if speed ~= speed or speed <= 0 or speed == math.huge then
            speed = 58
        end
        return math.clamp(speed, 1, 120)
    end

    local function bubbleGetMarkerCFrame()
        if type(_G.__BubbleTPBatGetMarkerCFrame) ~= "function" then
            return nil
        end
        local ok, marker = pcall(_G.__BubbleTPBatGetMarkerCFrame)
        if not ok then return nil end
        if typeof(marker) == "CFrame" then
            return marker
        end
        if typeof(marker) == "Vector3" then
            return CFrame.new(marker)
        end
        return nil
    end

    local function bubbleStop()
        local wasRunning = _G.AdaptNormalAimbotOn == true or BubbleNormal.conn ~= nil
        _G.AdaptNormalAimbotOn = false
        if BubbleNormal.conn then
            pcall(function() BubbleNormal.conn:Disconnect() end)
            BubbleNormal.conn = nil
        end
        BubbleNormal.nextSwingAt = 0
        BubbleNormal.nextPingSampleAt = 0
        bubbleResetTarget()

        local character = LP.Character
        local rootPart = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if humanoid then
            pcall(function() humanoid.AutoRotate = true end)
        end
        if rootPart then
            pcall(function() rootPart.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero end)
            if wasRunning then
                pcall(function() rootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero end)
            end
        end
        if _G.AdaptNormalAimbot then
            _G.AdaptNormalAimbot.conn = nil
            _G.AdaptNormalAimbot.target = nil
            _G.AdaptNormalAimbot.swingCooldown = false
        end
        return true
    end

    local function bubbleStart(character)
        character = character or LP.Character
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local rootPart = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not humanoid or not rootPart or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
            return false
        end

        _G.__AdaptAimbotEngineGeneration = (tonumber(_G.__AdaptAimbotEngineGeneration) or 0) + 1
        local engineGeneration = _G.__AdaptAimbotEngineGeneration

        if BubbleNormal.conn then
            pcall(function() BubbleNormal.conn:Disconnect() end)
            BubbleNormal.conn = nil
        end
        bubbleResetTarget()
        BubbleNormal.nextSwingAt = 0
        BubbleNormal.nextPingSampleAt = 0
        BubbleNormal.config.FOLLOW_SPEED = bubbleSelectedSpeed()
        humanoid.AutoRotate = false

        local tool = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool") or bubbleFindBat(character)
        if tool and tool.Parent ~= character then
            pcall(function() humanoid:EquipTool(tool) end)
        end

        BubbleNormal.conn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(deltaTime)
            -- A stale Normal callback must not stop or alter a newly selected engine.
            if engineGeneration ~= (tonumber(_G.__AdaptAimbotEngineGeneration) or 0) then
                return
            end
            if _G.AdaptNormalAimbotOn ~= true or _G.AdaptAimbotMode ~= "Normal" then
                bubbleStop()
                return
            end

            local currentCharacter = LP.Character
            local currentRoot = currentCharacter and currentCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local currentHumanoid = currentCharacter and currentCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if not currentCharacter or not currentRoot or not currentHumanoid
                or currentHumanoid.Health <= 0 then
                bubbleResetTarget()
                return
            end
            if currentHumanoid.AutoRotate then
                currentHumanoid.AutoRotate = false
            end

            local currentTool = currentCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool") or bubbleFindBat(currentCharacter)
            if currentTool and currentTool.Parent ~= currentCharacter then
                pcall(function() currentHumanoid:EquipTool(currentTool) end)
            end

            local now = tick()
            bubbleSamplePing(now)
            local state = BubbleNormal.state
            local config = BubbleNormal.config
            config.FOLLOW_SPEED = bubbleSelectedSpeed()

            -- Bubble TP Bat marker pursuit takes priority over ordinary enemy tracking.
            -- This branch intentionally follows the marker without triggering a swing.
            local markerCFrame = bubbleGetMarkerCFrame()
            if markerCFrame then
                local markerDirection = markerCFrame.Position - currentRoot.Position
                BubbleNormal.target = markerCFrame
                if _G.AdaptNormalAimbot then _G.AdaptNormalAimbot.target = markerCFrame end
                if markerDirection.Magnitude > 0.1 then
                    bubbleRotateRoot(currentRoot, markerDirection)
                end
                local markerSpeed = math.clamp(tonumber(AIMBOT_SPEED) or config.FOLLOW_SPEED, 1, 120)
                if markerDirection.Magnitude > config.MIN_FOLLOW_DISTANCE then
                    currentRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = markerDirection.Unit * markerSpeed
                else
                    currentRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(
                        0,
                        currentRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y * 0.5,
                        0
                    )
                end
                bubbleResetTarget()
                BubbleNormal.target = markerCFrame
                if _G.AdaptNormalAimbot then _G.AdaptNormalAimbot.target = markerCFrame end
                return
            end

            local targetPlayer = bubbleFindNearestTarget(currentRoot)
            local targetCharacter = targetPlayer and targetPlayer.Character
            local targetRoot = targetCharacter and targetCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local targetHumanoid = targetCharacter and targetCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if not targetRoot or not targetHumanoid or targetHumanoid.Health <= 0 then
                bubbleResetTarget()
                currentRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(
                    0,
                    currentRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y * 0.5,
                    0
                )
                return
            end

            state.targetPlayer = targetPlayer
            BubbleNormal.target = targetRoot
            if _G.AdaptNormalAimbot then
                _G.AdaptNormalAimbot.target = targetRoot
            end

            local targetCFrame = bubbleRenderCFrame(targetRoot) or targetRoot.CFrame
            local targetPosition = targetCFrame.Position
            local safeDeltaTime = math.max(tonumber(deltaTime) or 0, 1 / 240)

            -- Estimate target velocity, clamp outliers and smooth the signal.
            if state.lastTargetPos then
                local rawVelocity = (targetPosition - state.lastTargetPos) / safeDeltaTime
                local velocityDelta = rawVelocity - state.targetVelocity
                if velocityDelta.Magnitude > config.MAX_VELOCITY_CHANGE then
                    rawVelocity = state.targetVelocity
                        + velocityDelta.Unit * config.MAX_VELOCITY_CHANGE
                end

                local horizontalVelocity = Vector3.new(rawVelocity.X, 0, rawVelocity.Z)
                if horizontalVelocity.Magnitude > config.MAX_HORIZONTAL_VELOCITY then
                    horizontalVelocity = horizontalVelocity.Unit * config.MAX_HORIZONTAL_VELOCITY
                    rawVelocity = Vector3.new(horizontalVelocity.X, rawVelocity.Y, horizontalVelocity.Z)
                end

                bubblePushHistory(
                    state.accelerationHistory,
                    (rawVelocity - state.targetVelocity) / safeDeltaTime,
                    4
                )
                bubblePushHistory(state.velocityHistory, rawVelocity, 8)
                bubblePushHistory(state.verticalVelocityHistory, rawVelocity.Y, 5)
                state.targetVelocity = rawVelocity
                state.smoothedVelocity = state.smoothedVelocity:Lerp(
                    rawVelocity,
                    config.VELOCITY_SMOOTHING
                )
                if state.lastYVelocity <= 0 and rawVelocity.Y > 1 then
                    state.lastJumpTime = now
                end
                state.lastYVelocity = rawVelocity.Y
            end
            state.lastTargetPos = targetPosition

            -- Keep separate airborne velocity history for jumps and falls.
            local isAirborne = targetHumanoid.FloorMaterial == Enum.Material.Air
            state.airborneTime = isAirborne and (state.airborneTime + safeDeltaTime) or 0
            if isAirborne and state.airborneTime >= config.MIN_AIRBORNE_TIME then
                bubblePushHistory(state.aerialVelocityHistory, state.targetVelocity, 6)
            elseif not isAirborne then
                state.aerialVelocityHistory = {}
            end

            local predictionVelocity = state.smoothedVelocity
            if isAirborne and #state.aerialVelocityHistory > 0 then
                local aerialVelocity = bubbleAverageVector(state.aerialVelocityHistory)
                predictionVelocity = Vector3.new(
                    aerialVelocity.X,
                    state.targetVelocity.Y,
                    aerialVelocity.Z
                ) * config.AIR_CONTROL_FACTOR
            end

            -- Detect quick direction reversals and increase ping lead slightly.
            local quickDirectionChange = false
            local horizontalTargetVelocity = Vector3.new(
                state.targetVelocity.X,
                0,
                state.targetVelocity.Z
            )
            if horizontalTargetVelocity.Magnitude > 5 then
                local direction = horizontalTargetVelocity.Unit
                if state.previousDirection and state.previousDirection:Dot(direction) < 0.5 then
                    quickDirectionChange = now - state.lastDirectionChangeTime
                        < config.DIRECTION_CHANGE_DETECTION_TIME
                    state.lastDirectionChangeTime = now
                end
                state.previousDirection = direction
            end

            local serverDelay = state.currentPing + config.SERVER_TICKRATE
            if quickDirectionChange then
                serverDelay *= config.QUICK_DIRECTION_CHANGE_MULTIPLIER
            end

            -- Predict position using ping, smoothed velocity and acceleration.
            local averageAcceleration = bubbleAverageVector(state.accelerationHistory)
            local predictedPosition = targetPosition
                + predictionVelocity * serverDelay
                + averageAcceleration
                    * config.ACCELERATION_PREDICTION_WEIGHT
                    * serverDelay
                    * serverDelay
                    * 0.5

            local leadTime = config.PREDICTION_TIME * 1.1
            local leadPosition
            if isAirborne then
                leadPosition = predictedPosition
                    + predictionVelocity * leadTime
                    + Vector3.new(0, -0.5 * config.GRAVITY * leadTime * leadTime, 0)
            else
                leadPosition = predictedPosition + predictionVelocity * leadTime
            end

            local flatPredictionVelocity = Vector3.new(
                predictionVelocity.X,
                0,
                predictionVelocity.Z
            )
            if flatPredictionVelocity.Magnitude > 1 then
                leadPosition += flatPredictionVelocity.Unit * config.PREDICT_AHEAD
            end

            local targetDirection = leadPosition - currentRoot.Position
            bubbleRotateRoot(currentRoot, targetDirection)

            -- Swing uses the real target position and a cooldown, not the predicted point.
            local withinActivationRange = (targetPosition - currentRoot.Position).Magnitude
                <= config.ACTIVATE_DISTANCE
            if withinActivationRange and now - state.lastActivationTime >= 0.3 then
                if currentTool then
                    pcall(function() currentTool:Activate() end)
                end
                state.lastActivationTime = now
                BubbleNormal.nextSwingAt = now + 0.3
            end

            local followSpeed = bubbleSelectedSpeed()
            if targetDirection.Magnitude > config.MIN_FOLLOW_DISTANCE then
                currentRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = targetDirection.Unit * followSpeed
            else
                currentRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(
                    0,
                    currentRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y * 0.5,
                    0
                )
            end
        end)

        if _G.AdaptNormalAimbot then
            _G.AdaptNormalAimbot.conn = BubbleNormal.conn
        end
        return BubbleNormal.conn ~= nil
    end

    function stopAimbotAdapt()
        bubbleStop()
        if _G.AdaptRefreshAimbotVisual then pcall(_G.AdaptRefreshAimbotVisual) end
        if _G.AdaptRefreshMobileButtonStates then pcall(_G.AdaptRefreshMobileButtonStates) end
        return true
    end

    function startAimbotAdapt()
        if _G.AdaptSafeModeTryStart and not _G.AdaptSafeModeTryStart() then
            return false
        end
        if _G.AdaptStopAutoTPForAction then pcall(_G.AdaptStopAutoTPForAction) end
        if type(_G.__stopSpeedBoost) == "function" then pcall(_G.__stopSpeedBoost) end

        local bypassEngine = _G.SnowVS and _G.SnowVS.BatBypass
        if _G.AceAntiBypassAimbotOn == true
            or (bypassEngine and (bypassEngine.Connection or bypassEngine.Enabled == true)) then
            if type(_G.AceStopAntiBypassAimbot) == "function" then
                pcall(_G.AceStopAntiBypassAimbot, false)
            elseif bypassEngine then
                pcall(function() bypassEngine.Stop() end)
            end
        end

        selectedAimbotMode = "Normal"
        _G.AdaptAimbotMode = "Normal"
        _G.AdaptAimbotPendingMode = "Normal"
        _G.AdaptNormalAimbotOn = true
        _G.AceAntiBypassAimbotOn = false

        local started = bubbleStart(LP.Character)
        if not started then
            _G.AdaptNormalAimbotOn = false
        end
        if _G.AdaptAimbotModeSetVisual then pcall(_G.AdaptAimbotModeSetVisual, "Normal") end
        if _G.AdaptRefreshAimbotVisual then pcall(_G.AdaptRefreshAimbotVisual) end
        if _G.AdaptRefreshMobileButtonStates then pcall(_G.AdaptRefreshMobileButtonStates) end
        return started
    end

    _G.AdaptStartNormalAimbot = startAimbotAdapt
    _G.AdaptStopNormalAimbot = stopAimbotAdapt
    _G.AdaptNormalAimbotStart = startAimbotAdapt
    _G.AdaptNormalAimbotStop = stopAimbotAdapt
    _G.AdaptToggleAimbot = function()
        if _G.AdaptNormalAimbotOn == true then
            stopAimbotAdapt()
            return false
        end
        return startAimbotAdapt()
    end
    _G.AdaptFindAimbotBat = function() return bubbleFindBat(LP.Character) end
    _G.AdaptGetClosestAimbotTarget = function()
        local character = LP.Character
        local rootPart = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local targetPlayer = bubbleFindNearestTarget(rootPart)
        local targetCharacter = targetPlayer and targetPlayer.Character
        return targetCharacter and targetCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or nil
    end
    _G.AdaptGetNormalAimbotSpeed = bubbleSelectedSpeed
    _G.AdaptGetSelectedAimbotSpeedValues = function()
        return tonumber(AIMBOT_SPEED) or 58, tonumber(LAGGER_AIMBOT_SPEED) or 40
    end
    _G.AdaptSetSelectedAimbotSpeedValues = function(normalValue, laggerValue)
        if normalValue ~= nil then AIMBOT_SPEED = tonumber(normalValue) or AIMBOT_SPEED end
        if laggerValue ~= nil then LAGGER_AIMBOT_SPEED = tonumber(laggerValue) or LAGGER_AIMBOT_SPEED end
        if _G.AdaptRefreshAimbotSpeedBoxes then pcall(_G.AdaptRefreshAimbotSpeedBoxes) end
    end
    _G.AdaptRefreshAimbotSpeedBoxes = function()
        local normalValue = tonumber(AIMBOT_SPEED) or 58
        local laggerValue = tonumber(LAGGER_AIMBOT_SPEED) or 40
        if _G.AdaptAimbotSpeedBox then _G.AdaptAimbotSpeedBox.Text = tostring(normalValue) end
        if _G.AdaptLaggerAimbotSpeedBox then _G.AdaptLaggerAimbotSpeedBox.Text = tostring(laggerValue) end
    end

    if BubbleNormal.characterConnection then
        pcall(function() BubbleNormal.characterConnection:Disconnect() end)
    end
    BubbleNormal.characterConnection = LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(newCharacter)
        task.wait(0.5)
        if _G.AdaptNormalAimbotOn == true and _G.AdaptAimbotMode ~= "Bypass" then
            pcall(function() bubbleStart(newCharacter) end)
        end
    end)
end

local MIRROR_TP_DROP_THRESHOLD = 3
local MIRROR_TP_DOWN_Y = -7.00
local mirrorTPPreviousY = {}
local mirrorTPLastTeleport = 0

local function mirrorTPAimbotActive()
return _G.AdaptNormalAimbotOn == true
end

local function mirrorTPTeleportDown()
local character = LP.Character
local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if not root or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end

local now = tick()
if now - (mirrorTPLastTeleport or 0) < 0.08 then return end
mirrorTPLastTeleport = now

local _, yaw = root.CFrame:ToEulerAnglesYXZ()
local y = (MIRROR_TP_DOWN_Y or -7) + (math.random() * 0.6 - 0.3)
root.CFrame = CFrame.new(root.Position.X, y, root.Position.Z) * CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0)
root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new((math.random() - 0.5) * 0.4, 0, (math.random() - 0.5) * 0.4)
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
if not mirrorTPDownEnabled or not mirrorTPAimbotActive() then
if next(mirrorTPPreviousY) then
table.clear(mirrorTPPreviousY)
end
return
end

for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
if plr ~= LP and plr.Character then
local root = plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
if root then
local currentY = root.Position.Y
local previousY = mirrorTPPreviousY[plr.UserId]
if previousY and previousY - currentY >= (MIRROR_TP_DROP_THRESHOLD or 3) then
pcall(mirrorTPTeleportDown)
table.clear(mirrorTPPreviousY)
return
end
mirrorTPPreviousY[plr.UserId] = currentY
end
end
end
end)

function _G.AdaptSetMirrorTPDown(enabled)
mirrorTPDownEnabled = enabled == true
if not mirrorTPDownEnabled then
table.clear(mirrorTPPreviousY)
end
if _G.AdaptMirrorTPDownSetVisual then
_G.AdaptMirrorTPDownSetVisual(mirrorTPDownEnabled)
end
end


-- ============================================================
-- TP BAT V1 — RETAINED SPACE TP BAT LOGIC
-- V1 is the retained TP Bat mode.
-- Camera Lock uses the Ambitious raw-target/Anti-Void flow.
-- ============================================================
_G.AdaptTPBatMode = (_G.AdaptTPBatMode == "V2") and "V2" or "V1"

_G.AdaptTPBatV1 = _G.AdaptTPBatV1 or {
    enabled = false,
    target = nil,
    conn = nil,
    swingBusy = false,
    buttonOnlyOn = (_G.AdaptTPBatMode == "V1" and _G.AdaptTPBatPendingEnabled == true) or false,
}
_G.AdaptAmbitiousCameraLock = _G.AdaptAmbitiousCameraLock or {
    enabled = _G.AdaptCameraLockPendingEnabled == true,
    target = nil,
    conn = nil,
}
-- When this script is re-executed, an old _G table must not override the
-- state just read from the saved config. Replace stale camera connections too.
if _G.AdaptCameraLockPendingEnabled ~= nil then
    _G.AdaptAmbitiousCameraLock.enabled = _G.AdaptCameraLockPendingEnabled == true
end
if _G.AdaptAmbitiousCameraLock.conn then
    pcall(function() _G.AdaptAmbitiousCameraLock.conn:Disconnect() end)
    _G.AdaptAmbitiousCameraLock.conn = nil
end
_G.AdaptTPBatPendingEnabled = nil
_G.AdaptTPBatPendingMode = nil
_G.AdaptCameraLockPendingEnabled = nil

local function _tpbatRoot(character)
    return character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

local function _tpbatHumanoid(character)
    return character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
end

local function _tpbatBat()
    local character = LP.Character
    if not character then return nil end
    local bat = character:FindFirstChild("Bat")
    if bat and bat:IsA("Tool") then return bat end
    local backpack = LP:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
    bat = backpack and backpack:FindFirstChild("Bat")
    if bat and bat:IsA("Tool") then
        pcall(function() bat.Parent = character end)
        return bat
    end
    return nil
end

local function _tpbatValidPlayer(player)
    if not player or player == LP or not player.Parent then return false end
    if not player.Character then return false end
    local hum = player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return false end
    local root = player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    return root ~= nil
end

-- Exact Space source behavior: nearest valid enemy inside 250 studs.
local function _tpbatNearest()
    local myRoot = _tpbatRoot(LP.Character)
    if not myRoot then return nil end
    local closest, bestDist = nil, 250
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if _tpbatValidPlayer(player) then
            local root = player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local dist = (root.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude
            if dist < bestDist then
                bestDist = dist
                closest = player
            end
        end
    end
    return closest
end

local function _tpbatSwing(state)
    if state.swingBusy then return end
    state.swingBusy = true
    pcall(function()
        local bat = _tpbatBat()
        if bat then
            bat:Activate()
            local remoteEvent = bat:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("RemoteEvent")
            if remoteEvent then remoteEvent:FireServer() end
        end
    end)
    task.delay(0.08, function()
        if state then state.swingBusy = false end
    end)
end

-- TP Bat V1: selector-only dummy mode. It never starts an engine.
local function _tpbatV1Frame()
    -- V1 is intentionally a selector-only dummy. No TP engine runs.
    return nil
end

do
    -- ============================================================
    -- TP Bat engine: V1 executable core.
    -- Smart Bat TP is not started by the TP Bat toggle.
    -- ============================================================
    local localPlayer = LP
    local tbl36 = { batTp = nil }

    -- Compatibility hooks used by the original VX7 Bat TP core.
    -- La Peak's own UI/state continues to be the public controller.
    local Config = {
        batTpEnabled = false,
        batTpVersion = "V1",
        batTpStuds = 8,
        batTpStudsV1 = 8,
        batTpMaxRange = 350,
        batTpV1RotateSpeed = 514.2857,
        batTpV1RotatePhase = 0,
        batTpCameraSwimSpeed = 1.0,

    			end

    				or (

    		tbl40.tint = function(arg, color)
    			for i, descendant in ipairs(arg:GetDescendants()) do
    				if descendant:IsA("BasePart") and (descendant:GetAttribute("VX7GhostBody")) then
    					descendant.Color = color
    				elseif descendant.Name == "VX7GhostGlow" and (descendant:IsA("Highlight")) then
    					descendant.FillColor = color
    					descendant.OutlineColor = color
    				elseif descendant.Name == "VX7GhostCardStroke" and (descendant:IsA("UIStroke")) then
    					descendant.Color = color
    				elseif descendant.Name == "VX7GhostCardAccent" and (descendant:IsA("Frame")) then
    					descendant.BackgroundColor3 = color
    				elseif descendant.Name == "VX7GhostStatus" and (descendant:IsA("TextLabel")) then
    					descendant.TextColor3 = color
    				elseif descendant.Name == "VX7GhostCardGradient" and (descendant:IsA("UIGradient")) then
    					descendant.Color = ColorSequence.new({
    						ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, color:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.82)),
    						ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.58, color:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.65)),
    						ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, color),
    					})
    				end
    			end
    		end
    		tbl40.show = function(arg)
    			local snapshot, v33 = tbl40.snapshot, arg and tbl40.trust[arg]
    			if not tbl40.snapshotIsSafe(snapshot) or snapshot.player ~= arg or not v33 or not v33.threatActive then
    				tbl40.destroy()
    				return nil
    			end
    			v33 = tbl40.color()
    			if not tbl40.model then
    				local model = Instance.new("Model")
    				model.Name = "VX7_BatTP_LastPosition"
    				for i, v34 in ipairs(snapshot.parts or {}) do
    					local clone = v34.template and (v34.template:Clone()) or nil
    					if clone then
    						clone.Name = v34.name or "GhostPart" .. i
    						clone.Color = v33
    						clone.CFrame = snapshot.rootCFrame * v34.relative
    						clone:SetAttribute("VX7GhostBody", true)
    						clone:SetAttribute("VX7GhostIndex", i)
    						clone.Parent = model
    					end
    				end
    				local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
    				highlight.Name = "VX7GhostGlow"
    				highlight.Adornee = model
    				highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
    				highlight.FillColor = v33
    				highlight.FillTransparency = 0.76
    				highlight.OutlineColor = v33
    				highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0.12
    				pcall(function()
    					highlight:SetAttribute("VX7ESP", true)
    				end)
    				highlight.Parent = model
    				tbl40.decorate(model, arg, snapshot, v33)
    				model.Parent = workspace
    				tbl40.model = model
    			else
    				for i, child in ipairs(tbl40.model:GetChildren()) do
    					if child:IsA("BasePart") then
    						i = child:GetAttribute("VX7GhostIndex")
    						local parts = i and snapshot.parts and snapshot.parts[i]
    						if parts then
    							child.CFrame = snapshot.rootCFrame * parts.relative
    						elseif child.Name == "VX7GhostLabelAnchor" then
    							child.CFrame = CFrame.new(snapshot.position + Vector3.new(0, 3.15, 0))
    						end
    					end
    				end
    				tbl40.tint(tbl40.model, v33)
    			end
    			return snapshot.position
    		end

    		tbl40.monitorStep = function()
    			if Config.batTpEnabled or Config._smartBatTpDriving then
    				return
    			end
    			local v33 = tbl40.activeThreatPlayer() or (fn52())
    			local character2 = v33 and v33.Character
    			local humanoidRootPart2, humanoid2 =
    				character2 and (character2:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")),
    				character2 and (character2:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"))
    			if not humanoidRootPart2 or not humanoid2 or humanoid2.Health <= 0 then
    				tbl40.destroy()
    				return
    			end
    			local v34, flag6, v35 =
    				tbl40.actualRootIsSafe(humanoidRootPart2, character2), fn57(humanoidRootPart2, character2)
    			humanoid2 = not v34 or flag6
    			flag6 = tbl40.positionSpiked(v33, humanoidRootPart2, character2, humanoid2)
    			if v35 and v34 and (tbl40.useKnownProxyAnchor(v33, humanoidRootPart2, character2)) then
    				flag6, humanoid2 = false, false
    			end
    			if v34 and not tbl40.applyThreatLatch(v33, humanoidRootPart2, character2, flag6, humanoid2) then
    				tbl40.trackSafeAnchor(v33, humanoidRootPart2, character2)
    				tbl40.remember(v33, humanoidRootPart2)
    				tbl40.destroy()
    			elseif tbl40.activeThreatPlayer() == v33 then
    				v35 = tbl40.trust[v33]
    				if v35 and os.clock() < (v35.tpDownVisualGraceUntil or 0) then
    					tbl40.destroy()
    				else
    					tbl40.show(v33)
    				end
    			else
    				tbl40.destroy()
    			end
    		end
    		tbl40.monitorConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime)
    			tbl40.monitorElapsed = (tbl40.monitorElapsed or 0) + deltaTime
    			if tbl40.monitorElapsed < 0.016666666666666666 then
    				return
    			end
    			tbl40.monitorElapsed = 0
    			pcall(tbl40.monitorStep)
    		end)
