    		function Config._btpVx7GetBat()
    			local character2 = localPlayer.Character
    			if not character2 then
    				return nil
    			end
    			local bat = character2:FindFirstChild("Bat")
    			if bat then
    				return bat
    			end
    			local backpack = localPlayer:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
    			bat = backpack and (backpack:FindFirstChild("Bat"))
    			if bat then
    				bat.Parent = character2
    				return bat
    			end
    			return nil
    		end
    		Config._antiDieSystem = {
    			enabled = false,
    			loop = nil,
    			healthConn = nil,
    			charConn = nil,
    			lastHealTime = 0,
    			invincibleUntil = 0,
    			config = {
    				healthThreshold = 50,
    				invincibilityFrames = 0.75,
    				fallDamageProtection = false,
    				ragdollProtection = true,
    				autoRevive = true,
    			},
    		}
    		function Config._antiDieSuperHeal(arg)
    			if not arg or not arg.Parent then
    				return
    			end
    			local maxHealth = arg.MaxHealth or 100
    			if maxHealth <= 0 then
    				maxHealth = 100
    			end
    			pcall(function()
    				arg.Health = maxHealth
    				if arg.MaxHealth < maxHealth then
    					arg.MaxHealth = maxHealth
    				end
    			end)
    			local antiDieSystem = Config._antiDieSystem
    			antiDieSystem.invincibleUntil = os.clock() + antiDieSystem.config.invincibilityFrames
    			antiDieSystem.lastHealTime = os.clock()
    			pcall(function()
    				local parent = arg.Parent
    				if not parent then
    					return
    				end
    				for i, child in ipairs(parent:GetChildren()) do
    					if child:IsA("NumberValue") then
    						i = child.Name:lower()
    						if i:find("health") or (i:find("hp")) or (i:find("life")) then
    							child.Value = maxHealth
    						end
    					end
    					if child:IsA("BoolValue") and (child.Name:lower():find("dead")) then
    						child.Value = false
    					end
    				end
    			end)
    		end
    		function Config._antiDieAutoRevive()
    			if not Config._antiDieSystem.config.autoRevive then
    				return
    			end
    			local character2 = localPlayer.Character
    			local humanoid2, humanoidRootPart2 =
    				character2 and (character2:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")),
    				character2 and (character2:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
    			if not humanoid2 or humanoid2.Health > 0 then
    				return
    			end
    			Config._antiDieSuperHeal(humanoid2)
    			if Config.batTpEnabled or Config._smartBatTpDriving then
    				return
    			end
    			pcall(function()
    				humanoid2:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
    				humanoid2:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running)
    			end)
    			if humanoidRootPart2 then
    				pcall(function()
    					humanoidRootPart2.CFrame = CFrame.new(humanoidRootPart2.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
    					humanoidRootPart2.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
    				end)
    			end
    		end
    		function Config._antiDiePreventDamage(arg, arg2)
    			if not arg2 then
    				return
    			end
    			local antiDieSystem, maxHealth, batTpEnabled =
    				Config._antiDieSystem, arg2.MaxHealth or 100, Config.batTpEnabled or Config._smartBatTpDriving
    			if arg2.Health < maxHealth then
    				Config._antiDieSuperHeal(arg2)
    			end
    			if os.clock() < antiDieSystem.invincibleUntil and arg2.Health < maxHealth then
    				arg2.Health = maxHealth
    			end
    			if antiDieSystem.config.ragdollProtection and not batTpEnabled then
    				maxHealth = arg2:GetState()
    				if
    					maxHealth == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics
    					or maxHealth == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll
    					or maxHealth == Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown
    					or maxHealth == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead
    				then
    					pcall(function()
    						arg2:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
    						arg2:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running)
    					end)
    					Config._antiDieSuperHeal(arg2)
    					if arg then
    						pcall(function()
    							arg.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
    						end)
    					end
    				end
    			end
    			if arg2.Health <= 0 then
    				Config._antiDieSuperHeal(arg2)
    				if batTpEnabled then
    					return
    				end
    				pcall(function()
    					arg2:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
    					arg2:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running)
    				end)
    				if arg then
    					pcall(function()
    						arg.CFrame = CFrame.new(arg.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0))
    						arg.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
    					end)
    				end
    			end
    		end
    		function Config._btpV1AntiDieStop(arg)
    			if arg == false and Config.duelAntiDieEnabled then
    				return
    			end
    			arg = Config._antiDieSystem
    			arg.enabled = false
    			if arg.loop then
    				arg.loop:Disconnect()
    				arg.loop = nil
    			end
    			if arg.healthConn then
    				arg.healthConn:Disconnect()
    				arg.healthConn = nil
    			end
    			if arg.charConn then
    				arg.charConn:Disconnect()
    				arg.charConn = nil
    			end
    		end
    		function Config._btpV1AntiDieStart()
    			if not Config.duelAntiDieEnabled or Config._instaResetInProgress then
    				Config._btpV1AntiDieStop(true)
    				return
    			end
    			Config._btpV1AntiDieStop(true)
    			local antiDieSystem = Config._antiDieSystem
    			antiDieSystem.enabled = true
    			local function fn61(arg)
    				if antiDieSystem.healthConn then
    					antiDieSystem.healthConn:Disconnect()
    					antiDieSystem.healthConn = nil
    				end
    				local humanoid2 = arg and (arg:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"))
    				if not humanoid2 and arg then
    					humanoid2 = arg:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 3)
    				end
    				if not humanoid2 then
    					return
    				end
    				antiDieSystem.healthConn = humanoid2:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Health"):Connect(function()
    					if not antiDieSystem.enabled or not Config.duelAntiDieEnabled then
    						return
    					end
    					if humanoid2.Health < (humanoid2.MaxHealth or 100) then
    						Config._antiDieSuperHeal(humanoid2)
    					end
    					if humanoid2.Health <= 0 then
    						Config._antiDieAutoRevive()
    					end
    				end)
    				if humanoid2.Health < (humanoid2.MaxHealth or 100) then
    					Config._antiDieSuperHeal(humanoid2)
    				end
    			end
    			antiDieSystem.loop = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    				if not antiDieSystem.enabled or not Config.duelAntiDieEnabled or Config._instaResetInProgress then
    					return
    				end
    				local character2 = localPlayer.Character
    				local humanoid2, humanoidRootPart2 =
    					character2 and (character2:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")),
    					character2 and (character2:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
    				if not humanoid2 then
    					return
    				end
    				if humanoid2.Health <= 0 then
    					Config._antiDieAutoRevive()
    				elseif
    					humanoid2.Health <= antiDieSystem.config.healthThreshold
    					or humanoid2.Health < (humanoid2.MaxHealth or 100)
    				then
    					Config._antiDieSuperHeal(humanoid2)
    				end
    				Config._antiDiePreventDamage(humanoidRootPart2, humanoid2)
    			end)
    			if localPlayer.Character then
    				fn61(localPlayer.Character)
    			end
    			antiDieSystem.charConn = localPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character2)
    				if not antiDieSystem.enabled or not Config.duelAntiDieEnabled then
    					return
    				end
    				task.wait(0.05)
    				fn61(character2)
    				local humanoid2 = character2:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    				if humanoid2 then
    					Config._antiDieSuperHeal(humanoid2)
    				end
    			end)
    		end
    		function Config._setDuelAntiDieProtection(arg)

    		end

    				or n18 == Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown
    			if position then
    				if sethiddenproperty then

    			if btpFlightSafety.wasAirborne and not batTpEnabled then

    					Vector3.new(n18.X, 0, n18.Z), humanoidRootPart2.AssemblyAngularVelocity

    					end

    						(if vector.Magnitude > 55 then vector.Unit * 55 else vector).X,
    						math.clamp(n18.Y, -25, 25),
    						(if vector.Magnitude > 55 then vector.Unit * 55 else vector).Z
    					)

    					humanoidRootPart2.Anchored = false
    					humanoid2.PlatformStand = false
    					humanoid2.Sit = false
    					pcall(function()
    						humanoid2:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
    					end)
    					Config._btpLandingGuardUntil = now + 0.08
    				end
    			end
    			btpFlightSafety.wasAirborne = batTpEnabled
    			if not batTpEnabled and not position and humanoidRootPart2.CFrame.UpVector.Y > 0.65 then
    				btpFlightSafety.lastGroundCFrame = humanoidRootPart2.CFrame
    			end
    		end)
    		Config._btpStability = { badSince = nil, recoveryUntil = 0, releaseToken = 0, lastFix = 0 }
    		function Config._btpRecoverStability(arg)
    			local character2 = localPlayer.Character
    			local humanoidRootPart2, humanoid2 =
    				character2 and (character2:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")),
    				character2 and (character2:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"))
    			if not humanoidRootPart2 or not humanoid2 or humanoid2.Health <= 0 then
    				return false
    			end
    			local batTpEnabled = Config.batTpEnabled or Config._smartBatTpDriving
    			if batTpEnabled then
    				return false
    			end
    			if arg and sethiddenproperty then
    				pcall(sethiddenproperty, humanoidRootPart2, "PhysicsRepRootPart", nil)
    			end
    			arg = humanoid2:GetState()
    			local platformStand, flag6 =
    				humanoid2.PlatformStand
    					or arg == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics
    					or arg == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll
    					or not batTpEnabled and arg == Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown,
    				not batTpEnabled
    			arg = flag6 and humanoidRootPart2.CFrame.UpVector.Y < 0.55
    			if not platformStand and not arg then
    				return false
    			end
    			local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
    			raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    			raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { character2 }
    			raycastParams.IgnoreWater = true
    			pcall(function()
    				raycastParams.RespectCanCollide = true
    			end)
    			character2 = workspace:Raycast(
    				humanoidRootPart2.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0),
    				Vector3.new(0, -5, 0),
    				raycastParams
    			)
    			if not humanoid2.PlatformStand and not character2 then
    				return false
    			end
    			if flag6 and sethiddenproperty then
    				pcall(sethiddenproperty, humanoidRootPart2, "PhysicsRepRootPart", nil)
    			end
    			humanoidRootPart2.Anchored = false
    			humanoidRootPart2.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
    			character2 = humanoidRootPart2.AssemblyLinearVelocity
    			if flag6 then
    				humanoidRootPart2.AssemblyLinearVelocity =
    					Vector3.new(character2.X, math.max(character2.Y, 0), character2.Z)
    			end
    			if arg and not batTpEnabled then
    				flag6 = humanoidRootPart2.CFrame.LookVector
    				platformStand = Vector3.new(flag6.X, 0, flag6.Z)
    				if platformStand.Magnitude < 0.05 then
    					character2 = workspace.CurrentCamera
    					flag6 = character2 and character2.CFrame.LookVector or (Vector3.new(0, 0, -1))
    					platformStand = (Vector3.new(flag6.X, 0, flag6.Z))
    				end
    				platformStand = platformStand.Magnitude > 0.05 and platformStand.Unit or (Vector3.new(0, 0, -1))
    				humanoidRootPart2.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(
    					humanoidRootPart2.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.35, 0),
    					humanoidRootPart2.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.35, 0) + platformStand
    				)
    			end
    			humanoid2.PlatformStand = false
    			humanoid2.Sit = false
    			humanoid2.AutoRotate = true
    			pcall(function()
    				humanoid2:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
    			end)
    			Config._btpStability.lastFix = os.clock()
    			Config._btpStability.badSince = nil
    			return true
    		end
    		function Config._btpBeginRelease()
    			local btpStability = Config._btpStability

    			btpStability.recoveryUntil = os.clock() + 0.75

    			Config._btpRecoverStability(true)
    			local tbl41 = { 0.03, 0.12, 0.3 }
    			for i, v33 in ipairs(tbl41) do
    				task.delay(v33, function()
    					if
    						releaseToken ~= btpStability.releaseToken
    						or Config.batTpEnabled
    						or Config._smartBatTpDriving
    					then
    						return
    					end
    					Config._btpRecoverStability(true)
    				end)
    			end
    		end

    			if Config._instaResetInProgress then
    				return
    			end
    			local btpStability, now = Config._btpStability, os.clock()
    			if not Config.batTpEnabled and not Config._smartBatTpDriving and now > btpStability.recoveryUntil then
    				btpStability.badSince = nil
    				return
    			end

    				character2 and (character2:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")),
    				character2 and (character2:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"))

    				btpStability.badSince = nil
    				return
    			end
    			local state, batTpEnabled = humanoid2:GetState(), Config.batTpEnabled or Config._smartBatTpDriving
    			if batTpEnabled then
    				btpStability.badSince = nil
    				return
    			end
    			local platformStand, flag6 =
    				humanoid2.PlatformStand
    					or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics
    					or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll
    					or not batTpEnabled and state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown,
    				not batTpEnabled and humanoidRootPart2.CFrame.UpVector.Y < 0.55
    			if not platformStand and not flag6 then
    				btpStability.badSince = nil
    				return
    			end
    			btpStability.badSince = btpStability.badSince or now
    			if now - btpStability.badSince >= 0.14 and now - (btpStability.lastFix or 0) >= 0.18 then
    				Config._btpRecoverStability(not Config.batTpEnabled and not Config._smartBatTpDriving)
    			end
    		end)

    			end

    			end
    		end

    		function Config._btpFindClosestPlayer(arg, arg2, arg3)
    			local huge = math.huge
    			if not arg then
    				return nil, math.huge
    			end
    			local n18 = math.max(tonumber(Config.batTpMaxRange) or 350, 25)
    			local n19, v33 = n18 * 1.15
    			for i, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
    				if player ~= localPlayer and player.Character then
    					local humanoidRootPart2, humanoid2 =
    						player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"),
    						player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    					if humanoidRootPart2 and humanoid2 and humanoid2.Health > 0 then
    						i = (arg - humanoidRootPart2.Position).Magnitude
    						if i <= n18 then

    									fn57(humanoidRootPart2, player.Character), fn57(humanoidRootPart2, player.Character)
    								if v34 and not v36 then
    									continue

    								if not tbl40.actualRootIsSafe(humanoidRootPart2, player.Character) then
    									continue
    								end
    							end
    							if i < huge then
    								huge, v33 = i, player
    							end
    						end
    					end
    				end
    			end
    			if v33 and arg3 and arg3 ~= v33 and arg3.Parent == Players and arg3.Character then
    				arg2, n18 =
    					arg3.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"), arg3.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    				if arg2 and n18 and n18.Health > 0 then
    					local magnitude = (arg - arg2.Position).Magnitude
    					if magnitude <= n19 and magnitude <= huge * 1.35 then

    					end
    				end
    			end
    			return v33, huge
    		end

                or Config.batTpVersion ~= "V1"
                or _G.AdaptTPBatMode ~= "V1" then

    				or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll

    				return
    			end

    				Config._btpV1PreviousAutoRotate = humanoid2.AutoRotate
    			end
    			-- V1 TP Bat: keep the retained camera-follow behavior,
			-- but do not rotate the character with the target or camera.

    			if not character2:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool") then
    				fn60()
    			end
    			state = Config._btpVx7V1Target
    			character2 = state and state.Parent == Players and state.Character
    			local humanoidRootPart3, humanoid3 =
    				character2 and (character2:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")),
    				character2 and (character2:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"))
    			character2 = not humanoidRootPart3 or not humanoid3
    			state = tbl40.activeThreatPlayer()
    				or (
    					if character2 or humanoid3.Health <= 0
    						then (Config._btpV3ClosestTarget(humanoidRootPart2))
    						else state
    				)
    			Config._btpVx7V1Target = state
    			humanoid2 = state and state.Character
    			humanoid3, humanoidRootPart3 =
    				humanoid2 and (humanoid2:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")),
    				humanoid2 and (humanoid2:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"))
    			if not humanoid3 or not humanoidRootPart3 or humanoidRootPart3.Health <= 0 then
    				return
    			end
    			local v33, flag6, position = tbl40.actualRootIsSafe(humanoid3, humanoid2), fn57(humanoid3, humanoid2)
    			flag6 = v33 and flag6
    			character2 = v33 and (tbl40.positionSpiked(state, humanoid3, humanoid2, flag6))
    			if position and v33 and (tbl40.useKnownProxyAnchor(state, humanoid3, humanoid2)) then
    				flag6, character2 = false, false
    			end
    			character2 = tbl40.applyThreatLatch(state, humanoid3, humanoid2, character2, not v33 or flag6)
    			position, v33 = tbl40.aggressiveLivePosition(state, humanoid3, humanoid2, flag6, character2, false)
    			position = position and (fn53(state, position)) or nil
    			if position then
    				if v33 then
    					tbl40.trackSafeAnchor(state, humanoid3, humanoid2)
    					tbl40.remember(state, humanoid3)
    				end
    			else
    				character2 = tbl40.safeAnchors[state]
    				position = character2 and character2.character == humanoid2 and character2.position or nil
    			end
    			if not position or not tbl40.snapshotIsSafe({ position = position }) then
    				return
    			end
    			if v33 then
    				tbl40.destroy()
    			end
    			local n18, n19 =
    				CFrame.new(position) * (humanoid3.CFrame - humanoid3.Position), position + Vector3.new(0, 0.9, 0)
    			character2 = (humanoidRootPart2.Position - n19).Magnitude > Config._getBatTpStuds("V2")
    			flag6, humanoid2 = character2 and n19 or humanoidRootPart2.Position, humanoidRootPart3:GetState()
    			local flag7, assemblyLinearVelocity, vector =
    				character2
    					and (humanoidRootPart3.FloorMaterial == Enum.Material.Air or humanoid2 == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping or humanoid2 == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall)
    					and n19.Y > humanoidRootPart2.Position.Y + 1,
    				humanoid3.AssemblyLinearVelocity,
    				Vector3.new(n19.X - flag6.X, 0, n19.Z - flag6.Z)
    			-- Follow the LIVE camera direction. This means Shift Lock / camera lock
			-- immediately determines the character's yaw instead of a config yaw.
			currentCamera = workspace.CurrentCamera
			local cameraLook = currentCamera and currentCamera.CFrame.LookVector or humanoidRootPart2.CFrame.LookVector
			local cameraFlat = Vector3.new(cameraLook.X, 0, cameraLook.Z)
			local cframe
			if cameraFlat.Magnitude > 0.001 then
				cframe = CFrame.lookAt(flag6, flag6 + cameraFlat.Unit)
			else
				cframe = CFrame.new(flag6) * (humanoidRootPart2.CFrame - humanoidRootPart2.Position)
			end
			if character2 then
    				pcall(function()
    					humanoidRootPart2.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
    					humanoidRootPart2.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
    					fn62(humanoidRootPart2, cframe)

    					end
    					humanoidRootPart2.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
    				end)
    			else
    				if humanoidRootPart2.CFrame.LookVector:Dot(cframe.LookVector) < 0.985 then
    					pcall(function()
    						fn62(humanoidRootPart2, cframe)
    					end)
    				end
    				pcall(function()
    					humanoidRootPart2.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
    					humanoidRootPart2.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
    				end)
    			end
                position = os.clock()
    			if position >= (Config._btpVx7V1NextSwingAt or 0) then
    				Config._btpVx7V1NextSwingAt = position + 0.04

    						Config._btpBatRemoteBat = v34

    					end
    					v34:Activate()

    					end

    			end
