    local cards={}
    local previewCache={}
    local function previewImage(skin)
        if skin.image then return skin.image end
        if skin.ids and skin.ids[1] then return "rbxthumb://type=Asset&id="..tostring(skin.ids[1]).."&w=420&h=420" end
        return ""
    end
    local function clearPreview(viewport)
        for _,c in ipairs(viewport:GetChildren()) do pcall(function() c:Destroy() end) end
        viewport.CurrentCamera=nil
    end
    local function clonePreviewCharacter()
        local character=LP.Character
        if not character then return nil end
        local oldArchivable=character.Archivable
        character.Archivable=true
        local ok,result=pcall(function() return character:Clone() end)
        character.Archivable=oldArchivable
        if not ok or not result then return nil end
        for _,d in ipairs(result:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsA("Script") or d:IsA("LocalScript") or d:IsA("ModuleScript") or d.Name=="Animate" or d:IsA("Tool") or d:IsA("ForceField") or d:IsA("LinearVelocity") or d:IsA("AlignPosition") or d:IsA("AngularVelocity") or d:IsA("BillboardGui") or d:IsA("SurfaceGui") or d:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or d:IsA("Trail") or d:IsA("Highlight") then
                pcall(function() d:Destroy() end)
            elseif d:IsA("BasePart") then
                d.Anchored=true; d.CanCollide=false; d.CanQuery=false; d.CanTouch=false
            end
        end
        local hum=result:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum then
            hum.DisplayDistanceType=Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
            pcall(function() for _,tr in ipairs(hum:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do tr:Stop() end end)
            local animator=hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
            if animator then pcall(function() animator:Destroy() end) end
        end
        return result
    end
    local function clearWearables(model)
        for _,child in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do
            if child:IsA("Accessory") or child:IsA("Accoutrement") or child:IsA("Shirt") or child:IsA("Pants") or child:IsA("ShirtGraphic") or child:IsA("CharacterMesh") then
                pcall(function() child:Destroy() end)
            end
        end
    end
    local function attachPreviewAssets(model,ids)
        for _,id in ipairs(ids or {}) do
            local ok,objs=pcall(function() return game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://"..tostring(id)) end)
            if ok and type(objs)=="table" then
                for _,obj in ipairs(objs) do
                    if obj:IsA("Accessory") or obj:IsA("Accoutrement") then
                        local handle=obj:FindFirstChild("Handle")
                        if handle then
                            local att=handle:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Attachment")
                            local targetPart,targetAtt
                            if att then
                                for _,part in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do
                                    if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                                        local a=part:FindFirstChild(att.Name)
                                        if a then targetPart,targetAtt=part,a; break end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                            targetPart=targetPart or model:FindFirstChild("Head") or model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                            if targetPart then
                                if targetAtt and att then handle.CFrame=targetAtt.WorldCFrame*att.CFrame:Inverse() else handle.CFrame=targetPart.CFrame end
                                local weld=Instance.new("WeldConstraint"); weld.Part0=handle; weld.Part1=targetPart; weld.Parent=handle
                                handle.Anchored=true; handle.CanCollide=false
                                obj.Parent=model
                            else pcall(function() obj:Destroy() end) end
                        else pcall(function() obj:Destroy() end) end
                    elseif obj:IsA("Shirt") or obj:IsA("Pants") or obj:IsA("ShirtGraphic") then
                        local old=model:FindFirstChildOfClass(obj.ClassName); if old then old:Destroy() end
                        obj.Parent=model
                    else pcall(function() obj:Destroy() end) end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    local function hidePreviewPart(model,name)
        local p=model:FindFirstChild(name)
        if p and p:IsA("BasePart") then p.Transparency=1 end
    end
    local function applyPreviewSkin(model,index)
        local skin=VX7Skins[index] or VX7Skins[1]
        if skin.kind=="katana" or skin.kind=="custom" then
            -- VX7's first two entries are original/custom visual variants.
            clearWearables(model)
            local headPart=model:FindFirstChild("Head"); if headPart then headPart.Transparency=1 end
            local texture=skin.image or "rbxassetid://159454286"
            for _,name in ipairs({"UpperTorso","LowerTorso","Torso"}) do
                local torso=model:FindFirstChild(name)
                if torso then
                    local d1=Instance.new("Decal"); d1.Texture=texture; d1.Face=Enum.NormalId.Front; d1.Parent=torso
                    local d2=Instance.new("Decal"); d2.Texture=texture; d2.Face=Enum.NormalId.Back; d2.Parent=torso
                end
            end
            return
        end
        clearWearables(model)
        attachPreviewAssets(model,skin.ids)
        if skin.headless or skin.hideHead then
            hidePreviewPart(model,"Head")
            local h=model:FindFirstChild("Head"); if h then for _,d in ipairs(h:GetDescendants()) do if d:IsA("Decal") or d:IsA("Texture") then d.Transparency=1 end end end
        end
        if skin.hideLeft then for _,n in ipairs({"LeftUpperLeg","LeftLowerLeg","LeftFoot","Left Leg"}) do hidePreviewPart(model,n) end end
        if skin.hideRight then for _,n in ipairs({"RightUpperLeg","RightLowerLeg","RightFoot","Right Leg"}) do hidePreviewPart(model,n) end end
    end
    local function putPreview(viewport,index)
        clearPreview(viewport)
        local model=previewCache[index]
        if model and model.Parent then
            model=model:Clone()
        else
            model=clonePreviewCharacter()
            if not model then return end
            applyPreviewSkin(model,index)
            previewCache[index]=model:Clone()
        end
        local world=Instance.new("WorldModel"); world.Name="PreviewWorld"; world.Parent=viewport
        model.Name="OutfitPreview"; model.Parent=world; model:PivotTo(CFrame.new())
        local box,size=model:GetBoundingBox()
        local cam=Instance.new("Camera"); cam.FieldOfView=28; cam.Parent=viewport; viewport.CurrentCamera=cam
        local focus=box.Position+Vector3.new(0,size.Y*0.03,0)
        local dist=math.max(size.Y*2.2,size.X*2.6)
        cam.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(focus+Vector3.new(0,0,-dist),focus)
    end

            c.stroke.Thickness=on and 1.8 or 0.7
            c.card.BackgroundColor3=on and Color3.fromRGB(38,25,48) or COLORS.row
            c.check.Visible=on
        end
    end

        local image=Instance.new("ImageLabel",card); image.Name="SkinThumbnail"; image.Size=placeholder.Size; image.Position=placeholder.Position; image.BackgroundTransparency=1; image.BorderSizePixel=0; image.Image=previewImage(skin); image.ScaleType=Enum.ScaleType.Crop; image.ZIndex=224; corner(image,9)
        local viewport=Instance.new("ViewportFrame",card); viewport.Name="OutfitViewport"; viewport.Size=placeholder.Size; viewport.Position=placeholder.Position; viewport.BackgroundTransparency=1; viewport.BorderSizePixel=0; viewport.ZIndex=225; corner(viewport,9)
        local name=Instance.new("TextLabel",card); name.BackgroundTransparency=1; name.Size=UDim2.new(1,-12,0,18); name.Position=UDim2.new(0,6,0,96); name.Text=skin.name; name.TextColor3=COLORS.white; name.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold; name.TextSize=9; name.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left; name.ZIndex=226
        local desc=Instance.new("TextLabel",card); desc.BackgroundTransparency=1; desc.Size=UDim2.new(1,-12,0,12); desc.Position=UDim2.new(0,6,0,114); desc.Text=skin.sub; desc.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(170,170,180); desc.Font=Enum.Font.GothamMedium; desc.TextSize=7; desc.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left; desc.ZIndex=226
        local check=Instance.new("TextLabel",card); check.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(24,18); check.Position=UDim2.new(1,-29,0,11); check.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(220,150,255); check.BorderSizePixel=0; check.Text="ON"; check.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(20,10,25); check.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold; check.TextSize=8; check.ZIndex=227; check.Visible=false; corner(check,9)
        cards[i]={card=card,stroke=st,check=check,viewport=viewport}
        card.Activated:Connect(function()
            VX7SkinConfig.selected = i
            _G.LaPeakVX7SkinSelection = i
            vx7SaveSkinConfig()
            if VX7SkinConfig.enabled then vx7ApplyCharacter() end -- apply selected skin immediately
            refreshCards(); pcall(function() putPreview(viewport,i) end)
        end)
    end

    local previewRunning=false
    local previewConn
    local function startPreviewRotation()
        if previewRunning then return end
        previewRunning=true
        previewConn=RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
            if not gallery.Visible then return end
            for _,c in ipairs(cards) do
                local world=c.viewport and c.viewport:FindFirstChildOfClass("WorldModel")
                local model=world and world:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Model",true)
                if model then pcall(function() model:PivotTo(model:GetPivot()*CFrame.Angles(0,math.rad(22*math.clamp(dt,0,0.1)),0)) end) end
            end
        end)
    end
    local function stopPreviewRotation()
        previewRunning=false
        if previewConn then pcall(function() previewConn:Disconnect() end); previewConn=nil end
    end

    local dragging=false; local dragStart; local startPos; local dragInput
    head.InputBegan:Connect(function(input) if input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then dragging=true; dragStart=input.Position; startPos=gallery.Position end end)
    head.InputChanged:Connect(function(input) if input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then dragInput=input end end)
    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input) if dragging and input==dragInput then local d=input.Position-dragStart; gallery.Position=UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale,startPos.X.Offset+d.X,startPos.Y.Scale,startPos.Y.Offset+d.Y) end end)
    UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input) if input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then dragging=false end end)
    local function setGallery(open)
        gallery.Visible=open
        if open then
            gallery.Position=UDim2.new(0.5,0,0.5,0)
            galleryScale.Scale=getGalleryScale()
            refreshCards()
            startPreviewRotation()
            task.spawn(function()
                for i,c in ipairs(cards) do
                    if not gallery.Visible then break end
                    pcall(function() putPreview(c.viewport,i) end)
                    task.wait(0.12)
                end
            end)
        else
            stopPreviewRotation()
        end
    end
    vx7SkinOpen.Activated:Connect(function() setGallery(true) end)
    close.Activated:Connect(function() setGallery(false) end)

    -- Separate persistent VX7 Skin ON/OFF control directly under the OPEN row.
    local vx7SkinToggleRow=Instance.new("Frame")
    vx7SkinToggleRow.Name="Custom Skin"

    local skinToggleSub=Instance.new("TextLabel",vx7SkinToggleRow)

    skinToggleSub.Text="Apply selected VX7 skin"; skinToggleSub.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(170,170,180); skinToggleSub.Font=Enum.Font.GothamMedium; skinToggleSub.TextSize=8; skinToggleSub.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    local skinToggle=Instance.new("TextButton",vx7SkinToggleRow)
    skinToggle.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(72,28); skinToggle.Position=UDim2.new(1,-84,0.5,-14); skinToggle.BackgroundColor3=VX7SkinConfig.enabled and Color3.fromRGB(220,150,255) or Color3.fromRGB(30,30,36); skinToggle.BorderSizePixel=0
    skinToggle.Text=VX7SkinConfig.enabled and "ON" or "OFF"; skinToggle.TextColor3=VX7SkinConfig.enabled and Color3.fromRGB(20,10,25) or COLORS.white; skinToggle.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold; skinToggle.TextSize=9; skinToggle.AutoButtonColor=false

        local on=VX7SkinConfig.enabled==true
        skinToggle.Text=on and "ON" or "OFF"
        skinToggle.BackgroundColor3=on and Color3.fromRGB(220,150,255) or Color3.fromRGB(30,30,36)
        skinToggle.TextColor3=on and Color3.fromRGB(20,10,25) or COLORS.white
    end
    skinToggle.Activated:Connect(function()
        local nextEnabled = not VX7SkinConfig.enabled
        VX7SkinConfig.enabled = nextEnabled
        _G.LaPeakVX7SkinCustomEnabled = nextEnabled
        vx7SaveSkinConfig()
        if nextEnabled then
            vx7ApplyCharacter()
        else
            local character = LP.Character
            vx7Restore()
            vx7RestoreOriginalDescription(character)
        end
        refreshSkinToggle(); refreshCards()
    end)

    VX7SkinState.charConn=LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(newCharacter)
        VX7SkinState.generation = (VX7SkinState.generation or 0) + 1
        local gen = VX7SkinState.generation
        previewCache={}
        -- A respawn creates a brand-new character. Never carry old character clones into it.
        VX7SkinState.savedWearables={}
        VX7SkinState.savedTextures={}
        VX7SkinState.savedCharacter=nil
        VX7SkinState.hidden={}
        VX7SkinState.visuals={}
        VX7SkinState.originalDescriptionCharacter=nil
        if VX7SkinState.originalDescription then pcall(function() VX7SkinState.originalDescription:Destroy() end); VX7SkinState.originalDescription=nil end
        if VX7SkinState.customOrbit then pcall(function() VX7SkinState.customOrbit:Disconnect() end); VX7SkinState.customOrbit=nil end
        local function reapply()
            if gen ~= VX7SkinState.generation or LP.Character ~= newCharacter or not newCharacter.Parent then return end
            if not VX7SkinConfig.enabled then return end
            pcall(vx7ApplyCharacter)
        end
        task.defer(function()
            task.wait(0.15)
            reapply()
            task.delay(0.55,reapply)
            task.delay(1.25,reapply)
        end)
    end)

    -- VX7-style appearance-load hook: wait for Roblox's avatar appearance before the first apply.
    if LP.CharacterAppearanceLoaded then
        VX7SkinState.appearanceConn = LP.CharacterAppearanceLoaded:Connect(function(character)
            if VX7SkinConfig.enabled and LP.Character == character then
                task.defer(function() pcall(vx7ApplyCharacter) end)
            end
        end)
    end
    if VX7SkinConfig.enabled then task.defer(function() task.wait(0.15); pcall(vx7ApplyCharacter) end) end
    _G.LaPeakVX7SkinSet = vx7SetSkin
    _G.LaPeakVX7SkinOpen = function() setGallery(true) end
    _G.LaPeakVX7SkinClose = function() setGallery(false) end
end


-- Ragdoll Countdown under Headless / Korblox (always visible in VISUAL)
do
    local rcRow, setRcVis = toggleRow(Utility, "Ragdoll Countdown", ragdollCountdownEnabled == true, 0)
    _G.AdaptRagdollCountdownRow = rcRow
    setRagdollCountdownVisual = setRcVis
    local rcBtn = rcRow and rcRow:FindFirstChild("ToggleButton")
    if rcBtn then
        rcBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
            ragdollCountdownEnabled = not ragdollCountdownEnabled
            if setRcVis then setRcVis(ragdollCountdownEnabled) end
            if _G.LonelySetRagdollCountdown then
                pcall(_G.LonelySetRagdollCountdown, ragdollCountdownEnabled)
            end
            if ragdollCountdownEnabled then
                pcall(function() if hookRagdollCountdown then hookRagdollCountdown(LP.Character) end end)
            else
                pcall(function() if stopRagdollCountdown then stopRagdollCountdown() end end)
            end
            if saveAdaptConfig then pcall(saveAdaptConfig) end
        end)
    end
    if rcRow then
        rcRow.Visible = true
        rcRow.LayoutOrder = 0
    end
end

end)

function _G.AdaptRestoreFonts()
    if _G.AdaptFontAddedConn then
        pcall(function() _G.AdaptFontAddedConn:Disconnect() end)
        _G.AdaptFontAddedConn = nil
    end
    if _G.AdaptFontBackup then
        for obj, oldFont in pairs(_G.AdaptFontBackup) do
            pcall(function()
                if obj and obj.Parent then obj.Font = oldFont end
            end)
        end
    end
    _G.AdaptFontBackup = {}
end

function _G.AdaptFontEnum(name)
    if name == "Coding Font" then return Enum.Font.GothamMedium end
    if name == "Summer" then return Enum.Font.GothamMedium end
    if name == "Beachy" then return Enum.Font.GothamMedium end
    if name == "Scary" then return Enum.Font.GothamMedium end
    if name == "Bangers" then return Enum.Font.GothamMedium end
    return nil
end

function _G.AdaptApplyFontToObject(obj)
    if not obj then return end
    if not (obj:IsA("TextLabel") or obj:IsA("TextButton") or obj:IsA("TextBox")) then return end
    if not _G.AdaptFontBackup then _G.AdaptFontBackup = {} end
    if _G.AdaptFontBackup[obj] == nil then
        pcall(function() _G.AdaptFontBackup[obj] = obj.Font end)
    end
    local f = _G.AdaptFontEnum(_G.AdaptCustomFontSelected or "None")
    if f then pcall(function() obj.Font = f end) end
end

function _G.AdaptApplyCustomFont(name)
    _G.AdaptRestoreFonts()
    _G.AdaptCustomFontSelected = name or "None"
    customFontVisualEnabled = _G.AdaptCustomFontSelected ~= "None"

    if customFontVisualEnabled then
        for _, obj in ipairs(PlayerGui:GetDescendants()) do
            _G.AdaptApplyFontToObject(obj)
        end
        _G.AdaptFontAddedConn = PlayerGui.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(obj)
            if (_G.AdaptCustomFontSelected or "None") ~= "None" then
                _G.AdaptApplyFontToObject(obj)
            end
        end)
    end

    pcall(function()
        if saveAdaptConfig then saveAdaptConfig() end
    end)
end

function _G.AdaptInstallFontRow()
    local targetPage = MenuCustomize or pages.MENU
    if not targetPage or not targetPage.Parent then return end
    local old = targetPage:FindFirstChild("Custom Font")
    if old then old:Destroy() end

    local row = Instance.new("Frame")
    row.Name = "Custom Font"
    row.BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.row
    row.BackgroundTransparency = 0.22
    row.Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 138)

    local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")

    title.TextSize = 11

    title.ZIndex = 5

    local names = {"None","Coding Font","Summer","Beachy","Scary","Bangers"}

        if name == "Coding Font" then return Enum.Font.GothamMedium end
        if name == "Summer" then return Enum.Font.GothamMedium end
        if name == "Beachy" then return Enum.Font.GothamMedium end
        if name == "Scary" then return Enum.Font.GothamMedium end
        if name == "Bangers" then return Enum.Font.GothamMedium end
        return Enum.Font.GothamMedium

    local function refreshSelected()
        for name, btn in pairs(buttons) do

            btn.BackgroundTransparency = selected and 0.03 or 0.18
            local st = btn:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
            if st then
                st.Transparency = selected and 0.05 or 0.5
                st.Thickness = selected and 1.4 or 1
            end
        end
    end

    for i, name in ipairs(names) do
        local col = (i - 1) % 3
        local rowIndex = math.floor((i - 1) / 3)

        local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")

        btn.ZIndex = 6

        stroke(btn,COLORS.strokeSoft,1,0.5)

        local nameLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        nameLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        nameLabel.Text = name
        nameLabel.TextColor3 = COLORS.white
        nameLabel.TextTransparency = 0.22
        nameLabel.TextSize = 8
        nameLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
        nameLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,12)
        nameLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0,0,1,-13)
        nameLabel.ZIndex = 7
        nameLabel.Parent = btn

        buttons[name] = btn

        btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            pcall(function()
                _G.AdaptApplyCustomFont(name)
            end)
            refreshSelected()
        end)
    end

    refreshSelected()
end

function updateBackgroundButtons()
    for i, btn in pairs(bgButtons or {}) do
        if not btn or not btn.Parent then continue end
        local selected = (tonumber(currentBackground) == tonumber(i))
        local st = btn:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
        if btn.Name == "BgThumbNone" then
            if st then st:Destroy() end
            btn.BackgroundColor3 = selected and Color3.fromRGB(90,90,98) or Color3.fromRGB(28,28,32)
            local nl = btn:FindFirstChild("NoneLabel")
            if nl then
                nl.TextColor3 = selected and Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255) or Color3.fromRGB(200,200,210)
                nl.Font = selected and Enum.Font.GothamBlack or Enum.Font.GothamMedium
            end
        else
            if not st then
                st = Instance.new("UIStroke")
                st.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
                st.Parent = btn
            end
            if selected then
                st.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
                st.Thickness = 2
                st.Transparency = 0
            else
                st.Color = Color3.fromRGB(80,80,90)
                st.Thickness = 1
                st.Transparency = 1 -- no border until selected
            end
            btn.ImageTransparency = selected and 0 or 0.18
        end
    end
end

-- Yout v12 full pink visual logic: reusable accent gradients.
local function LaPeakYoutGradient(c)
    return ColorSequence.new({
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.00, c:Lerp(Color3.new(1,1,1), 0.55)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.45, c),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1.00, c:Lerp(Color3.new(0,0,0), 0.35)),
    })
end
local function LaPeakYoutGradientDark(c)
    return ColorSequence.new({
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.00, c:Lerp(Color3.new(0,0,0), 0.35)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.55, c:Lerp(Color3.new(0,0,0), 0.65)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1.00, c:Lerp(Color3.new(0,0,0), 0.80)),
    })
end
local function LaPeakApplyGradient(obj, c, dark)
    if not obj then return end
    local g = obj:FindFirstChild("LaPeakThemeGradient")
    if not g then g = Instance.new("UIGradient") end
    g.Name = "LaPeakThemeGradient"
    g.Rotation = 0
    g.Color = dark and LaPeakYoutGradientDark(c) or LaPeakYoutGradient(c)
    g.Parent = obj
end

local colorOrder = VX7_THEME_ORDER
local activeButton

local function vx7ThemePalette()
    return VX7_FULL_PALETTES[_G.AdaptThemeName] or VX7_FULL_PALETTES.BLACK_PINK
end

local function vx7ApplyGuiObject(obj, p)
    if not obj or not obj.Parent then return end
    -- Never recolor the 9 theme swatches themselves or the fixed photo.
    if obj:GetAttribute("VX7ThemeName") then return end
    if obj == BgImage or (BgImage and obj:IsDescendantOf(BgImage)) then return end
    local n = string.lower(tostring(obj.Name or ""))
    local t = string.lower(tostring((obj:IsA("TextButton") and obj.Text) or ""))

    if obj:IsA("UIStroke") then
        local owner = obj.Parent
        local on = owner and owner:GetAttribute("AdaptMobileVisualState") == "on"
        local special = n:find("accent",1,true) or n:find("selected",1,true) or n:find("active",1,true)
        obj.Color = (on or special) and p.accent2 or p.border
        return
    end
    if obj:IsA("UIGradient") then
        if obj.Name ~= "LaPeakThemeGradient" and obj.Name ~= "ButtonNoneGradient" then
            obj.Color = ColorSequence.new({
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0,p.accent),
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5,p.accent2),
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1,p.accent),
            })
        end
        return
    end
    if obj:IsA("Frame") then
        if n:find("selectedslide",1,true) or n:find("accentline",1,true) or n:find("accent",1,true) then
            obj.BackgroundColor3 = p.accent
        elseif n:find("minimized",1,true) or n == "miniframe" or n:find("topbar",1,true) then
            obj.BackgroundColor3 = p.top
        elseif n:find("side",1,true) or n:find("sidebar",1,true) then
            obj.BackgroundColor3 = p.side
        elseif n:find("track",1,true) then
            obj.BackgroundColor3 = p.fillIdle
        elseif n:find("fill",1,true) or n:find("knob",1,true) then
            obj.BackgroundColor3 = p.fill
        elseif n:find("row",1,true) or n:find("panel",1,true) or n:find("card",1,true) or n:find("section",1,true) then
            obj.BackgroundColor3 = p.panel
        elseif n == "main" or n:find("root",1,true) then
            obj.BackgroundColor3 = p.bg
        end
        return
    end
    if obj:IsA("TextLabel") or obj:IsA("TextButton") or obj:IsA("TextBox") then
        local isButton = obj:IsA("TextButton")
        local active = obj:GetAttribute("AdaptMobileVisualState") == "on"
        local selected = n:find("selected",1,true) or n:find("active",1,true) or t == "on" or t == "enabled"
        if n:find("discord",1,true) or n:find("speed",1,true) or n:find("mode",1,true) or n:find("brand",1,true) or n:find("title",1,true) then
            obj.TextColor3 = p.statsAccent or p.accent
        elseif n:find("sub",1,true) or n:find("hint",1,true) or n:find("desc",1,true) or n:find("muted",1,true) then
            obj.TextColor3 = p.muted
        elseif active or selected then
            obj.TextColor3 = p.contrast or p.bg
        else
            obj.TextColor3 = p.text
        end
        if isButton then
            if active or selected then
                obj.BackgroundColor3 = p.accent
            else
                obj.BackgroundColor3 = p.panel
            end
        end
        return
    end
end

local function applyVX7FullGuiTheme()
    local p = vx7ThemePalette()
    pcall(function()
        if Main then Main.BackgroundColor3 = p.bg end
        if MiniFrame then MiniFrame.BackgroundColor3 = p.top end
        if Gui then
            -- Main menu contents/background image are intentionally NOT recolored.
            -- Only the main menu shell/stroke follows the selected theme.
            if Main then
                local mainStroke = Main:FindFirstChild("MainShellStroke") or Main:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
                if mainStroke then
                    mainStroke.Color = p.accent
                    mainStroke.Transparency = 0
                    mainStroke.Thickness = 1.6
                end
            end
            for _, obj in ipairs(Gui:GetDescendants()) do
                if not (Main and (obj == Main or obj:IsDescendantOf(Main))) then
                    vx7ApplyGuiObject(obj,p)
                end
            end
        end
        -- Important non-child GUI surfaces used by this hub.
        if overheadSpeedLabel then overheadSpeedLabel.TextColor3 = p.statsAccent end
        if discordLbl then discordLbl.TextColor3 = p.statsAccent end
        if _G.AdaptAutoPlayStatusLabel and _G.AdaptAutoPlayStatusLabel.Parent then
            _G.AdaptAutoPlayStatusLabel.TextColor3 = p.statsAccent
        end
        if _G.LonelyStealBarFrame then
            local bar=_G.LonelyStealBarFrame
            local tr=bar:FindFirstChild("Track")
            local fill=tr and tr:FindFirstChild("Fill")
            if fill then fill.BackgroundColor3=p.fill; LaPeakApplyGradient(fill,p.accent,false) end
            if tr then tr.BackgroundColor3=p.fillIdle end
            local st=bar:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke"); if st then st.Color=p.border end
            for _,name in ipairs({"Percent","Stats"}) do local x=bar:FindFirstChild(name); if x and x:IsA("TextLabel") then x.TextColor3=p.statsAccent end end
        end
    end)
end

local function bindVX7ThemeLive()
    if _G._LonelyVX7ThemeDescConn then return end
    if Gui then
        _G._LonelyVX7ThemeDescConn = Gui.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(obj)
            task.defer(function() vx7ApplyGuiObject(obj,vx7ThemePalette()) end)
        end)
    end
end

local function applyThemeColor()
local tint = _G.AdaptThemeColors[_G.AdaptThemeName] or _G.AdaptThemeColors.BLACK_PINK

--Leaked By Xlu0 AndPrime--
BgImage.ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)

AdaptLogoAsset.ImageColor3 = tint
end
if TitleSweepText then TitleSweepText.TextColor3 = tint end
if _G.AdaptIntroTitleSweep and _G.AdaptIntroTitleSweep.Parent then
_G.AdaptIntroTitleSweep.TextColor3 = tint
end

THEME_ACCENT = tint
THEME_ACCENT_DIM = Color3.new(tint.R * 0.62, tint.G * 0.62, tint.B * 0.62)

-- Full Yout v12-style accent pass for the main menu.
pcall(function()
    if Main then
        for _, obj in ipairs(Main:GetDescendants()) do
            if obj:IsA("UIStroke") then
                obj.Color = tint
            elseif obj:IsA("Frame") and obj.Name == "SelectedSlide" then
                obj.BackgroundColor3 = tint
                obj.BackgroundTransparency = 0.78
            elseif obj:IsA("TextButton") and not VX7_THEME_NAMES[obj.Name] and obj.Name ~= "PINK" and obj.Name ~= "PURPLE" and obj.Name ~= "BLUE" and obj.Name ~= "RED" and obj.Name ~= "YELLOW" and obj.Name ~= "GREY" and obj.Name ~= "WHITE" and obj.Name ~= "FOREST" then
                if obj.BackgroundTransparency < 0.98 then
                    obj.BackgroundColor3 = tint:Lerp(Color3.new(0,0,0), 0.78)
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)

-- Apply the Yout v12 accent consistently to the menu, mobile controls and steal bar.
pcall(function()
    if Main then
        local mainStroke = Main:FindFirstChild("MainShellStroke") or Main:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
        if mainStroke then mainStroke.Color = tint end
    end
    if _G.AdaptRepaintStealBar then pcall(_G.AdaptRepaintStealBar) end
    -- VX7 mobile quick buttons: repaint the actual Frame/TextButton registry immediately.
    for _, entry in pairs(mobileButtons or {}) do
        local btn = entry and (entry.frame or entry.btn)
        local active = false
        if btn then
            pcall(function()
                active = btn:GetAttribute("AdaptMobileVisualState") == "on"
                    or (entry.textButton and entry.textButton:GetAttribute("AdaptMobileVisualState") == "on")
            end)
        end
        if btn and btn.Parent then
            local bg = btn:FindFirstChild("ButtonNoneBackground")
            if bg then
                bg.BackgroundColor3 = tint:Lerp(Color3.new(0,0,0), 0.72)
                LaPeakApplyGradient(bg, tint, true)
            else
                bg = btn
                if not active then bg.BackgroundColor3 = vx7ThemePalette().panel end
            end
            local st = btn:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
            if st then
                st.Color = active and tint or vx7ThemePalette().border
                st.Transparency = 0
                st.Thickness = active and 2.0 or 1.4
            end
            local tb = entry.textButton or btn:FindFirstChild("VX7Button")
            if tb and tb:IsA("TextButton") then
                tb.TextColor3 = active and (vx7ThemePalette().contrast or Color3.new(1,1,1)) or vx7ThemePalette().text
                tb.Font = active and Enum.Font.GothamBlack or Enum.Font.GothamBold
            end
            btn:SetAttribute("AdaptMobileVisualState", active and "on" or "off")
        end
        if entry and entry.setActive then
            pcall(function() entry.setActive(active) end)
        end
    end
end)

local shapeDisplay = {FOUNDED = "FOUNDED", CIRCLE = "CIRCLE", SQUARE = "SQUARE"}
local shapeButtons = {}
local function applyShape(shape)
    shape = tostring(shape or "FOUNDED"):upper()
    if shape ~= "FOUNDED" and shape ~= "CIRCLE" and shape ~= "SQUARE" then shape = "FOUNDED" end
    _G.AdaptMobileButtonShape = shape
    -- Shape selection is persistent immediately; all button coordinates use one shared position table.
    for key, b in pairs(shapeButtons) do
        if b then
            local selected = key == shape
            b.BackgroundColor3 = selected and Color3.fromRGB(245,245,245) or Color3.fromRGB(8,8,12)
            b.TextColor3 = selected and Color3.fromRGB(10,10,12) or Color3.fromRGB(185,185,192)
            b.Font = selected and Enum.Font.GothamBlack or Enum.Font.GothamMedium
        end
    end
    if _G.AdaptApplyMobileButtonShape then pcall(_G.AdaptApplyMobileButtonShape) end
    if _G.AdaptRefreshMobileButtonStates then pcall(_G.AdaptRefreshMobileButtonStates) end
    -- V2 three-mode speed is its own Vanta GUI. Shape changes must never
    -- replace, resize, hide, or alter that GUI. Rebuild only to guarantee it
    -- remains present with the same selected mode and saved position.
    if _G.AdaptSpeedMethod == "V2" and _G.LonelyBuildThreeModeSpeed then
        task.defer(function() pcall(_G.LonelyBuildThreeModeSpeed) end)
    end
    if saveAdaptConfig then pcall(saveAdaptConfig) end
end
for i, shape in ipairs(shapeOrder) do
    local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
    b.Name = "MobileShape_" .. shape
    b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(8,8,12)
    b.BackgroundTransparency = 0.05
    b.BorderSizePixel = 0
    b.Text = shapeDisplay[shape]
    b.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(185,185,192)

    b.ZIndex = 7
    b.Parent = row
    corner(b, shape == "SQUARE" and 4 or 7)
    stroke(b, COLORS.strokeSoft, 1, 0.45)
    shapeButtons[shape] = b
    b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() applyShape(shape) end)
end

local buttons = {}

local function selectedIndex()
    local current = tostring(selectedGetter() or "")
    local id = current:match("(%d+)")
    if not id then return 0 end
    for i,assetId in ipairs(assetIds) do
        if tostring(assetId) == tostring(id) then return i end
    end
    return 0
end

local function updateButtons()
    local selected = selectedIndex()
    for index,thumb in pairs(buttons) do
        local on = index == selected
        local st = thumb:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
        if st then
            st.Color = on and Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255) or Color3.fromRGB(80,80,90)
            st.Transparency = on and 0 or 0.4
            st.Thickness = on and 1.25 or 1
        end
        thumb.ImageTransparency = on and 0 or 0.22
    end
end

local function choose(index)
    selectedSetter(index == 0 and "" or ("rbxassetid://" .. tostring(assetIds[index])))
    updateButtons()
end

local function makeThumb(index,assetId)
    local thumb = Instance.new("ImageButton")
    thumb.Name = "Thumb" .. tostring(index)
    thumb.ZIndex = 5
    thumb.LayoutOrder = index + 1
    thumb.Size = UDim2.new(0,42,0,34)
    thumb.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0)
    thumb.BorderSizePixel = 0
    thumb.Image = assetId and ("rbxassetid://" .. tostring(assetId)) or ""
    thumb.ImageTransparency = 0.22
    thumb.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop
    thumb.AutoButtonColor = false
    thumb.Parent = scroll
    corner(thumb,9)
    stroke(thumb,Color3.fromRGB(80,80,90),1,0.4)

    if index == 0 then
        local none = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        none.Name = "NoneLabel"
        none.ZIndex = 6
        none.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0)
        none.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        none.Text = "NONE"
        none.TextColor3 = COLORS.white
        none.TextSize = 9
        none.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
        none.Parent = thumb
    end

    buttons[index] = thumb
    thumb.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() choose(index) end)
end

makeThumb(0,nil)
for i,id in ipairs(assetIds) do
    makeThumb(i,id)
end

    local function _mpFmtTime(t)
      t = math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(t) or 0))
      return string.format("%d:%02d", math.floor(t / 60), t % 60)
    end

    local function _mpSmallBtn(parent, name, text, size, pos, textSize)
      local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
      b.Name = name
      b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(8, 8, 14)
      b.BackgroundTransparency = 0.05
      b.BorderSizePixel = 0
      b.Text = text
      b.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(245, 245, 255)
      b.TextSize = textSize or 13
      b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
      b.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
      b.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
      b.AutoButtonColor = false
      b.Active = true
      b.Selectable = true
      b.Size = size
      b.Position = pos
      b.ZIndex = 6
      b.Parent = parent
      corner(b, 10)
      stroke(b, Color3.fromRGB(90, 90, 105), 1, 0.5)
      b.MouseEnter:Connect(function() tween(b, {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 40)}, 0.1) end)
      b.MouseLeave:Connect(function() tween(b, {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(8, 8, 14)}, 0.1) end)
      return b
    end

local function _mpToggleRow(parent, labelText, getVal, setVal, yPos)
    local f = Instance.new("Frame")
    f.Name = labelText
    f.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 22)
    f.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
    f.BorderSizePixel = 0
    f.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 36)
    f.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, yPos)
    f.ZIndex = 4
    f.Parent = parent
    corner(f, 9)
    stroke(f, Color3.fromRGB(90, 90, 105), 1, 0.45)

    local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    lbl.Text = labelText
    lbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(245, 245, 255)
    lbl.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    lbl.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.35
    lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    lbl.TextSize = 12
    lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 0)
    lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -92, 1, 0)
    lbl.ZIndex = 5
    lbl.Parent = f

    -- Sfondo con gradiente (dietro al testo)
    local pillBg = Instance.new("Frame")
    pillBg.Name = "PillBg"
    pillBg.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(8, 8, 14)
    pillBg.BackgroundTransparency = 0
    pillBg.BorderSizePixel = 0
    pillBg.Size = UDim2.new(0, 60, 0, 24)
    pillBg.Position = UDim2.new(1, -72, 0.5, -12)
    pillBg.ZIndex = 5
    pillBg.Parent = f
    corner(pillBg, 12)

    -- Bordo della pill
    local pillBgStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    pillBgStroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
    pillBgStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(90, 90, 105)
    pillBgStroke.Thickness = 1
    pillBgStroke.Transparency = 0.5
    pillBgStroke.Parent = pillBg

    -- Gradiente (sarà gestito da _G._AmbitiousApplyAccent)
    local pillBgGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
    pillBgGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(220, 100, 255)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(147, 51, 234)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(101, 31, 190)),
    })
    pillBgGrad.Rotation = 18
    pillBgGrad.Enabled = false
    pillBgGrad.Parent = pillBg

    -- Registra lo sfondo con il gradiente per l'accentatura
    _G._AmbitiousRegAccent(pillBg, pillBgGrad, "toggle")

    -- Testo (trasparente, sopra lo sfondo)
    local pill = Instance.new("TextButton")
    pill.Name = "Pill"
    pill.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    pill.BorderSizePixel = 0
    pill.Text = "OFF"
    pill.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 180)
    pill.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    pill.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.35
    pill.TextSize = 11
    pill.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
    pill.AutoButtonColor = false
    pill.Size = UDim2.new(0, 60, 0, 24)
    pill.Position = UDim2.new(1, -72, 0.5, -12)
    pill.ZIndex = 7
    pill.Parent = f
    corner(pill, 12)

    local function apply(v)
        local isGrey = _G._AmbitiousAccentIsGrey and _G._AmbitiousAccentIsGrey() or false
        local onBase, onEdge = Color3.fromRGB(147, 51, 234), Color3.fromRGB(216, 180, 254)
        if _G._AmbitiousToggleOnColor then
            local b, e = _G._AmbitiousToggleOnColor()
            if b then onBase = b end
            if e then onEdge = e end
        end

        if v then
            pill.Text = "ON"
            pill.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)   -- BIANCO
            pillBg.BackgroundColor3 = onBase
            pillBgGrad.Enabled = true   -- SEMPRE ATTIVO, ma il gradiente avrà colori appropriati (viola o grigio) grazie al registrazione
            pillBgStroke.Color = onEdge
            pillBgStroke.Transparency = 0.15
        else
            pill.Text = "OFF"
            pill.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 180)
            pillBg.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(8, 8, 14)
            pillBgGrad.Enabled = false
            pillBgStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(90, 90, 105)
            pillBgStroke.Transparency = 0.5
        end
    end

    apply(getVal() == true)

    pill.Activated:Connect(function()
        local nv = not (getVal() == true)
        setVal(nv)
        apply(nv)
    end)

    -- HOVER: la pill si ingrandisce, stesso feeling del pulsante PLAY.
    -- Si animano sia pillBg (sfondo + gradiente) sia pill (testo),
    -- perche' sono due oggetti fratelli sovrapposti.
    pill.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        tween(pillBg, {Size = UDim2.new(0, 66, 0, 28), Position = UDim2.new(1, -75, 0.5, -14)}, 0.12)
        tween(pill,   {Size = UDim2.new(0, 66, 0, 28), Position = UDim2.new(1, -75, 0.5, -14)}, 0.12)
    end)
    pill.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        tween(pillBg, {Size = UDim2.new(0, 60, 0, 24), Position = UDim2.new(1, -72, 0.5, -12)}, 0.12)
        tween(pill,   {Size = UDim2.new(0, 60, 0, 24), Position = UDim2.new(1, -72, 0.5, -12)}, 0.12)
    end)

    return f, apply
end

      -- REFRESH UI
      local function refresh()
        if not (mpGui and mpGui.Parent) then return end
        nameLbl.Text = getMusicSongName()
        counterLbl.Text = "TRACK " .. tostring(selectedMusicSong) .. " / " .. tostring(#MUSIC_PLAYER_OPTIONS)
        volValue.Text = string.format("%.2f", musicPlayerVolume)
        spdValue.Text = string.format("%.1fx", musicPlayerSpeed)
        -- Le pill rispecchiano sempre lo stato reale delle variabili
        if applyAutoNext then applyAutoNext(musicAutoPlayNext == true) end
        if applyShuffle then applyShuffle(musicShuffleEnabled == true) end
        if applyLoop then applyLoop(musicLoopEnabled == true) end
        local s = _musicPlayerSound
        local alive = s and s.Parent
        playBtn.Text = (alive and s.IsPlaying) and "PAUSE" or "PLAY"
        if alive then
          -- Durata e posizione mostrate come tempo REALE di ascolto: a 2x
          -- la canzone dura la meta', a 0.5x il doppio. TimeLength e
          -- TimePosition di Roblox sono sempre in tempo della traccia, non
          -- tengono conto di PlaybackSpeed, quindi si divide qui.
          local sp = tonumber(musicPlayerSpeed) or 1
          if sp <= 0 then sp = 1 end
          local len = (s.TimeLength or 0) / sp
          local pos = (s.TimePosition or 0) / sp
          if len > 0 then
            barFill.Size = UDim2.new(math.clamp(pos / len, 0, 1), 0, 1, 0)
            curLbl.Text = _mpFmtTime(pos)
            totLbl.Text = _mpFmtTime(len)
          else
            barFill.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
            curLbl.Text = "0:00"
            totLbl.Text = "--:--"
          end
        else
          barFill.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
          curLbl.Text = "0:00"
          totLbl.Text = "0:00"
        end
      end
      _G.AmbitiousMusicRefreshUI = refresh
      refresh()

      task.spawn(function()
        while mpGui and mpGui.Parent do
          pcall(refresh)
          task.wait(0.2)
        end
      end)

      backdrop.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
          closeMusicPlayer()
        end
      end)

      frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
      frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
      TweenService:Create(frame, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
        Size = UDim2.new(0, POPUP_W, 0, POPUP_H),
        Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -POPUP_W / 2, 0.5, -POPUP_H / 2)
      }):Play()
    end)
  end

  section(Settings, "SETTINGS", 999)
  local resetHolder = Instance.new("Frame")

local _lonelyPcKeyLastFire = {}
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
local isControllerInput = tostring(input.UserInputType):find("Gamepad") ~= nil
-- External-button keybind capture takes priority over normal feature dispatch.
if listeningForExternalKey then
    if tick() - (keybindListenStartedAt or 0) < 0.18 then return end
    local target = listeningForExternalKey
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
        listeningForExternalKey = nil
        if _G.LonelyRefreshExternalKeybindUI then pcall(_G.LonelyRefreshExternalKeybindUI) end
        return
    end
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Backspace or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Delete then
        externalKeybinds[target] = nil
    else
        for k,v in pairs(externalKeybinds) do if k ~= target and v == input.KeyCode then externalKeybinds[k] = nil end end
        externalKeybinds[target] = input.KeyCode
    end
    listeningForExternalKey = nil
    if _G.LonelyRefreshExternalKeybindUI then pcall(_G.LonelyRefreshExternalKeybindUI) end
    if saveAdaptConfig then pcall(saveAdaptConfig) end
    return
end
if listeningForControllerKey then return end
if gameProcessed and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard and not listeningForSpeedKey and not listeningForTPDownKey then return end
if UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then return end
if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard and not isControllerInput then return end
if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then return end
-- Roblox can deliver more than one InputBegan path for a single physical
-- key/button when UI/game input is involved. Guard only the dispatch layer;
-- keybind capture remains unaffected. This prevents one press from becoming
-- start+stop while still allowing a later press immediately.
local _dispatchNow = tick()
local _dispatchKey = tostring(input.UserInputType) .. ":" .. tostring(input.KeyCode)
if (_dispatchNow - (_lonelyPcKeyLastFire[_dispatchKey] or 0)) < 0.12 then return end
_lonelyPcKeyLastFire[_dispatchKey] = _dispatchNow
if speedKeybinds.ToggleUI and input.KeyCode == speedKeybinds.ToggleUI then
if Main.Visible then
if _G.LonelyCloseMainMenu then _G.LonelyCloseMainMenu() end
elseif _G.LonelyOpenMainMenu then
_G.LonelyOpenMainMenu()
else
Main.Visible=true; MiniFrame.Visible=false; Main.Size=FULL_MAIN_SIZE
end
if saveAdaptConfig then pcall(saveAdaptConfig) end
return
end
if listeningForSpeedKey then
if tick() - (keybindListenStartedAt or 0) < 0.18 then return end
local targetKey = listeningForSpeedKey
if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
listeningForSpeedKey = nil
refreshAllSpeedKeybinds()
return
end
if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Backspace or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Delete then
speedKeybinds[targetKey] = nil
else
for otherKeyId, boundKey in pairs(speedKeybinds) do
if otherKeyId ~= targetKey and boundKey == input.KeyCode then
speedKeybinds[otherKeyId] = nil
end
end
if tpDownKeybind == input.KeyCode then
tpDownKeybind = nil
refreshTPDownKeybind()
end
speedKeybinds[targetKey] = input.KeyCode
end
listeningForSpeedKey = nil
refreshAllSpeedKeybinds()
if saveAdaptConfig then pcall(saveAdaptConfig) end
return
end
if listeningForTPDownKey then
if tick() - (keybindListenStartedAt or 0) < 0.18 then return end
if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
listeningForTPDownKey = false
refreshTPDownKeybind()
return
end
if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Backspace or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Delete then
tpDownKeybind = nil
else
for keyId, boundKey in pairs(speedKeybinds) do
if boundKey == input.KeyCode then
speedKeybinds[keyId] = nil
end
end
tpDownKeybind = input.KeyCode
end
listeningForTPDownKey = false
refreshAllSpeedKeybinds()
refreshTPDownKeybind()
if saveAdaptConfig then pcall(saveAdaptConfig) end
return
end
if not _G.LonelyIsMobileButtonPaused("carry") and speedKeybinds.SpeedToggle and input.KeyCode == speedKeybinds.SpeedToggle then
toggleCarryMode()
return
end
if not (_G.LonelyIsMobileButtonPaused("laggerNormal") or _G.LonelyIsMobileButtonPaused("laggerCarry")) and speedKeybinds.LaggerToggle and input.KeyCode == speedKeybinds.LaggerToggle then
toggleLaggerMode()
return
end
if not _G.LonelyIsMobileButtonPaused("aimbot") and speedKeybinds.Aimbot and input.KeyCode == speedKeybinds.Aimbot then
if _G.AdaptSafeModeIsLocked and _G.AdaptSafeModeIsLocked() then
if _G.AdaptSafeModeForceStop then _G.AdaptSafeModeForceStop("SAFE MODE LOCK") end
return
end
-- BUBBLE BAT AIM PC KEYBIND: one press toggles the single aimbot engine.
if _G.AdaptToggleAimbot then
    pcall(_G.AdaptToggleAimbot)
end
if _G.AdaptRefreshAimbotVisual then pcall(_G.AdaptRefreshAimbotVisual) end
if saveAdaptConfig then pcall(saveAdaptConfig) end
return
end
if not _G.LonelyIsMobileButtonPaused("antiDesync") and speedKeybinds.AntiDesyncAimbot and input.KeyCode == speedKeybinds.AntiDesyncAimbot then
if _G.AdaptSafeModeIsLocked and _G.AdaptSafeModeIsLocked() then
if _G.AdaptSafeModeForceStop then _G.AdaptSafeModeForceStop("SAFE MODE LOCK") end
return
end
if _G.AdaptToggleAntiDesyncAimbot then
_G.AdaptToggleAntiDesyncAimbot()
elseif _G.AdaptStartAntiDesyncAimbot and _G.AdaptStopAntiDesyncAimbot then
if _G.AdaptAntiDesyncAimbotOn then _G.AdaptStopAntiDesyncAimbot() else _G.AdaptStartAntiDesyncAimbot() end
end
return
end
if not _G.LonelyIsMobileButtonPaused("autoLeft") and speedKeybinds.AutoLeft and input.KeyCode == speedKeybinds.AutoLeft then
if _G.AdaptSetAutoLeft then _G.AdaptSetAutoLeft(not autoLeftEnabled) end
return
end
if not _G.LonelyIsMobileButtonPaused("autoRight") and speedKeybinds.AutoRight and input.KeyCode == speedKeybinds.AutoRight then
if _G.AdaptSetAutoRight then _G.AdaptSetAutoRight(not autoRightEnabled) end
return
end
if speedKeybinds.DropBrainrot and input.KeyCode == speedKeybinds.DropBrainrot then
if _G.AdaptRunDropBR then pcall(_G.AdaptRunDropBR) end
return
end
if not _G.LonelyIsMobileButtonPaused("tp") and tpDownKeybind and input.KeyCode == tpDownKeybind then
runTPFloor()
return
end
-- User-configurable keyboard bindings for every external mobile button.
for mobileKey, boundKey in pairs(externalKeybinds) do
    if boundKey and input.KeyCode == boundKey then
        if _G.LonelyIsMobileButtonPaused and _G.LonelyIsMobileButtonPaused(mobileKey) then return end
        if _G.LonelyFireExternalButton then _G.LonelyFireExternalButton(mobileKey) end
        return
    end
end
end)
task.defer(function()
task.wait(0.15)
pcall(function()
for _, pageName in ipairs({"MOVEMENT","COMBAT"}) do
local page = pages[pageName]
if page then
for _, holder in ipairs(page:GetDescendants()) do
if holder:IsA("Frame") and holder:FindFirstChild("SelectedSlide") then
holder.Size = UDim2.new(1,-4,0,34)
holder.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0)
holder.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3

local slide = holder:FindFirstChild("SelectedSlide")
if slide then
slide.Size = UDim2.new(0.5,-4,1,-8)
slide.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
slide.BackgroundTransparency = 0.85
local s = slide:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
if s then
s.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
s.Thickness = 1
s.Transparency = 0.2
end
end

for _, child in ipairs(holder:GetChildren()) do
if child:IsA("TextLabel") or child:IsA("TextButton") then
child.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
child.TextSize = 12
end
end
end
end

for _, obj in ipairs(page:GetDescendants()) do
if obj:IsA("TextButton") and obj.Name == "ArrowButton" then
obj.Position = UDim2.new(1,-108,0.5,-13)
obj.Size = UDim2.new(0,38,0,26)
obj.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(8,8,12)
obj.BackgroundTransparency = 0.18
obj.Text = "V"
obj.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
obj.TextSize = 22
obj.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
local c = obj:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
if c then c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,7) end
end
end
end
end
end)
end)

_G.__AdaptDuelsSetupStealBar = function()
    -- ================================================================
    -- STEAL BAR — FILE 2 UI ONLY
    -- No old Lonely bar UI, no BAR toggle, no lock button on the bar,
    -- no demo animation, no fake progress.
    --
    -- Auto Steal engines call:
    --   _G.StealBar.SetProgress(0..1)
    --   _G.StealBar.Reset()
    --   _G.StealBar.SetState(...)
    --
    -- Normal V1 / Normal V2 / Semi V1 / Semi V2 therefore all share
    -- exactly this one visual bar.
    -- ================================================================
    local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
    local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
    local Stats = game:GetService("Stats")

    local old = LP:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui") and LP.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("StealBarGui")
    if old then old:Destroy() end
    pcall(function()
        local cg = game:GetService("CoreGui")
        local oldCg = cg:FindFirstChild("StealBarGui")
        if oldCg then oldCg:Destroy() end
    end)

    local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    gui.Name = "StealBarGui"
    gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
    gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
    gui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Global
    safeParentGui(gui)

    local BAR_W, BAR_H = 324, 56
    -- Exact Steal Bar palette from the supplied standalone source.
    local INK = Color3.fromRGB(6, 6, 6)
    local TRACK_COL = Color3.fromRGB(17, 17, 17)
    local FILL_COL = Color3.fromRGB(215, 215, 220)
    local WHITE = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    local BORDER_COL = Color3.fromRGB(238, 238, 228)
    local PINK_BRIGHT = Color3.fromRGB(238, 238, 242)
    local PINK_MID = Color3.fromRGB(215, 215, 220)
    local PURPLE_DEEP = Color3.fromRGB(168, 168, 178)
    local RED = Color3.fromRGB(200, 30, 30)

    local pbFrame = Instance.new("Frame", gui)
    pbFrame.Name = "StealBar"
    pbFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0,BAR_W,0,BAR_H)
    pbFrame.Position = tableToUDim2(
        _G.AdaptStealBarPosition,
        UDim2.new(0.5,-162,1,-70)
    )
    pbFrame.BackgroundColor3 = INK
    pbFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.04
    pbFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
    pbFrame.Active = false
    pbFrame.Selectable = false
    pbFrame.ClipsDescendants = false
    pbFrame.ZIndex = 2

    -- Rounded rectangle, not a separate floating control.
    Instance.new("UICorner",pbFrame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,11)

    local barStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke",pbFrame)
    barStroke.Color = BORDER_COL
    barStroke.Thickness = 1.6
    barStroke.Transparency = 0.08

    -- Animated white particles: actual movement, not static dots.
    local rng = Random.new()
    local barSnow = {}
    for i=1,18 do
        local d=Instance.new("Frame")
        d.Name="SnowDot_"..i
        local sz=rng:NextNumber(1.2,3.2)
        d.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(sz,sz)
        d.BackgroundColor3=WHITE
        d.BackgroundTransparency=rng:NextNumber(0.35,0.72)
        d.BorderSizePixel=0
        d.ZIndex=3
        d.Parent=pbFrame
        Instance.new("UICorner",d).CornerRadius=UDim.new(1,0)
        table.insert(barSnow,{gui=d,x=rng:NextNumber(2,BAR_W-4),y=rng:NextNumber(-BAR_H,BAR_H),speed=rng:NextNumber(8,20),drift=rng:NextNumber(-5,5)})
    end

    local avatar=Instance.new("ImageLabel",pbFrame)
    avatar.Name="Avatar"
    avatar.Size=UDim2.new(0,28,0,28)

    avatar.BackgroundTransparency=0.2
    avatar.BorderSizePixel=0
    avatar.ImageTransparency=0.12
    avatar.ZIndex=5
    Instance.new("UICorner",avatar).CornerRadius=UDim.new(1,0)
    local avatarStroke=Instance.new("UIStroke",avatar)
    avatarStroke.Color=WHITE
    avatarStroke.Thickness=1
    avatarStroke.Transparency=0.2
    task.spawn(function()
        for _=1,12 do
            if not avatar.Parent then return end
            local ok,img,ready=pcall(function()
                return Players:GetUserThumbnailAsync(LP.UserId,Enum.ThumbnailType.HeadShot,Enum.ThumbnailSize.Size150x150)
            end)
            if ok and img and img~="" then
                avatar.Image=img
                avatar.ImageTransparency=0
                if ready then return end
            end
            task.wait(0.35)
        end
    end)

    local divider=Instance.new("Frame",pbFrame)
    divider.Name="Divider"
    divider.Size=UDim2.new(0,2,0,22)
    divider.Position=UDim2.new(0,41,0.5,0)
    divider.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(0,0.5)
    divider.BackgroundColor3=WHITE
    divider.BackgroundTransparency=0.25
    divider.BorderSizePixel=0
    divider.ZIndex=4

    local percentLbl=Instance.new("TextLabel",pbFrame)
    percentLbl.Name="Percent"
    percentLbl.Size=UDim2.new(0,52,0,20)
    percentLbl.Position=UDim2.new(0,48,0,3)
    percentLbl.BackgroundTransparency=1
    percentLbl.Text="0%"

    statsLbl.TextColor3=WHITE

    knob.Name="Knob"
    knob.Size=UDim2.new(0,11,0,11)
    knob.Position=UDim2.new(0,6,0.5,0)
    knob.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(0.5,0.5)
    knob.BackgroundColor3=WHITE
    knob.BorderSizePixel=0
    knob.ZIndex=7
    Instance.new("UICorner",knob).CornerRadius=UDim.new(1,0)

    knobStroke.Color=Color3.fromRGB(120,120,120)
    knobStroke.Thickness=1
    knobStroke.Transparency=0.4

    local function syncKnob()
        local x=fill.AbsoluteSize.X
        local maxX=math.max(track.AbsoluteSize.X,12)
        knob.Position=UDim2.new(0,math.clamp(x,6,maxX-6),0.5,0)
    end
    fill:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(syncKnob)
    track:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(syncKnob)
    task.defer(syncKnob)

    -- ONLY size control: the existing Settings > STEAL UI > Progress Bar Size.
    local pbScale=Instance.new("UIScale")
    pbScale.Name="AdaptProgressBarScale"
    pbScale.Scale=math.clamp(
        tonumber(_G.AdaptProgressBarScaleValue)
        or tonumber(aceProgressBarScaleValue)
        or 1,
        0.3,3
    )
    pbScale.Parent=pbFrame
    _G.LonelyStealBarFrame=pbFrame
    _G.LonelyStealBarScale=pbScale

    -- Drag exactly like the old bar: UNLOCKED = draggable, LOCK GUI = fixed.
    -- The lock lives in the main Settings menu; there is no lock/unlock control
    -- on the new bar itself. Position is saved through the existing config.
    do
        local dragging=false
        local dragStart=nil
        local startPos=nil
        local dragInput=nil

        local function beginDrag(input)
            if _G.AdaptGuiLocked == true then return end
            dragging=true
            dragStart=input.Position
            startPos=pbFrame.Position
            dragInput=input
        end

        pbFrame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
                or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                beginDrag(input)
                input.Changed:Connect(function()
                    if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                        dragging=false
                        dragInput=nil
                        _G.AdaptStealBarPosition=udim2ToTable(pbFrame.Position)
                        if saveAdaptConfig then pcall(saveAdaptConfig) end
                    end
                end)
            end
        end)

        UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
            if not dragging or _G.AdaptGuiLocked == true then return end
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
                or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                local delta=input.Position-dragStart
                pbFrame.Position=UDim2.new(
                    startPos.X.Scale,startPos.X.Offset+delta.X,
                    startPos.Y.Scale,startPos.Y.Offset+delta.Y
                )
            end
        end)
    end

    -- Live FPS / ping / clock + animated bar snow.
    local fpsAcc,fpsCount,fpsShown=0,0,0
    RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
        if not pbFrame.Parent then return end
        for _,sp in ipairs(barSnow) do
            local d=sp.gui
            if d and d.Parent then
                sp.y=sp.y+sp.speed*dt
                sp.x=sp.x+sp.drift*dt
                if sp.y>BAR_H+3 then
                    sp.y=rng:NextNumber(-18,-2)
                    sp.x=rng:NextNumber(2,BAR_W-4)
                    sp.speed=rng:NextNumber(8,20)
                    sp.drift=rng:NextNumber(-5,5)
                end
                if sp.x<2 then sp.x=2; sp.drift=math.abs(sp.drift) end
                if sp.x>BAR_W-4 then sp.x=BAR_W-4; sp.drift=-math.abs(sp.drift) end
                d.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(sp.x,sp.y)
            end
        end
        fpsAcc=fpsAcc+dt
        fpsCount=fpsCount+1
        if fpsAcc>=0.5 then
            fpsShown=math.floor(fpsCount/fpsAcc)
            fpsAcc,fpsCount=0,0
            local ping=0
            pcall(function()
                ping=math.floor(Stats.Network.ServerStatsItem["Data Ping"]:GetValue())
            end)
            local t=os.date("*t")
            local h12=t.hour%12
            if h12==0 then h12=12 end
            local meridiem=t.hour<12 and "AM" or "PM"
            statsLbl.Text=string.format(
                "FPS %d  PING %dms | %02d:%02d %s",
                fpsShown,ping,h12,t.min,meridiem
            )
        end
    end)

    -- One authoritative API. There is no second/legacy bar implementation.
    local StealBar={}
    local resetGeneration=0
    function StealBar.SetProgress(p)
        resetGeneration=resetGeneration+1
        p=tonumber(p) or 0
        if p>1 then p=p/100 end
        p=math.clamp(p,0,1)
        fill.Size=UDim2.new(p,0,1,0)
        percentLbl.Text=math.floor(p*100+0.5).."%"
        syncKnob()
    end

    function StealBar.Reset(delaySeconds)
        resetGeneration=resetGeneration+1
        local myGeneration=resetGeneration
        local delay=tonumber(delaySeconds) or 0
        if delay>0 then
            task.delay(delay,function()
                if myGeneration~=resetGeneration or not pbFrame.Parent then return end
                fill.Size=UDim2.new(0,0,1,0)
                percentLbl.Text="0%"
                syncKnob()
                        barStroke.Color=BORDER_COL
                barStroke.Thickness=1.4
                barStroke.Transparency=0.15
            end)
            return
        end
        fill.Size=UDim2.new(0,0,1,0)
        percentLbl.Text="0%"
        syncKnob()
        barStroke.Color=BORDER_COL
        barStroke.Thickness=1.6
        barStroke.Transparency=0.15
    end

    -- State changes only affect the border; progress is NEVER generated here.
    function StealBar.SetState(state)
        state=tostring(state or "IDLE")
        if state=="STEALING" then
            barStroke.Color=BORDER_COL
            barStroke.Thickness=1.6
            barStroke.Transparency=0.05
        elseif state=="READY" then
            barStroke.Color=BORDER_COL
            barStroke.Thickness=1.1
            barStroke.Transparency=0.05
        else
            barStroke.Color=BORDER_COL
            barStroke.Thickness=1.4
            barStroke.Transparency=0.15
        end
    end

    function StealBar.Show(on)
        pbFrame.Visible=(on~=false)
    end

    function StealBar.IsVisible()
        return pbFrame.Visible
    end

    _G.StealBar=StealBar

    -- One authoritative repaint for EVERY Steal Bar visual surface.
    -- Keeps the progress value untouched while synchronizing border/track/fill/text/avatar.
    _G.AdaptRepaintStealBar=function()
        pcall(function()
            if not pbFrame or not pbFrame.Parent then return end
            local text = WHITE
            local contrast = WHITE
            local fillCol = FILL_COL

            pbFrame.BackgroundColor3 = INK
            pbFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.04
            barStroke.Color = BORDER_COL
            barStroke.Thickness = 1.4
            barStroke.Transparency = 0.15

            if track and track.Parent then
                track.BackgroundColor3 = TRACK_COL
                local ts = track:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
                if not ts then
                    ts = Instance.new("UIStroke")
                    ts.Name = "StealTrackStroke"
                    ts.Parent = track
                end
                ts.Color = WHITE
                ts.Thickness = 1
                ts.Transparency = 0.05
            end
            if fill and fill.Parent then
                fill.BackgroundColor3 = fillCol
                local grad = fill:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient")
                if not grad then
                    grad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
                    grad.Parent = fill
                end
                grad.Name = "StealFillGradient"
                grad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
                    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.00, Color3.fromRGB(238, 238, 242)),
                    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1.00, Color3.fromRGB(168, 168, 178)),
                })
                grad.Rotation = 0
            end
            if knob and knob.Parent then
                knob.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE
                local ks=knob:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
                if ks then ks.Color=Color3.fromRGB(120,120,120); ks.Thickness=1; ks.Transparency=0.4 end
            end
            if divider and divider.Parent then divider.BackgroundColor3=BORDER_COL; divider.BackgroundTransparency=0.22 end
            if percentLbl and percentLbl.Parent then percentLbl.TextColor3=WHITE end
            if statsLbl and statsLbl.Parent then statsLbl.TextColor3=WHITE end
            if avatar and avatar.Parent then
                local avs=avatar:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
                if avs then avs.Color=BORDER_COL; avs.Thickness=1; avs.Transparency=0.12 end
            end
            for _,sp in ipairs(barSnow) do
                if sp.gui and sp.gui.Parent then
                    sp.gui.BackgroundColor3=WHITE
                end
            end
        end)
    end

    StealBar.Reset()
    StealBar.SetState("IDLE")
    _G.AdaptRepaintStealBar()
end
_G.__AdaptDuelsSetupStealBar()

local function _l4PeakStartIntroSong()
    pcall(function()
        local asset = getcustomasset or getsynasset
        if type(asset) ~= "function" or type(writefile) ~= "function" then return end

        local exists = false
        if type(isfile) == "function" then
            local ok, value = pcall(isfile, SONG_FILE)
            exists = ok and value == true
        end

        -- Cached song: bind + play synchronously so frame 0 of the intro has audio.
        if exists then
            local ok, id = pcall(asset, SONG_FILE)
            if ok and id and sound.Parent then
                sound.SoundId = id
                sound.TimePosition = 0
                sound:Play()
            end
            return
        end

        -- First run: download in parallel; the intro animation never waits for HTTP.
        local ok, body = pcall(function() return game:HttpGet(SONG_URL) end)
        if not ok or type(body) ~= "string" or #body == 0 then return end
        if not pcall(writefile, SONG_FILE, body) then return end
        local ok2, id = pcall(asset, SONG_FILE)
        if ok2 and id and sound.Parent then
            sound.SoundId = id
            sound.TimePosition = 0
            sound:Play()
        end
    end)
end

task.spawn(_l4PeakStartIntroSong)

local finished = false
local introDone = false
local heldInput = nil
local holdStarted = nil
local holdGeneration = 0
local connections = {}
local startTime = os.clock()

local function cleanup()
    for _, c in ipairs(connections) do
        pcall(function()
            c:Disconnect()
        end)
    end
    pcall(function()
        sound:Stop()
        sound:Destroy()
    end)
    pcall(function()
        intro:Destroy()
    end)
    introDone = true
end

local function finishIntro(fast)
    if finished then return end
    finished = true
    holdGeneration += 1
    local d = fast and 0.14 or 0.34
    pcall(function()
        TweenService:Create(
            overlay,
            TweenInfo.new(d,Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
            {BackgroundTransparency = 0}
        ):Play()
    end)
    pcall(function()
        TweenService:Create(
            sound,
            TweenInfo.new(d,Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
            {Volume = 0}
        ):Play()
    end)
    task.delay(d + 0.04, cleanup)
end

local skipButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
skipButton.Name = "SkipButton"
skipButton.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1,0)
skipButton.Position = UDim2.new(1,-16,0,18)
skipButton.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(88,38)
skipButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(4,10,18)
skipButton.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
skipButton.BorderSizePixel = 0
skipButton.AutoButtonColor = false
skipButton.Text = "SKIP"
skipButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
skipButton.TextSize = 14
skipButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(235,242,255)
skipButton.ZIndex = 60
skipButton.Parent = intro

skipStroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
skipStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(45,120,255)
skipStroke.Thickness = 1.5
skipStroke.Transparency = 0.2

table.insert(connections, skipButton.Activated:Connect(function()
    finishIntro(true)
end))

table.insert(connections, UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if finished then return end
    local kind = input.UserInputType
    if kind ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch and kind ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then return end
    heldInput = input
    holdStarted = os.clock()
    holdGeneration += 1
    local gen = holdGeneration
    task.delay(HOLD_TO_SKIP,function()
        if finished or heldInput ~= input or gen ~= holdGeneration then return end
        finishIntro(true)
    end)
end))

table.insert(connections, UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if heldInput == input then
        heldInput = nil
        holdStarted = nil
        holdGeneration += 1
        skipLabel.Visible = false
        skipLabel.Text = ""
    end
end))

table.insert(connections, game:GetService("RunService").RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if finished then return end
    if heldInput and holdStarted then
        local left = math.max(0,HOLD_TO_SKIP-(os.clock()-holdStarted))
        skipLabel.Visible = true
        skipLabel.Text = string.format("HOLD TO SKIP  %.1fs",left)
    else
        skipLabel.Visible = false
    end
end))

function aceTryRestoreAutoTP()

end

function aceRepairKeybinds()
for keyId, defaultKey in pairs(DEFAULT_SPEED_KEYBINDS) do
if speedKeybinds[keyId] == nil or speedKeybinds[keyId] == Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then
speedKeybinds[keyId] = defaultKey
end
end
--Leaked By Xlu0 AndPrime--
if speedKeybinds.AntiDesyncAimbot == nil then
speedKeybinds.AntiDesyncAimbot = Enum.KeyCode.V
end
if tpDownKeybind == Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then tpDownKeybind = DEFAULT_TP_DOWN_KEYBIND end
if refreshAllSpeedKeybinds then refreshAllSpeedKeybinds() end
if refreshTPDownKeybind then refreshTPDownKeybind() end
end

function _G.AdaptApplyMobileButtonsHidden()
local shouldHide = (_G.AdaptHideMobileButtons == true)

local g = nil
pcall(function()
    g = PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("AdaptMobileButtons")
end)

if not g then
    pcall(function()
        local cg = game:GetService("CoreGui")
        g = cg and cg:FindFirstChild("AdaptMobileButtons")
    end)
end

if not g and gethui then
    pcall(function()
        local hui = gethui()
        g = hui and hui:FindFirstChild("AdaptMobileButtons")
    end)
end

if not g and mobileGui and mobileGui.Parent then
    g = mobileGui
end

if g then
    g.Enabled = not shouldHide
end

    pcall(setHideMobileButtonsVisual, shouldHide)
end
