local function normalizeMobileImage(value)
value = tostring(value or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
if value == "" then return "" end
local id = value:match("^(%d+)$")
if id then return "rbxassetid://" .. id end
local embedded = value:match("[?&]id=(%d+)") or value:match("/(%d+)[/%?]?")
if embedded then return "rbxassetid://" .. embedded end
return value
end
function _G.AdaptApplyMobileButtonImage()
local image = normalizeMobileImage(_G.AdaptMobileButtonImage)
for _, entry in pairs(mobileButtons) do
local btn = entry and entry.btn
local img = btn and btn:FindFirstChild("MobileBackgroundImage")
if img then
img.Image = image
img.ImageColor3 = _G.AdaptThemeColors[_G.AdaptThemeName] or _G.AdaptThemeColors.BLACK_PINK
img.Visible = image ~= ""
end
end
end
function _G.AdaptApplyMobileButtonShape()
-- Full 3 modes from Adapt: CIRCLE (7UP full round) / FOUNDED / SQUARE
local shape = tostring(_G.AdaptMobileButtonShape or "FOUNDED"):upper()
if shape ~= "CIRCLE" and shape ~= "FOUNDED" and shape ~= "SQUARE" then shape = "FOUNDED" end
_G.AdaptMobileButtonShape = shape
for key, entry in pairs(mobileButtons) do
local btn = entry and entry.btn
local holder = entry and entry.holder
if btn and holder then
local isCircle = shape == "CIRCLE"
local isSquare = shape == "SQUARE"
-- keep square footprint so CIRCLE looks fully round (7UP style)
local side = 58
if holder.Size.X.Offset >= 100 then
    -- leave wide buttons alone if any remain
else
    holder.Size = UDim2.new(0, side, 0, side)
end
btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
btn.TextSize = 10
local textOverlay = btn:FindFirstChild("MobileButtonText")
if textOverlay then
textOverlay.Font = btn.Font
textOverlay.TextSize = btn.TextSize
end
-- radii: CIRCLE = full 7UP circle | FOUNDED = soft | SQUARE = slight
local radius = UDim.new(0, 12) -- FOUNDED default
if isCircle then radius = UDim.new(1, 0) end -- full circle like 7UP
if isSquare then radius = UDim.new(0, 6) end
local function applyCorner(obj)
    if not obj then return end
    local c = obj:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
    if not c then c = Instance.new("UICorner"); c.Parent = obj end
    c.CornerRadius = radius
end
applyCorner(btn)
applyCorner(btn:FindFirstChild("MobileBackgroundImage"))
applyCorner(btn:FindFirstChild("ButtonNoneBackground"))
local glow = holder:FindFirstChild("Glow")
if glow then
    applyCorner(glow)
    -- glow follows circle tightly
    if isCircle then
        glow.Size = UDim2.new(1, 4, 1, 4)
        glow.Position = UDim2.new(0, -2, 0, -2)
    end
end
local dot = btn:FindFirstChild("Dot")
if isSquare then
if not dot then
 dot = Instance.new("Frame")
 dot.Name = "Dot"
 dot.Size = UDim2.new(0, 6, 0, 6)
 dot.Position = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 7)
 dot.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80,80,95)
 dot.BorderSizePixel = 0
 dot.ZIndex = btn.ZIndex + 2
 dot.Parent = btn
 Instance.new("UICorner", dot).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1,0)
end
dot.Visible = true
else
if dot then dot.Visible = false end
end
-- refresh border style after shape change
if entry.setActive then
    local keepOn = btn:GetAttribute("AdaptMobilePressed") == true
    btn:SetAttribute("AdaptMobileVisualState", nil)
    pcall(entry.setActive, keepOn)
end
end
end
end
function _G.AdaptApplyMobileButtonSize()
_G.AdaptMobileButtonScale = math.clamp(tonumber(_G.AdaptMobileButtonScale) or 1.00, 0.30, 1.35)
for _, entry in pairs(mobileButtons) do
local holder = entry and entry.holder
if holder then
local sc = holder:FindFirstChild("MobileButtonScale") or Instance.new("UIScale")
sc.Name = "MobileButtonScale"
sc.Scale = _G.AdaptMobileButtonScale
sc.Parent = holder
end
end
pcall(function()
local gui = PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("AdaptDuelsAdaptReconstruct") or PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("AdaptHubPolished") or PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("CyberHub")
local root = gui or PlayerGui
for _, obj in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
if obj.Name == "Mobile Buttons Size" then
local valueBox = obj:FindFirstChild("Value")
if valueBox and valueBox:IsA("TextLabel") then
valueBox.Text = string.format("%.2f", _G.AdaptMobileButtonScale)
end
end
end
end)
end
local function setActive(btn, state)
    if not btn then return end

    local pressed = btn:GetAttribute("AdaptMobilePressed") == true
    state = (state == true) or pressed
    btn:SetAttribute("AdaptMobileVisualState", state and "on" or "off")

    -- One visual system for EVERY mobile button.
    -- TP Bat and Bat Aimbot use exactly the same ON/OFF colors and typography.
    local holder = btn.Parent
    local noneBg = btn:FindFirstChild("ButtonNoneBackground")
    local bgImage = btn:FindFirstChild("MobileBackgroundImage")
    local textOverlay = btn:FindFirstChild("MobileButtonText")
    local st = btn:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")

    local ON_BG = Color3.fromRGB(245,245,245)
    local ON_TEXT = Color3.fromRGB(10,10,12)
    local OFF_BG = Color3.fromRGB(12,12,15)
    local OFF_TEXT = Color3.fromRGB(185,185,192)
    local ON_STROKE = Color3.fromRGB(160,160,168)
    local OFF_STROKE = Color3.fromRGB(70,70,78)

    if noneBg then
        noneBg.BackgroundTransparency = 0
        noneBg.BackgroundColor3 = state and ON_BG or OFF_BG

        local ng = noneBg:FindFirstChild("ButtonNoneGradient")
        if ng then
            ng.Enabled = false
        end
    end

    if bgImage then
        bgImage.ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
        if bgImage.Image ~= "" then
            bgImage.Visible = true
            if noneBg then
                noneBg.BackgroundTransparency = 0.18
            end
        else
            bgImage.Visible = false
        end
    end

    if textOverlay then
        textOverlay.TextColor3 = state and ON_TEXT or OFF_TEXT
        textOverlay.Font = state and Enum.Font.GothamBlack or Enum.Font.GothamMedium
        textOverlay.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
        textOverlay.TextStrokeTransparency = state and 0.55 or 0.25
    end

    pcall(function()
        btn.Font = state and Enum.Font.GothamBlack or Enum.Font.GothamMedium
        btn.TextColor3 = state and ON_TEXT or OFF_TEXT
    end)

    if st then
        st.Color = state and ON_STROKE or OFF_STROKE
        st.Thickness = state and 2.2 or 1.35
        st.Transparency = state and 0 or 0.18
        st.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
    end

    local glow = holder and holder:FindFirstChild("Glow")
    if glow then
        glow.Visible = false
        glow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        local gs = glow:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
        if gs then
            gs.Transparency = 1
        end
    end
end

local function pulse(btn)
if not btn then return end
btn:SetAttribute("AdaptMobilePressed", true)
setActive(btn, true)
task.delay(0.18, function()
if btn and btn.Parent then
btn:SetAttribute("AdaptMobilePressed", false)
setActive(btn, false)
end
end)
end
local function addLaPeakSnowToMobileButton(btn)
    if not btn or btn:FindFirstChild("LaPeakMobileSnow") then return end
    btn.ClipsDescendants = true
    local layer = Instance.new("Frame")
    layer.Name = "LaPeakMobileSnow"
    layer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    layer.BorderSizePixel = 0
    layer.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
    layer.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0,0)
    layer.ClipsDescendants = true
    layer.Active = false
    layer.Selectable = false
    layer.ZIndex = btn.ZIndex + 1
    layer.Parent = btn
    local rng = Random.new()
    local particles = {}
    for i=1,14 do
        local dot = Instance.new("Frame")
        dot.Name = "Snow_" .. i
        local sz = rng:NextNumber(1.2,3.0)
        dot.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(sz,sz)
        dot.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(248,248,255)
        dot.BackgroundTransparency = rng:NextNumber(0.20,0.68)
        dot.BorderSizePixel = 0
        dot.Active = false
        dot.Selectable = false
        dot.ZIndex = layer.ZIndex
        dot.Parent = layer
        Instance.new("UICorner",dot).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1,0)
        particles[#particles+1] = {gui=dot,x=rng:NextNumber(0,1),y=rng:NextNumber(-1,1),speed=rng:NextNumber(0.10,0.28),drift=rng:NextNumber(-0.06,0.06),sway=rng:NextNumber(0,6.28),swaySpeed=rng:NextNumber(0.8,1.8)}
    end
    local elapsed = 0
    local conn
    conn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
        if not layer.Parent then if conn then conn:Disconnect() end return end
        elapsed = elapsed + dt
        for _, sp in ipairs(particles) do
            local d = sp.gui
            if d and d.Parent then
                sp.y = sp.y + sp.speed * dt
                sp.x = sp.x + sp.drift * dt + math.sin(elapsed * sp.swaySpeed + sp.sway) * 0.001
                if sp.y > 1.06 then
                    sp.y = -0.08
                    sp.x = rng:NextNumber(-0.03,1.03)
                    sp.speed = rng:NextNumber(0.10,0.28)
                    sp.drift = rng:NextNumber(-0.06,0.06)
                end
                if sp.x < -0.04 then sp.x = 1.04 elseif sp.x > 1.04 then sp.x = -0.04 end
                d.Position = UDim2.new(sp.x,0,sp.y,0)
            end
        end
    end)
end

stroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
local pressing, dragging = false, false
local pressPos, holderStart = nil, nil
local movedDistance = 0
local MOVE_THRESHOLD = 8

btn.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
    if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        pressing = true
        dragging = false
        movedDistance = 0
        pressPos = i.Position
        holderStart = holder.Position
        btn:SetAttribute("AdaptMobilePressed", true)
        setActive(btn, true)
        pcall(function()
            TS:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.08, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
                Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 4),
                Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -4)
            }):Play()
        end)
    end
end)

btn.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
    if not pressing then return end
    if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        local delta = i.Position - pressPos
        movedDistance = delta.Magnitude
        if movedDistance > MOVE_THRESHOLD then dragging = true end
        if dragging and not _G.AdaptGuiLocked and holderStart then
            holder.Position = UDim2.new(
                holderStart.X.Scale, holderStart.X.Offset + delta.X,
                holderStart.Y.Scale, holderStart.Y.Offset + delta.Y
            )
        end
    end
end)

local function finishMobileInput(i)
    if not pressing then return end
    if i.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and i.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end

    if not dragging and movedDistance <= MOVE_THRESHOLD then
        pcall(onPress, btn)
    elseif dragging and not _G.AdaptGuiLocked then
        -- Keep the edited coordinate in memory. It is persisted when Lock GUI is enabled.
        saveMobileButtonPosition(key, holder.Position)
    end

    pressing = false
    dragging = false
    movedDistance = 0
    pressPos = nil
    holderStart = nil
    btn:SetAttribute("AdaptMobilePressed", false)

    pcall(function()
        TS:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.10, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        }):Play()
    end)

    task.delay(0.08, function()
        if btn and btn.Parent then
            local keepOn = false
            if key == "autoLeft" then keepOn = autoLeftEnabled == true
            elseif key == "autoRight" then keepOn = autoRightEnabled == true
            elseif key == "aimbot" then
                if _G.AdaptAimbotMode == "Bypass" then
                    keepOn = _G.AceAntiBypassAimbotOn == true
                else
                    keepOn = _G.AdaptNormalAimbotOn == true
                end
            elseif key == "antiDesync" or key == "tpBat" then
                if _G.AdaptTPBatMode == "V2" then
                    keepOn = _G.__LaPeakTPBatCleanV2 and _G.__LaPeakTPBatCleanV2.enabled == true
                else
                    keepOn = _G.AdaptTPBatV1 and _G.AdaptTPBatV1.enabled == true
                    if not keepOn and _G.__LaPeakTPBatV1Core and _G.__LaPeakTPBatV1Core.isOn then
                        local ok, liveOn = pcall(_G.__LaPeakTPBatV1Core.isOn)
                        keepOn = ok and liveOn == true
                    end
                end
            elseif key == "antiAntiTP" then keepOn = _G.AdaptAntiTPBatEnabled == true
            elseif key == "carry" then keepOn = currentSpeedMode == "Carry"
            elseif key == "laggerNormal" then keepOn = currentSpeedMode == "Lagger"
            elseif key == "laggerCarry" then keepOn = currentSpeedMode == "Lagger Carry"
            elseif key == "customSpeed" then keepOn = currentSpeedMode == "Custom"
            elseif key == "customCarry" then keepOn = currentSpeedMode == "Custom Carry"
            end
            setActive(btn, keepOn)
        end
    end)
end

btn.InputEnded:Connect(finishMobileInput)
UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
    if pressing then finishMobileInput(i) end
end)

mobileButtons[key] = {holder = holder, btn = btn, onPress = onPress, setActive = function(state) setActive(btn, state) end}
return btn
end

-- ============================================================
-- INSTA RESET — FULL VX7 RESET CORE
-- Replaces the old La Peak reset sequence.
-- VX7 sequence: busy/token state -> stop anti-ragdoll -> freeze camera
-- -> disable character collisions -> clear velocity -> clear PhysicsRepRootPart
-- -> vertical launch -> wait for CharacterAdded -> restore collisions/camera
-- -> restart anti-ragdoll -> hard timeout cleanup.
-- ============================================================
local _VX7IR = {
    busy = false,
    character = nil,
    respawnConn = nil,
    token = nil,
    collisions = {},
}

_G._AdaptInstantResetBusy = false
_G.AdaptInstantResetInProgress = false
_G.AdaptInstantResetVersion = 2

local function _VX7IRSetButton(on)
    pcall(function()
        local mb = mobileButtons and mobileButtons.instaReset
        if mb and mb.setActive then
            mb.setActive(on == true)
        end
    end)
end

local function _VX7IRClearVelocity(root)
    if not root then return end
    pcall(function()
        root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
        root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
    end)
end

_VX7IR.finish = function(newHumanoid)
    if _VX7IR.respawnConn then
        pcall(function()
            _VX7IR.respawnConn:Disconnect()
        end)
        _VX7IR.respawnConn = nil
    end

    -- VX7 restores every BasePart's original CanCollide state.
    for part, oldCanCollide in pairs(_VX7IR.collisions) do
        if part and part.Parent then
            pcall(function()
                part.CanCollide = oldCanCollide
            end)
        end
    end
    _VX7IR.collisions = {}

    local character = LP.Character
    local humanoid = newHumanoid or (character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"))
    local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if camera then
        pcall(function()
            if humanoid then
                camera.CameraSubject = humanoid
            end
            camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
        end)
    end

    _VX7IR.busy = false
    _VX7IR.character = nil
    _VX7IR.token = nil
    _G._AdaptInstantResetBusy = false
    _G.AdaptInstantResetInProgress = false
    pcall(function() Config._instaResetInProgress = false end)
    pcall(function() Config.instaResetEnabled = false end)
    pcall(function() instaResetEnabled = false end)
    _VX7IRSetButton(false)

    -- Restore the same protections VX7 restarts after the reset sequence.
    if antiRagdollEnabled and startAntiRagdoll then
        pcall(startAntiRagdoll)
    end
end

_G.AdaptInstantReset = function()
    if _VX7IR.busy then
        return
    end

    local character = LP.Character
    local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not root or not humanoid then
        return
    end

    local token = {}
    _VX7IR.busy = true
    _VX7IR.character = character
    _VX7IR.token = token
    _G._AdaptInstantResetBusy = true
    _G.AdaptInstantResetInProgress = true
    _G.AdaptInstantResetVersion = 2
    pcall(function() Config._instaResetInProgress = true end)
    pcall(function() Config.instaResetEnabled = true end)
    pcall(function() instaResetEnabled = true end)
    _VX7IRSetButton(true)

    -- Keep Anti Ragdoll running through Instant Reset/respawn.
    -- Only the temporary Anti Die guard is paused for the reset sequence.
    pcall(function() if Config._btpV1AntiDieStop then Config._btpV1AntiDieStop(true) end end)

    -- The respawn connection is token-protected so an old reset cannot finish
    -- a later reset sequence.
    _VX7IR.respawnConn = LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(newCharacter)
        local conn = _VX7IR.respawnConn
        _VX7IR.respawnConn = nil
        if conn then
            pcall(function()
                conn:Disconnect()
            end)
        end

        task.wait(0.1)
        local newHumanoid = newCharacter:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 3)
        if _VX7IR.token ~= token then
            return
        end
        _VX7IR.finish(newHumanoid)
    end)

    local ok, err = pcall(function()
        -- VX7 freezes the camera before forcing the reset.
        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if camera then
            camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
            camera.CFrame = camera.CFrame
        end

        -- Save and disable collisions for every BasePart in the old character.
        for _, descendant in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
            if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
                _VX7IR.collisions[descendant] = descendant.CanCollide
                descendant.CanCollide = false
            end
        end

        -- VX7 clears current physics before the launch/reset impulse.
        _VX7IRClearVelocity(root)

        -- Same PhysicsRepRootPart reset used by VX7.
        if sethiddenproperty then
            pcall(sethiddenproperty, root, "PhysicsRepRootPart", nil)
        end

        -- VX7 reset impulse.
        root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 3000000, 0)
    end)

    if not ok then
        _VX7IR.finish()
        warn("VX7 Insta Reset: " .. tostring(err))
        return
    end

    -- VX7 hard timeout: if CharacterAdded never arrives, clean up after 5s.
    task.delay(5, function()
        if _VX7IR.token ~= token then
            return
        end

        if LP.Character == character and root.Parent then
            _VX7IRClearVelocity(root)
        end

        _VX7IR.finish()
    end)
end

_G.AdaptStopInstantReset = function()
    if not _VX7IR.busy then
        return
    end

    local token = _VX7IR.token
    _VX7IR.token = nil
    if _VX7IR.respawnConn then
        pcall(function()
            _VX7IR.respawnConn:Disconnect()
        end)
        _VX7IR.respawnConn = nil
    end
    if token then
        _VX7IR.finish()
    end
end

_G.AdaptGetInstantResetState = function()
    return _VX7IR.busy == true
end

-- Safety cleanup if another CharacterAdded handler fires before the dedicated
-- reset connection gets a chance to finish.
LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
    if not _VX7IR.busy then
        return
    end

    local token = _VX7IR.token
    _VX7IR.token = nil
    if _VX7IR.respawnConn then
        pcall(function()
            _VX7IR.respawnConn:Disconnect()
        end)
        _VX7IR.respawnConn = nil
    end

    if token then
        task.defer(function()
            if LP.Character == character then
                local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                _VX7IR.finish(humanoid)
            end
        end)
    end
end)

-- All legacy mobile button instances removed. VX7 mobile engine below is the sole mobile button runtime.

-- Central mobile-state refresh. Every persistent feature button is driven by
-- its real runtime state, so Auto Carry / Soft / Normal mode changes also
-- immediately update the corresponding speed button font to GothamBlack.
_G.AdaptRefreshMobileButtonStates = function()
    if not mobileButtons then return end
    local states = {
        autoLeft = autoLeftEnabled == true,
        autoRight = autoRightEnabled == true,
        aimbot = (_G.AdaptAimbotMode == "Bypass" and _G.AceAntiBypassAimbotOn == true)
            or (_G.AdaptAimbotMode ~= "Bypass" and _G.AdaptNormalAimbotOn == true),
        antiDesync = (_G.AdaptTPBatV1 and _G.AdaptTPBatV1.enabled == true),
        antiAntiTP = _G.AdaptAntiTPBatEnabled == true,
        carry = currentSpeedMode == "Carry",
        laggerNormal = currentSpeedMode == "Lagger",
        laggerCarry = currentSpeedMode == "Lagger Carry",
        customSpeed = currentSpeedMode == "Custom",
        customCarry = currentSpeedMode == "Custom Carry",
    }
    for key, on in pairs(states) do
        local entry = mobileButtons[key]
        if entry and entry.setActive then
            pcall(entry.setActive, on)
        end
    end
end

-- If already on V2 at boot, hide all V1 speed mobile buttons

    task.wait(0.3)
    if _G.AdaptSpeedMethod == "V2" and type(_G.LonelyApplySpeedMethodVis) == "function" then
        pcall(_G.LonelyApplySpeedMethodVis)
    end
    if _G.AdaptSpeedMethod == "V2" and mobileButtons then
        for _, k in ipairs({"carry","laggerNormal","laggerCarry","customSpeed","customCarry"}) do
            local e = mobileButtons[k]
            if e and e.holder then e.holder.Visible = false end
            if e and e.btn then e.btn.Visible = false end
        end
    end
end)

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
if mobileButtons.autoLeft then mobileButtons.autoLeft.setActive(autoLeftEnabled == true) end
if mobileButtons.autoRight then mobileButtons.autoRight.setActive(autoRightEnabled == true) end
if mobileButtons.aimbot then
    -- Bat Aim outside button follows the active engine, not Normal-only state.
    local _batAimMobileOn = false
    if _G.AdaptAimbotMode == "Bypass" then
        _batAimMobileOn = (_G.AceAntiBypassAimbotOn == true)
    else
        _batAimMobileOn = (_G.AdaptNormalAimbotOn == true)
    end
    mobileButtons.aimbot.setActive(_batAimMobileOn)
end
if mobileButtons.antiDesync then mobileButtons.antiDesync.setActive(_G.AdaptAntiDesyncAimbotOn == true) end
local isV2 = (_G.AdaptSpeedMethod == "V2")
for _, k in ipairs({"carry","laggerNormal","laggerCarry","customSpeed","customCarry"}) do
    local e = mobileButtons[k]
    if e and e.holder then
        if isV2 then
            e.holder.Visible = false
            if e.btn then e.btn.Visible = false end
        end
    end
end
if not isV2 then
    -- Single source of truth: whichever speed mode is currently active is
    -- bold. This also catches Auto Carry Speed SOFT/NORMAL transitions.
    if mobileButtons.carry then mobileButtons.carry.setActive(currentSpeedMode == "Carry") end
    if mobileButtons.laggerNormal then mobileButtons.laggerNormal.setActive(currentSpeedMode == "Lagger") end
    if mobileButtons.laggerCarry then mobileButtons.laggerCarry.setActive(currentSpeedMode == "Lagger Carry") end
    if mobileButtons.customSpeed then mobileButtons.customSpeed.setActive(currentSpeedMode == "Custom") end
    if mobileButtons.customCarry then mobileButtons.customCarry.setActive(currentSpeedMode == "Custom Carry") end
end
-- Auto Carry Speed itself also follows its real runtime state.
if mobileButtons.carry then
    local autoCarryActive = (autoCarrySpeedEnabled == true and (_G.AdaptAutoCarryState and _G.AdaptAutoCarryState.locked == true))
    if autoCarryActive and (currentSpeedMode == "Carry" or currentSpeedMode == "Lagger Carry") then
        mobileButtons.carry.setActive(true)
        if currentSpeedMode == "Lagger Carry" and mobileButtons.laggerCarry then mobileButtons.laggerCarry.setActive(true) end
    end
end
end)
end)

_G.LonelyForceCircleButtons = function()
    pcall(function()
        local shape = tostring(_G.AdaptMobileButtonShape or "FOUNDED"):upper()
        if shape ~= "CIRCLE" and shape ~= "FOUNDED" and shape ~= "SQUARE" then shape = "FOUNDED" end
        _G.AdaptMobileButtonShape = shape
        if _G.AdaptApplyMobileButtonShape then pcall(_G.AdaptApplyMobileButtonShape) end
        -- only force full-circle corners when CIRCLE
        if shape ~= "CIRCLE" then return end
        local pg = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
        if not pg then return end
        for _, gui in ipairs(pg:GetChildren()) do
            if gui:IsA("ScreenGui") then
                for _, d in ipairs(gui:GetDescendants()) do
                    if d:IsA("TextButton") and (tostring(d.Name):find("MB_") or d.Name == "Instant Reset") then
                        local c = d:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
                        if not c then c = Instance.new("UICorner"); c.Parent = d end
                        c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
                        for _, ch in ipairs(d:GetChildren()) do
                            if ch:IsA("ImageLabel") or ch:IsA("Frame") then
                                local cc = ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
                                if not cc then cc = Instance.new("UICorner"); cc.Parent = ch end
                                cc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
                            end
                        end
                        local holder = d.Parent
                        if holder and holder:IsA("Frame") and tostring(holder.Name):find("MBH_") then
                            local side = math.max(holder.Size.X.Offset, holder.Size.Y.Offset)
                            if side < 40 then side = 58 end
                            if holder.Size.X.Offset < 100 then
                                holder.Size = UDim2.new(0, side, 0, side)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end)
end

        bb.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 3.2, 0)
        bb.AlwaysOnTop = true
        bb.MaxDistance = 80
        bb.Parent = hrp
        local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        lbl.Name = "SpeedText"
        lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
        lbl.TextSize = 16
        lbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)

if not _G._LonelyAimbotSpeedConn then
    _G._LonelyAimbotSpeedConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        local on = (_G.AdaptNormalAimbotOn == true) or (_G.AdaptAntiDesyncAimbotOn == true)
        local char = LP.Character
        local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not on or not hrp then
            local bb = hrp and hrp:FindFirstChild("LonelyAimbotSpeedBB")
            if bb then bb.Enabled = false end
            return
        end
        local bb = lonelyEnsureSpeedBillboard()
        if not bb then return end
        bb.Enabled = true
        local lbl = bb:FindFirstChild("SpeedText")
        if lbl then
            local v = hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity
            local spd = math.sqrt(v.X * v.X + v.Z * v.Z)
            lbl.Text = string.format("%.1f", spd)
        end
    end)
end

-- Per-button hide
_G.LonelySetButtonHidden = function(key, hidden)
    _G.AdaptPerButtonHidden = _G.AdaptPerButtonHidden or {}
    _G.AdaptPerButtonHidden[key] = hidden == true
    pcall(function()
        local v2Speed = (_G.AdaptSpeedMethod == "V2") and (
            key == "carry" or key == "laggerNormal" or key == "laggerCarry"
            or key == "customSpeed" or key == "customCarry" or key == "lagger"
        )
        if mobileButtons and mobileButtons[key] and mobileButtons[key].holder then
            if v2Speed then
                mobileButtons[key].holder.Visible = false
            else
                mobileButtons[key].holder.Visible = not hidden
            end
        end
        -- Hide Button Mobile is visual-only: hiding a button must NOT turn its
        -- feature off. The button can be shown again and its current state is preserved.
        -- Speed Method V2 still owns its own forced-hidden speed buttons above.

    end)
    if saveAdaptConfig then pcall(saveAdaptConfig) end
end

task.defer(function()
    task.wait(1.0)
    pcall(function()
        for key, hidden in pairs(_G.AdaptPerButtonHidden or {}) do
            if hidden and mobileButtons and mobileButtons[key] and mobileButtons[key].holder then
                mobileButtons[key].holder.Visible = false
            end
        end
    end)
end)

-- ===== RAGDOLL COUNTDOWN (full from Ace) =====
ragdollCountdownEnabled = (ragdollCountdownEnabled ~= false)
local RAGDOLL_COUNTDOWN_SECONDS = 3
local _lonelyRagConn, _lonelyRagCharConn
local _lonelyRagEnd = 0
local _lonelyRagLabel

local function _lonelyStopRagdollCountdown()
    if _lonelyRagConn then pcall(function() _lonelyRagConn:Disconnect() end); _lonelyRagConn = nil end
    if _lonelyRagCharConn then pcall(function() _lonelyRagCharConn:Disconnect() end); _lonelyRagCharConn = nil end
    if _lonelyRagLabel then _lonelyRagLabel.Visible = false; _lonelyRagLabel.Text = "" end
end

local function _lonelyEnsureOverhead(char)
    char = char or LP.Character
    if not char then return end
    local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
    if not head then return end
    local gui = head:FindFirstChild("LonelyOverheadInfo")
    if not gui then
        gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
        gui.Name = "LonelyOverheadInfo"
        gui.Size = UDim2.new(0, 220, 0, 40)
        gui.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 2.2, 0)
        gui.AlwaysOnTop = true
        gui.LightInfluence = 0
        gui.Parent = head
    end
    local lbl = gui:FindFirstChild("RagdollCountdown")
    if not lbl then
        lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        lbl.Name = "RagdollCountdown"
        lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        lbl.Text = ""
        lbl.Visible = false
        lbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 255, 120)
        lbl.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        lbl.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
        lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
        lbl.TextSize = 22
        lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
        lbl.Parent = gui
    end
    _lonelyRagLabel = lbl
    return lbl
end

function _G.LonelyHookRagdollCountdown(char)
    _lonelyStopRagdollCountdown()
    if not ragdollCountdownEnabled then return end
    char = char or LP.Character
    if not char then return end
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum then return end
    _lonelyEnsureOverhead(char)
    local function begin()
        _lonelyRagEnd = tick() + RAGDOLL_COUNTDOWN_SECONDS
        if _lonelyRagLabel then _lonelyRagLabel.Visible = true end
    end
    local function isRag()
        local st = hum:GetState()
        return hum.PlatformStand
            or st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics
            or st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll
            or st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown
    end
    _lonelyRagCharConn = hum.StateChanged:Connect(function(_, ns)
        if ns == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics
            or ns == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll
            or ns == Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown then
            begin()
        end
    end)
    _lonelyRagConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not ragdollCountdownEnabled then _lonelyStopRagdollCountdown(); return end
        if not _lonelyRagLabel or not _lonelyRagLabel.Parent then
            _lonelyEnsureOverhead(LP.Character)
        end
        if isRag() and _lonelyRagEnd < tick() then begin() end
        local left = math.max(0, _lonelyRagEnd - tick())
        if left > 0 and isRag() then
            _lonelyRagLabel.Visible = true
            _lonelyRagLabel.Text = string.format("RAGDOLL %.1f", left)
            _lonelyRagLabel.TextColor3 = left <= 1 and Color3.fromRGB(255,230,90) or Color3.fromRGB(80,255,120)
        else
            if _lonelyRagLabel then
                _lonelyRagLabel.Visible = false
                _lonelyRagLabel.Text = ""
            end
        end
    end)
end

_G.LonelySetRagdollCountdown = function(on)
    ragdollCountdownEnabled = on == true
    if ragdollCountdownEnabled then
        _G.LonelyHookRagdollCountdown(LP.Character)
    else
        _lonelyStopRagdollCountdown()
    end
    if setRagdollCountdownVisual then pcall(setRagdollCountdownVisual, ragdollCountdownEnabled) end
    if saveAdaptConfig then pcall(saveAdaptConfig) end
end

if LP.Character then
    task.defer(function()
        task.wait(0.5)
        if ragdollCountdownEnabled then _G.LonelyHookRagdollCountdown(LP.Character) end
    end)
end
LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
    task.wait(0.5)
    if ragdollCountdownEnabled then _G.LonelyHookRagdollCountdown(char) end
end)

-- ===== PER-BUTTON HIDE (expand V list) =====
_G.AdaptMobileButtonHiddenKeys = _G.AdaptMobileButtonHiddenKeys or {}
_G.AdaptMobileButtonSavedPos = _G.AdaptMobileButtonSavedPos or {}
_G.AdaptMobileButtonSavedSize = _G.AdaptMobileButtonSavedSize or {}

function _G.LonelyApplyPerButtonHide()
    pcall(function()
        if not mobileButtons then return end
        for key, entry in pairs(mobileButtons) do
            local hidden = _G.AdaptMobileButtonHiddenKeys[key] == true
            local holder = entry and entry.holder
            local btn = entry and entry.btn
            if holder then
                if hidden then
                    -- save pos/size once
                    if not _G.AdaptMobileButtonSavedPos[key] then
                        _G.AdaptMobileButtonSavedPos[key] = {holder.Position.X.Scale, holder.Position.X.Offset, holder.Position.Y.Scale, holder.Position.Y.Offset}
                        _G.AdaptMobileButtonSavedSize[key] = {holder.Size.X.Offset, holder.Size.Y.Offset}
                    end
                    holder.Visible = false
                    if btn then btn.Active = false end
                else
                    holder.Visible = true
                    if btn then btn.Active = true end
                    local sp = _G.AdaptMobileButtonSavedPos[key]
                    local ss = _G.AdaptMobileButtonSavedSize[key]
                    if sp then
                        holder.Position = UDim2.new(sp[1], sp[2], sp[3], sp[4])
                    end
                    if ss then
                        local scale = tonumber(_G.AdaptMobileButtonScale) or 1
                        -- restore base size; UIScale handles scale
                        holder.Size = UDim2.new(0, ss[1], 0, ss[2])
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end)
end

function _G.LonelySetButtonHidden(key, hide)
    _G.AdaptMobileButtonHiddenKeys = _G.AdaptMobileButtonHiddenKeys or {}
    _G.AdaptPerButtonHidden = _G.AdaptPerButtonHidden or {}
    -- ON in the Hide Button Mobile list = hide ONLY that button.
    -- OFF = immediately show it again. This never changes the feature's
    -- actual enabled/disabled state.
    local v = hide == true
    _G.AdaptMobileButtonHiddenKeys[key] = v
    _G.AdaptPerButtonHidden[key] = v
    _G.LonelyApplyPerButtonHide()
    if saveAdaptConfig then pcall(saveAdaptConfig) end
end

                if data then mini.Position = UDim2.new(0, tonumber(data.x) or 16, 0, tonumber(data.y) or 76) end
            end
        end)
        local function saveTogglePos()
            pcall(function()
                local pos = mini.Position
                local data = {x = pos.X.Offset, y = pos.Y.Offset}
                if writefile and HttpService then
                    writefile("CoKeduels_toggle_pos.json", HttpService:JSONEncode(data))
                end
            end)
        end

        -- Drag pill respects Lock GUI; tapping it still opens the main menu.
        do
            local pressing, dragStart, startPos, moved = false, nil, nil, false
            local function onBegin(input)
                if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
                -- Lock GUI: allow a tap to open, but never allow dragging.
                pressing = true
                moved = false
                dragStart = input.Position
                startPos = mini.Position
            end
            mini.InputBegan:Connect(onBegin)
            minTap.InputBegan:Connect(onBegin)
            UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
                if _G.AdaptGuiLocked == true then
                    -- Lock only blocks dragging; a simple tap still opens the menu.
                    moved = false
                    return
                end
                if not pressing then return end
                if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                    local d = input.Position - dragStart
                    if math.abs(d.X) > 4 or math.abs(d.Y) > 4 then moved = true end
                    mini.Position = UDim2.new(0, startPos.X.Offset + d.X, 0, startPos.Y.Offset + d.Y)
                end
            end)
            UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
                if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                    if pressing and not moved then
                        -- tap = open
                        if _G.LonelyOpenMainMenu then _G.LonelyOpenMainMenu() end
                    end
                    if pressing and moved then saveTogglePos() end
                    pressing = false
                end
            end)
            minOpenBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                if _G.LonelyOpenMainMenu then _G.LonelyOpenMainMenu() end
            end)
        end

        local animating = false
        local savedMainPos = Main.Position

        function _G.LonelyCloseMainMenu()
            if animating then return end
            if not Main.Visible then
                if mini then mini.Visible = true end
                return
            end
            animating = true
            _G.__AdaptDuelsMinimized = true
            savedMainPos = Main.Position
            -- VX7 style: slide menu off to the LEFT (Lonely v6)
            local closedX = -((FULL_MAIN_SIZE and FULL_MAIN_SIZE.X.Offset) or 360) - 40
            local y = savedMainPos.Y.Offset
            if mini then mini.Visible = true end
            local tw = TS:Create(Main, TweenInfo.new(0.7, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {
                Position = UDim2.new(0, closedX, 0, y),
            })
            tw:Play()
            tw.Completed:Connect(function()
                Main.Visible = false
                Main.Position = savedMainPos
                animating = false
            end)
            if saveAdaptConfig then pcall(saveAdaptConfig) end
        end

        function _G.LonelyOpenMainMenu()
            if animating then return end
            if Main.Visible then
                if mini then mini.Visible = false end
                return
            end
            animating = true
            _G.__AdaptDuelsMinimized = false
            if mini then mini.Visible = false end
            local dest = savedMainPos or Main.Position
            local closedX = -((FULL_MAIN_SIZE and FULL_MAIN_SIZE.X.Offset) or 360) - 40
            local y = dest.Y.Offset
            Main.Position = UDim2.new(0, closedX, 0, y)
            Main.Visible = true
            Main.Size = FULL_MAIN_SIZE
            -- VX7: slide in from left
            local tw = TS:Create(Main, TweenInfo.new(0.7, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
                Position = dest,
            })
            tw:Play()
            tw.Completed:Connect(function() animating = false end)
            if saveAdaptConfig then pcall(saveAdaptConfig) end
        end

        function _G.LonelyToggleMainMenu()
            if Main.Visible then _G.LonelyCloseMainMenu() else _G.LonelyOpenMainMenu() end
        end
        _G.CokeToggleMainUI = _G.LonelyToggleMainMenu
        _G.CokeShowMainUI = _G.LonelyOpenMainMenu
        _G.CokeHideMainUI = _G.LonelyCloseMainMenu

        -- Close button: to, dễ bấm như Lonely
        if Close then
            Close.Size = UDim2.new(0, 44, 0, 40)
            Close.Position = UDim2.new(1, -54, 0, 8)
            Close.ZIndex = 80
            Close.Active = true
            Close.AutoButtonColor = true
            Close.Text = "—"
            Close.TextSize = 18
            Close.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
            Close.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(228, 228, 232)
            Close.BackgroundTransparency = 0.05
            Close.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 21, 24)
            pcall(function()
                if getconnections then
                    for _, c in ipairs(getconnections(Close.MouseButton1Click) or {}) do
                        pcall(function() c:Disable() end)
                    end
                    for _, c in ipairs(getconnections(Close.Activated) or {}) do
                        pcall(function() c:Disable() end)
                    end
                end
            end)
            Close.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                if _G.LonelyCloseMainMenu then _G.LonelyCloseMainMenu() end
            end)
            Close.Activated:Connect(function()
                if _G.LonelyCloseMainMenu then _G.LonelyCloseMainMenu() end
            end)
            -- hit area phụ nếu nút bị che
            local hit = Main:FindFirstChild("CloseHit")
            if not hit then
                hit = Instance.new("TextButton")
                hit.Name = "CloseHit"
                hit.Size = UDim2.new(0, 56, 0, 48)
                hit.Position = UDim2.new(1, -60, 0, 4)
                hit.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                hit.Text = ""
                hit.ZIndex = 90
                hit.Parent = Main
                hit.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                    if _G.LonelyCloseMainMenu then _G.LonelyCloseMainMenu() end
                end)
            end
        end

        -- Ensure main starts open, mini hidden
        Main.Visible = true
        mini.Visible = false
        print("[Lonely] Full Coke open/close menu | left pill | drag locked OK")
    end)
end)

-- Force Ragdoll Countdown row under Headless/Korblox every tab switch
task.defer(function()
    task.wait(1)
    pcall(function()
        local util = pages and pages.VISUALS
        if not util then return end
        local rc = util:FindFirstChild("Ragdoll Countdown")
        if not rc then
            local r, setV = toggleRow(util, "Ragdoll Countdown", ragdollCountdownEnabled == true, 0)
            rc = r
            local b = r and r:FindFirstChild("ToggleButton")
            if b then
                b.Activated:Connect(function()
                    ragdollCountdownEnabled = not ragdollCountdownEnabled
                    if setV then setV(ragdollCountdownEnabled) end
                    if _G.LonelySetRagdollCountdown then pcall(_G.LonelySetRagdollCountdown, ragdollCountdownEnabled) end
                    if ragdollCountdownEnabled then
                        pcall(function() if hookRagdollCountdown then hookRagdollCountdown(LP.Character) end end)
                    else
                        pcall(function() if stopRagdollCountdown then stopRagdollCountdown() end end)
                    end
                end)
            end
        end
        if rc then
            rc.Visible = true
            rc.LayoutOrder = 0
            -- place right after Korblox visually
            local korb = util:FindFirstChild("Korblox")
            if korb and korb.LayoutOrder then
                rc.LayoutOrder = (korb.LayoutOrder or -1) + 1
            end
        end
        print("[Lonely] Ragdoll Countdown forced under Korblox")
    end)
end)

-- ===================== LONELY SPEED METHOD V1/V2 PACK =====================
-- V1: Normal / Carry / Lagger / LaggerCarry / Custom / CustomCarry (mobile btns)
-- V2: 3-mode GUI (Normal Spd | Lagger Spd | Custom Spd) Vanta-style borders
--     WalkSpeed < 25 => steal phase (auto switch carry-like speeds)
-- Bat aim speed per V2 mode
task.defer(function()
    task.wait(0.8)
    pcall(function()
        local TS = TweenService
        local RS = RunService
        local UIS = UserInputService

        _G.AdaptSpeedMethod = tostring(_G.AdaptSpeedMethod or "V1")
        if _G.AdaptSpeedMethod ~= "V1" and _G.AdaptSpeedMethod ~= "V2" then _G.AdaptSpeedMethod = "V1" end
        _G.AdaptThreeModeSpeed = _G.AdaptThreeModeSpeed or "Normal"
        _G.AdaptV2AimSpeed = _G.AdaptV2AimSpeed or {Normal = tonumber(AIMBOT_SPEED) or 58, Lagger = tonumber(LAGGER_AIMBOT_SPEED) or 40, Custom = tonumber(AIMBOT_SPEED) or 58}
        _G.AdaptAutoSpd = _G.AdaptAutoSpd or {carry=false, lagger=false, laggerCarry=false, customSpeed=false, customCarry=false}

        local V2_HIDE_KEYS = {
            carry = true, laggerNormal = true, laggerCarry = true,
            customSpeed = true, customCarry = true,
            lagger = true, -- aliases
        }

        local threeGui = nil
        local function destroyThree()
            if threeGui then pcall(function() threeGui:Destroy() end) end
            threeGui = nil
        end

        -- Vanta-style animated white border stroke
        local function vantaStroke(parent)
            local s = Instance.new("UIStroke")
            s.Name = "VantaStroke"
            s.Thickness = 2.6
            s.Color = Color3.fromRGB(168, 72, 255)
            s.Transparency = 0.05
            s.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
            s.Parent = parent
            local g = Instance.new("UIGradient")
            g.Color = ColorSequence.new({
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)),
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.32, Color3.fromRGB(205, 150, 255)),
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.58, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)),
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(157, 55, 235)),
            })
            g.Parent = s
            task.spawn(function()
                local a = 0
                while s.Parent do
                    a = (a + 2) % 360
                    g.Rotation = a
                    task.wait(0.03)
                end
            end)
            return s
        end

        local function speedModeColor(mode, active)
            local vs = (_G.AdaptV2Speeds and _G.AdaptV2Speeds[mode]) or {}
            local n = tonumber(vs.run)
            if mode == "Normal" then n = n or tonumber(NS) or 60 end
            if mode == "Lagger" then n = n or tonumber(LAGGER_SPEED) or 10.1 end
            if mode == "Custom" then n = n or tonumber(CUSTOM_SPEED) or 63 end
            n = math.max(0, n or 0)
            local base = active and 1 or 0.62
            if n < 20 then return Color3.fromRGB(math.floor(210*base), math.floor(45*base), math.floor(75*base)) end
            if n < 40 then return Color3.fromRGB(math.floor(225*base), math.floor(105*base), math.floor(35*base)) end
            if n < 60 then return Color3.fromRGB(math.floor(190*base), math.floor(70*base), math.floor(220*base)) end
            return Color3.fromRGB(math.floor(255*base), math.floor(55*base), math.floor(170*base))
        end

        local function buildThreeMode()
            destroyThree()
            if _G.AdaptSpeedMethod ~= "V2" then return end
            local scales = _G.AdaptThreeModeBtnScales or {Normal=1, Lagger=1, Custom=1}
            threeGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
            threeGui.Name = "Lonely_ThreeModeSpeed"
            threeGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
            threeGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
            threeGui.DisplayOrder = 50
            threeGui.Parent = PlayerGui

            local modes = {"Normal", "Lagger", "Custom"}
            local labels = {"NORMAL", "LAGGER", "CUSTOM"}
            local baseW, baseH, pad = 100, 38, 8
            -- compute total width with individual scales
            local widths = {}
            local totalW = 0
            for i, m in ipairs(modes) do
                local sc = math.clamp(tonumber(scales[m]) or 1, 0.5, 1.8)
                widths[i] = math.floor(baseW * sc)
                totalW = totalW + widths[i] + (i < 3 and pad or 0)
            end
            local maxH = 0
            for _, m in ipairs(modes) do
                maxH = math.max(maxH, math.floor(baseH * math.clamp(tonumber(scales[m]) or 1, 0.5, 1.8)))
            end

            local row = Instance.new("Frame", threeGui)
            row.Name = "Row"
            row.Size = UDim2.new(0, totalW, 0, maxH + 4)
            local saved = _G.AdaptThreeModePos
            if type(saved) == "table" and saved.x and saved.y then
                row.Position = UDim2.new(0, saved.x, 0, saved.y)
            else
                row.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -math.floor(totalW / 2), 1, -120)
            end
            row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            row.Active = true

            local lay = Instance.new("UIListLayout", row)
            lay.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
            lay.Padding = UDim.new(0, pad)
            lay.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
            lay.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center
            lay.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder

            for i = 1, 3 do
                local mode = modes[i]
                local sc = math.clamp(tonumber(scales[mode]) or 1, 0.5, 1.8)
                local b = Instance.new("TextButton", row)
                b.Name = "Three_" .. mode
                b.LayoutOrder = i
                b.Size = UDim2.new(0, widths[i], 0, math.floor(baseH * sc))
                b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(12, 12, 16)
                b.BorderSizePixel = 0
                b.Text = labels[i]
                b.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 245)
                b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
                b.TextSize = math.clamp(math.floor(12 * sc), 9, 16)
                b.AutoButtonColor = false
                Instance.new("UICorner", b).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, math.floor(14 * sc))
                -- Vanta mobile style: idle has NO border; selected/pressed gets
                -- a purple outer border with a white-to-purple animated edge.
                local base = Instance.new("UIStroke", b)
                base.Name = "BaseStroke"
                base.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
                base.Thickness = 0
                base.Transparency = 1
                local on = (_G.AdaptThreeModeSpeed or "Normal") == mode
                b.BackgroundColor3 = speedModeColor(mode, on)
                if on then
                    b.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                    base.Transparency = 1
                    vantaStroke(b)
                    local inner = Instance.new("UIGradient")
                    inner.Name = "SelectedFill"
                    inner.Color = ColorSequence.new({
                        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)),
                        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(214,170,255)),
                        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(128,45,190)),
                    })
                    inner.Rotation = 90
                    inner.Parent = b
                end
                b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                    _G.AdaptThreeModeSpeed = mode
                    -- apply speeds from V2 config
                    local vs = (_G.AdaptV2Speeds and _G.AdaptV2Speeds[mode]) or {}
                    if mode == "Normal" then
                        if vs.run then NS = tonumber(vs.run) or NS end
                        if vs.steal then CS = tonumber(vs.steal) or CS end
                        if setSpeedMode then pcall(setSpeedMode, "Normal") end
                        currentSpeedMode = "Normal"
                    elseif mode == "Lagger" then
                        if vs.run then LAGGER_SPEED = tonumber(vs.run) or LAGGER_SPEED end
                        if vs.steal then LAGGER_CARRY_SPEED = tonumber(vs.steal) or LAGGER_CARRY_SPEED end
                        if setSpeedMode then pcall(setSpeedMode, "Lagger") end
                        currentSpeedMode = "Lagger"
                    else
                        if vs.run then CUSTOM_SPEED = tonumber(vs.run) or CUSTOM_SPEED end
                        if vs.steal then CUSTOM_CARRY_SPEED = tonumber(vs.steal) or CUSTOM_CARRY_SPEED end
                        if setSpeedMode then pcall(setSpeedMode, "Custom") end
                        currentSpeedMode = "Custom"
                    end
                    buildThreeMode()
                    if saveAdaptConfig then pcall(saveAdaptConfig) end
                end)
            end
            do
                local dragging, start, spos = false, nil, nil
                local function isLocked()
                    -- chỉ khóa 3-mode khi bật Lock Buttons / Lock Mobile
                    return (_G.AdaptMobileButtonsLocked == true)
                        or (_G.AdaptThreeModeLocked == true)
                        or (type(mobileButtons)=="table" and mobileButtons.locked == true)
                end
                row.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp)
                    if isLocked() then return end
                    if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                        dragging = true; start = inp.Position; spos = row.Position
                    end
                end)
                UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(inp)
                    if not dragging or isLocked() then dragging = false return end
                    if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                        local d = inp.Position - start
                        row.Position = UDim2.new(0, spos.X.Offset + d.X, 0, spos.Y.Offset + d.Y)
                    end
                end)
                UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(inp)
                    if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                        if dragging and not isLocked() then
                            _G.AdaptThreeModePos = {x = row.Position.X.Offset, y = row.Position.Y.Offset}
                            if saveAdaptConfig then pcall(saveAdaptConfig) end
                        end
                        dragging = false
                    end
                end)
            end
        end

        if not _G._LonelyThreeModeSpeedColorWatch then
            _G._LonelyThreeModeSpeedColorWatch = true
            task.spawn(function()
                while true do
                    task.wait(0.15)
                    pcall(function()
                        if threeGui and threeGui.Parent then
                            local active = _G.AdaptThreeModeSpeed or "Normal"
                            for _, mode in ipairs({"Normal","Lagger","Custom"}) do
                                local b = threeGui:FindFirstChild("Row") and threeGui.Row:FindFirstChild("Three_"..mode)
                                if b then
                                    b.BackgroundColor3 = speedModeColor(mode, active == mode)
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end)
                end
            end)
        end

        local function applyMobileVis()
            local isV2 = (_G.AdaptSpeedMethod == "V2")
            local KEYS = {"carry", "laggerNormal", "laggerCarry", "customSpeed", "customCarry", "lagger"}
            pcall(function()
                local refs = mobileButtons or _G.AdaptMobileButtonRefs or {}
                for _, k in ipairs(KEYS) do
                    local e = refs[k]
                    if type(e) == "table" then
                        if e.holder then e.holder.Visible = (not isV2) end
                        if e.btn then e.btn.Visible = (not isV2) end
                    end
                end
                for key, e in pairs(refs) do
                    local kl = string.lower(tostring(key))
                    if kl:find("carry") or kl:find("lagger") or kl:find("custom") then
                        if type(e) == "table" then
                            if e.holder then e.holder.Visible = (not isV2) end
                            if e.btn then e.btn.Visible = (not isV2) end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)
            -- also force by text on any ScreenGui
            pcall(function()
                local function scan(parent)
                    if not parent then return end
                    for _, gui in ipairs(parent:GetChildren()) do
                        if gui:IsA("ScreenGui") and gui.Name ~= "Lonely_ThreeModeSpeed" then
                            for _, ch in ipairs(gui:GetDescendants()) do
                                if ch:IsA("TextButton") then
                                    local txt = (ch.Text or ""):upper():gsub("\n", " ")
                                    local hit = txt:find("CARRY SPEED") or txt:find("LAGGER")
                                        or txt:find("CUSTOM SPEED") or txt:find("CUSTOM CARRY")
                                        or txt:find("LAGGER CARRY") or txt:find("LAGGER SPEED")
                                    if hit then
                                        if isV2 then
                                            ch.Visible = false
                                            if ch.Parent and ch.Parent:IsA("GuiObject") then
                                                ch.Parent.Visible = false
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                scan(PlayerGui)
                pcall(function() scan(game:GetService("CoreGui")) end)
            end)
            if isV2 then
                pcall(buildThreeMode)
            else
                pcall(destroyThree)
            end
        end

        _G.LonelyApplySpeedMethodVis = applyMobileVis
        -- External speed mode buttons are mode-only; V1/V2 remains in the
        -- Movement menu and is never appended to these floating buttons.
        local function sanitizeExternalSpeedLabels()
            if not threeGui then return end
            for _,d in ipairs(threeGui:GetDescendants()) do
                if d:IsA("TextButton") then
                    local t = tostring(d.Text or ""):gsub("%s+V[12]$","")
                    d.Text = t
                end
            end
        end
        _G.LonelySanitizeExternalSpeedLabels = sanitizeExternalSpeedLabels

        -- keep V2 mobile buttons hidden even if other code re-shows them
        if not _G._LonelyV2HideWatch then
            _G._LonelyV2HideWatch = true
            task.spawn(function()
                while true do
                    task.wait(0.12)
                    if _G.AdaptSpeedMethod == "V2" then
                        pcall(function()
                            local refs = mobileButtons or _G.AdaptMobileButtonRefs or {}
                            for _, k in ipairs({"carry","laggerNormal","laggerCarry","customSpeed","customCarry","lagger"}) do
                                local e = refs[k]
                                if type(e) == "table" then
                                    if e.holder then e.holder.Visible = false end
                                    if e.btn then e.btn.Visible = false end
                                end
                            end
                        end)
                    end
                end
            end)
        end


        -- V2 loop: WalkSpeed < 25 => steal phase
        if not _G._LonelyV2SpeedWatch then
            _G._LonelyV2SpeedWatch = true
            RS.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
                if _G.AdaptSpeedMethod ~= "V2" then return end
                local char = LP.Character
                local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if not hum then return end
                local ws = tonumber(hum.WalkSpeed) or 16
                local stealLike = ws > 0 and ws < 25
                local mode = _G.AdaptThreeModeSpeed or "Normal"
                if mode == "Lagger" then
                    if stealLike then
                        if currentSpeedMode ~= "Lagger Carry" and setSpeedMode then pcall(setSpeedMode, "Lagger Carry") end
                    else
                        if currentSpeedMode ~= "Lagger" and setSpeedMode then pcall(setSpeedMode, "Lagger") end
                    end
                elseif mode == "Custom" then
                    if stealLike then
                        if currentSpeedMode ~= "Custom Carry" and setSpeedMode then pcall(setSpeedMode, "Custom Carry") end
                    else
                        if currentSpeedMode ~= "Custom" and setSpeedMode then pcall(setSpeedMode, "Custom") end
                    end
                else -- Normal
                    if stealLike then
                        if currentSpeedMode ~= "Carry" and setSpeedMode then pcall(setSpeedMode, "Carry") end
                    else
                        if currentSpeedMode ~= "Normal" and setSpeedMode then pcall(setSpeedMode, "Normal") end
                    end
                end
            end)
        end

        -- UI: Speed Method V1/V2 chips + Auto Spd expand (Movement tab)
        local mov = pages and pages.MOVEMENT
        if mov then
            -- remove old chips if re-exec
            local old = mov:FindFirstChild("Speed Method Row")
            if old then old:Destroy() end
            local oldA = mov:FindFirstChild("Auto Spd Expand")
            if oldA then oldA:Destroy() end

            local methodRow = Instance.new("Frame")
            methodRow.Name = "Speed Method Row"
            methodRow.Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 72)
            methodRow.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(16, 16, 22)
            methodRow.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
            methodRow.BorderSizePixel = 0
            methodRow.LayoutOrder = 0
            methodRow.ZIndex = 5
            methodRow.Parent = mov
            pcall(function() corner(methodRow, 10) end)
            pcall(function() stroke(methodRow, Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255), 1.15, 0.35) end)

            local lab = Instance.new("TextLabel", methodRow)
            lab.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            lab.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 25)
            lab.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 1)
            lab.Text = "Speed Method"
            lab.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            lab.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
            lab.TextSize = 12
            lab.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
            lab.ZIndex = 6

            local segment = Instance.new("Frame", methodRow)
            segment.Name = "Speed Method Selector"
            segment.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18,18,22)
            segment.BackgroundTransparency = 0.12
            segment.Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 36)
            segment.Position = UDim2.new(0, 6, 0, 31)
            segment.BorderSizePixel = 0
            segment.ZIndex = 6
            pcall(function() corner(segment, 9) end)
            pcall(function() stroke(segment, Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255), 1, 0.35) end)

            local slide = Instance.new("Frame", segment)
            slide.Name = "SelectedSlide"
            slide.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(58,58,64)
            slide.BackgroundTransparency = 0.08
            slide.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -4, 1, -8)
            slide.Position = UDim2.new(0, 3, 0, 4)
            slide.BorderSizePixel = 0
            slide.ZIndex = 7
            pcall(function() corner(slide, 8) end)
            pcall(function() stroke(slide, Color3.fromRGB(235,235,245), 1, 0.08) end)

            local v1 = Instance.new("TextButton", segment)
            v1.Name = "V1"
            v1.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            v1.Text = "V1"
            v1.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
            v1.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
            v1.TextSize = 12
            v1.AutoButtonColor = false
            v1.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 0)
            v1.ZIndex = 10

            local v2 = Instance.new("TextButton", segment)
            v2.Name = "V2"
            v2.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            v2.Text = "V2"
            v2.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
            v2.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
            v2.TextSize = 12
            v2.AutoButtonColor = false
            v2.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 0)
            v2.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 0)
            v2.ZIndex = 10

            local function refreshMethodUI()
                local isV2 = _G.AdaptSpeedMethod == "V2"
                tween(slide, {
                    Position = isV2 and UDim2.new(0.5, -1, 0, 4) or UDim2.new(0, 3, 0, 4)
                }, 0.16)
                tween(v1, {
                    TextTransparency = isV2 and 0.5 or 0,
                    TextStrokeTransparency = isV2 and 0.45 or 0.15
                }, 0.12)
                tween(v2, {
                    TextTransparency = isV2 and 0 or 0.5,
                    TextStrokeTransparency = isV2 and 0.15 or 0.45
                }, 0.12)
                applyMobileVis()
                local ae = mov:FindFirstChild("Auto Spd Expand")
                if ae then ae.Visible = not isV2 end
                for _, n in ipairs({
                    "V2 Config Header", "V2_Normal", "V2_Lagger", "V2_Custom",
                    "V2 Size Header", "V2Size_Normal", "V2Size_Lagger", "V2Size_Custom",
                    "ThreeMode Scale", "ThreeMode Scale Header", "V2 Aim Speeds",
                }) do
                    local el = mov:FindFirstChild(n)
                    if el then
                        if n:find("Aim") or n:find("ThreeMode Scale") then
                            el.Visible = false
                        else
                            el.Visible = isV2
                        end
                    end
                end
                for _, n in ipairs({
                    "Normal Speed", "Carry Speed", "Lagger Speed", "Lagger Carry Speed",
                    "Custom Speed", "Custom Carry Speed", "Lagger Normal Speed",
                    "Auto Carry Speed", "Auto Spd Expand",
                }) do
                    local el = mov:FindFirstChild(n)
                    if el then el.Visible = not isV2 end
                end
                pcall(function()
                    local combat = pages and pages.COMBAT
                    if not combat then return end
                    for _, name in ipairs({
                        "Normal Aimbot Speed", "Normal Lagger Aimbot Speed",
                        "Aimbot Speed", "Lagger Aimbot Speed",
                    }) do
                        local r = combat:FindFirstChild(name)
                        if r then r.Visible = not isV2 end
                    end
                    for _, ch in ipairs(combat:GetChildren()) do
                        local n = tostring(ch.Name or "")
                        if n:find("Aimbot Speed") or n:find("aimbot speed") then
                            ch.Visible = not isV2
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end

            v1.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                _G.AdaptSpeedMethod = "V1"
                refreshMethodUI()
                pcall(applyMobileVis)
                if saveAdaptConfig then pcall(saveAdaptConfig) end
            end)
            v2.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                _G.AdaptSpeedMethod = "V2"
                refreshMethodUI()
                pcall(applyMobileVis)
                if saveAdaptConfig then pcall(saveAdaptConfig) end
            end)

            -- Auto Spd expand (V1 only)
            local autoWrap = Instance.new("Frame")
            autoWrap.Name = "Auto Spd Expand"
            autoWrap.Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 36)
            autoWrap.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None
            autoWrap.ClipsDescendants = true
            autoWrap.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(16, 16, 22)
            autoWrap.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
            autoWrap.BorderSizePixel = 0
            autoWrap.LayoutOrder = 0.5
            autoWrap.ZIndex = 5
            autoWrap.Parent = mov
            pcall(function() corner(autoWrap, 10) end)

            local head = Instance.new("TextLabel", autoWrap)
            head.Size = UDim2.new(1, -54, 0, 36)
            head.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 0)
            head.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            head.Text = "Auto Spd"
            head.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(245, 245, 255)
            head.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold

            local function refreshAutoSpdExpand()
                headV.Text = "V"
                body.Visible = true
                -- Use the actual row count/height instead of AbsoluteContentSize during the
                -- first frame. This prevents the expanded list from drawing over the next
                -- section (Speed Configuration).
                local rowCount = 0
                for _, child in ipairs(body:GetChildren()) do
                    if child:IsA("GuiObject") and child ~= body:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIListLayout") then
                        rowCount = rowCount + 1
                    end
                end
                local rowHeight = 40
                local rowGap = 4
                local targetBodyH = open and math.max(28, (rowCount * rowHeight) + (math.max(0,rowCount-1) * rowGap) + 2) or 0
                local targetWrapH = open and (38 + targetBodyH + 8) or 36

                TS:Create(headV, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Rotation = open and 180 or 0}):Play()
                TS:Create(body, TweenInfo.new(0.20, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Size = UDim2.new(1,-8,0,targetBodyH)}):Play()
                -- autoWrap owns the whole accordion height, so UIListLayout pushes
                -- Speed Configuration and everything below it instead of overlapping.
                TS:Create(autoWrap, TweenInfo.new(0.20, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Size = UDim2.new(1,-4,0,targetWrapH)}):Play()
                if not open then
                    task.delay(0.22,function() if not open then body.Visible=false end end)
                end
            end
            headV.Activated:Connect(function()
                if expandBusy then return end
                expandBusy = true
                open = not open
                refreshAutoSpdExpand()
                task.delay(0.20,function() expandBusy=false end)

-- [AUTO SPD FINAL LAYOUT FIX]
-- Keep the accordion and the speed configuration rows in one deterministic
-- vertical order. This prevents Auto Spd expansion from visually crossing
-- into Speed Configuration even when earlier patches changed LayoutOrder.
task.defer(function()
    task.wait(1.6)
    pcall(function()
        local p = pages and pages.MOVEMENT
        if not p then return end
        local function order(name, value)
            local o = p:FindFirstChild(name)
            if o then o.LayoutOrder = value end
        end
        order("Auto Carry Speed", -1)
        order("Speed Method Row", 0)
        order("Auto Spd Expand", 1)
        order("SPEED CONFIGURATION", 2)
        order("Normal Speed", 3)
        order("Carry Speed", 4)
        order("LAGGER CONFIGURATION", 6)
        order("Lagger Speed", 7)
        order("Lagger Carry Speed", 8)
        order("CUSTOM CONFIGURATION", 10)
        order("Custom Speed", 11)
        order("Custom Carry", 12)

        local modes = {}
        for _, child in ipairs(p:GetChildren()) do
            if child.Name == "Mode" and child:IsA("GuiObject") and child.Visible then
                table.insert(modes, child)
            end
        end
        table.sort(modes, function(a,b) return (a.LayoutOrder or 0) < (b.LayoutOrder or 0) end)
        if modes[1] then modes[1].LayoutOrder = 5 end
        if modes[2] then modes[2].LayoutOrder = 9 end
        if modes[3] then modes[3].LayoutOrder = 13 end

        local auto = p:FindFirstChild("Auto Spd Expand")
        if auto then
            auto.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None
            auto.ClipsDescendants = true
        end
    end)
end)
    end)
end)

-- ESP theme color: others only, persist for new players
pcall(function()
    local function paintEspChar(char, plr)
        if not char or plr == LP then return end
        local col = (_G.AdaptThemeColors and _G.AdaptThemeColors[_G.AdaptThemeName]) or THEME_ACCENT
        local hl = char:FindFirstChild("AdaptDuelsESP")
        if hl and hl:IsA("Highlight") then
            hl.FillColor = col
            hl.OutlineColor = col
        end
        for _, d in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsA("BillboardGui") and (d.Name:find("ESP") or d.Name:find("Name") or d.Name:find("Speed")) then
                for _, tlab in ipairs(d:GetDescendants()) do
                    if tlab:IsA("TextLabel") and plr ~= LP then
                        tlab.TextColor3 = col
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    _G.LonelyPaintEspTheme = function()
        local col = (_G.AdaptThemeColors and _G.AdaptThemeColors[_G.AdaptThemeName]) or THEME_ACCENT
        for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if plr ~= LP and plr.Character then
                paintEspChar(plr.Character, plr)
            end
        end
    end
    Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(plr)
        plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
            task.wait(0.5)
            if _G.AdaptSpeedMethod then end
            pcall(function() _G.LonelyPaintEspTheme() end)
        end)
    end)
end)
