                lab.BackgroundTransparency=1; lab.Text="V"..i; lab.TextColor3=COLORS.white; lab.TextSize=11; lab.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBlack; lab.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Center; lab.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5); lab.Size=UDim2.new(1/n,0,1,0); lab.Position=UDim2.new((1/n)*(i-.5),0,.5,0); lab.ZIndex=8; lab.Parent=ver; labels[i]=lab
                local click=Instance.new("TextButton")
                click.BackgroundTransparency=1; click.Text=""; click.AutoButtonColor=false; click.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5); click.Size=UDim2.new(1/n,0,1,0); click.Position=UDim2.new((1/n)*(i-.5),0,.5,0); click.ZIndex=10; click.Parent=ver
                click.Activated:Connect(function() if _G.AdaptAntiTPBat and _G.AdaptAntiTPBat.setVersion then _G.AdaptAntiTPBat.setVersion(i) else _G.AdaptAntiTPBatVersion=i end end)
            end
            local spamRow=Instance.new("Frame")
            spamRow.Name="SpamRow"; spamRow.BackgroundColor3=COLORS.row; spamRow.BackgroundTransparency=.3; spamRow.Size=UDim2.new(1,-4,0,34); spamRow.Position=UDim2.new(0,2,0,48); spamRow.BorderSizePixel=0; spamRow.ZIndex=4; spamRow.Parent=holder; corner(spamRow,9); stroke(spamRow,COLORS.strokeSoft,1.15,.38)
            local lbl=Instance.new("TextLabel")
            lbl.BackgroundTransparency=1; lbl.Text="SPAM"; lbl.TextColor3=COLORS.white; lbl.Font=Enum.Font.GothamSemibold; lbl.TextSize=11; lbl.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left; lbl.Size=UDim2.new(1,-70,1,0); lbl.Position=UDim2.new(0,12,0,0); lbl.Parent=spamRow
            local spam=Instance.new("TextButton")
            spam.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(50,50,56); spam.BorderSizePixel=0; spam.Text=""; spam.Size=UDim2.new(0,44,0,22); spam.Position=UDim2.new(1,-54,.5,-11); spam.AutoButtonColor=false; spam.Parent=spamRow; corner(spam,11); stroke(spam,COLORS.strokeSoft,1,.4)
            local knob=Instance.new("Frame")
            knob.Size=UDim2.new(0,16,0,16); knob.Position=UDim2.new(0,3,.5,-8); knob.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255); knob.BorderSizePixel=0; knob.Parent=spam; corner(knob,9)
            local function refresh()
                local on=_G.AdaptAntiTPBatEnabled==true
                if toggle then toggle.Text=on and "ON" or "OFF" end
                if setVisual then setVisual(on) end
                local cur=math.clamp(tonumber(_G.AdaptAntiTPBatVersion) or 1,1,4)
                tween(slide,{Position=UDim2.new((1/n)*(cur-.5),0,.5,0)},.16)
                for i,lab in ipairs(labels) do lab.TextTransparency=(i==cur) and 0 or .45 end
                local sp=_G.AdaptAntiTPBatSpam==true
                spam.BackgroundColor3=sp and Color3.fromRGB(95,95,102) or Color3.fromRGB(50,50,56)
                knob.Position=sp and UDim2.new(1,-19,.5,-8) or UDim2.new(0,3,.5,-8)
            end
            local toggleBusy = false
            if toggle then
              toggle.Activated:Connect(function()
                if toggleBusy then return end
                toggleBusy = true
                local on = not (_G.AdaptAntiTPBatEnabled == true)
                if _G.AdaptAntiTPBat and _G.AdaptAntiTPBat.setEnabled then
                  _G.AdaptAntiTPBat.setEnabled(on, false)
                end
                refresh()
                task.delay(0.16, function() toggleBusy = false end)
              end)
            end
            local spamBusy = false
            spam.Activated:Connect(function()
              if spamBusy then return end
              spamBusy = true
              local on=not (_G.AdaptAntiTPBatSpam==true)
              if _G.AdaptAntiTPBat and _G.AdaptAntiTPBat.setSpam then
                _G.AdaptAntiTPBat.setSpam(on)
              end
              refresh()
              task.delay(0.16, function() spamBusy = false end)
            end)
            local expandBusy = false
            local expanded = false
            arrow.Activated:Connect(function()
                if expandBusy then return end
                expandBusy = true
                expanded = not expanded
                _G._AmbitiousExpand(holder, expanded, 84, arrow)
                refresh()
                task.delay(0.27, function() expandBusy = false end)
            end)
            _G._AdaptAntiTPBatSetRowVisual=function() refresh() end
            _G._AdaptAntiTPBatSetSpamVisual=function() refresh() end
            _G._AdaptAntiTPBatSetVersionVisual=function() refresh() end
            refresh()
        end)
    end)

    -- Custom menu background by Roblox asset id.
    task.defer(function()
        task.wait(0.35)
        pcall(function()
            local settings=pages and (pages.SETTINGS or pages.Settings)
            if not settings then return end
            if settings:FindFirstChild("Background Image ID") then return end
            local row=Instance.new("Frame")
            row.Name="Background Image ID"; row.BackgroundColor3=COLORS.row; row.BackgroundTransparency=.28
            row.Size=UDim2.new(1,-4,0,42); row.BorderSizePixel=0; row.LayoutOrder=2.5; row.Parent=settings
            corner(row,9); stroke(row,COLORS.strokeSoft,1.15,.38)
            local label=Instance.new("TextLabel"); label.BackgroundTransparency=1; label.Text="BACKGROUND IMAGE ID"; label.TextColor3=COLORS.white; label.TextSize=10; label.Font=Enum.Font.GothamMedium; label.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left; label.Size=UDim2.new(.48,0,1,0); label.Position=UDim2.new(0,12,0,0); label.Parent=row
            local box=Instance.new("TextBox"); box.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(8,8,12); box.BackgroundTransparency=.18; box.BorderSizePixel=0; box.Text=tostring(_G.AdaptCustomBackgroundId or ""); box.PlaceholderText="Roblox image asset id"; box.TextColor3=COLORS.white; box.PlaceholderColor3=Color3.fromRGB(125,125,135); box.TextSize=10; box.Font=Enum.Font.GothamMedium; box.ClearTextOnFocus=false; box.Size=UDim2.new(0,118,0,26); box.Position=UDim2.new(1,-178,.5,-13); box.Parent=row; corner(box,7); stroke(box,COLORS.strokeSoft,1,.35)
            local apply=Instance.new("TextButton"); apply.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(38,38,45); apply.BorderSizePixel=0; apply.Text="APPLY"; apply.TextColor3=COLORS.white; apply.TextSize=9; apply.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBlack; apply.Size=UDim2.new(0,54,0,26); apply.Position=UDim2.new(1,-60,.5,-13); apply.AutoButtonColor=false; apply.Parent=row; corner(apply,7); stroke(apply,COLORS.strokeSoft,1,.35)
            local function doApply()
                local raw=tostring(box.Text or ""):gsub("rbxassetid://",""):gsub("%s+","")
                _G.AdaptCustomBackgroundId=raw
                if raw~="" and BgImage then BgImage.Image="rbxassetid://"..raw; BgImage.Visible=true; currentBackground=0 else if BgImage then BgImage.Visible=false end end
                if saveAdaptConfig then pcall(saveAdaptConfig) end
            end
            apply.MouseButton1Click:Connect(doApply)
            box.FocusLost:Connect(function() if box.Text~="" then doApply() end end)
            if tostring(_G.AdaptCustomBackgroundId or "")~="" then box.Text=tostring(_G.AdaptCustomBackgroundId); doApply() end
        end)
    end)

    -- Dynamic per-button Hide Mobile Buttons: list is built from the actual
    -- mobileButtons table, so newly created external buttons appear too.
    task.defer(function()
        task.wait(1.0)
        pcall(function()
            local settings=pages and (pages.SETTINGS or pages.Settings)
            if not settings then return end
            local old=settings:FindFirstChild("Hide MB Expand")
            if old then old:Destroy() end
            local oldGlobal=settings:FindFirstChild("Hide Mobile Buttons")
            if oldGlobal then oldGlobal.Visible=false end
            _G.AdaptMobileButtonHiddenKeys=_G.AdaptMobileButtonHiddenKeys or {}
            local wrap=Instance.new("Frame"); wrap.Name="Hide Button Mobile Ambitious"; wrap.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(20,20,24); wrap.BackgroundTransparency=.25; wrap.Size=UDim2.new(1,-4,0,36); wrap.BorderSizePixel=0; wrap.ClipsDescendants=true; wrap.LayoutOrder=11; wrap.Parent=settings; corner(wrap,9)
            local head=Instance.new("TextButton"); head.BackgroundTransparency=1; head.Text="HIDE BUTTON MOBILE"; head.TextColor3=COLORS.white; head.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold; head.TextSize=12; head.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left; head.Position=UDim2.new(0,12,0,0); head.Size=UDim2.new(1,-58,0,36); head.Parent=wrap
            local headV=Instance.new("TextButton"); headV.Name="ExpandV"; headV.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(8,8,12); headV.BorderSizePixel=0; headV.Text="V"; headV.TextColor3=COLORS.white; headV.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBlack; headV.TextSize=13; headV.AutoButtonColor=false; headV.Size=UDim2.new(0,34,0,24); headV.Position=UDim2.new(1,-44,0,6); headV.Parent=wrap; corner(headV,7); stroke(headV,COLORS.strokeSoft,1,.35)
            local list=Instance.new("Frame"); list.BackgroundTransparency=1; list.Size=UDim2.new(1,-8,0,0); list.Position=UDim2.new(0,4,0,36); list.Parent=wrap; local lay=Instance.new("UIListLayout",list); lay.SortOrder=Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder; lay.Padding=UDim.new(0,4)
            local expanded=false
            local function keyLabel(k,entry)
                if entry and entry.label then return tostring(entry.label) end
                return tostring(k):gsub("([a-z])([A-Z])","%1 %2"):upper()
            end
            local function rebuild()
                for _,c in ipairs(list:GetChildren()) do if not c:IsA("UIListLayout") then c:Destroy() end end
                local keys={}
                for k,entry in pairs(mobileButtons or {}) do if type(entry)=="table" and entry.holder then table.insert(keys,k) end end
                table.sort(keys,function(a,b) return tostring(a)<tostring(b) end)
                for i,k in ipairs(keys) do
                    local r=Instance.new("Frame"); r.BackgroundColor3=COLORS.row; r.BackgroundTransparency=.3; r.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,34); r.LayoutOrder=i; r.Parent=list; corner(r,8)
                    local tx=Instance.new("TextLabel"); tx.BackgroundTransparency=1; tx.Text=keyLabel(k,mobileButtons[k]); tx.TextColor3=COLORS.white; tx.TextSize=10; tx.Font=Enum.Font.GothamSemibold; tx.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left; tx.Position=UDim2.new(0,10,0,0); tx.Size=UDim2.new(1,-70,1,0); tx.Parent=r
                    local tog=Instance.new("TextButton"); tog.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(8,8,12); tog.BorderSizePixel=0; tog.Text=""; tog.Size=UDim2.new(0,44,0,22); tog.Position=UDim2.new(1,-52,.5,-11); tog.AutoButtonColor=false; tog.Parent=r; corner(tog,11)
                    local knob=Instance.new("Frame"); knob.Size=UDim2.new(0,16,0,16); knob.BorderSizePixel=0; knob.Parent=tog; corner(knob,9)
                    local function paint()
                        local hidden=_G.AdaptMobileButtonHiddenKeys[k]==true
                        tog.BackgroundColor3=hidden and Color3.fromRGB(147,51,234) or Color3.fromRGB(50,50,56); knob.Position=hidden and UDim2.new(1,-19,.5,-8) or UDim2.new(0,3,.5,-8); knob.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
                    end
                    paint(); tog.Activated:Connect(function()
                        if tog:GetAttribute("Busy") then return end
                        tog:SetAttribute("Busy",true)
                        local nextHidden = not (_G.AdaptMobileButtonHiddenKeys[k]==true)
                        _G.LonelySetButtonHidden(k,nextHidden)
                        paint()
                        task.delay(0.08,function() if tog then tog:SetAttribute("Busy",false) end end)
                    end)
                end
            end
            headV.Activated:Connect(function()
                expanded=not expanded; headV.Text="V"
                tween(headV,{Rotation=expanded and 180 or 0},0.16)
                rebuild(); local n=0; for k,e in pairs(mobileButtons or {}) do if type(e)=="table" and e.holder then n=n+1 end end
                list.Size=UDim2.new(1,-8,0,expanded and (n*38) or 0); wrap.Size=UDim2.new(1,-4,0,expanded and (36+n*38+6) or 36)
            end)
            rebuild()
            _G.LonelyApplyPerButtonHide()
        end)
    end)

    -- Ambitious-style menu minimize/open animation and Lonely mini button.
    task.defer(function()
        task.wait(.25)
        pcall(function()
            local restPos=Main.Position
            local token=0
            local function edge(pos)
                local vp=workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(800,600)
                local cx=pos.X.Scale*vp.X+pos.X.Offset; local cy=pos.Y.Scale*vp.Y+pos.Y.Offset
                local dx=math.min(cx,vp.X-cx); local dy=math.min(cy,vp.Y-cy)
                if dx<dy then return cx<vp.X/2 and "L" or "R" end
                return cy<vp.Y/2 and "T" or "B"
            end
            local function offscreen(pos,dir)
                local vp=workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(800,600)
                if dir=="L" then return UDim2.new(pos.X.Scale,pos.X.Offset-420,pos.Y.Scale,pos.Y.Offset) end
                if dir=="R" then return UDim2.new(pos.X.Scale,pos.X.Offset+420,pos.Y.Scale,pos.Y.Offset) end
                if dir=="T" then return UDim2.new(pos.X.Scale,pos.X.Offset,pos.Y.Scale,pos.Y.Offset-620) end
                return UDim2.new(pos.X.Scale,pos.X.Offset,pos.Y.Scale,pos.Y.Offset+620)
            end
            _G.AdaptHubClose=function(showMini)
                token+=1; local my=token; local pos=restPos; local dir=edge(pos)
                MiniFrame.Visible=false; Main.Visible=true
                TweenService:Create(Main,TweenInfo.new(.38,Enum.EasingStyle.Quint,Enum.EasingDirection.In),{Position=offscreen(pos,dir)}):Play()
                if showMini then task.delay(.2,function() if my==token then MiniFrame.Visible=true end end) end
                task.delay(.4,function() if my~=token then return end Main.Visible=false; Main.Position=pos end)
            end
            _G.AdaptHubOpen=function()
                token+=1; local my=token; local pos=restPos; local dir=edge(pos)
                MiniFrame.Visible=false; Main.Size=FULL_MAIN_SIZE; Main.Position=offscreen(pos,dir); Main.Visible=true
                TweenService:Create(Main,TweenInfo.new(.52,Enum.EasingStyle.Back,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),{Position=pos}):Play()
                task.delay(.6,function() if my==token then Main.Position=pos end end)
            end
            MiniButton.Activated:Connect(function() _G.AdaptHubOpen() end)
        end)
    end)
end


-- Final Clean-style main menu controller.
-- Close: slide to the LEFT. Open: slide in from the LEFT to the saved position.
-- The main menu remains draggable whether GUI Lock is ON or OFF.
do
    task.defer(function()
        task.wait(.8)
        pcall(function()
            local TS = TweenService
            local token = 0
            local animating = false
            local restPos = Main.Position

            local function getRest()
                return savedMainPositionTable and tableToUDim2(savedMainPositionTable, restPos) or restPos
            end

            local function closedPosition(pos)
                local width = (FULL_MAIN_SIZE.X.Offset or 356) + 50
                return UDim2.new(pos.X.Scale, pos.X.Offset - width, pos.Y.Scale, pos.Y.Offset)
            end

            function _G.LonelyCloseMainMenu()
                if animating then return end
                if not Main.Visible then
                    MiniFrame.Visible = true
                    return
                end
                animating = true
                token += 1
                local my = token
                restPos = getRest()
                savedMainPositionTable = udim2ToTable(restPos)
                local target = closedPosition(restPos)

                TweenService:Create(
                    Main,
                    TweenInfo.new(.40, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.In),
                    {Position = target}
                ):Play()

                task.delay(.20, function()
                    if my == token then
                        MiniFrame.Visible = true
                    end
                end)

                task.delay(.42, function()
                    if my ~= token then return end
                    Main.Visible = false
                    Main.Position = restPos
                    Main.Size = FULL_MAIN_SIZE
                    Main.Rotation = 0
                    animating = false
                end)
                if saveAdaptConfig then pcall(saveAdaptConfig) end
            end

            function _G.LonelyOpenMainMenu()
                if animating then return end
                if Main.Visible then
                    MiniFrame.Visible = false
                    return
                end
                animating = true
                token += 1
                local my = token
                restPos = getRest()
                local start = closedPosition(restPos)

                MiniFrame.Visible = false
                Main.Size = FULL_MAIN_SIZE
                Main.Rotation = 0
                Main.Position = start
                Main.Visible = true

                TweenService:Create(
                    Main,
                    TweenInfo.new(.52, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                    {Position = restPos}
                ):Play()

                task.delay(.58, function()
                    if my == token then
                        Main.Position = restPos
                        Main.Rotation = 0
                        animating = false
                    end
                end)
                if saveAdaptConfig then pcall(saveAdaptConfig) end
            end

            _G.LonelyToggleMainMenu = function()
                if Main.Visible then
                    _G.LonelyCloseMainMenu()
                else
                    _G.LonelyOpenMainMenu()
                end
            end
            _G.CokeToggleMainUI = _G.LonelyToggleMainMenu
            _G.CokeShowMainUI = _G.LonelyOpenMainMenu
            _G.CokeHideMainUI = _G.LonelyCloseMainMenu
        end)
    end)
end

-- ============================================================
-- LONELY FINAL FIX LAYER
-- Ambitious/7UP/404 compatibility fixes requested by user.
-- This layer intentionally contains no Intro/Tigy or Body Lock.
-- Wrapped in an IIFE so its helper locals do not consume the main
-- Luau chunk's 200 local-register budget.
-- ============================================================
(function()
    local function _safeDisconnect(c)
        if c then pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
    end

    -- [404] Anti Drop logic only: no billboard, no text, always-on background.
    -- It mirrors the 404 HRP velocity spoof but does not create any overhead UI.
    _G.LonelyAntiDrop404 = _G.LonelyAntiDrop404 or { enabled = true, active = false }
    local AD = _G.LonelyAntiDrop404
    local mt = getrawmetatable and getrawmetatable(game) or nil
    local oldIndex, oldNewIndex
    local spoofVelocity = Vector3.zero

    function AD.Stop()
        AD.enabled = false
        if mt and oldIndex then
            pcall(function()
                setreadonly(mt, false)
                mt.__index = oldIndex
                mt.__newindex = oldNewIndex
                setreadonly(mt, true)
            end)
        end
        oldIndex, oldNewIndex = nil, nil
        AD.active = false
    end

    function AD.Start()
        AD.enabled = true
        if AD.active or not mt or not newcclosure or not setreadonly then return end
        if not checkcaller then return end
        oldIndex, oldNewIndex = mt.__index, mt.__newindex
        local ok = pcall(function()
            setreadonly(mt, false)
            mt.__index = newcclosure(function(self, key)
                if not checkcaller() and (key == "AssemblyLinearVelocity" or key == "Velocity")
                    and typeof(self) == "Instance" and self:IsA("BasePart")
                    and self.Name == "HumanoidRootPart"
                    and LP.Character and self:IsDescendantOf(LP.Character) then
                    return spoofVelocity
                end
                return oldIndex(self, key)
            end)
            mt.__newindex = newcclosure(function(self, key, value)
                if not checkcaller() and (key == "AssemblyLinearVelocity" or key == "Velocity")
                    and typeof(self) == "Instance" and self:IsA("BasePart")
                    and self.Name == "HumanoidRootPart"
                    and LP.Character and self:IsDescendantOf(LP.Character) then
                    spoofVelocity = value
                    return
                end
                return oldNewIndex(self, key, value)
            end)
            setreadonly(mt, true)
        end)
        if ok then AD.active = true else AD.active = false end
    end
    pcall(AD.Start)

    -- [Auto Left/Right] use the selected Normal speed instead of the old
    -- hard-coded 58/60 fallback.
    _G.LonelyGetNormalMoveSpeed=function()
        -- Auto Left/Right MUST use the Movement > Normal Speed field.
        -- Never substitute Custom/Lagger/Carry speed here.
        return tonumber(NS) or 60
    end

    -- Patch the actual movement-speed globals used by the existing loops.
    -- This keeps Auto Left/Right synchronized when Normal Speed is edited.
    local function syncAutoMoveSpeed()
        local v=_G.LonelyGetNormalMoveSpeed()
        _G.AdaptAutoMoveSpeed=v
        if _G.AdaptV2Speeds and _G.AdaptV2Speeds.Normal then
            _G.AdaptV2Speeds.Normal.run=v
        end
    end
    syncAutoMoveSpeed()
    if not _G._LonelyAutoMoveSpeedSync then
        _G._LonelyAutoMoveSpeedSync=true
        RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            pcall(syncAutoMoveSpeed)
        end)
    end

    -- Speed Method V2: hide Custom speed controls and old external speed
    -- buttons immediately; do not destroy the 3-mode GUI.
    _G.LonelyRefreshSpeedV2Visibility=function()
        local v2=_G.AdaptSpeedMethod=="V2"
        if mobileButtons then
            for _,k in ipairs({"carry","laggerNormal","laggerCarry","customSpeed","customCarry"}) do
                local e=mobileButtons[k]
                if e and e.holder then e.holder.Visible=not v2 and not ((_G.AdaptPerButtonHidden or {})[k]==true) end
                if e and e.btn then e.btn.Visible=not v2 and not ((_G.AdaptPerButtonHidden or {})[k]==true) end
            end
        end
        if pages and (pages.MOVEMENT or pages.Movement) then
            local p=pages.MOVEMENT or pages.Movement
            local c=p:FindFirstChild("V2_Custom")
            if c then c.Visible=not v2 end
        end
    end
    pcall(_G.LonelyRefreshSpeedV2Visibility)
    if _G.AdaptSpeedMethod=="V2" and _G.LonelyBuildThreeModeSpeed then
        task.defer(function() task.wait(0.2); pcall(_G.LonelyBuildThreeModeSpeed) end)
    end

    -- Hide Button Mobile: ON = hidden, OFF = visible. Changing the switch
    -- takes effect immediately and does not force the feature itself OFF.
    if _G.LonelySetButtonHidden then
        local oldSet=_G.LonelySetButtonHidden
        _G.LonelySetButtonHidden=function(key,hidden)
            _G.AdaptPerButtonHidden=_G.AdaptPerButtonHidden or {}
            _G.AdaptPerButtonHidden[key]=hidden==true
            if hidden then
                if _G.LonelyPauseMobileButton then pcall(_G.LonelyPauseMobileButton,key) end
            else
                if _G.LonelyResumeMobileButton then pcall(_G.LonelyResumeMobileButton,key) end
            end
            pcall(oldSet,key,hidden)
            pcall(_G.LonelyRefreshSpeedV2Visibility)
        end
    end

    -- ================================================================
    -- FULL EXTERNAL BUTTON INPUT LAYER
    -- Hidden mobile buttons are paused: keyboard/controller cannot invoke
    -- them, and an active feature is stopped until the button is shown again.
    -- ================================================================
    _G.LonelyMobileButtonPaused = _G.LonelyMobileButtonPaused or {}
    _G.LonelyMobileButtonResume = _G.LonelyMobileButtonResume or {}
    local function lonelyButtonPaused(key)
        return _G.LonelyMobileButtonPaused[tostring(key)] == true
    end
    _G.LonelyIsMobileButtonPaused = lonelyButtonPaused

    local function lonelyPauseButton(key)
        key = tostring(key)
        if lonelyButtonPaused(key) then return end
        _G.LonelyMobileButtonPaused[key] = true
        local resume = false
        local resumeMode = nil
        if key == "aimbot" then
            resume = (_G.AdaptNormalAimbotOn == true)
            if _G.AdaptNormalAimbotOn and _G.AdaptStopNormalAimbot then pcall(_G.AdaptStopNormalAimbot) end
        elseif key == "antiDesync" then
            resume = _G.AdaptAntiDesyncAimbotOn == true
            if resume and _G.AdaptStopAntiDesyncAimbot then pcall(_G.AdaptStopAntiDesyncAimbot) end
        elseif key == "autoLeft" then
            resume = autoLeftEnabled == true
            if resume and _G.AdaptSetAutoLeft then pcall(_G.AdaptSetAutoLeft,false) end
        elseif key == "autoRight" then
            resume = autoRightEnabled == true
            if resume and _G.AdaptSetAutoRight then pcall(_G.AdaptSetAutoRight,false) end
        elseif key == "antiAntiTP" then
            resume = _G.AdaptAntiTPBatEnabled == true
            if resume and _G.AdaptAntiTPBat and _G.AdaptAntiTPBat.setEnabled then pcall(_G.AdaptAntiTPBat.setEnabled,false,true) elseif resume and _G.AdaptToggleAntiTPBat then pcall(_G.AdaptToggleAntiTPBat) end
        elseif key == "carry" or key == "laggerNormal" or key == "laggerCarry" or key == "customSpeed" or key == "customCarry" then
            resumeMode = currentSpeedMode
            resume = currentSpeedMode ~= "Normal"
            if resume and setSpeedMode then pcall(setSpeedMode,"Normal") end
        end
        _G.LonelyMobileButtonResume[key] = {active=resume, mode=resumeMode}
    end

    local function lonelyResumeButton(key)
        key = tostring(key)
        if not lonelyButtonPaused(key) then return end
        _G.LonelyMobileButtonPaused[key] = nil
        local snap = _G.LonelyMobileButtonResume[key]
        _G.LonelyMobileButtonResume[key] = nil
        if not snap or snap.active ~= true then return end
        if key == "aimbot" then
            if _G.AdaptStartNormalAimbot then pcall(_G.AdaptStartNormalAimbot) end
        elseif key == "antiDesync" then
            if _G.AdaptStartAntiDesyncAimbot then pcall(_G.AdaptStartAntiDesyncAimbot) end
        elseif key == "autoLeft" then
            if _G.AdaptSetAutoLeft then pcall(_G.AdaptSetAutoLeft,true) end
        elseif key == "autoRight" then
            if _G.AdaptSetAutoRight then pcall(_G.AdaptSetAutoRight,true) end
        elseif key == "antiAntiTP" then
            if _G.AdaptAntiTPBat and _G.AdaptAntiTPBat.setEnabled then pcall(_G.AdaptAntiTPBat.setEnabled,true) elseif _G.AdaptToggleAntiTPBat then pcall(_G.AdaptToggleAntiTPBat) end
        elseif (key == "carry" or key == "laggerNormal" or key == "laggerCarry" or key == "customSpeed" or key == "customCarry") and snap.mode and setSpeedMode then
            pcall(setSpeedMode,snap.mode)
        end
    end
    _G.LonelyPauseMobileButton = lonelyPauseButton
    _G.LonelyResumeMobileButton = lonelyResumeButton

    local function lonelyFireExternalButton(key)
        key = tostring(key)
        if lonelyButtonPaused(key) then return false end
        local e = mobileButtons and mobileButtons[key]
        if not e or type(e.onPress) ~= "function" then return false end
        pcall(e.onPress,e.btn)
        return true
    end
    _G.LonelyFireExternalButton = lonelyFireExternalButton

                local b=Instance.new("TextButton"); b.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(8,8,12); b.BackgroundTransparency=.18; b.Text=keyName(externalKeybinds[key]); b.TextColor3=COLORS.white; b.Font=Enum.Font.GothamMedium; b.TextSize=10; b.AutoButtonColor=false; b.Size=UDim2.new(0,56,0,24); b.Position=UDim2.new(1,-64,.5,-12); b.Parent=r; corner(b,12); stroke(b,COLORS.strokeSoft,1,.45)

    -- One listener handles controller capture + every bound external button.
    UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
        local isPad=tostring(input.UserInputType):find("Gamepad") ~= nil
        if not isPad then return end
        if listeningForControllerKey then
            local target=listeningForControllerKey
            if input.KeyCode ~= Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then
                if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonStart and UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then return end
                for k,v in pairs(controllerKeybinds) do if k ~= target and v == input.KeyCode then controllerKeybinds[k]=nil end end
                controllerKeybinds[target]=input.KeyCode
                listeningForControllerKey=nil
                if _G.LonelyRefreshControllerBindUI then pcall(_G.LonelyRefreshControllerBindUI) end
                if saveAdaptConfig then pcall(saveAdaptConfig) end
            end
            return
        end
        if gameProcessed then return end
        for key,bound in pairs(controllerKeybinds) do
            if bound and input.KeyCode == bound then
                if lonelyButtonPaused(key) then return end
                lonelyFireExternalButton(key)
                return
            end
        end
    end)

    -- Final Hide Button Mobile rebuild: enumerate the real mobileButtons table,
    -- one live ON/OFF switch per actual external button.
    task.defer(function()

            corner(wrap,9); stroke(wrap,COLORS.strokeSoft,1.15,.35)

            local headV=Instance.new("TextButton")
            headV.Name="ExpandV"; headV.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(8,8,12); headV.BorderSizePixel=0; headV.Text="V"; headV.TextColor3=COLORS.white; headV.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBlack; headV.TextSize=13; headV.AutoButtonColor=false; headV.Size=UDim2.new(0,34,0,24); headV.Position=UDim2.new(1,-44,0,6); headV.Parent=wrap; corner(headV,7); stroke(headV,COLORS.strokeSoft,1,.35)
            local list=Instance.new("Frame")
            list.Name="ActualMobileButtonList"; list.BackgroundTransparency=1; list.Size=UDim2.new(1,-8,0,0); list.Position=UDim2.new(0,4,0,36); list.Parent=wrap
            local layout=Instance.new("UIListLayout",list); layout.SortOrder=Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder; layout.Padding=UDim.new(0,4)
            local expanded=false
            local function collect()
                local out={}
                for k,e in pairs(mobileButtons or {}) do if type(e)=="table" and e.holder and e.holder.Parent then table.insert(out,{k=tostring(k),e=e}) end end
                table.sort(out,function(a,b) return a.k:lower()<b.k:lower() end)
                return out
            end
            local function displayName(k,e)
                local txt=e and e.btn and tostring(e.btn.Text or ""):gsub("\n"," "):gsub("%s+"," "):gsub("^%s+"," "):gsub("%s+$","") or ""
                if txt~="" then return txt end
                return k:gsub("([a-z])([A-Z])","%1 %2"):upper()
            end
            local function rebuild()
                for _,c in ipairs(list:GetChildren()) do if not c:IsA("UIListLayout") then c:Destroy() end end
                local entries=collect()
                for i,item in ipairs(entries) do
                    local key,entry=item.k,item.e

                        local hidden=_G.AdaptMobileButtonHiddenKeys[key]==true or _G.AdaptPerButtonHidden[key]==true
                        state.Text=hidden and "ON" or "OFF"
                        track.BackgroundColor3=hidden and Color3.fromRGB(95,95,102) or Color3.fromRGB(50,50,56)

    -- VX7 BLACK/PINK: Discord labels use the same pink/deep-purple alternating gradient.
    local function applyDiscordPinkPurpleGradient(root)
        if not root then return end
        for _,d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsA("TextLabel") and (d.Name=="Discord" or d.Name=="DiscordInvite") then
                d.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
                local g=d:FindFirstChild("VX7PinkPurpleGradient")
                if not g then
                    g=Instance.new("UIGradient")
                    g.Name="VX7PinkPurpleGradient"
                    g.Parent=d
                end
                g.Color=ColorSequence.new({
                    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.00,Color3.fromRGB(255,55,170)),
                    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.22,Color3.fromRGB(150,18,105)),
                    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.46,Color3.fromRGB(255,74,177)),
                    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.70,Color3.fromRGB(112,12,82)),
                    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1.00,Color3.fromRGB(255,74,177)),
                })
                g.Rotation=0
            end
        end
    end
    pcall(function() applyDiscordPinkPurpleGradient(game:GetService("CoreGui")) end)
    pcall(function() applyDiscordPinkPurpleGradient(LP:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")) end)

    -- Keep local overhead branding synchronized with the active VX7 theme.
    local function keepLocalOverheadTheme()
        local c = LP.Character
        if not c then return end
        pcall(function() applyDiscordPinkPurpleGradient(c) end)
        local p = (VX7_FULL_PALETTES and VX7_FULL_PALETTES[_G.AdaptThemeName or "BLACK_PINK"]) or nil
        local accent = p and p.accent or Color3.fromRGB(255,80,175)
        for _,d in ipairs(c:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsA("TextLabel") and (d.Name=="Discord" or d.Name=="Speed") then
                d.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
            end
        end
    end
    if not _G._LonelyLocalColorNeutral then
        _G._LonelyLocalColorNeutral=true
        RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(keepLocalOverheadTheme)
    end

    -- E01-style top-screen steal warning:
    -- red countdown 3 -> 0, then green "STOLE" for 0.5s and disappears.
    local warningGui, warningFrame, warningText, warningConn
    local lastStealStamp=0
    local function destroyStealWarning()
        _safeDisconnect(warningConn); warningConn=nil
        if warningGui then pcall(function() warningGui:Destroy() end) end
        warningGui=nil; warningFrame=nil; warningText=nil
    end
    local function showStealWarning()
        destroyStealWarning()
        local pg=LP:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui") or PlayerGui
        if not pg then return end
        warningGui=Instance.new("ScreenGui")
        warningGui.Name="LonelyE01Warning"
        warningGui.ResetOnSpawn=false
        warningGui.IgnoreGuiInset=true
        warningGui.DisplayOrder=999999
        warningGui.Parent=pg
        warningFrame=Instance.new("Frame")
        warningFrame.Size=UDim2.new(0,320,0,54)
        warningFrame.Position=UDim2.new(0.5,-160,0,28)
        warningFrame.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(180,25,30)
        warningFrame.BackgroundTransparency=0.08
        warningFrame.BorderSizePixel=0
        warningFrame.Parent=warningGui
        corner(warningFrame,16)
        local s=Instance.new("UIStroke",warningFrame)
        s.Color=Color3.fromRGB(255,90,90); s.Thickness=2
        warningText=Instance.new("TextLabel",warningFrame)
        warningText.BackgroundTransparency=1
        warningText.Size=UDim2.new(1,-18,1,0)
        warningText.Position=UDim2.new(0,9,0,0)
        warningText.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBlack
        warningText.TextSize=20
        warningText.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
        warningText.Text="STOLE 3"
        warningText.Parent=warningFrame

        local start=tick()
        warningConn=RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
            if not warningText or not warningText.Parent then
                destroyStealWarning(); return
            end
            local e=tick()-start
            if e<3 then
                local n=math.max(0,3-math.floor(e))
                warningFrame.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(180,25,30)
                s.Color=Color3.fromRGB(255,90,90)
                warningText.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
                warningText.Text="STOLE "..tostring(n)
            elseif e<3.5 then
                warningFrame.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(25,180,75)
                s.Color=Color3.fromRGB(100,255,140)
                warningText.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
                warningText.Text="STOLE"
            else
                destroyStealWarning()
            end
        end)
    end
    _G.LonelyShowStealWarning=showStealWarning

    if not _G._LonelyStealWarningWatcher then
        _G._LonelyStealWarningWatcher=true
        task.spawn(function()
            local last=0
            while true do
                task.wait(0.03)
                local g=_G.AdaptGalaxyV3
                local stamp=g and tonumber(g.lastResultTime)
                local result=g and tostring(g.lastResult or "")
                if stamp and stamp>last and result:lower():find("^stole%s") then
                    last=stamp
                    showStealWarning()
                end
            end
        end)
    end

    -- Remove any stale Body Lock / Intro GUI remnants created by older chunks.
    task.defer(function()
        task.wait(0.4)
        pcall(function()
            for _,root in ipairs({PlayerGui, game:GetService("CoreGui")}) do
                for _,d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
                    local n=tostring(d.Name):lower()
                    if n:find("bodylock") or n=="body lock" or n:find("tigyintro") or n=="intro" or n:find("intro music") or n:find("intro song") then
                        if d:IsA("ScreenGui") or d:IsA("Frame") or d:IsA("TextButton") or d:IsA("TextLabel") then
                            pcall(function() d:Destroy() end)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
    end)

    -- Prevent the old Adapt intro entry points from starting anything.
    _G._LonelyShowIntro=false
    _G._LonelyRunIntroNow=function() end
    _G.__AdaptDuelsRunIntro=function() end
end)()

-- ============================================================================
-- FINAL OVERRIDE: AMBITIOUS-STYLE RAGDOLL COUNTDOWN (SELF + ENEMIES)
-- 2.6s timer, BallSocketConstraint detection, CharacterAdded/PlayerAdded
-- watchers, live 0.1s countdown, cleanup and persistent toggle handling.
-- ============================================================================
do
    ragdollCountdownEnabled = (ragdollCountdownEnabled ~= false)
    _G._LonelyRCD = _G._LonelyRCD or {conn=nil, charConn=nil, endTime=0, seconds=2.6}
    _G._LonelyEnemyRagdollData = _G._LonelyEnemyRagdollData or {}
    _G._LonelyEnemyRagdollConns = _G._LonelyEnemyRagdollConns or {}
    _G._LonelyEnemyRagdollWatcher = _G._LonelyEnemyRagdollWatcher or nil
    _G._LonelyEnemyRagdollUpdate = _G._LonelyEnemyRagdollUpdate or nil
    _G.AmbitiousEnemyRagdollData = _G._LonelyEnemyRagdollData

    local function _rcDisconnect(c)
        if c then pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
    end

    local function _rcDestroyEnemyGui(data)
        if data and data.gui then pcall(function() data.gui:Destroy() end) end
    end

    local function _rcClearEnemy(plr)
        local data=_G._LonelyEnemyRagdollData[plr]
        _rcDestroyEnemyGui(data)
        _G._LonelyEnemyRagdollData[plr]=nil
        local conns=_G._LonelyEnemyRagdollConns[plr]
        if conns then
            _rcDisconnect(conns.ragdollDetect)
            _rcDisconnect(conns.stateChange)
            _rcDisconnect(conns.charAdded)
        end
        _G._LonelyEnemyRagdollConns[plr]=nil
    end

    local function _rcSetupEnemy(plr,char)
        if plr==LP or not char then return end
        local oldConns=_G._LonelyEnemyRagdollConns[plr]
        local charAdded=oldConns and oldConns.charAdded
        _rcClearEnemy(plr)
        local conns={charAdded=charAdded}
        local function mark()
            if not ragdollCountdownEnabled then return end
            local now=tick()
            local data=_G._LonelyEnemyRagdollData[plr]
            if data and data.gui and data.gui.Parent then
                data.endTime=now+_G._LonelyRCD.seconds
                return
            end
            local head=char:FindFirstChild("Head")
            if not head then return end
            local bb=Instance.new("BillboardGui")
            bb.Name="LonelyEnemyRagdollCountdown"
            bb.Adornee=head
            bb.Size=UDim2.new(0,120,0,30)
            bb.StudsOffset=Vector3.new(0,3.2,0)
            bb.AlwaysOnTop=true
            bb.LightInfluence=0
            bb.ResetOnSpawn=false
            bb.Parent=PlayerGui or LP:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
            local label=Instance.new("TextLabel")
            label.Name="Countdown"
            label.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,1,0)
            label.BackgroundTransparency=1
            label.Text="RAGDOLL 2.6"
            label.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(80,255,120)
            label.TextStrokeColor3=Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0)
            label.TextStrokeTransparency=0
            label.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBlack
            label.TextSize=20
            label.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
            label.Parent=bb
            _G._LonelyEnemyRagdollData[plr]={gui=bb,endTime=now+_G._LonelyRCD.seconds}
        end
        conns.ragdollDetect=char.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)
            if d:IsA("BallSocketConstraint") then mark() end
        end)
        local hum=char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum then
            conns.stateChange=hum.StateChanged:Connect(function(_,state)
                local rag=(state==Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics or state==Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll)
                if not rag then
                    local data=_G._LonelyEnemyRagdollData[plr]
                    if data and tick()>=(data.endTime or 0) then _rcClearEnemy(plr) end
                end
            end)
        else
            conns.stateChange=char.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_,parent)
                if not parent then _rcClearEnemy(plr) end
            end)
        end
        _G._LonelyEnemyRagdollConns[plr]=conns
    end

    local function _rcStartEnemies()
        if _G._LonelyEnemyRagdollWatcher then return end
        _G._LonelyEnemyRagdollUpdate=RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            if not ragdollCountdownEnabled then return end
            local now=tick()
            for plr,data in pairs(_G._LonelyEnemyRagdollData) do
                if not data or not data.gui or not data.gui.Parent then
                    _G._LonelyEnemyRagdollData[plr]=nil
                elseif data.endTime and data.endTime>now then
                    local label=data.gui:FindFirstChild("Countdown")
                    if label then
                        local left=data.endTime-now
                        label.Text=string.format("RAGDOLL %.1f",left)
                        label.TextColor3=left<=1 and Color3.fromRGB(255,230,90) or Color3.fromRGB(80,255,120)
                    end
                else
                    _rcClearEnemy(plr)
                end
            end
        end)
        _G._LonelyEnemyRagdollWatcher=Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(plr)
            if plr==LP then return end
            local cconn=plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char) _rcSetupEnemy(plr,char) end)
            local conns=_G._LonelyEnemyRagdollConns[plr] or {}
            conns.charAdded=cconn
            _G._LonelyEnemyRagdollConns[plr]=conns
            if plr.Character then _rcSetupEnemy(plr,plr.Character) end
        end)
        for _,plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if plr~=LP then
                local conns=_G._LonelyEnemyRagdollConns[plr] or {}
                _rcDisconnect(conns.charAdded)
                conns.charAdded=plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char) _rcSetupEnemy(plr,char) end)
                _G._LonelyEnemyRagdollConns[plr]=conns
                if plr.Character then _rcSetupEnemy(plr,plr.Character) end
            end
        end
        _G._LonelyEnemyRemovingConn=Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(plr) _rcClearEnemy(plr) end)
    end

    local function _rcStopEnemies()
        _rcDisconnect(_G._LonelyEnemyRagdollWatcher); _G._LonelyEnemyRagdollWatcher=nil
        _rcDisconnect(_G._LonelyEnemyRagdollUpdate); _G._LonelyEnemyRagdollUpdate=nil
        _rcDisconnect(_G._LonelyEnemyRemovingConn); _G._LonelyEnemyRemovingConn=nil
        for plr in pairs(_G._LonelyEnemyRagdollConns) do _rcClearEnemy(plr) end
        for plr,data in pairs(_G._LonelyEnemyRagdollData) do _rcDestroyEnemyGui(data); _G._LonelyEnemyRagdollData[plr]=nil end
    end

    local function _rcEnsureOwnLabel()
        local char=LP.Character
        if not char then return nil end
        local head=char:FindFirstChild("Head") or char:WaitForChild("Head",4)
        if not head then return nil end
        if type(setupOverheadInfo)=="function" then
            pcall(setupOverheadInfo,char)
        end
        if ragdollCountdownLabel and ragdollCountdownLabel.Parent then return ragdollCountdownLabel end
        local gui=head:FindFirstChild("AdaptDuelsOverheadInfo") or head:FindFirstChild("LonelyOverheadInfo")
        if not gui then
            gui=Instance.new("BillboardGui")
            gui.Name="LonelyOverheadInfo"
            gui.Size=UDim2.new(0,220,0,40)
            gui.StudsOffset=Vector3.new(0,2.2,0)
            gui.AlwaysOnTop=true
            gui.LightInfluence=0
            gui.Parent=head
        end
        local lbl=gui:FindFirstChild("RagdollCountdown")
        if not lbl then
            lbl=Instance.new("TextLabel")
            lbl.Name="RagdollCountdown"
            lbl.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,1,0)
            lbl.BackgroundTransparency=1
            lbl.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(80,255,120)
            lbl.TextStrokeColor3=Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0)
            lbl.TextStrokeTransparency=0
            lbl.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBlack
            lbl.TextSize=22
            lbl.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
            lbl.Parent=gui
        end
        ragdollCountdownLabel=lbl
        return lbl
    end

    local function _rcStopSelf()
        _rcDisconnect(_G._LonelyRCD.conn); _G._LonelyRCD.conn=nil
        _rcDisconnect(_G._LonelyRCD.charConn); _G._LonelyRCD.charConn=nil
        _G._LonelyRCD.endTime=0
        if ragdollCountdownLabel then ragdollCountdownLabel.Visible=false; ragdollCountdownLabel.Text="" end
    end

    local function _rcHookSelf(char)
        _rcStopSelf()
        if not ragdollCountdownEnabled then return end
        char=char or LP.Character
        if not char then return end
        local hum=char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or char:WaitForChild("Humanoid",4)
        if not hum then return end
        _rcEnsureOwnLabel()
        local function begin()
            _G._LonelyRCD.endTime=tick()+_G._LonelyRCD.seconds
            if ragdollCountdownLabel then ragdollCountdownLabel.Visible=true end
        end
        local function isRag()
            local st=hum:GetState()
            return hum.PlatformStand or st==Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics or st==Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll
        end
        _G._LonelyRCD.charConn=hum.StateChanged:Connect(function(_,state)
            if state==Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics or state==Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll then begin() end
        end)
        _G._LonelyRCD.conn=RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
            if not ragdollCountdownEnabled then _rcStopSelf(); _rcStopEnemies(); return end
            if not ragdollCountdownLabel or not ragdollCountdownLabel.Parent then _rcEnsureOwnLabel() end
            if isRag() and _G._LonelyRCD.endTime<tick() then begin() end
            local left=math.max(0,_G._LonelyRCD.endTime-tick())
            if left>0 then
                ragdollCountdownLabel.Visible=true
                ragdollCountdownLabel.Text=string.format("RAGDOLL %.1f",left)
                ragdollCountdownLabel.TextColor3=left<=1 and Color3.fromRGB(255,230,90) or Color3.fromRGB(80,255,120)
            else
                ragdollCountdownLabel.Visible=false
                ragdollCountdownLabel.Text=""
            end
        end)
    end

    function stopRagdollCountdown()
        _rcStopSelf()
        _rcStopEnemies()
    end
    function hookRagdollCountdown(char)
        _rcStopSelf()
        _rcStopEnemies()
        if not ragdollCountdownEnabled then return end
        _rcStartEnemies()
        _rcHookSelf(char or LP.Character)
    end
    _G.LonelyHookRagdollCountdown=hookRagdollCountdown
    _G.LonelySetRagdollCountdown=function(on)
        ragdollCountdownEnabled=on==true
        if ragdollCountdownEnabled then hookRagdollCountdown(LP.Character) else stopRagdollCountdown() end
        if setRagdollCountdownVisual then pcall(setRagdollCountdownVisual,ragdollCountdownEnabled) end
        if saveAdaptConfig then pcall(saveAdaptConfig) end
    end
    if LP.Character then task.defer(function() if ragdollCountdownEnabled then hookRagdollCountdown(LP.Character) end end) end
    if not _G._LonelyRCDFinalCharConn then
        _G._LonelyRCDFinalCharConn=LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
            task.wait(0.25)
            if ragdollCountdownEnabled then hookRagdollCountdown(char) end
        end)
    end
end

-- ============================================================
-- CUSTOM TOOLS ENGINE (Transparent / Custom)
-- ============================================================
do
    local _Players    = game:GetService("Players")
    local _RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
    local _LP         = _Players.LocalPlayer

    -- Item riconosciuti (Bat / Slap Bat / Medusa's Head)
    local CT_ITEMS = {
        { key = "Bat",    match = function(n) n = n:lower() return n:find("bat") ~= nil or n:find("slap") ~= nil end },
        { key = "Medusa", match = function(n) return n:lower():find("medusa") ~= nil end },
    }

    local function ctMatchItem(inst)
        if not (inst:IsA("Tool") or inst:IsA("Model") or inst:IsA("Accessory") or inst:IsA("BasePart")) then
            return nil
        end
        for _, item in ipairs(CT_ITEMS) do
            if item.match(inst.Name) then return item end
        end
        return nil
    end

    local function isReplicaStuff(d)
        if d.Name == "LocalReplica" or d.Name == "FlowerSkin_KatanaRealistic" or d.Name == "FlowerSkin_AssetKatana" then
            return true
        end
        if d:FindFirstAncestor("LocalReplica")
            or d:FindFirstAncestor("FlowerSkin_KatanaRealistic")
            or d:FindFirstAncestor("FlowerSkin_AssetKatana") then
            return true
        end
        return false
    end

    -- ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- GESTORE TRASPARENZA CONDIVISO
    -- Evita che Transparent e Custom Tools si sovrascrivano a vicenda.
    -- Ogni modulo "prenota" un valore, vince la priorita' piu' alta,
    -- e il valore originale vero viene letto una sola volta (baseline).
    -- ------------------------------------------------------------
    local CT_Trans = {}
    do
        local PRIORITY = { "custom", "rainbow", "transparent" }
        local baseline = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
        local claims   = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
        -- Connessioni GetPropertyChangedSignal("Transparency") per parte:
        -- servono a rimettere subito il valore se il gioco lo sovrascrive
        -- (e' il motivo per cui la bat originale ricompariva sopra la custom).
        local guards   = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

        function CT_Trans.getBaseline(part)
            local b = baseline[part]
            if b ~= nil then return b end
            local ok, val = pcall(function() return part.Transparency end)
            if not ok then return nil end
            baseline[part] = val
            return val
        end

        local function wantedValue(part)
            local c = claims[part]
            if not c then return nil end
            for _, who in ipairs(PRIORITY) do
                if c[who] ~= nil then return c[who] end
            end
            return nil
        end

        -- Scrive solo se il valore e' davvero diverso: il watchdog dei
        -- Custom Tools richiama claim() sulle stesse parti ogni 0.4s e
        -- senza questo controllo sarebbero centinaia di property write
        -- inutili al secondo.
        local function setIfDifferent(part, v)
            local ok, cur = pcall(function() return part.Transparency end)
            if ok and cur ~= nil and math.abs(cur - v) <= 0.001 then return end
            pcall(function() part.Transparency = v end)
        end

        local function resolve(part)
            local v = wantedValue(part)
            if v ~= nil then
                setIfDifferent(part, v)
                return
            end
            local b = baseline[part]
            if b ~= nil then
                setIfDifferent(part, b)
            end
        end

        -- Riapplica subito il valore prenotato se qualcun altro lo cambia.
        local function armGuard(part)
            if guards[part] then return end
            local ok, conn = pcall(function()
                return part:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Transparency"):Connect(function()
                    local v = wantedValue(part)
                    if v == nil then return end
                    local ok2, cur = pcall(function() return part.Transparency end)
                    if ok2 and cur ~= nil and math.abs(cur - v) > 0.001 then
                        pcall(function() part.Transparency = v end)
                    end
                end)
            end)
            if ok and conn then guards[part] = conn end
        end

        local function disarmGuard(part)
            local conn = guards[part]
            if conn then
                pcall(function() conn:Disconnect() end)
                guards[part] = nil
            end
        end

        -- Rete di sicurezza: se un evento e' andato perso (o la parte e'
        -- stata sostituita) il sweep periodico rimette tutto a posto.
        function CT_Trans.enforce()
            for part, _ in pairs(claims) do
                if part.Parent then
                    local v = wantedValue(part)
                    if v ~= nil then
                        local ok, cur = pcall(function() return part.Transparency end)
                        if ok and cur ~= nil and math.abs(cur - v) > 0.001 then
                            pcall(function() part.Transparency = v end)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        function CT_Trans.claim(part, who, value)
            if not part then return end
            if CT_Trans.getBaseline(part) == nil then return end
            local c = claims[part]
            if not c then c = {}; claims[part] = c end
            c[who] = value
            armGuard(part)
            resolve(part)
        end

        function CT_Trans.release(part, who)
            if not part then return end
            local c = claims[part]
            if not c then return end
            c[who] = nil
            if next(c) == nil then
                claims[part] = nil
                disarmGuard(part)
            end
            if part.Parent then resolve(part) end
        end
    end

    -- ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- JANITOR: ogni 10s scarta le entry di oggetti non piu' esistenti,
    -- cosi' le tabelle non crescono in sessioni molto lunghe.
    -- ------------------------------------------------------------
    local CT_JANITORS = {}
    task.spawn(function()
        while true do
            task.wait(10)
            for _, fn in ipairs(CT_JANITORS) do pcall(fn) end
        end
    end)

    -- Sweep trasparenze: 4 volte al secondo rimette i valori prenotati.
    -- Gira solo se almeno uno dei tre moduli e' acceso.
    task.spawn(function()
        while true do
            task.wait(0.25)
            if _G.AmbitiousCustomToolsEnabled == true
            or _G.AmbitiousTransparentToolsEnabled == true then
                pcall(CT_Trans.enforce)
            end
        end
    end)

    -- ############################################################
    -- ##                   TRANSPARENT TOOLS                    ##
    -- ############################################################
    do
        local TRANSPARENCY = 0.5   -- 0 = opaco, 1 = invisibile

        local enabled  = false
        local tracked  = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
        local watchers = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
        local unregister

        local function canTouch(d)
            if not d:IsA("BasePart") then return false end
            -- non toccare le parti invisibili di default (baseline, non valore corrente)
            local base = CT_Trans.getBaseline(d)
            if base == nil or base >= 1 then return false end
            return true
        end

        local function addNode(entry, d)
            if isReplicaStuff(d) then return end
            if not canTouch(d) then return end
            if entry.seen[d] then return end
            entry.seen[d] = true
            local node = { obj = d }
            table.insert(entry.parts, node)
            CT_Trans.claim(d, "transparent", TRANSPARENCY)
        end

        local function register(root)
            if tracked[root] then return end
            local entry = { parts = {}, seen = {}, conns = {} }
            tracked[root] = entry

            for _, d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do addNode(entry, d) end
            if root:IsA("BasePart") then addNode(entry, root) end

            table.insert(entry.conns, root.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)
                addNode(entry, d)
            end))
            table.insert(entry.conns, root.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
                if not parent then unregister(root, false) end
            end))
        end

        function unregister(root, doRestore)
            local entry = tracked[root]
            if not entry then return end
            for _, conn in ipairs(entry.conns) do pcall(function() conn:Disconnect() end) end
            for _, node in ipairs(entry.parts) do
                CT_Trans.release(node.obj, "transparent")
            end
            tracked[root] = nil
        end

        local function tryRegister(inst)
            if not enabled then return end
            if ctMatchItem(inst) then register(inst) end
        end

        local function unwatch(container)
            local conns = watchers[container]
            if not conns then return end
            for _, c in ipairs(conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
            watchers[container] = nil
        end

        local function watch(container)
            if not container or watchers[container] then return end
            watchers[container] = { container.ChildAdded:Connect(tryRegister) }
            for _, child in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do tryRegister(child) end
        end

        local function watchAll()
            watch(_LP:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack"))
            watch(_LP.Character)
        end

        _LP.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
            if enabled and child:IsA("Backpack") then watch(child) end
        end)

        _LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
            for root in pairs(tracked) do unregister(root, false) end
            -- pulizia totale: il vecchio Character e il vecchio Backpack sono morti
            for container in pairs(watchers) do unwatch(container) end
            if not enabled then return end
            watch(char)
            task.defer(function()
                if enabled then watchAll() end
            end)
        end)

        table.insert(CT_JANITORS, function()
            for root in pairs(tracked) do
                if not root.Parent then unregister(root, false) end
            end
            for container in pairs(watchers) do
                if not container.Parent then unwatch(container) end
            end
        end)

        _G.AmbitiousTransparentTools = {
            setEnabled = function(on)
                on = on and true or false
                enabled = on
                _G.AmbitiousTransparentToolsEnabled = on
                if on then
                    watchAll()
                else
                    for root in pairs(tracked) do unregister(root, true) end
                    for container in pairs(watchers) do unwatch(container) end
                end
            end,
            isEnabled = function() return enabled end,
        }
    end

katanaSkinEnabled = false

local KatanaSkin = (function()
    local Players       = game:GetService("Players")
    local InsertService = game:GetService("InsertService")
    local Lighting2     = game:GetService("Lighting")
    local ReplicatedStorage2 = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
    local LocalPlayer   = Players.LocalPlayer

    local KC = {
        red  = Color3.new(0.784314, 0, 0),
        red2 = Color3.new(1, 0.392157, 0.392157),
        gold = Color3.new(1, 0.72549, 0.196078),
    }

    local State = {
        Skin = "KATANA",
        SkinOrder = { "KATANA", "NONE" },
        LastBat = nil,
        LastAppliedSkin = nil,
        OriginalKatanaTemplate = nil,
        ExactTemplates = {},
        ExactTemplateSearched = {},
        ExactAssetIds = { KATANA = "" },
        Original = {},
    }

    local function findBatForKatanaSkin()
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        if char then
            local t = char:FindFirstChild("Bat")
            if t and t:IsA("Tool") then return t end
        end
        local bp = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
        if bp then
            local t = bp:FindFirstChild("Bat")
            if t and t:IsA("Tool") then return t end
        end
        return nil
    end

    local function setPartSafe(part)
        if not part or not part:IsA("BasePart") then return end
        part.Anchored    = false
        part.CanCollide  = false
        part.CanTouch    = false
        part.CanQuery    = false
        part.Massless    = true
    end

    local function weldToHandle(part, handle)
        if not part or not handle or not part:IsA("BasePart") or not handle:IsA("BasePart") then return end
        setPartSafe(part)
        local w = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
        w.Name   = "FlowerSkin_AssetWeld"
        w.Part0  = handle
        w.Part1  = part
        w.Parent = part
    end

    local function rememberOriginal(tool)
        if not tool then return end
        local handle = tool:FindFirstChild("Handle")
        local slash  = tool:FindFirstChild("Slash")
        State.Original[tool] = State.Original[tool] or {}
        local o = State.Original[tool]
        if handle and handle:IsA("BasePart") and not o.Handle then
            o.Handle = {
                Transparency = handle.Transparency,
                LocalTransparencyModifier = handle.LocalTransparencyModifier,
                CastShadow = handle.CastShadow,
            }
        end
        if slash and slash:IsA("Sound") and not o.SlashSoundId then
            o.SlashSoundId = slash.SoundId
        end
    end

    local function captureKatanaTemplate()
        if State.OriginalKatanaTemplate then return end
        local function scan(container)
            if not container then return end
            local bat = container:FindFirstChild("Bat")
            if not bat then return end
            local folder = bat:FindFirstChild("FlowerSkin_KatanaRealistic")
            local asset  = folder and folder:FindFirstChild("FlowerSkin_AssetKatana")
            if asset then State.OriginalKatanaTemplate = asset:Clone() end
        end
        scan(LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack"))
        scan(LocalPlayer.Character)
    end

    local function hideOriginalHandle(tool, hidden)
        local handle = tool and tool:FindFirstChild("Handle")
        if not handle or not handle:IsA("BasePart") then return end
        rememberOriginal(tool)
        if hidden then
            handle.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
            handle.Transparency = 1
            handle.CastShadow = false
        else
            local o = State.Original[tool] and State.Original[tool].Handle
            handle.LocalTransparencyModifier = o and o.LocalTransparencyModifier or 0
            handle.Transparency = o and o.Transparency or 0
            handle.CastShadow = o and o.CastShadow
            if handle.CastShadow == nil then handle.CastShadow = true end
        end
    end

    local function setSlashSound(tool, soundId)
        rememberOriginal(tool)
        local slash = tool and tool:FindFirstChild("Slash")
        if slash and slash:IsA("Sound") then
            slash.SoundId = soundId or ((State.Original[tool] and State.Original[tool].SlashSoundId) or slash.SoundId)
        end
    end

    local function removeSkin(tool)
        if not tool then return end
        local oldFolder = tool:FindFirstChild("FlowerSkin_KatanaRealistic")
        if oldFolder then oldFolder:Destroy() end
        local oldLoose = tool:FindFirstChild("FlowerSkin_AssetKatana")
        if oldLoose then oldLoose:Destroy() end
        hideOriginalHandle(tool, false)
        setSlashSound(tool, nil)
    end

    local function addRedVFX(parentPart)
        if not parentPart or not parentPart:IsA("BasePart") then return end
        local existing = parentPart:FindFirstChild("FlowerSkin_ExtraRedVFX")
        if existing then existing:Destroy() end

        local top = Instance.new("Attachment")
        top.Name = "FlowerSkin_ExtraRedVFX"
        top.Position = Vector3.new(0, parentPart.Size.Y * 0.5, 0)
        top.Parent = parentPart

        local bottom = Instance.new("Attachment")
        bottom.Name = "FlowerSkin_ExtraRedVFX_End"
        bottom.Position = Vector3.new(0, -parentPart.Size.Y * 0.5, 0)
        bottom.Parent = parentPart

        local trail = Instance.new("Trail")
        trail.Name = "FlowerSkin_ExtraRedVFX"
        trail.Attachment0 = top
        trail.Attachment1 = bottom
        trail.Color = ColorSequence.new({
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, KC.red2),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.new(0.54902, 0, 0)),
        })
        trail.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.35),
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
        })
        trail.Lifetime = 0.18
        trail.LightEmission = 0.55
        trail.Parent = parentPart

        local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
        emitter.Name = "FlowerSkin_ExtraRedVFX"
        emitter.Color = ColorSequence.new({
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.new(0.784314, 0, 0)),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, KC.red2),
        })
        emitter.LightEmission = 0.55
        emitter.Rate = 14
        emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.25, 0.45)
        emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(0.2, 0.7)
        emitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(12, 12)
        emitter.Size = NumberSequence.new({
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.08),
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0),
        })
        emitter.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"
        emitter.Parent = parentPart
    end

    local function newPart(parent, name, size, offset, color, material)
        local p = Instance.new("Part")
        p.Name = name
        p.Size = size
        p.Color = color
        p.Material = material or Enum.Material.Neon
        p.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
        p.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
        setPartSafe(p)
        p.Parent = parent
        return p, offset or CFrame.identity
    end

    local EXACT_TEMPLATE_NAMES = {
        KATANA = { "FlowerSkin_AssetKatana", "Katana", "FlowerSkin_KatanaRealistic" },
    }

    local function isScriptObject(inst)
        return inst:IsA("Script") or inst:IsA("LocalScript") or inst:IsA("ModuleScript")
    end

    local function stripScripts(root)
        if not root then return end
        if isScriptObject(root) then root:Destroy(); return end
        for _, inst in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
            if isScriptObject(inst) then inst:Destroy() end
        end
    end

    local function hasAnyBasePart(root)
        if not root then return false end
        if root:IsA("BasePart") then return true end
        return root:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true) ~= nil
    end

    local function isGeneratedProxy(root)
        local ok, v = pcall(function() return root:GetAttribute("CursedBatSkinsGenerated") end)
        return ok and v == true
    end

    local function usableTemplate(root)
        if not root or isGeneratedProxy(root) then return nil end
        if root:IsA("Model") or root:IsA("Tool") or root:IsA("Folder") or root:IsA("BasePart") then
            if hasAnyBasePart(root) then return root end
        end
        return nil
    end

    local function findUsableNamed(root, names)
        if not root then return nil end
        for _, name in ipairs(names) do
            if root.Name == name then
                local d = usableTemplate(root)
                if d then return d end
            end
        end
        for _, name in ipairs(names) do
            local found = root:FindFirstChild(name, true)
            local u = usableTemplate(found)
            if u then return u end
        end
        return nil
    end

    local function assetTextFromId(assetId)
        local raw = tostring(assetId or ""):gsub("%s+", "")
        if raw == "" then return nil end
        if raw:match("^rbxassetid://") or raw:match("^rbxasset://") then return raw end
        if raw:match("^%d+$") then return "rbxassetid://" .. raw end
        return raw
    end

    local function loadExactTemplateFromAssetId(skinName)
        local assetText = assetTextFromId(State.ExactAssetIds[skinName])
        if not assetText then return nil end
        local loaded = {}
        pcall(function() loaded = game:GetObjects(assetText) end)
        if #loaded == 0 then
            local id = tostring(assetText):match("(%d+)")
            if id then
                pcall(function()
                    table.insert(loaded, InsertService:LoadAsset(tonumber(id)))
                end)
            end
        end
        local names = EXACT_TEMPLATE_NAMES[skinName] or {}
        for _, root in ipairs(loaded) do
            local exact = findUsableNamed(root, names) or usableTemplate(root)
            if exact then
                local clone = exact:Clone()
                stripScripts(clone)
                return clone
            end
        end
        return nil
    end

    local function findExactTemplateInGame(skinName)
        local names = EXACT_TEMPLATE_NAMES[skinName]
        if not names then return nil end
        local containers = {
            LocalPlayer.Character,
            LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack"),
            ReplicatedStorage2,
            Lighting2,
            workspace,
        }
        for _, container in ipairs(containers) do
            local source = findUsableNamed(container, names)
            if source then
                local clone = source:Clone()
                stripScripts(clone)
                return clone
            end
        end
        return nil
    end

    local function getExactTemplate(skinName)
        if skinName == "KATANA" and State.OriginalKatanaTemplate then
            return State.OriginalKatanaTemplate
        end
        if State.ExactTemplates[skinName] then return State.ExactTemplates[skinName] end
        if State.ExactTemplateSearched[skinName] then return nil end
        State.ExactTemplateSearched[skinName] = true
        local loaded = loadExactTemplateFromAssetId(skinName) or findExactTemplateInGame(skinName)
        if loaded then State.ExactTemplates[skinName] = loaded end
        return loaded
    end

    local function containerToModel(clone, folder)
        if clone:IsA("Model") then
            clone.Name = "FlowerSkin_AssetKatana"
            clone.Parent = folder
            return clone
        end
        if clone:IsA("BasePart") then
            local model = Instance.new("Model")
            model.Name = "FlowerSkin_AssetKatana"
            model.Parent = folder
            clone.Parent = model
            return model
        end
        if clone:IsA("Tool") or clone:IsA("Folder") then
            local nested = clone:FindFirstChild("FlowerSkin_AssetKatana")
                or clone:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Model")
                or clone:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
            if nested and nested.Parent == clone then
                nested.Parent = nil
                clone:Destroy()
                return containerToModel(nested, folder)
            end
            local model = Instance.new("Model")
            model.Name = "FlowerSkin_AssetKatana"
            model.Parent = folder
            for _, child in ipairs(clone:GetChildren()) do
                if not isScriptObject(child) then child.Parent = model end
            end
            clone:Destroy()
            return model
        end
        return nil
    end

    local function applyExactMesh(tool, skinName)
        local handle = tool and tool:FindFirstChild("Handle")
        if not handle or not handle:IsA("BasePart") then return false end
        local template = getExactTemplate(skinName)
        if not template then return false end

        local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
        folder.Name = "FlowerSkin_KatanaRealistic"
        folder.Parent = tool

        local model = containerToModel(template:Clone(), folder)
        if not model or not hasAnyBasePart(model) then
            folder:Destroy()
            return false
        end
        stripScripts(model)
        -- Clean Bat skin must be a visual-only assembly. Remove inherited joints,
        -- constraints and body movers from the source asset BEFORE
        -- welding the parts to Bat.Handle. Keeping source joints and adding a
        -- second Handle weld can over-constrain the assembly and cause fling
        -- when Custom Tools is enabled while the Bat is already equipped.
        for _, link in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
            if link:IsA("JointInstance") or link:IsA("Constraint") or link:IsA("BodyMover") then
                pcall(function() link:Destroy() end)
            end
        end
        pcall(function() model:SetAttribute("CursedBatSkinsExactMesh", true) end)

        local firstPart
        for _, inst in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
            if inst:IsA("BasePart") then
                firstPart = firstPart or inst
                setPartSafe(inst)
                pcall(function()
                    inst.CanCollide = false
                    inst.CanTouch = false
                    inst.CanQuery = false
                    inst.Massless = true
                    inst.CustomPhysicalProperties = PhysicalProperties.new(0.01, 0, 0, 0, 0)
                end)
            end
        end
        if not firstPart then folder:Destroy(); return false end

        if model:IsA("Model") then
            model.PrimaryPart = model.PrimaryPart or firstPart
            pcall(function() model:PivotTo(handle.CFrame) end)
        end
        for _, inst in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
            if inst:IsA("BasePart") then weldToHandle(inst, handle) end
        end

        local vfxPart = model:FindFirstChild("SharpParts", true)
            or model:FindFirstChild("WeaponPart", true)
            or model:FindFirstChild("Handle", true)
            or firstPart
        if vfxPart and not vfxPart:FindFirstChild("FlowerSkin_ExtraRedVFX") then
            addRedVFX(vfxPart)
        end
        return true
    end

    local function buildProxyModel(tool, skinName)
        local handle = tool and tool:FindFirstChild("Handle")
        if not handle or not handle:IsA("BasePart") then return nil end

        local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
        folder.Name = "FlowerSkin_KatanaRealistic"
        folder.Parent = tool

        local model = Instance.new("Model")
        model.Name = "FlowerSkin_AssetKatana"
        model:SetAttribute("CursedBatSkinsGenerated", true)
        model.Parent = folder

        local parts = {}
        local function add(name, size, offset, color, material)
            local part, cfOffset = newPart(model, name, size, offset, color, material)
            part.CFrame = handle.CFrame * cfOffset
            weldToHandle(part, handle)
            table.insert(parts, part)
            return part
        end

        if skinName == "KATANA" then
            add("Handle2", Vector3.new(0.22, 1.0, 0.22), CFrame.new(0, -0.85, 0), Color3.new(0.04, 0.04, 0.045), Enum.Material.Metal)
            local sharp = add("SharpParts", Vector3.new(0.22, 3.35, 0.12), CFrame.new(0, 1.05, 0), KC.red2, Enum.Material.Neon)
            add("WeaponPart", Vector3.new(0.3, 2.7, 0.08), CFrame.new(0.08, 1.15, 0), KC.red, Enum.Material.Neon)
            add("NeonAccent", Vector3.new(0.75, 0.12, 0.42), CFrame.new(0, -0.28, 0), KC.gold, Enum.Material.Neon)
            addRedVFX(sharp)
        end
        model.PrimaryPart = parts[1]
        return model
    end

    local SKIN_SOUND_IDS = {
        KATANA = "rbxassetid://111808555599832",
    }

    local function applySkin(skinName)
        captureKatanaTemplate()
        local tool = findBatForKatanaSkin()
        if not tool then
            State.LastBat = nil
            State.LastAppliedSkin = nil
            return false
        end
        rememberOriginal(tool)
        removeSkin(tool)
        if skinName == "NONE" then
            State.LastBat = tool
            State.LastAppliedSkin = skinName
            return true
        end
        hideOriginalHandle(tool, true)
        setSlashSound(tool, SKIN_SOUND_IDS[skinName])
        if not applyExactMesh(tool, skinName) then
            buildProxyModel(tool, skinName)
        end
        local handle = tool:FindFirstChild("Handle")
        if handle then
            local fire = handle:FindFirstChildOfClass("Fire") or handle:FindFirstChild("Fire")
            if fire and fire:IsA("Fire") then
                fire.Enabled = true
                fire.Color = KC.red
                fire.SecondaryColor = KC.red2
            end
        end
        State.LastBat = tool
        State.LastAppliedSkin = skinName
        return true
    end

    return {
        State = State,
        ApplySkin = applySkin,
        SetExactAssetId = function(assetId)
            State.ExactAssetIds.KATANA = tostring(assetId or "")
            State.ExactTemplateSearched.KATANA = nil
            State.ExactTemplates.KATANA = nil
        end,
    }
end)()

_G.CursedBatKatana = KatanaSkin

task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        if katanaSkinEnabled then
            local bat
            local c = LP.Character
            if c then
                local t = c:FindFirstChild("Bat")
                if t and t:IsA("Tool") then bat = t end
            end
            if not bat then
                local bp = LP:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
                if bp then
                    local t = bp:FindFirstChild("Bat")
                    if t and t:IsA("Tool") then bat = t end
                end
            end
            if bat and (bat ~= KatanaSkin.State.LastBat or KatanaSkin.State.LastAppliedSkin ~= "KATANA") then
                pcall(function() KatanaSkin.ApplySkin("KATANA") end)
            end
        end
        task.wait(0.5)
    end
end)

    -- ############################################################
    -- ##                     CUSTOM TOOLS                       ##
