    -- ## Bat -> Diamond Sword  Medusa's Head -> Golden Desert Eagle ##
    -- ############################################################
    do
        -- Catalogo skin. "cat" e' la categoria di oggetto su cui si applica.
        local ASSETS = {
            DiamondSword      = { cat = "Bat",    label = "Diamond Sword",
                                  mesh = "rbxassetid://8827558932", tex = "rbxassetid://8827558969",
                                  scale = Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2),
                                  c0 = CFrame.new(-0.05, -0.1, -0.12) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), math.rad(180), 300),
                                  -- view = distanza della camera nell'anteprima:
                                  -- piu' alta, piu' piccolo appare l'oggetto
                                  view = 4.9 },
            Katana            = { cat = "Bat",    label = "Katana",
                                  mesh = "rbxassetid://13528902482", tex = "rbxassetid://13528902373",
                                  scale = Vector3.new(1.4, 1.4, 1.4),
                                  c0 = CFrame.new(0, 0.6, 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(270), math.rad(180), math.rad(180)),
                                  view = 6.6 },
            Skull             = { cat = "Medusa", label = "Skull",
                                  mesh = "rbxassetid://2050312704", tex = "rbxassetid://2050313393",
                                  scale = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1),
                                  c0 = CFrame.new(0, 0.65, -0.4) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(330), 0, 0),
                                  view = 4.2 },
            GoldenDesertEagle = { cat = "Medusa", label = "Golden Desert Eagle",
                                  mesh = "rbxassetid://430251413", tex = "rbxassetid://435840335",
                                  scale = Vector3.new(0.01, 0.01, 0.01),
                                  c0 = CFrame.new(0, 0, -0.8) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(330), math.rad(180), 0),
                                  view = 3.0 },
        }
        _G.AmbitiousCustomToolAssets = ASSETS

        -- Skin attualmente scelta per ogni categoria.
        _G.AmbitiousCustomToolSkins = _G.AmbitiousCustomToolSkins
            or { Bat = "DiamondSword", Medusa = "GoldenDesertEagle" }

        local function skinFor(cat)
            local key = _G.AmbitiousCustomToolSkins[cat]
            if key and ASSETS[key] and ASSETS[key].cat == cat then return key end
            return (cat == "Bat") and "DiamondSword" or "GoldenDesertEagle"
        end

        local enabled       = false
        local tracked       = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })  -- [tool] = { hidden, conns }
        local watchers      = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
        local pendingHandle = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })  -- [tool] = conn
        local teardown

        local function buildReplica(handle, mode)
            local existing = handle:FindFirstChild("LocalReplica")
            if existing then existing:Destroy() end

            local data = ASSETS[mode] or ASSETS.DiamondSword

            local m = Instance.new("Model")
            m.Name = "LocalReplica"
            pcall(function()
                m:SetAttribute("CustomSkinKey", mode)
                m:SetAttribute("CustomSkinCategory", data.cat)
                m:SetAttribute("BatSkin", data.batSkin == true)
            end)

            local p = Instance.new("Part")
            p.Name        = "MainPart"
            p.CanCollide  = false
            p.CanQuery    = false
            p.CanTouch    = false
            p.Massless    = true
            p.Size        = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
            p.Transparency= 0
            p.Anchored    = false
            p.Parent      = m

            local mesh = Instance.new("SpecialMesh")
            mesh.MeshType  = Enum.MeshType.FileMesh
            mesh.MeshId    = data.mesh
            mesh.TextureId = data.tex
            mesh.Parent    = p

            local w = Instance.new("Motor6D")
            w.Part0 = handle
            w.Part1 = p

            -- Scala e impugnatura vengono dal catalogo, non da un if per skin
            mesh.Scale = data.scale
            w.C0 = data.c0

            w.Parent = p
            m.Parent = handle
            return m
        end

        -- Nasconde (NON distrugge) solo la grafica: parti, decal e texture.
        -- Suoni, script e componenti di gioco restano intatti.
        -- Idempotente di proposito: il watchdog lo richiama sulle stesse
        -- parti per ri-prenotare la trasparenza se e' stata persa.
        local function hideNode(entry, d)
            if isReplicaStuff(d) then return end
            if d:IsA("BasePart") or d:IsA("Decal") or d:IsA("Texture") then
                entry.hidden[d] = true
                CT_Trans.claim(d, "custom", 1)
            end
        end

        local function setupTool(tool)
            if tracked[tool] then return end

            local handle = tool:FindFirstChild("Handle")
            if not handle then
                if pendingHandle[tool] then return end
                local c
                c = tool.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
                    if child.Name == "Handle" then
                        pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end)
                        pendingHandle[tool] = nil
                        if enabled then setupTool(tool) end
                    end
                end)
                pendingHandle[tool] = c
                return
            end

            local entry = { hidden = {}, conns = {} }
            tracked[tool] = entry

            local item = ctMatchItem(tool)
            local cat = (item and item.key == "Bat") and "Bat" or "Medusa"
            local mode = skinFor(cat)
            entry.cat = cat

            -- Ambitious Custom Tools: hide the original appearance and attach
            -- a local, non-colliding replica for either Bat or Medusa.
            for _, d in ipairs(tool:GetDescendants()) do hideNode(entry, d) end
            buildReplica(handle, mode)

            table.insert(entry.conns, tool.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)
                task.defer(function()
                    if tracked[tool] then hideNode(entry, d) end
                end)
            end))
            table.insert(entry.conns, tool.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
                if not parent then teardown(tool, false) end
            end))
        end

        function teardown(tool, doRestore)
            local entry = tracked[tool]
            if not entry then return end
            for _, conn in ipairs(entry.conns) do pcall(function() conn:Disconnect() end) end

            local handle = tool:FindFirstChild("Handle")
            if handle then
                local rep = handle:FindFirstChild("LocalReplica")
                if rep then pcall(function() rep:Destroy() end) end
            end

            for obj in pairs(entry.hidden) do
                CT_Trans.release(obj, "custom")
            end
            entry.hidden = {}
            tracked[tool] = nil
        end

        local function tryRegister(inst)
            if not enabled then return end
            if inst:IsA("Tool") and ctMatchItem(inst) then
                setupTool(inst)
            end
        end

        local function unwatch(container)
            local conns = watchers[container]
            if not conns then return end
            for _, c in ipairs(conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
            watchers[container] = nil
        end

        local function watch(container)
            if not container or watchers[container] then return end
            watchers[container] = { container.ChildAdded:Connect(tryRegister) }
            for _, child in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do tryRegister(child) end
        end

        local function watchAll()
            watch(_LP:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack"))
            watch(_LP.Character)
        end

        _LP.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
            if enabled and child:IsA("Backpack") then watch(child) end
        end)

        _LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
            for tool in pairs(tracked) do teardown(tool, false) end
            for _, c in pairs(pendingHandle) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
            table.clear(pendingHandle)
            -- pulizia totale: il vecchio Character e il vecchio Backpack sono morti
            for container in pairs(watchers) do unwatch(container) end
            if not enabled then return end
            watch(char)
            task.defer(function()
                if enabled then watchAll() end
            end)
        end)

        table.insert(CT_JANITORS, function()
            for tool in pairs(tracked) do
                if not tool.Parent then teardown(tool, false) end
            end
            for tool, c in pairs(pendingHandle) do
                if not tool.Parent then
                    pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end)
                    pendingHandle[tool] = nil
                end
            end
            for container in pairs(watchers) do
                if not container.Parent then unwatch(container) end
            end
        end)

        -- ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- WATCHDOG INTEGRITA'
        -- Copre i due bug segnalati:
        --  1) la replica custom sparisce e resta solo l'arma originale
        --     (tool ri-parentato, Handle sostituito, replica distrutta);
        --  2) l'arma originale ricompare sopra la replica
        --     (trasparenza sovrascritta dal gioco -> ri-nascosta).
        -- ------------------------------------------------------------
        local function rebuildIfNeeded(tool, entry, deep)
            local handle = tool:FindFirstChild("Handle")
            if not handle then return end
            local item = ctMatchItem(tool)
            local cat = (item and item.key == "Bat") and "Bat" or "Medusa"
            local rep      = handle:FindFirstChild("LocalReplica")
            local mainPart = rep and rep:FindFirstChild("MainPart")
            local motor    = mainPart and mainPart:FindFirstChildOfClass("Motor6D")
            local broken   = (not rep) or (not mainPart) or (not motor) or motor.Part0 ~= handle
            if broken then
                buildReplica(handle, skinFor(cat))
            end
            -- Ripassata completa solo se la replica era rotta o su richiesta
            if broken or deep then
                for _, d in ipairs(tool:GetDescendants()) do hideNode(entry, d) end
            end
        end

        -- deep = ripassa anche tutti i descendant dei tool (piu' costoso).
        -- Il giro leggero controlla solo che la replica esista: la
        -- trasparenza e' gia' coperta dai guard + sweep di CT_Trans.
        local function integrityPass(deep)
            if not enabled then return end
            -- ri-aggancia i container (Backpack ricreato, respawn, ecc.)
            watchAll()
            local bp = _LP:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
            if bp then for _, ch in ipairs(bp:GetChildren()) do tryRegister(ch) end end
            local chr = _LP.Character
            if chr then for _, ch in ipairs(chr:GetChildren()) do tryRegister(ch) end end
            for tool, entry in pairs(tracked) do
                if not tool.Parent then
                    teardown(tool, false)
                else
                    rebuildIfNeeded(tool, entry, deep)
                end
            end
        end

        _G.AmbitiousCustomToolsRecheck = function() pcall(integrityPass, true) end

        -- Cambio skin: aggiorna la scelta e ricostruisce subito le repliche
        -- gia' agganciate, senza dover spegnere e riaccendere il modulo.
        _G.AmbitiousSetCustomToolSkin = function(cat, key)
            if not ASSETS[key] or ASSETS[key].cat ~= cat then return end
            _G.AmbitiousCustomToolSkins[cat] = key
            for tool, entry in pairs(tracked) do
                if tool.Parent and entry.cat == cat then
                    local handle = tool:FindFirstChild("Handle")
                    if handle then
                        pcall(function()
                            local oldReplica = handle:FindFirstChild("LocalReplica")
                            if oldReplica then oldReplica:Destroy() end
                            buildReplica(handle, key)
                        end)
                    end
                end
            end
            if saveAmbitiousConfig then pcall(saveAmbitiousConfig) end
        end

        task.spawn(function()
            local n = 0
            while true do
                task.wait(0.4)
                if enabled then
                    n = n + 1
                    pcall(integrityPass, (n % 5) == 0)   -- deep ogni 2s
                end
            end
        end)

        -- Riapplica subito quando equipaggi/sganci un'arma, senza aspettare
        -- il giro del watchdog.
        _LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
            task.delay(0.6, function() if enabled then pcall(integrityPass, true) end end)
        end)

        _G.AmbitiousCustomTools = {
            setEnabled = function(on)
                on = on and true or false
                enabled = on
                _G.AmbitiousCustomToolsEnabled = on
                if on then
                    watchAll()
                    pcall(integrityPass, true)
                else
                    for tool in pairs(tracked) do teardown(tool, true) end
                    for _, c in pairs(pendingHandle) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
                    table.clear(pendingHandle)
                    for container in pairs(watchers) do unwatch(container) end
                end
            end,
            isEnabled = function() return enabled end,
        }
    end

    -- ############################################################
    -- ##                    CUSTOM SOUNDS                       ##
    -- ##   Bat -> katana slash      Medusa -> gunshot           ##
    -- ##   Indipendente da Custom Tools: funziona anche da solo ##
    -- ############################################################
    do
        local SOUNDS = {
            Bat    = { id = "rbxassetid://5713085119", skip = 0.2 },
            Medusa = { id = "rbxassetid://3102797479", doublePlay = true, delay = 0.5 },
        }

        -- Un Sound puo' essere agganciato UNA volta sola: senza questo le
        -- connessioni si accumulavano a ogni re-equip (memory leak).
        local hooked = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

        local enabled       = false
        local tracked       = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })  -- [tool] = { sound, data, conns, muted }
        local watchers      = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
        local pendingHandle = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
        local teardown

        local function playCustom(entry)
            local cs = entry.sound
            if not cs or not cs.Parent then return end
            local d = entry.data

            -- cancella un eventuale secondo colpo ancora in coda
            if entry.timer then
                pcall(task.cancel, entry.timer)
                entry.timer = nil
            end

            pcall(function()
                cs:Stop()
                cs.TimePosition = d.skip or 0
                cs.Volume = 1
                cs:Play()
            end)

            if d.doublePlay and d.delay then
                entry.timer = task.delay(d.delay, function()
                    entry.timer = nil
                    if not enabled then return end
                    if cs and cs.Parent then
                        pcall(function()
                            cs:Stop()
                            cs.TimePosition = d.skip or 0
                            cs.Volume = 1
                            cs:Play()
                        end)
                    end
                end)
            end
        end

        -- Silenzia il suono originale e fa partire quello custom
        local function hookSound(entry, snd)
            if not snd:IsA("Sound") then return end
            if snd.Name == "CustomSound" then return end
            if hooked[snd] then return end          -- gia' agganciato: niente doppioni
            if entry.muted[snd] ~= nil then return end

            entry.muted[snd] = snd.Volume
            hooked[snd] = true

            local function trigger()
                if not enabled then return end
                if snd.Playing or snd.TimePosition > 0 then
                    pcall(function()
                        snd.Volume = 0
                        snd:Stop()
                    end)
                    playCustom(entry)
                end
            end

            local c1 = snd:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Playing"):Connect(trigger)
            local c2 = snd:GetPropertyChangedSignal("TimePosition"):Connect(trigger)
            table.insert(entry.conns, c1)
            table.insert(entry.conns, c2)

            -- il Sound viene distrutto: si liberano subito le connessioni
            local c3
            c3 = snd.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
                if parent then return end
                pcall(function() c1:Disconnect() end)
                pcall(function() c2:Disconnect() end)
                pcall(function() c3:Disconnect() end)
                hooked[snd] = nil
                entry.muted[snd] = nil
                if entry.timer then
                    pcall(task.cancel, entry.timer)
                    entry.timer = nil
                end
            end)
            table.insert(entry.conns, c3)

            if snd.Playing then trigger() end
        end

        local function setupTool(tool)
            if tracked[tool] then return end

            local item = ctMatchItem(tool)
            if not item then return end
            local data = SOUNDS[item.key]
            if not data then return end

            local handle = tool:FindFirstChild("Handle")
            if not handle then
                if pendingHandle[tool] then return end
                local c
                c = tool.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
                    if child.Name == "Handle" then
                        pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end)
                        pendingHandle[tool] = nil
                        if enabled then setupTool(tool) end
                    end
                end)
                pendingHandle[tool] = c
                return
            end

            local old = handle:FindFirstChild("CustomSound")
            if old then pcall(function() old:Destroy() end) end

            local cs = Instance.new("Sound")
            cs.Name        = "CustomSound"
            cs.SoundId     = data.id
            cs.Volume      = 1
            cs.Looped      = false
            cs.RollOffMode = Enum.RollOffMode.Inverse
            cs.MaxDistance = 1000
            cs.MinDistance = 1000
            cs.Parent      = handle

            local entry = { sound = cs, data = data, conns = {}, muted = {} }
            tracked[tool] = entry

            for _, d in ipairs(tool:GetDescendants()) do hookSound(entry, d) end

            table.insert(entry.conns, tool.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)
                if tracked[tool] then hookSound(entry, d) end
            end))
            table.insert(entry.conns, tool.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
                if not parent then teardown(tool) end
            end))
        end

        function teardown(tool)
            local entry = tracked[tool]
            if not entry then return end
            if entry.timer then
                pcall(task.cancel, entry.timer)
                entry.timer = nil
            end
            for _, conn in ipairs(entry.conns) do pcall(function() conn:Disconnect() end) end
            if entry.sound then pcall(function() entry.sound:Destroy() end) end
            for snd, vol in pairs(entry.muted) do
                hooked[snd] = nil
                if snd and snd.Parent then pcall(function() snd.Volume = vol end) end
            end
            tracked[tool] = nil
        end

        local function tryRegister(inst)
            if not enabled then return end
            if inst:IsA("Tool") and ctMatchItem(inst) then setupTool(inst) end
        end

        local function unwatch(container)
            local conns = watchers[container]
            if not conns then return end
            for _, c in ipairs(conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
            watchers[container] = nil
        end

        local function watch(container)
            if not container or watchers[container] then return end
            watchers[container] = { container.ChildAdded:Connect(tryRegister) }
            for _, child in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do tryRegister(child) end
        end

        local function watchAll()
            watch(_LP:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack"))
            watch(_LP.Character)
        end

        _LP.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
            if enabled and child:IsA("Backpack") then watch(child) end
        end)

        _LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
            for tool in pairs(tracked) do teardown(tool) end
            for _, c in pairs(pendingHandle) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
            table.clear(pendingHandle)
            for container in pairs(watchers) do unwatch(container) end
            if not enabled then return end
            watch(char)
            task.defer(function()
                if enabled then watchAll() end
            end)
        end)

        table.insert(CT_JANITORS, function()
            for tool in pairs(tracked) do
                if not tool.Parent then teardown(tool) end
            end
            for tool, c in pairs(pendingHandle) do
                if not tool.Parent then
                    pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end)
                    pendingHandle[tool] = nil
                end
            end
            for container in pairs(watchers) do
                if not container.Parent then unwatch(container) end
            end
        end)

        _G.AmbitiousCustomSounds = {
            setEnabled = function(on)
                on = on and true or false
                enabled = on
                _G.AmbitiousCustomSoundsEnabled = on
                if on then
                    watchAll()
                else
                    for tool in pairs(tracked) do teardown(tool) end
                    for _, c in pairs(pendingHandle) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
                    table.clear(pendingHandle)
                    for container in pairs(watchers) do unwatch(container) end
                end
            end,
            isEnabled = function() return enabled end,
        }
    end

    _G.AmbitiousTransparentToolsEnabled = _G.AmbitiousTransparentToolsEnabled == true
    _G.AmbitiousCustomToolsEnabled      = _G.AmbitiousCustomToolsEnabled == true
    _G.AmbitiousCustomSoundsEnabled     = _G.AmbitiousCustomSoundsEnabled == true

    -- Re-apply saved tool features after load (join game / re-execute)
    local function _lonelyReapplyToolFeatures(reason)
        pcall(function()
            if _G.AmbitiousTransparentTools and _G.AmbitiousTransparentTools.setEnabled then
                if _G.AmbitiousTransparentToolsEnabled == true then
                    _G.AmbitiousTransparentTools.setEnabled(true)
                end
            end
            if _G.AmbitiousCustomTools and _G.AmbitiousCustomTools.setEnabled then
                if _G.AmbitiousCustomToolsEnabled == true then
                    _G.AmbitiousCustomTools.setEnabled(true)
                    if _G.AmbitiousCustomToolsRecheck then pcall(_G.AmbitiousCustomToolsRecheck) end
                    if _G.LonelyReapplyBatToolV20 then pcall(_G.LonelyReapplyBatToolV20) end
                end
            end
            if _G.AmbitiousCustomSounds and _G.AmbitiousCustomSounds.setEnabled then
                if _G.AmbitiousCustomSoundsEnabled == true then
                    _G.AmbitiousCustomSounds.setEnabled(true)
                end
            end
            if _G.AmbitiousRainbowJoystickEnabled == true then
                -- joystick module may expose set via toggle only; force flag consumers
                pcall(function()
                    if _G.AmbitiousRainbowJoystick and _G.AmbitiousRainbowJoystick.setEnabled then
                        _G.AmbitiousRainbowJoystick.setEnabled(true)
                    end
                end)
            end
        end)
    end
    _G.LonelyReapplyToolFeatures = _lonelyReapplyToolFeatures
    task.defer(function()
        task.wait(0.35)
        _lonelyReapplyToolFeatures("init")
        task.wait(1.0)
        _lonelyReapplyToolFeatures("init-late")
    end)
    if not _G.__LonelyToolFeaturesRespawn then
        _G.__LonelyToolFeaturesRespawn = true
        LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
            task.delay(0.4, function() _lonelyReapplyToolFeatures("respawn") end)
            task.delay(1.2, function() _lonelyReapplyToolFeatures("respawn-late") end)
        end)
    end
end

local headlessConnections = {}

-- >>> RAINBOW MOBILE JOYSTICK BEGIN
-- ============================================================
-- RAINBOW MOBILE JOYSTICK
-- Colora in arcobaleno il thumbstick e il tasto salto dei controlli touch.
-- Il modulo sta FUORI da __AmbitiousDuelsSetupVisualsUI: quella funzione
-- viene richiamata dal Reset All Settings, e definirlo li' dentro
-- significherebbe registrare un secondo set di connessioni ad ogni reset.
-- ============================================================
_G.AmbitiousRainbowJoystickEnabled = _G.AmbitiousRainbowJoystickEnabled == true
;(function()
  local conns = {}
  local renderConn = nil
  -- [oggetto] = {prop = "ImageColor3" | "BackgroundColor3", orig = Color3}
  -- Il colore originale si tiene da parte alla prima volta che si incontra
  -- l'oggetto: spegnendo il toggle si rimette quello, invece di lasciare
  -- i controlli dell'ultima tinta dell'arcobaleno.
  local targets = {}

  local startRJ, stopRJ

  local function restoreAll()
    for obj, info in pairs(targets) do
      if obj and obj.Parent then
        pcall(function() obj[info.prop] = info.orig end)
      end
    end
    targets = {}
  end

  local function addTarget(obj)
    if targets[obj] then return end
    if obj:IsA("ImageLabel") or obj:IsA("ImageButton") then
      targets[obj] = {prop = "ImageColor3", orig = obj.ImageColor3}
    elseif obj:IsA("Frame") then
      targets[obj] = {prop = "BackgroundColor3", orig = obj.BackgroundColor3}
    end
  end

  local function rescan()
    local touchGui = PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("TouchGui")
    if not touchGui then return end

    for _, v in ipairs(touchGui:GetDescendants()) do
      if v:IsA("ImageLabel") or v:IsA("Frame") then
        local n = v.Name:lower()
        if n:find("thumbstick") or n:find("stick") then addTarget(v) end
      end
    end

    -- Tasto salto: il primo ImageButton dentro TouchControlFrame, con i
    -- suoi figli. Come nell'originale ci si ferma al primo.
    local tcf = touchGui:FindFirstChild("TouchControlFrame")
    if tcf then
      for _, v in ipairs(tcf:GetDescendants()) do
        if v:IsA("ImageButton") then
          addTarget(v)
          for _, d in ipairs(v:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsA("ImageLabel") then addTarget(d) end
          end
          break
        end
      end
    end
  end

  stopRJ = function()
    for _, c in ipairs(conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
    conns = {}
    if renderConn then
      pcall(function() renderConn:Disconnect() end)
      renderConn = nil
    end
    restoreAll()
  end

  startRJ = function()
    stopRJ()
    rescan()

    -- I controlli touch possono comparire dopo (Roblox li crea al primo
    -- tocco) o essere ricostruiti: si riaggancia invece di dare per
    -- scontato che TouchGui esista gia'. Niente WaitForChild con timeout,
    -- che bloccherebbe il toggle per dieci secondi su PC.
    table.insert(conns, PlayerGui.ChildAdded:Connect(function(ch)
      if ch.Name == "TouchGui" and _G.AmbitiousRainbowJoystickEnabled then
        task.wait(0.2)
        if _G.AmbitiousRainbowJoystickEnabled then startRJ() end
      end
    end))

    local touchGui = PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("TouchGui")
    if touchGui then
      table.insert(conns, touchGui.DescendantAdded:Connect(function()
        task.wait(0.2)
        if _G.AmbitiousRainbowJoystickEnabled then rescan() end
      end))
    end

    renderConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
      local t = tick() * 2
      local color = Color3.new(
        math.sin(t) * 0.5 + 0.5,
        math.sin(t + 2) * 0.5 + 0.5,
        math.sin(t + 4) * 0.5 + 0.5
      )
      for obj, info in pairs(targets) do
        if obj and obj.Parent then
          obj[info.prop] = color
        else
          -- oggetto distrutto: si toglie dalla lista invece di ritentare
          -- di colorarlo sessanta volte al secondo
          targets[obj] = nil
        end
      end
    end)
  end

  function _G.AmbitiousSetRainbowJoystick(on)
    on = on and true or false
    _G.AmbitiousRainbowJoystickEnabled = on
    if on then startRJ() else stopRJ() end
  end
end)()

-- Applica lo stato letto dal config (loadAmbitiousConfig gira prima di qui).
if _G.AmbitiousRainbowJoystickEnabled then
  pcall(_G.AmbitiousSetRainbowJoystick, true)
end
-- <<< RAINBOW MOBILE JOYSTICK END

-- V11 Ambitious Medusa-hit timestamp watcher used by Synchronize After Hit.
_G._AmbitiousMedusaHitTime = _G._AmbitiousMedusaHitTime or 0
do
  local conns = _G._LonelyMedusaWatcherConns or {}
  local function clear() for _,c in ipairs(conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end; table.clear(conns) end
  local function hookPart(part)
    if not part:IsA("BasePart") then return end
    table.insert(conns, part:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Anchored"):Connect(function()
      if part.Anchored and part.Transparency == 1 then _G._AmbitiousMedusaHitTime=tick() end
    end))
  end
  local function attach(char)
    clear(); _G._AmbitiousMedusaHitTime=0
    if not char then return end
    for _,p in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do hookPart(p) end
    table.insert(conns,char.DescendantAdded:Connect(hookPart))
  end
  _G._LonelyMedusaWatcherConns=conns
  if LP.Character then attach(LP.Character) end
  if not _G._LonelyMedusaCharConn then
    _G._LonelyMedusaCharConn=LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(c) task.wait(0.1); attach(c) end)
  end
end

-- [V16] Kick Warning removed completely.

-- FINAL LONELY / AMBITIOUS UI + INPUT REPAIR
-- ============================================================================
do
    -- ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 1) Hide Button Mobile: Ambitious-style global row + V dropdown.
    -- ON  = hide + pause the selected button's feature/input.
    -- OFF = show + resume the feature if it was active before hiding.
    -- The list is rebuilt from the actual mobile button table.
    -- ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    task.defer(function()
        task.wait(2.4)
        pcall(function()
            local settings = pages and (pages.SETTINGS or pages.Settings)
            if not settings then return end

            for _, name in ipairs({
                "Hide Button Mobile Ambitious",
                "LonelyHideButtonsRow",
                "Hide MB Expand",
                "LonelyHideList"
            }) do
                local old = settings:FindFirstChild(name)
                if old then old:Destroy() end
            end

            _G.AdaptMobileButtonHiddenKeys = _G.AdaptMobileButtonHiddenKeys or {}
            _G.AdaptPerButtonHidden = _G.AdaptPerButtonHidden or {}

            local wrap = Instance.new("Frame")
            wrap.Name = "Hide Button Mobile Ambitious"
            wrap.BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.row
            wrap.BackgroundTransparency = 0.22
            wrap.Size = UDim2.new(1,-4,0,42)
            wrap.BorderSizePixel = 0
            wrap.LayoutOrder = 11
            wrap.ClipsDescendants = true
            wrap.Parent = settings
            corner(wrap,9)
            stroke(wrap,COLORS.strokeSoft,1.15,.35)

            local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
            title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            title.Text = "Hide Button Mobile"
            title.TextColor3 = COLORS.white
            title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
            title.TextSize = 12
            title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
            title.Position = UDim2.new(0,12,0,0)
            title.Size = UDim2.new(1,-58,0,42)
            title.Parent = wrap

            local arrow = Instance.new("TextButton")
            arrow.Name = "HideMobileArrow"
            arrow.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(8,8,12)
            arrow.BackgroundTransparency = .18
            arrow.BorderSizePixel = 0
            arrow.Text = "V"
            arrow.TextColor3 = COLORS.white
            arrow.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
            arrow.TextSize = 15
            arrow.AutoButtonColor = false
            arrow.Size = UDim2.new(0,38,0,26)
            arrow.Position = UDim2.new(1,-48,.5,-13)
            arrow.ZIndex = 10
            arrow.Parent = wrap
            corner(arrow,7)
            stroke(arrow,COLORS.strokeSoft,1,.35)

            local list = Instance.new("Frame")
            list.Name = "HideMobileOptions"
            list.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            list.Size = UDim2.new(1,-8,0,0)
            list.Position = UDim2.new(0,4,0,42)
            list.Parent = wrap
            local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
            layout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
            layout.Padding = UDim.new(0,5)
            layout.Parent = list

            local expanded = false

            local function entries()
                local out = {}
                for key, entry in pairs(_G.AdaptMobileButtonRefs or {}) do
                    if type(entry) == "table" and entry.holder and entry.holder.Parent and entry.btn then
                        out[#out+1] = {key=tostring(key), entry=entry}
                    end
                end
                table.sort(out,function(a,b) return a.key:lower() < b.key:lower() end)
                return out
            end

            local function labelFor(key, entry)
                local txt = tostring(entry.btn.Text or "")
                    :gsub("\n"," ")
                    :gsub("%s+"," ")
                    :gsub("^%s+","")
                    :gsub("%s+$","")
                if txt ~= "" then return txt end
                return key:gsub("([a-z])([A-Z])","%1 %2"):upper()
            end

            local function paintRow(row, key)
                local hidden = _G.AdaptMobileButtonHiddenKeys[key] == true
                    or _G.AdaptPerButtonHidden[key] == true
                local state = row:FindFirstChild("State")
                local track = row:FindFirstChild("Track")
                local knob = track and track:FindFirstChild("Knob")
                if state then state.Text = hidden and "ON" or "OFF" end
                if track then
                    track.BackgroundColor3 = hidden and Color3.fromRGB(147,51,234) or Color3.fromRGB(50,50,56)
                end
                if knob then
                    knob.Position = hidden
                        and UDim2.new(1,-19,.5,-8)
                        or UDim2.new(0,3,.5,-8)
                end
            end

            local function rebuild()
                for _, c in ipairs(list:GetChildren()) do
                    if not c:IsA("UIListLayout") then c:Destroy() end
                end

                local es = entries()
                for i, item in ipairs(es) do
                    local key, entry = item.key, item.entry

                    local row = Instance.new("Frame")
                    row.Name = "HideOpt_" .. key
                    row.BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.row
                    row.BackgroundTransparency = .30
                    row.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,36)
                    row.LayoutOrder = i
                    row.BorderSizePixel = 0
                    row.Parent = list
                    corner(row,9)
                    stroke(row,COLORS.strokeSoft,1.1,.38)

                    local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
                    label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                    label.Text = labelFor(key,entry)
                    label.TextColor3 = COLORS.white
                    label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamSemibold
                    label.TextSize = 10
                    label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
                    label.Position = UDim2.new(0,10,0,0)
                    label.Size = UDim2.new(1,-115,1,0)
                    label.Parent = row

                    local state = Instance.new("TextLabel")
                    state.Name = "State"
                    state.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                    state.TextColor3 = COLORS.white
                    state.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
                    state.TextSize = 9
                    state.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
                    state.Size = UDim2.new(0,35,1,0)
                    state.Position = UDim2.new(1,-96,0,0)
                    state.Parent = row

                    local track = Instance.new("TextButton")
                    track.Name = "Track"
                    track.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50,50,56)
                    track.BorderSizePixel = 0
                    track.Text = ""
                    track.AutoButtonColor = false
                    track.Size = UDim2.new(0,44,0,22)
                    track.Position = UDim2.new(1,-52,.5,-11)
                    track.Parent = row
                    corner(track,11)
                    local knob = Instance.new("Frame")
                    knob.Name = "Knob"
                    knob.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
                    knob.BorderSizePixel = 0
                    knob.Size = UDim2.new(0,16,0,16)
                    knob.Parent = track
                    corner(knob,999)

                    paintRow(row,key)
                    track.Activated:Connect(function()
                        local hidden = not (
                            _G.AdaptMobileButtonHiddenKeys[key] == true
                            or _G.AdaptPerButtonHidden[key] == true
                        )
                        _G.LonelySetButtonHidden(key, hidden)
                        paintRow(row,key)
                        if saveAdaptConfig then pcall(saveAdaptConfig) end
                    end)
                end

                if expanded then
                    local h = #es * 41 + 8
                    list.Size = UDim2.new(1,-8,0,h)
                    wrap.Size = UDim2.new(1,-4,0,42+h+4)
                end
            end

            arrow.Activated:Connect(function()
                expanded = not expanded

                -- Same visual as Aimbot/Bat Aim: V <-> ^ with smooth rotation.
                arrow.Text = "V"
                TS:Create(
                    arrow,
                    TweenInfo.new(0.16, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                    {Rotation = expanded and 180 or 0}
                ):Play()

                -- Bat Aim-style open/close tween; the arrow itself never moves.
                rebuild()
                local h = expanded and (#entries() * 41 + 8) or 0
                TS:Create(
                    list,
                    TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                    {Size = UDim2.new(1,-8,0,h)}
                ):Play()
                TS:Create(
                    wrap,
                    TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                    {Size = UDim2.new(1,-4,0,expanded and (42+h+4) or 42)}
                ):Play()
            end)

            rebuild()
            pcall(_G.LonelyApplyPerButtonHide)
        end)
    end)

    -- ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 2) ESP Tracker: direct toggle only.
    -- No V expander and no color picker. Tracker follows VX7 BLACK/PINK.
    -- ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    task.defer(function()
        task.wait(2.5)
        pcall(function()
            local utility = pages and (pages.VISUALS or pages.Visuals or pages.UTILITY or pages.Utility)
            if not utility then return end

            local old = utility:FindFirstChild("ESP Tracker Options")
            if old then old:Destroy() end
            local oldArrow = utility:FindFirstChild("ESPTrackerArrow")
            if oldArrow then oldArrow:Destroy() end

            local trackerOn = BoxedESPOptions and BoxedESPOptions.tracker == true or false
            local trackerRow, setTracker = toggleRow(utility,"Show Tracker",trackerOn,(utility:FindFirstChild("ESP") and ((utility:FindFirstChild("ESP").LayoutOrder or 2)+0.1)) or 2.1)
            local tbtn = trackerRow and trackerRow:FindFirstChild("ToggleButton")
            local function applyTrackerTheme()
                if not BoxedESPOptions then BoxedESPOptions = {} end
                local p = VX7_FULL_PALETTES and VX7_FULL_PALETTES[_G.AdaptThemeName or "BLACK_PINK"]
                BoxedESPOptions.trackerColor = (p and p.accent) or Color3.fromRGB(255,80,175)
                for _, data in pairs(BoxedESPData or {}) do
                    if data.tracker then pcall(function() data.tracker.Color = BoxedESPOptions.trackerColor end) end
                    if data.box then pcall(function() data.box.Color = BoxedESPOptions.trackerColor end) end
                end
            end
            applyTrackerTheme()
            if tbtn then
                tbtn.Activated:Connect(function()
                    trackerOn = not trackerOn
                    if BoxedESPOptions then BoxedESPOptions.tracker = trackerOn end
                    applyTrackerTheme()
                    if refreshBoxedESP then pcall(refreshBoxedESP) end
                    if setTracker then setTracker(trackerOn) end
                    if saveAdaptConfig then pcall(saveAdaptConfig) end
                end)
            end
            if setTracker then setTracker(trackerOn) end
        end)
    end)

    -- ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 4) Anti Anti TP: force an immediate state change on the external button.
    -- Do not wait for watchdog/UI refresh to determine whether it turned off.
    -- ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    task.defer(function()
        task.wait(1.0)
        pcall(function()
            local e = (_G.AdaptMobileButtonRefs or {}).antiAntiTP
            if not e or type(e.onPress) ~= "function" then return end
            local pressBusy = false
            e.onPress = function(btn)
                if pressBusy then return end
                pressBusy = true
                local api = _G.AdaptAntiTPBat
                local currentlyOn = _G.AdaptAntiTPBatEnabled == true
                if api and api.setEnabled then
                    pcall(api.setEnabled, not currentlyOn, true)
                elseif _G.AdaptToggleAntiTPBat then
                    pcall(_G.AdaptToggleAntiTPBat)
                else
                    _G.AdaptAntiTPBatEnabled = not currentlyOn
                end
                if btn then
                    if e.setActive then pcall(e.setActive, _G.AdaptAntiTPBatEnabled == true) end
                end
                if _G._AdaptAntiTPBatRefreshUI then pcall(_G._AdaptAntiTPBatRefreshUI) end
                if saveAdaptConfig then pcall(saveAdaptConfig) end
            end
        end)
    end)

    -- ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 5) Hide pause coverage: every external button gets paused when hidden.
    -- Existing keyboard + controller listeners already call
    -- LonelyIsMobileButtonPaused before firing.
    -- ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    _G.LonelyMobileButtonPaused = _G.LonelyMobileButtonPaused or {}
    _G.LonelyMobileButtonResume = _G.LonelyMobileButtonResume or {}
    local oldPause = _G.LonelyPauseMobileButton
    local oldResume = _G.LonelyResumeMobileButton
    _G.LonelyPauseMobileButton = function(key)
        key = tostring(key)
        if oldPause then pcall(oldPause,key) end
        -- One-shot buttons have no persistent loop; they are still blocked by
        -- the paused flag and therefore cannot be fired by keyboard/controller.
        _G.LonelyMobileButtonPaused[key] = true
    end
    _G.LonelyResumeMobileButton = function(key)
        key = tostring(key)
        if oldResume then pcall(oldResume,key) end
        _G.LonelyMobileButtonPaused[key] = nil
    end

    -- ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 6) Ensure existing Ambitious-style enemy ragdoll countdown is running
    -- whenever the feature is enabled. It already uses the 2.6s timer and
    -- BallSocketConstraint watcher; this bridge only fixes startup/load.
    -- ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    task.defer(function()
        task.wait(1.0)
        pcall(function()
            if ragdollCountdownEnabled and _G.LonelyHookRagdollCountdown then
                _G.LonelyHookRagdollCountdown(LP.Character)
            end
        end)
    end)

-- ===== MODE V ALIGNMENT / HITBOX NORMALIZER =====
do
  task.defer(function()
    task.wait()
    pcall(function()
      local combat = pages and pages.COMBAT
      if not combat then return end
      local names = {"Auto Steal", "Aimbot", "TP Bat"}
      for _, name in ipairs(names) do
        local row = combat:FindFirstChild(name)
        if row then
          local b = row:FindFirstChild("ArrowButton") or row:FindFirstChild("TPBatArrow")
          if b and b:IsA("GuiObject") then
            b.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0,0)
            b.Size = UDim2.new(0,38,0,26)
            b.Position = UDim2.new(1,-100,0.5,-13)
            b.Text = "V"
            b.ZIndex = 30
          end
        end
      end
    end)
  end)
end

      local TOOL_SKIN_WHITELIST = {
        DiamondSword = true,

        GoldenDesertEagle = true,
      }
      for key, def in pairs(_G.AmbitiousCustomToolAssets or {}) do
        if TOOL_SKIN_WHITELIST[key] then
          cards[#cards + 1] = buildCard(def, key, #cards + 1)
        end
      end

      -- Rotazione continua delle anteprime
      spinConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
        for _, e in ipairs(cards) do
          if e.card.Visible and e.part.Parent then
            e.part.CFrame = e.part.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, dt * 1.2, 0)

      ctGui.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
        if not parent and spinConn then
          pcall(function() spinConn:Disconnect() end)
          spinConn = nil

      -- ---------- cambio sezione con scorrimento ----------
      local current = "Bat"

      -- La larghezza si prende dalla misura NOTA del popup, non da
      -- AbsoluteSize: quando il layout gira il riquadro sta ancora crescendo
      -- dall'animazione di apertura e AbsoluteSize e' praticamente zero.
      -- Era per quello che le card finivano incollate a sinistra col bordo
      -- tagliato e lo spazio a destra vuoto.
      local PAGE_W = 420 - 24
      local GAP = 14
      -- Margine interno. Lo UIStroke e' disegnato FUORI dal bordo della card
      -- e la pagina ha ClipsDescendants: se le card arrivavano a filo, la
      -- cornice della prima e dell'ultima veniva tagliata. In piu' l'hover
      -- allarga la card di 6px, che devono avere dove andare.
      local INSET = 9
      -- Le card si dividono tutta la larghezza disponibile: con due riempiono
      -- la riga, con una sola occupa tutto. Quando aggiungeremo altre skin
      -- basta cambiare questa formula (o passare a una griglia su piu' righe).
      local function layoutCat(cat, fromRight, animate)
        local list = {}
        for _, e in ipairs(cards) do
          if e.cat == cat then list[#list + 1] = e end
        end
        local n = #list
        if n == 0 then return list end
        local cardW = math.floor((PAGE_W - INSET * 2 - GAP * (n - 1)) / n)
        for i, e in ipairs(list) do
          local targetX = INSET + (i - 1) * (cardW + GAP)
          e.card.Size = UDim2.new(0, cardW, 0, 172)
          e.baseW = cardW
          e.baseX = targetX
          e.card.Visible = true
          if animate then
            e.card.Position = UDim2.new(0, targetX + (fromRight and 300 or -300), 0, 10)
            tween(e.card, {Position = UDim2.new(0, targetX, 0, 10)}, 0.24)
          else
            e.card.Position = UDim2.new(0, targetX, 0, 10)
          end
        end
        return list
      end

      local switchToken = 0
      local function setCat(cat, animate)
        if cat == current and animate then return end
        local goingRight = (cat == "Medusa")
        switchToken = switchToken + 1
        local myToken = switchToken

        local outList = {}
        for _, e in ipairs(cards) do
          if e.cat ~= cat and e.card.Visible then outList[#outList + 1] = e end
        end

        current = cat

        if animate then
          -- Le card che escono vengono nascoste NON appena sono fuori dal
          -- riquadro, non a fine animazione: prima restavano visibili per
          -- tutta la durata dello scorrimento e si vedeva la Katana ferma
          -- mentre gia' entrava la sezione Medusa.
          for _, e in ipairs(outList) do
            local x = e.card.Position.X.Offset
            tween(e.card, {Position = UDim2.new(0, x + (goingRight and -300 or 300), 0, 10)}, 0.18)
          end
          task.delay(0.14, function()
            if myToken ~= switchToken then return end
            for _, e in ipairs(outList) do
              if e.card.Parent then e.card.Visible = false end
            end
          end)
        else
          for _, e in ipairs(outList) do e.card.Visible = false end
        end

        layoutCat(cat, goingRight, animate)
        -- slide + etichette
        local idx = (cat == "Bat") and 1 or 2
        tween(slide, {Position = UDim2.new(0.25 + 0.5 * (idx - 1), 0, 0.5, 0)}, 0.2)
        for i, lbl in ipairs(catLabels) do
          -- sulla meta' chiara il testo va scuro, sull'altra resta chiaro
          tween(lbl, {
            TextColor3 = (i == idx) and Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 28) or Color3.fromRGB(225, 225, 235),
            TextTransparency = (i == idx) and 0 or 0.35,
          }, 0.16)
        end
      end

      for i, c in ipairs(CATS) do
        local clickTab = Instance.new("TextButton")
        clickTab.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        clickTab.Text = ""
        clickTab.AutoButtonColor = false
        clickTab.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
        clickTab.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 0)
        clickTab.Position = UDim2.new(0.25 + 0.5 * (i - 1), 0, 0.5, 0)
        clickTab.ZIndex = 8
        clickTab.Parent = tabsHolder
        local key = c.key
        clickTab.Activated:Connect(function() setCat(key, true) end)
      end

      backdrop.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
           or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
          closeCTPicker()
        end
      end)

      -- stato iniziale, senza animazione
      task.defer(function()
        for _, e in ipairs(cards) do e.card.Visible = false end
        setCat("Bat", false)
      end)

      frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
      frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
      TweenService:Create(frame, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
        Size = UDim2.new(0, 420, 0, 470),
        Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -210, 0.5, -235)
      }):Play()
    end)
  end
  -- <<< CUSTOM TOOLS + SELETTORE SKIN END

  do
    local rowTT, setVisualTT = toggleRow(Utility, "Transparent Tools", _G.AmbitiousTransparentToolsEnabled == true, 12)
    local btn = rowTT and rowTT:FindFirstChild("ToggleButton")
    if btn then
      btn.Activated:Connect(function()
        local on = not (_G.AmbitiousTransparentToolsEnabled == true)
        if _G.AmbitiousTransparentTools then _G.AmbitiousTransparentTools.setEnabled(on) end
        if setVisualTT then setVisualTT(on) end
        pcall(function()
          if saveAdaptConfig then saveAdaptConfig() end
          if saveAmbitiousConfig then saveAmbitiousConfig() end
        end)
      end)
    end
  end

  do
    local rowCS, setVisualCS = toggleRow(Utility, "Custom Sounds", _G.AmbitiousCustomSoundsEnabled == true, 16)
    local btn = rowCS and rowCS:FindFirstChild("ToggleButton")
    if btn then
      btn.Activated:Connect(function()
        local on = not (_G.AmbitiousCustomSoundsEnabled == true)
        if _G.AmbitiousCustomSounds then _G.AmbitiousCustomSounds.setEnabled(on) end
        if setVisualCS then setVisualCS(on) end
        pcall(function()
          if saveAdaptConfig then saveAdaptConfig() end
          if saveAmbitiousConfig then saveAmbitiousConfig() end
        end)
      end)
    end
  end

  end -- Custom Tools guard

  -- Final visibility pass: this runs after every Tools object has been
  -- constructed, so the Visuals tab contains the actual controls and not
  -- just the engine.
  task.defer(function()
      task.wait()
      pcall(function()
          local names = {
              {"TOOLS",12},
              {"Custom Tools",13},
              {"Custom Tools Selector",13.1},
              {"Transparent Tools",15},
              {"Custom Sounds",16},
              {"RAINBOW MOBILE JOYSTICK",17},
              {"Rainbow Mobile Joystick",18},
          }
          for _,it in ipairs(names) do
              local o=Utility:FindFirstChild(it[1])
              if o then
                  o.Visible=true
                  o.LayoutOrder=it[2]
              end
          end
          local sel=Utility:FindFirstChild("Custom Tools Selector")
          if sel then
              sel.Visible=false
              sel.Size=UDim2.new(1,-4,0,0)
          end
      end)
  end)

-- >>> STRETCH REZ: toggle + tendina BEGIN

-- ===== MOTION BLUR =====
do
    local function _startMotionBlur()
        if _motionBlurConn then pcall(function() _motionBlurConn:Disconnect() end); _motionBlurConn = nil end
        -- Crea o recupera il BlurEffect in Lighting
        if not _motionBlurEffect or not _motionBlurEffect.Parent then
            _motionBlurEffect = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("BlurEffect")
            if not _motionBlurEffect then
                _motionBlurEffect = Instance.new("BlurEffect")
                _motionBlurEffect.Name = "AmbitiousMotionBlur"
            end
        end
        _motionBlurEffect.Size = 0
        _motionBlurEffect.Enabled = true
        _motionBlurEffect.Parent = Lighting
        local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
        local lastCFrame = camera.CFrame
        _motionBlurCurrentValue = 0
        _motionBlurConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(deltaTime)
            if not motionBlurEnabled then
                if _motionBlurConn then pcall(function() _motionBlurConn:Disconnect() end); _motionBlurConn = nil end
                if _motionBlurEffect and _motionBlurEffect.Parent then
                    _motionBlurEffect.Size = 0
                    _motionBlurEffect.Enabled = false
                end
                return
            end
            local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
            if not cam then return end
            local currentCF = cam.CFrame
            local dot = currentCF.LookVector:Dot(lastCFrame.LookVector)
            local angleRad = math.acos(math.clamp(dot, -1, 1))
            local angleDeg = math.deg(angleRad)
            local speed = angleDeg * 20
            local targetBlur = math.min(speed, 7)
            _motionBlurCurrentValue = _motionBlurCurrentValue + (targetBlur - _motionBlurCurrentValue) * math.min(1, deltaTime * 10)
            if _motionBlurEffect and _motionBlurEffect.Parent then
                _motionBlurEffect.Size = _motionBlurCurrentValue
            end
            lastCFrame = currentCF
        end)
    end

    local function _stopMotionBlur()
        if _motionBlurConn then pcall(function() _motionBlurConn:Disconnect() end); _motionBlurConn = nil end
        if _motionBlurEffect and _motionBlurEffect.Parent then
            _motionBlurEffect.Size = 0
            _motionBlurEffect.Enabled = false
        end
        _motionBlurCurrentValue = 0
    end

    _G.LonelyStartMotionBlur = _startMotionBlur
    _G.LonelyStopMotionBlur = _stopMotionBlur

    local row, setVisual = toggleRow(Utility, "Motion Blur", motionBlurEnabled, 15)
    local _mblurBtn = row and row:FindFirstChild("ToggleButton")
    if _mblurBtn then
        _mblurBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
            motionBlurEnabled = not motionBlurEnabled
            if motionBlurEnabled then
                _startMotionBlur()
            else
                _stopMotionBlur()
            end
            if setVisual then setVisual(motionBlurEnabled) end
            saveAmbitiousConfig()
        end)
    end

    -- Ripristina lo stato al load
    if motionBlurEnabled then
        _startMotionBlur()
    end
end

    end
end
