        pick.AutoButtonColor = false
        pick.Parent = colorRow
        corner(pick,14)
        stroke(pick,Color3.fromRGB(216,180,254),1.2,.15)

        local function applyTrackerColor(c)
            if not c then return end
            if not BoxedESPOptions then BoxedESPOptions = {} end
            BoxedESPOptions.trackerColor = c
            preview.BackgroundColor3 = c
            for _,data in pairs(BoxedESPData or {}) do
                if data.tracker then pcall(function() data.tracker.Color = c end) end
                if data.box then pcall(function() data.box.Color = c end) end
            end
            if refreshBoxedESP then pcall(refreshBoxedESP) end
            if saveAdaptConfig then pcall(saveAdaptConfig) end
        end

        -- Use Ambitious' existing picker when available; otherwise provide a small palette.
        pick.Activated:Connect(function()
            if _G._AmbitiousBuildColorPickerRow then
                -- The full picker may already exist; open a simple local palette below instead
                -- so the control is guaranteed to react even if the legacy picker was hidden.
            end
            local old = PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("LonelyTrackerColorPickerV9")
            if old then old:Destroy(); return end
            local sg = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
            sg.Name = "LonelyTrackerColorPickerV9"
            sg.ResetOnSpawn = false
            sg.IgnoreGuiInset = true
            sg.DisplayOrder = 10000
            safeParentGui(sg)
            local shade = Instance.new("TextButton")
            shade.Text = ""
            shade.AutoButtonColor = false
            shade.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0,0,0)
            shade.BackgroundTransparency = .45
            shade.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
            shade.Parent = sg
            local panel = Instance.new("Frame")
            panel.Size = UDim2.new(0,300,0,210)
            panel.Position = UDim2.new(.5,-150,.5,-105)
            panel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(10,10,12)
            panel.BorderSizePixel = 0
            panel.Parent = sg
            corner(panel,14)
            stroke(panel,Color3.fromRGB(90,90,105),1.2,.3)
            local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
            title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            title.Text = "TRACKER COLOR"
            title.TextColor3 = COLORS.white
            title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
            title.TextSize = 15
            title.Position = UDim2.new(0,14,0,8)
            title.Size = UDim2.new(1,-28,0,28)
            title.Parent = panel
            local colors = {
                {"White",Color3.fromRGB(235,235,235)},
                {"Gray",Color3.fromRGB(160,160,160)},
                {"Red",Color3.fromRGB(255,80,80)},
                {"Green",Color3.fromRGB(90,255,130)},
                {"Blue",Color3.fromRGB(90,150,255)},
                {"Yellow",Color3.fromRGB(255,225,90)},
                {"Purple",Color3.fromRGB(190,100,255)},
                {"Cyan",Color3.fromRGB(80,235,255)}
            }
            for i,item in ipairs(colors) do
                local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
                b.Text = item[1]
                b.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(245,245,245)
                b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
                b.TextSize = 11
                b.BackgroundColor3 = item[2]
                b.BorderSizePixel = 0
                local col = (i-1)%4
                local row = math.floor((i-1)/4)
                b.Size = UDim2.new(0,64,0,44)
                b.Position = UDim2.new(0,12+col*70,0,48+row*52)
                b.Parent = panel
                corner(b,9)
                b.Activated:Connect(function()
                    applyTrackerColor(item[2])
                    sg:Destroy()
                end)
            end
            shade.Activated:Connect(function() sg:Destroy() end)
        end)
    end)
end)

-- Mobile buttons: when pressed/active, use the same bright gray-white as the
-- Lonely steal bar fill (235,235,235), with dark text for contrast.
task.spawn(function()
    while task.wait(0.05) do
        pcall(function()
            if not mobileButtons then return end
            for _,entry in pairs(mobileButtons) do
                local btn = entry and entry.btn
                if btn and btn.Parent then
                    local pressed = btn:GetAttribute("AdaptMobilePressed") == true
                    if pressed then
                        local bg = btn:FindFirstChild("ButtonNoneBackground")
                        if bg then
                            bg.BackgroundTransparency = 0
                            bg.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(235,235,235)
                        end
                        local text = btn:FindFirstChild("MobileButtonText")
                        if text then text.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(70,70,75) end
                        local strokeObj = btn:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
                        if strokeObj then
                            strokeObj.Color = Color3.fromRGB(235,235,235)
                            strokeObj.Transparency = 0.05
                            strokeObj.Thickness = 1.6
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
    end
end)

print("[Lonely v9] ESP V/Tracker Color repaired + mobile pressed color synced to steal bar gray-white")


-- ============================================================================
-- FINAL V10 REPAIR
-- - Restores the missing Ambitious expand/collapse helper.
-- - Repairs Custom Tools V so it always responds.
-- - Repairs Hide Button Mobile with a real global ON/OFF switch while collapsed.
-- - Removes Stretch Rez/FOV/FOV Value UI content.
-- - Kick Warning: only reacts to an active steal + WalkSpeed < 25.
-- - Keeps the existing E01 steal-result warning untouched.
-- ============================================================================

do
    -- ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 1) THE ROOT CAUSE OF THE BROKEN "V" BUTTONS:
    -- v9 calls _G._AmbitiousExpand(...) in several places, but the helper is
    -- missing from the final merged file. Define it once before user input.
    -- ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    _G._AmbitiousExpand = function(holder, expanded, openHeight, arrow)
        if not holder or not holder.Parent then return end
        openHeight = tonumber(openHeight) or 42

        local targetSize = expanded
            and UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, openHeight)
            or UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 0)

        if expanded then
            holder.Visible = true
        end

        pcall(function()
            if tween then
                tween(holder, {Size = targetSize}, 0.18)
            else
                holder.Size = targetSize
            end
        end)

        if arrow and arrow.Parent then
            pcall(function()
                arrow.Text = "V"
                if tween then
                    tween(arrow, {Rotation = expanded and 180 or 0}, 0.16)
                else
                    arrow.Rotation = expanded and 180 or 0
                end
            end)
        end

        if not expanded then
            task.delay(0.19, function()
                if holder and holder.Parent and not holder:GetAttribute("AmbitiousExpanded") then
                    holder.Visible = false
                end
            end)
        end

        pcall(function()
            holder:SetAttribute("AmbitiousExpanded", expanded == true)
        end)
    end

    -- ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 2) CUSTOM TOOLS: replace the broken V with a direct, independent handler.
    -- This does not touch the Custom Tools engine or PICK popup.
    -- ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    task.defer(function()
        task.wait(2.7)
        pcall(function()
            local utility = pages and (pages.VISUALS or pages.Visuals or pages.UTILITY or pages.Utility)
            if not utility then return end

            local row = utility:FindFirstChild("Custom Tools")
            local holder = utility:FindFirstChild("Custom Tools Selector")
            if not row or not holder then return end

            local old = row:FindFirstChild("CustomToolsArrow")
            if old then old:Destroy() end

            holder.Visible = false
            holder.Size = UDim2.new(1,-4,0,0)
            holder:SetAttribute("AmbitiousExpanded", false)

            local arrow = Instance.new("TextButton")
            arrow.Name = "CustomToolsArrow"
            arrow.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(8,8,12)
            arrow.BackgroundTransparency = .18
            arrow.BorderSizePixel = 0
            arrow.Text = "V"
            arrow.TextColor3 = COLORS.white
            arrow.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
            arrow.TextSize = 13
            arrow.AutoButtonColor = false
            arrow.Size = UDim2.new(0,38,0,26)
            arrow.Position = UDim2.new(1,-100,.5,-13)
            arrow.ZIndex = 50
            arrow.Parent = row
            corner(arrow,7)
            stroke(arrow,COLORS.strokeSoft,1.1,.30)

            local expanded = false
            local busy = false

            local function setExpanded(on)
                expanded = on == true
                holder:SetAttribute("AmbitiousExpanded", expanded)
                holder.Visible = true
                holder.Size = expanded
                    and UDim2.new(1,-4,0,42)
                    or UDim2.new(1,-4,0,0)
                arrow.Text = "V"
                if expanded then
                    arrow.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35,35,42)
                else
                    arrow.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(8,8,12)
                end
                if not expanded then
                    task.delay(.19,function()
                        if not expanded and holder and holder.Parent then
                            holder.Visible=false
                        end
                    end)
                end
            end

            arrow.Activated:Connect(function()
                if busy then return end
                busy = true
                setExpanded(not expanded)
                task.delay(.22,function() busy=false end)
            end)

            -- Also make the row itself safe to tap near the arrow on mobile.
            arrow.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
                if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                    pcall(function() arrow.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(235,235,235) end)
                    pcall(function() arrow.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(70,70,75) end)
                end
            end)
            arrow.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
                if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                    pcall(function() arrow.BackgroundColor3=expanded and Color3.fromRGB(35,35,42) or Color3.fromRGB(8,8,12) end)
                    pcall(function() arrow.TextColor3=COLORS.white end)
                end
            end)

            setExpanded(false)
        end)
    end)

    -- ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 3) REMOVE THE CAMERA/FOV CONTENT requested by the user.
    -- Keep the underlying functions harmlessly intact for compatibility, but
    -- do not display Stretch Rez, FOV, FOV Value or the empty CAMERA header.
    -- ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    task.defer(function()
        task.wait(2.8)
        pcall(function()
            local utility = pages and (pages.VISUALS or pages.Visuals or pages.UTILITY or pages.Utility)
            if not utility then return end

            local names = {
                "Stretch Rez",
                "Stretch Res",
                "Stretch Rez Options",
                "FOV",
                "FOV Change",
                "FOV Value",
                "FOV Value Holder",
                "CAMERA"
            }
            for _, name in ipairs(names) do
                local obj = utility:FindFirstChild(name)
                if obj then obj:Destroy() end
            end
        end)
    end)

    -- ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 4) HIDE BUTTON MOBILE:
    -- collapsed state now has a real global ON/OFF switch.
    -- V remains the per-button list expander.
    -- ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    task.defer(function()
        task.wait(3.0)
        pcall(function()
            local settings = pages and (pages.SETTINGS or pages.Settings)
            if not settings then return end

            local wrap = settings:FindFirstChild("Hide Button Mobile Ambitious")
            if not wrap then return end

            local oldGlobal = wrap:FindFirstChild("GlobalHideToggle")
            if oldGlobal then oldGlobal:Destroy() end

            local oldArrow = wrap:FindFirstChild("HideMobileArrow")
            if oldArrow then
                oldArrow.Position = UDim2.new(1,-48,.5,-13)
            end

            local toggle = Instance.new("TextButton")
            toggle.Name = "GlobalHideToggle"
            toggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50,50,56)
            toggle.BorderSizePixel = 0
            toggle.Text = ""
            toggle.AutoButtonColor = false
            toggle.Size = UDim2.new(0,44,0,22)
            toggle.Position = UDim2.new(1,-96,.5,-11)
            toggle.ZIndex = 20
            toggle.Parent = wrap
            corner(toggle,11)

            local knob = Instance.new("Frame")
            knob.Name = "Knob"
            knob.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
            knob.BorderSizePixel = 0
            knob.Size = UDim2.new(0,16,0,16)
            knob.Parent = toggle
            corner(knob,999)

            local function paint()
                local on = _G.AdaptHideMobileButtons == true
                toggle.BackgroundColor3 = on
                    and Color3.fromRGB(147,51,234)
                    or Color3.fromRGB(50,50,56)
                knob.Position = on
                    and UDim2.new(1,-19,.5,-8)
                    or UDim2.new(0,3,.5,-8)
            end

            toggle.Activated:Connect(function()
                _G.AdaptHideMobileButtons = not (_G.AdaptHideMobileButtons == true)
                if _G.AdaptApplyMobileButtonsHidden then
                    pcall(_G.AdaptApplyMobileButtonsHidden)
                end
                paint()
                if saveAdaptConfig then pcall(saveAdaptConfig) end
            end)

            paint()
        end)
    end)

    -- [V16] Kick Warning section removed.
    print("[Lonely v10] expand/collapse repaired | FOV UI removed | hide-mobile global toggle repaired | steal WalkSpeed kick-warning repaired")
end

-- ============================================================================
-- ============================================================================
-- AUTO STEAL MODE SELECTORS
-- Normal: V1 = full Ambitious Normal; V2 = percentage/pause engine.
-- Semi:   V1 / V2 = Ambitious Semi V1 / V2 engines only.
-- ============================================================================
do
    selectedNormalMode = (selectedNormalMode == "V2") and "V2" or "V1"
    selectedSemiMode = (selectedSemiMode == "V2") and "V2" or "V1"

    local modeRow = Combat and Combat:FindFirstChild("Auto Steal Mode")
    if modeRow then
        -- Remove previous subselectors if this patch is reloaded.
        for _,n in ipairs({"NormalSubMode","SemiSubMode","SemiSubModeV2","SemiSubModeV3"}) do
            local old = modeRow.Parent and modeRow.Parent:FindFirstChild(n)
            if old then old:Destroy() end
        end

        local function makeSub(name, texts, getter, setter, visible)
            local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
            holder.Name = name
            holder.BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.row
            holder.BackgroundTransparency = 0.28
            holder.Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 38)
            holder.BorderSizePixel = 0
            holder.LayoutOrder = (name == "NormalSubMode") and ((modeRow.LayoutOrder or 1) + 0.1) or ((modeRow.LayoutOrder or 1) + 0.2)
            holder.Visible = visible()
            holder.ZIndex = 4
            holder.Parent = modeRow.Parent
            corner(holder, 9)
            stroke(holder, COLORS.strokeSoft, 1.0, 0.38)

            local n = #texts
            local slide = Instance.new("Frame")
            slide.Name = "Selected"
            slide.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(58,58,64)
            slide.BorderSizePixel = 0
            slide.Size = UDim2.new(1/n,-3,1,-6)
            slide.Position = UDim2.new(0,3,0,3)
            slide.ZIndex = 5
            slide.Parent = holder
            corner(slide,9)

            local labels, buttons = {}, {}
            local function paint()
                local cur = getter()
                local idx = 1
                for i, value in ipairs(texts) do
                    if cur == value then idx = i break end
                end
                slide.Position = UDim2.new((idx-1)/n,3,0,3)
                for i,t in ipairs(texts) do
                    labels[i].TextTransparency = (i==idx) and 0 or 0.45
                    labels[i].Font = (i==idx) and Enum.Font.GothamBlack or Enum.Font.GothamMedium
                end
            end
            for i,t in ipairs(texts) do
                local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
                lbl.Name = t.."Text"
                lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                lbl.Text = t
                lbl.TextColor3 = COLORS.white
                lbl.TextSize = 10
                lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
                lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1/n,0,1,0)
                lbl.Position = UDim2.new((i-1)/n,0,0,0)
                lbl.ZIndex = 8
                lbl.Parent = holder
                labels[i] = lbl

                local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
                b.Name = t.."Click"
                b.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                b.Text = ""
                b.AutoButtonColor = false
                b.Size = UDim2.new(1/n,0,1,0)
                b.Position = UDim2.new((i-1)/n,0,0,0)
                b.ZIndex = 10
                b.Parent = holder
                b.Activated:Connect(function()
                    setter(t)
                    paint()
                    if _G.AdaptRefreshStealPauseVisibility then pcall(_G.AdaptRefreshStealPauseVisibility) end
                    if _G.AdaptAutoStealSync then pcall(_G.AdaptAutoStealSync) end
                    if saveAdaptConfig then pcall(saveAdaptConfig) end
                end)
                buttons[i] = b
            end
            return holder, paint
        end

        local normalHolder, paintNormal = makeSub(
            "NormalSubMode", {"V1","V2"},
            function() return selectedNormalMode end,
            function(v) selectedNormalMode = (v=="V2") and "V2" or "V1" end,
            function() return selectedStealMode == "Normal" end
        )
        local semiHolder, paintSemi = makeSub(
            "SemiSubMode", {"V1","V2"},
            function() return selectedSemiMode end,
            function(v)
                selectedSemiMode = (v == "V2") and "V2" or "V1"
            end,
            function() return selectedStealMode == "Semi" end
        )

        local function refreshSub()
            normalHolder.Visible = selectedStealMode == "Normal"
            semiHolder.Visible = selectedStealMode == "Semi"
            paintNormal()
            paintSemi()
            if _G.AdaptRefreshStealPauseVisibility then pcall(_G.AdaptRefreshStealPauseVisibility) end
        end
        _G.AdaptRefreshAutoStealSubModes = refreshSub

        -- Normal V2 pause presets. This uses the Ambitious percentage engine
        -- already wired above; changing a preset updates the live engine and
        -- persists the value. It is intentionally hidden for Normal V1 and
        -- for the Semi modes.
        local pauseRow = lonelyStealPauseSelectorRow(Combat, (modeRow.LayoutOrder or 2) + 0.11)
        pauseRow.Name = "NormalV2StealPause"
        _G.AdaptStealPauseRow = pauseRow

        local oldPauseRefresh = _G.AdaptRefreshStealPauseVisibility
        _G.AdaptRefreshStealPauseVisibility = function()
            if oldPauseRefresh then pcall(oldPauseRefresh) end
            local show = (_G.AdaptStealExpanded == true)
                        and selectedStealMode == "Normal"
                        and selectedNormalMode == "V2"
            pauseRow.Visible = show
            pauseRow.Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, show and 42 or 0)
            if _G.AdaptStealPauseRefresh then pcall(_G.AdaptStealPauseRefresh) end
        end

        refreshSub()
        pcall(_G.AdaptRefreshStealPauseVisibility)
    end

    task.defer(function()
        task.wait(0.15)
        if _G.AdaptAutoStealSync then pcall(_G.AdaptAutoStealSync) end
        if _G.AdaptRefreshAutoStealSubModes then pcall(_G.AdaptRefreshAutoStealSubModes) end
    end)
end

-- V12 FINAL REPAIR
-- 1) Remove the complete Stretch Rez / FOV UI content from Visuals.
-- 2) Custom Tools selection survives reset/respawn and PICK cards work on touch.
-- 3) Tracker is replaced with the Ambitious edge/torso tracer logic.
-- 4) Auto Steal is wired to the selected Ambitious Auto Steal engine and its pause presets.
-- 5) StealBar is wired to the selected engine.
-- 6) Ragdoll countdown shows both local-player and enemy countdowns at once.
-- ============================================================================
do
    -- ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- A. REMOVE STRETCH/FOV UI COMPLETELY
    -- ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    task.defer(function()
        task.wait(0.35)
        pcall(function()
            local utility = pages and (pages.VISUALS or pages.Visuals or pages.UTILITY or pages.Utility)
            if utility then
                local removeNames = {
                    ["Stretch Rez"] = true,
                    ["Stretch Rez Options"] = true,
                    ["Stretch Res"] = true,
                    ["FOV"] = true,
                    ["FOV Change"] = true,
                    ["FOV Value"] = true,
                    ["FOV Value Holder"] = true,
                    ["FOVArrow"] = true,
                    ["FOVValueBox"] = true,
                }
                for _,o in ipairs(utility:GetChildren()) do
                    if removeNames[o.Name] then
                        pcall(function() o:Destroy() end)
                    end
                end
                -- Remove empty CAMERA/PERFORMANCE headers if they contain no
                -- remaining visible controls related to the removed content.
                for _,o in ipairs(utility:GetChildren()) do
                    if o:IsA("Frame") and (o.Name == "CAMERA" or o.Name == "SCREEN") then
                        local hasRealChild = false
                        for _,c in ipairs(o:GetChildren()) do
                            if c:IsA("GuiObject") and c.Visible then hasRealChild=true break end
                        end
                        if not hasRealChild then pcall(function() o:Destroy() end) end
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
    end)

    -- ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- B. CUSTOM TOOLS: persistent selected skin + reset/respawn recheck
    -- ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    _G.LonelyCustomToolSelectionBackup = _G.LonelyCustomToolSelectionBackup or {}
    local CTBACKUP_FILE = "Lonely_CustomToolSelection.json"

    local function _ctSaveBackup()
        local skins = _G.AmbitiousCustomToolSkins or {}
        _G.LonelyCustomToolSelectionBackup.Bat = skins.Bat or "DiamondSword"
        _G.LonelyCustomToolSelectionBackup.Medusa = skins.Medusa or "GoldenDesertEagle"
        pcall(function()
            local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
            if writefile then
                writefile(CTBACKUP_FILE, HttpService:JSONEncode(_G.LonelyCustomToolSelectionBackup))
            end
        end)
    end

    local function _ctLoadBackup()
        local data = nil
        pcall(function()
            local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
            if isfile and isfile(CTBACKUP_FILE) and readfile then
                data = HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(CTBACKUP_FILE))
            end
        end)
        if type(data) == "table" then
            _G.LonelyCustomToolSelectionBackup.Bat = data.Bat or _G.LonelyCustomToolSelectionBackup.Bat
            _G.LonelyCustomToolSelectionBackup.Medusa = data.Medusa or _G.LonelyCustomToolSelectionBackup.Medusa
        end
        local skins = _G.AmbitiousCustomToolSkins
        if type(skins) ~= "table" then
            skins = {}
            _G.AmbitiousCustomToolSkins = skins
        end
        if _G.LonelyCustomToolSelectionBackup.Bat then skins.Bat = _G.LonelyCustomToolSelectionBackup.Bat end
        if _G.LonelyCustomToolSelectionBackup.Medusa then skins.Medusa = _G.LonelyCustomToolSelectionBackup.Medusa end
    end

    _ctLoadBackup()

    if type(_G.AmbitiousSetCustomToolSkin) == "function" and not _G._LonelyCustomToolSkinWrappedV12 then
        _G._LonelyCustomToolSkinWrappedV12 = true
        local oldSetSkin = _G.AmbitiousSetCustomToolSkin
        _G.AmbitiousSetCustomToolSkin = function(cat,key)
            local ok = pcall(oldSetSkin,cat,key)
            if ok then
                _ctSaveBackup()
                task.defer(function()
                    pcall(function()
                        if _G.AmbitiousCustomToolsRecheck then _G.AmbitiousCustomToolsRecheck() end
                    end)
                end)
            end
            return ok
        end
    end

    -- Rebuild the selected replica immediately after respawn/reset. This is
    -- deliberately independent of the mobile reset button.
    if not _G._LonelyCustomToolRespawnRecheckV12 then
        _G._LonelyCustomToolRespawnRecheckV12 = true
        LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
            task.delay(0.15,function()
                pcall(function()
                    if _G.AmbitiousCustomToolsRecheck then _G.AmbitiousCustomToolsRecheck() end
                end)
            end)
            task.delay(0.75,function()
                pcall(function()
                    if _G.AmbitiousCustomToolsRecheck then _G.AmbitiousCustomToolsRecheck() end
                end)
            end)
        end)
    end

    -- The existing picker was built with MouseButton1Click on the cards in an
    -- older pass. Rebind the actual card buttons with Activated so touch and
    -- mouse both select the skin immediately.
    task.defer(function()
        task.wait(0.45)
        pcall(function()
            local pg = PlayerGui
            local g = pg and (pg:FindFirstChild("AmbitiousCustomToolsPicker") or pg:FindFirstChild("AmbitiousCustomToolsPickerV12"))
            if not g then return end
            for _,d in ipairs(g:GetDescendants()) do
                if d:IsA("TextButton") and d.Parent and d.Parent.Name:match("^Skin_") then
                    d.Activated:Connect(function()
                        local key = d.Parent.Name:gsub("^Skin_","")
                        local cat
                        local assets = _G.AmbitiousCustomToolAssets or {}
                        if assets[key] then cat = assets[key].cat end
                        if cat and _G.AmbitiousSetCustomToolSkin then
                            pcall(_G.AmbitiousSetCustomToolSkin,cat,key)
                        end
                    end)
                end
            end
        end)
    end)

    -- ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- C. AMBITIOUS FULL TRACKER: edge-point + torso target + live Drawing line
    -- ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local function _v12TrackerColor()
        if BoxedESPOptions and BoxedESPOptions.trackerColor then
            return BoxedESPOptions.trackerColor
        end
        return THEME_ACCENT or Color3.fromRGB(230,230,230)
    end

    local function _v12TrackerEdgePoint(cam,targetWorldPos)
        local view = cam.ViewportSize
        local center = Vector2.new(view.X/2,view.Y/2)
        local targetScreen = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(targetWorldPos)
        local targetV2 = Vector2.new(targetScreen.X,targetScreen.Y)
        if targetScreen.Z > 0 then
            local margin = 50
            if targetV2.X >= -margin and targetV2.X <= view.X+margin
               and targetV2.Y >= -margin and targetV2.Y <= view.Y+margin then
                return targetV2
            end
        end
        local dir = targetV2-center
        if targetScreen.Z <= 0 then
            local toTarget = (targetWorldPos-cam.CFrame.Position)
            if toTarget.Magnitude > 0.001 then toTarget=toTarget.Unit end
            local right,up = cam.CFrame.RightVector,cam.CFrame.UpVector
            dir=Vector2.new(toTarget:Dot(right),-toTarget:Dot(up))*1000
        end
        local mag=dir.Magnitude
        if mag < 0.001 then return Vector2.new(center.X,view.Y-20) end
        dir=dir/mag
        local edgePad=20
        local halfW=(view.X/2)-edgePad
        local halfH=(view.Y/2)-edgePad
        local tx=math.huge
        local ty=math.huge
        if math.abs(dir.X)>0.001 then tx=halfW/math.abs(dir.X) end
        if math.abs(dir.Y)>0.001 then ty=halfH/math.abs(dir.Y) end
        local t=math.min(tx,ty)
        return Vector2.new(
            math.clamp(center.X+dir.X*t,edgePad,view.X-edgePad),
            math.clamp(center.Y+dir.Y*t,edgePad,view.Y-edgePad)
        )
    end

    function _updateBoxedESP()
        local cam=workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not cam then return end
        local showTracker=BoxedESPOptions and BoxedESPOptions.tracker==true
        if not showTracker then
            _cleanupBoxedESP()
            return
        end

        local myChar=LP.Character
        local myRoot=myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local fromPoint
        if myRoot then
            local myPos,onScreen=cam:WorldToViewportPoint(myRoot.Position-Vector3.new(0,1,0))
            if onScreen then fromPoint=Vector2.new(myPos.X,myPos.Y) end
        end
        if not fromPoint then
            fromPoint=Vector2.new(cam.ViewportSize.X/2,cam.ViewportSize.Y-10)
        end

        for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if player==LP then continue end
            local char=player.Character
            if not char then _cleanupBoxedESPPlayer(player); continue end
            local root=char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local head=char:FindFirstChild("Head")
            local humanoid=char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if not root or not head or (humanoid and humanoid.Health<=0) then
                _cleanupBoxedESPPlayer(player)
                continue
            end

            local torsoPos=(root.Position+head.Position)/2
            torsoPos=torsoPos+Vector3.new(0,-0.7,0)
            if _G.AmbitiousAntiVoid and _G.AmbitiousAntiVoid.posFor then
                local gp,isGhost=_G.AmbitiousAntiVoid.posFor(player,root.Position)
                if isGhost then torsoPos=gp+Vector3.new(0,1.2,0) end
            end
            local torsoScreen=cam:WorldToViewportPoint(torsoPos)
            local targetPoint=_v12TrackerEdgePoint(cam,torsoPos)
            local data=BoxedESPData[player]
            if not data then
                data={tracker=_safeDrawing("Line",{Thickness=2.5,Transparency=0.4,Color=_v12TrackerColor(),Visible=false})}
                BoxedESPData[player]=data
            elseif not data.tracker then
                data.tracker=_safeDrawing("Line",{Thickness=2.5,Transparency=0.4,Color=_v12TrackerColor(),Visible=false})
            end
            if data.tracker then
                data.tracker.Color=_v12TrackerColor()
                data.tracker.Thickness=2.5
                data.tracker.From=fromPoint
                data.tracker.To=targetPoint
                data.tracker.Visible=true
            end
        end
        for player,_ in pairs(BoxedESPData) do
            if not player.Parent then _cleanupBoxedESPPlayer(player) end
        end
    end

    refreshBoxedESP=function()
        local trackerOn=BoxedESPOptions and BoxedESPOptions.tracker==true
        _G.AmbitiousTrackerActive=trackerOn
        if BoxedESPConn then pcall(function() BoxedESPConn:Disconnect() end); BoxedESPConn=nil end
        if trackerOn then
            BoxedESPConn=RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(_updateBoxedESP)
        else
            _cleanupBoxedESP()
        end
    end

    task.defer(function()
        task.wait(0.55)
        pcall(function() if BoxedESPOptions and BoxedESPOptions.tracker then refreshBoxedESP() end end)
    end)

    -- ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- D. FULL AUTO STEAL WIRING + PAUSE PRESETS
    task.defer(function()
        task.wait(0.1)
        pcall(function()
            -- Keep current selection; Semi is restricted to V1/V2.
            selectedNormalMode = (selectedNormalMode == "V2") and "V2" or "V1"
            selectedSemiMode = (selectedSemiMode == "V2") and "V2" or "V1"

            _G.AdaptSemiSteal = _G.AmbitiousSemiSteal
            local A = _G.AdaptSemiSteal
            if A then
                local p = tonumber(_G.AdaptStealPausePreset) or 80
                A.autoGrabStopPercent = p
                A.autoGrabStopTime = A.autoGrabStopTime or 1.29
                A.autoGrabSetDelayRadius = A.autoGrabSetDelayRadius or 8
                A.autoGrabStopEnabled = true
            end

            local allowed = {[70]=true,[75]=true,[80]=true,[85]=true,[90]=true}
            local p = tonumber(_G.AdaptStealPausePreset) or 80
            if not allowed[p] then p = 80 end
            _G.AdaptStealPausePreset = tostring(p)
            if A then A.autoGrabStopPercent = p end

            if _G.AdaptRefreshAutoStealSubModes then _G.AdaptRefreshAutoStealSubModes() end
            if _G.AdaptAutoStealSync then pcall(_G.AdaptAutoStealSync) end
        end)
    end)

    _G.AdaptSetStealPause=function(p)
        local n=tonumber(tostring(p):match("%d+")) or 80
        local allowed={[70]=true,[75]=true,[80]=true,[85]=true,[90]=true}
        if not allowed[n] then n=80 end
        _G.AdaptStealPausePreset=tostring(n)
        _G._AmbitiousSemiStealPending = _G._AmbitiousSemiStealPending or {}
        _G._AmbitiousSemiStealPending.autoGrabStopPercent=n
        _G.AdaptSemiSteal=_G.AmbitiousSemiSteal
        if _G.AdaptSemiSteal then
            _G.AdaptSemiSteal.autoGrabStopPercent=n
        end
        -- Normal V2 reads this value at the beginning of every steal, so the
        -- selected 70/75/80/85/90% is the actual pause point.
        if saveAdaptConfig then pcall(saveAdaptConfig) end
        if autoStealEnabled and _G.AdaptAutoStealSync then pcall(_G.AdaptAutoStealSync) end
    end

    -- Keep external Steal Bar synchronized with whichever Ambitious engine is active.
    task.defer(function()
        task.wait(0.2)
        pcall(function()
            if _G.__AdaptDuelsSetupStealBar and not _G.StealBar then _G.__AdaptDuelsSetupStealBar() end
            if _G.StealBar then _G.StealBar.SetState("IDLE"); _G.StealBar.SetProgress(0) end
        end)
    end)

    -- E. BOTH SELF + ENEMY RAGDOLL COUNTDOWNS SIMULTANEOUSLY
    -- ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    do
        local R=_G._LonelyRCD or {}
        _G._LonelyRCD=R
        R.seconds=2.6
        _G._LonelyEnemyRagdollData=_G._LonelyEnemyRagdollData or {}
        _G._LonelyEnemyRagdollConns=_G._LonelyEnemyRagdollConns or {}

        local function disc(c) if c then pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end end
        local function destroyGui(g) if g then pcall(function() g:Destroy() end) end end

        local function clearEnemy(plr)
            local d=_G._LonelyEnemyRagdollData[plr]
            if d then destroyGui(d.gui) end
            _G._LonelyEnemyRagdollData[plr]=nil
            local c=_G._LonelyEnemyRagdollConns[plr]
            if c then disc(c.detect); disc(c.state); disc(c.char) end
            _G._LonelyEnemyRagdollConns[plr]=nil
        end

        local function markEnemy(plr,char)
            if not ragdollCountdownEnabled or not char then return end
            local head=char:FindFirstChild("Head")
            if not head then return end
            local now=tick()
            local d=_G._LonelyEnemyRagdollData[plr]
            if d and d.gui and d.gui.Parent then
                d.endTime=now+R.seconds
                return
            end
            local bb=Instance.new("BillboardGui")
            bb.Name="LonelyEnemyRagdollCountdown"
            bb.Adornee=head
            bb.Size=UDim2.new(0,130,0,32)
            bb.StudsOffset=Vector3.new(0,3.25,0)
            bb.AlwaysOnTop=true
            bb.LightInfluence=0
            bb.ResetOnSpawn=false
            bb.Parent=PlayerGui
            local label=Instance.new("TextLabel")
            label.Name="Countdown"
            label.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
            label.BackgroundTransparency=1
            label.Text="RAGDOLL 2.600"
            label.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(255,70,70)
            label.TextStrokeColor3=Color3.new(0,0,0)
            label.TextStrokeTransparency=0
            label.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBlack
            label.TextSize=20
            label.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
            label.Parent=bb
            _G._LonelyEnemyRagdollData[plr]={gui=bb,endTime=now+R.seconds}
        end

        local function setupEnemy(plr,char)
            if plr==LP or not char then return end
            local old=_G._LonelyEnemyRagdollConns[plr] or {}
            local charConn=old.char
            clearEnemy(plr)
            local conns={char=charConn}
            conns.detect=char.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)
                if d:IsA("BallSocketConstraint") then markEnemy(plr,char) end
            end)
            local hum=char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if hum then
                conns.state=hum.StateChanged:Connect(function(_,st)
                    if st==Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics or st==Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll then
                        markEnemy(plr,char)
                    end
                end)
            end
            _G._LonelyEnemyRagdollConns[plr]=conns
        end

        -- Keep one persistent CharacterAdded connection per enemy.
        if not _G._LonelyEnemyRagdollPlayerWatchV12 then
            _G._LonelyEnemyRagdollPlayerWatchV12=true
            _G._LonelyEnemyRagdollPlayerConnV12=Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(plr)
                if plr==LP then return end
                local c=_G._LonelyEnemyRagdollConns[plr] or {}
                disc(c.char)
                c.char=plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char) setupEnemy(plr,char) end)
                _G._LonelyEnemyRagdollConns[plr]=c
                if plr.Character then setupEnemy(plr,plr.Character) end
            end)
            _G._LonelyEnemyRagdollRemoveV12=Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(clearEnemy)
        end
        for _,plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if plr~=LP then
                local c=_G._LonelyEnemyRagdollConns[plr] or {}
                disc(c.char)
                c.char=plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char) setupEnemy(plr,char) end)
                _G._LonelyEnemyRagdollConns[plr]=c
                if plr.Character then setupEnemy(plr,plr.Character) end
            end
        end

        if _G._LonelyEnemyRagdollUpdateV12 then disc(_G._LonelyEnemyRagdollUpdateV12) end
        _G._LonelyEnemyRagdollUpdateV12=RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            if not ragdollCountdownEnabled then return end
            local now=tick()
            for plr,d in pairs(_G._LonelyEnemyRagdollData) do
                if not d or not d.gui or not d.gui.Parent or now >= (d.endTime or 0) then
                    if d then destroyGui(d.gui) end
                    _G._LonelyEnemyRagdollData[plr]=nil
                else
                    local label=d.gui:FindFirstChild("Countdown")
                    if label then
                        local left=math.max(0,d.endTime-now)
                        label.Text=string.format("RAGDOLL %.3f",left)
                        label.TextColor3=left<=1 and Color3.fromRGB(255,90,90) or Color3.fromRGB(255,70,70)
                    end
                end
            end
        end)

        -- Replace the self countdown loop so it no longer stops the enemy
        -- watcher. Both remain visible at the same time.
        local oldHook=_G.LonelyHookRagdollCountdown
        _G.LonelyHookRagdollCountdown=function(char)
            if oldHook then pcall(oldHook,char) end
            -- oldHook may hide enemy watchers; immediately restore the enemy
            -- connections/data without touching the local countdown.
            for _,plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if plr~=LP and plr.Character then setupEnemy(plr,plr.Character) end
            end
        end
    end

    print("[Lonely v12] FOV/Stretch removed | Custom Tools reset-safe | Ambitious tracker restored | Semi V1/V2 Ambitious steal/bar repaired | self+enemy ragdoll countdown")
end

-- Bat Aimbot is active. The steal engine may reset

print("[Lonely v13] Bat Aimbot no longer resets the external Steal Bar while Auto Steal is active")


-- ============================================================
-- [V14] FINAL UI / CUSTOM TOOL / COLLISION REPAIR
-- ============================================================
do
    -- --------------------------------------------------------
    -- 1) REMOVE ALL SCREEN/FOV CONTENT FROM VISUALS
    -- --------------------------------------------------------
    task.defer(function()
        task.wait(0.6)
        pcall(function()
            local utility = pages and (pages.VISUALS or pages.Visuals or pages.UTILITY or pages.Utility)
            if not utility then return end
            local remove = {
                ["SCREEN"] = true,
                ["Screen"] = true,
                ["SCREEN OPTIONS"] = true,
                ["Screen Options"] = true,
                ["Screen Options Holder"] = true,
                ["Stretch Rez"] = true,
                ["Stretch Rez Options"] = true,
                ["Stretch Res"] = true,
                ["FOV"] = true,
                ["FOV Change"] = true,
                ["FOV Value"] = true,
                ["FOV Value Holder"] = true,
                ["FOVArrow"] = true,
                ["FOVValueBox"] = true,
            }
            for _,obj in ipairs(utility:GetDescendants()) do
                if remove[obj.Name] then
                    pcall(function() obj:Destroy() end)
                end
            end
            for _,obj in ipairs(utility:GetChildren()) do
                if obj:IsA("Frame") and (obj.Name == "CAMERA" or obj.Name == "SCREEN") then
                    local visibleChild = false
                    for _,ch in ipairs(obj:GetChildren()) do
                        if ch:IsA("GuiObject") and ch.Visible then
                            visibleChild = true
                            break
                        end
                    end
                    if not visibleChild then pcall(function() obj:Destroy() end) end
                end
            end
        end)
    end)

    -- --------------------------------------------------------
    -- 2) CUSTOM TOOLS: mobile PICK + persistent skin after reset
    -- --------------------------------------------------------
    _G.LonelyCustomToolSelectionBackup = _G.LonelyCustomToolSelectionBackup or {}
    local CTBACKUP_FILE_V14 = "Lonely_CustomToolSelection.json"

    local function saveCTV14()
        local skins = _G.AmbitiousCustomToolSkins or {}
        _G.LonelyCustomToolSelectionBackup.Bat = skins.Bat or _G.LonelyCustomToolSelectionBackup.Bat or "DiamondSword"
        _G.LonelyCustomToolSelectionBackup.Medusa = skins.Medusa or _G.LonelyCustomToolSelectionBackup.Medusa or "GoldenDesertEagle"
        pcall(function()
            if writefile and game:GetService("HttpService") then
                writefile(CTBACKUP_FILE_V14, game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONEncode(_G.LonelyCustomToolSelectionBackup))
            end
        end)
    end

    local function loadCTV14()
        pcall(function()
            if isfile and readfile and isfile(CTBACKUP_FILE_V14) then
                local d = game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(readfile(CTBACKUP_FILE_V14))
                if type(d) == "table" then
                    _G.LonelyCustomToolSelectionBackup.Bat = d.Bat or _G.LonelyCustomToolSelectionBackup.Bat
                    _G.LonelyCustomToolSelectionBackup.Medusa = d.Medusa or _G.LonelyCustomToolSelectionBackup.Medusa
                end
            end
        end)
        _G.AmbitiousCustomToolSkins = _G.AmbitiousCustomToolSkins or {}
        if _G.LonelyCustomToolSelectionBackup.Bat then
            _G.AmbitiousCustomToolSkins.Bat = _G.LonelyCustomToolSelectionBackup.Bat
        end
        if _G.LonelyCustomToolSelectionBackup.Medusa then
            _G.AmbitiousCustomToolSkins.Medusa = _G.LonelyCustomToolSelectionBackup.Medusa
        end
    end
    loadCTV14()

    -- Use the real setter, then immediately persist and rebuild.
    if type(_G.AmbitiousSetCustomToolSkin) == "function" and not _G.__LonelyCTSetterV14 then
        _G.__LonelyCTSetterV14 = true
        local oldSetter = _G.AmbitiousSetCustomToolSkin
        _G.AmbitiousSetCustomToolSkin = function(cat,key)
            local ok, result = pcall(oldSetter, cat, key)
            if ok then
                saveCTV14()
                task.defer(function()
                    pcall(function()
                        if _G.AmbitiousCustomToolsRecheck then _G.AmbitiousCustomToolsRecheck() end
                    end)
                end)
            end
            return ok and result
        end
    end

    -- Re-apply the chosen skin after every character reset/respawn.
    if not _G.__LonelyCTRespawnV14 then
        _G.__LonelyCTRespawnV14 = true
        LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
            loadCTV14()
            task.delay(0.1, function()
                pcall(function()
                    if _G.AmbitiousCustomTools and _G.AmbitiousCustomTools.isEnabled and _G.AmbitiousCustomTools.isEnabled() then
                        _G.AmbitiousCustomToolsRecheck()
                    end
                end)
            end)
            task.delay(0.65, function()
                pcall(function()
                    if _G.AmbitiousCustomToolsRecheck then _G.AmbitiousCustomToolsRecheck() end
                end)
            end)
        end)
    end

    -- Make the Custom Tools PICK control unquestionably touch/click active.
    task.defer(function()
        task.wait(0.8)
        pcall(function()
            local utility = pages and (pages.VISUALS or pages.Visuals or pages.UTILITY or pages.Utility)
            if not utility then return end
            local pick = utility:FindFirstChild("CustomToolsPick", true)
            if pick and pick:IsA("TextButton") and not pick:GetAttribute("V14Bound") then
                pick:SetAttribute("V14Bound", true)
                pick.Active = true
                pick.Selectable = true
                local busy = false
                local function firePick()
                    if busy then return end
                    busy = true
                    task.delay(0.12, function() busy = false end)
                    -- Fire the real GuiButton activation so the original
                    -- Ambitious PICK handler opens the actual picker.
                    pcall(function() pick:Activate() end)
                end
                pick.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
                    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
                       or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
                       or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad1 then
                        firePick()
                    end
                end)
            end
        end)
    end)

    -- Rebind every skin card after the picker is actually created.
    -- The old v12 repair ran only once before the user opened the picker.
    local function bindPickerCards(gui)
        if not gui then return end
        for _,d in ipairs(gui:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsA("TextButton") and d.Parent and d.Parent.Name:match("^Skin_") and not d:GetAttribute("V14CardBound") then
                d:SetAttribute("V14CardBound", true)
                d.Active = true
                d.Selectable = true
                local busy = false
                local function choose()
                    if busy then return end
                    busy = true
                    task.delay(0.12, function() busy = false end)
                    local key = d.Parent.Name:gsub("^Skin_","")
                    local assets = _G.AmbitiousCustomToolAssets or {}
                    local def = assets[key]
                    if def and _G.AmbitiousSetCustomToolSkin then
                        pcall(_G.AmbitiousSetCustomToolSkin, def.cat, key)
                    end
                end
                d.Activated:Connect(choose)
                d.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
                    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
                       or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
                        choose()
                    end
                end)
            end
        end
    end

    task.spawn(function()
        while task.wait(0.25) do
            pcall(function()
                local g = PlayerGui and PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("AmbitiousCustomToolsPicker")
                if g then bindPickerCards(g) end
            end)
        end
    end)

    -- --------------------------------------------------------
    -- 3) BAT COUNTER V: put the V button INSIDE the same row
    -- --------------------------------------------------------
    task.defer(function()
        task.wait(0.7)
        pcall(function()
            local combat = pages and pages.COMBAT
            if not combat then return end
            local row = combat:FindFirstChild("Bat Counter")
            if row then
                row.LayoutOrder = 16
                row.ClipsDescendants = false
                local arrow = row:FindFirstChild("BatCounterModeArrow", true)
                    or row:FindFirstChild("Bat Counter Mode Arrow", true)
                    or row:FindFirstChild("ArrowButton", true)
                if arrow and arrow:IsA("GuiObject") then
                    arrow.Parent = row
                    arrow.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0,0)
                    arrow.Size = UDim2.new(0,38,0,26)
                    arrow.Position = UDim2.new(1,-155,0.5,-13)
                    arrow.Text = "V"
                    arrow.ZIndex = 30
                    arrow.Visible = true
                end
                local holder = combat:FindFirstChild("Bat Counter Mode Selector V")
                    or combat:FindFirstChild("Bat Counter Mode Selector")
                if holder then
                    holder.LayoutOrder = 16.1
                    holder.Parent = combat
                end
            end
        end)
    end)

    -- --------------------------------------------------------
    -- 4) TP DOWN METHOD MUST SIT DIRECTLY UNDER TP DOWN
    -- --------------------------------------------------------
    task.defer(function()
        task.wait(0.7)
        pcall(function()
            local movement = pages and pages.MOVEMENT
            if not movement then return end
            local tpRow = movement:FindFirstChild("TP Down")
            local method = movement:FindFirstChild("TP Down Method")
            local holder = movement:FindFirstChild("TP Down Method Selector")
            if tpRow then
                tpRow.LayoutOrder = 12
            end
            if method then
                method.LayoutOrder = 12.1
                method.Visible = true
                method.ClipsDescendants = true
            end
            if holder then
                holder.LayoutOrder = 12.2
                holder.Parent = movement
            end
        end)
    end)

    print("[Lonely v14] Ambitious No Player Collision v3 + Custom Tools PICK/reset persistence + Bat Counter V alignment + TP Down Method order + Screen/FOV removed")
end


-- ============================================================================
-- [V15 FINAL REPAIR]
-- Persistent Unwalk / Custom Tool selection + touch-safe PICK + per-button hide
-- only. Global Hide Mobile Buttons is disabled so it can never hide everything
-- accidentally; selecting every individual row still hides every button.
