do
    local PlayersV15 = game:GetService("Players")
    local LPV15 = PlayersV15.LocalPlayer
    local UISV15 = game:GetService("UserInputService")
    local HttpServiceV15 = game:GetService("HttpService")

    -- ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 1) GLOBAL HIDE MOBILE: disable the old "hide everything" switch.
    --    The only source of truth is AdaptMobileButtonHiddenKeys.
    -- ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local _savedHideMobileButtons = (_G.AdaptHideMobileButtons == true)
    _G.AdaptHideMobileButtons = _savedHideMobileButtons

    if _G.AdaptApplyMobileButtonsHidden then
        local oldApplyGlobalV15 = _G.AdaptApplyMobileButtonsHidden
        if not _G.__LonelyGlobalHideDisabledV15 then
            _G.__LonelyGlobalHideDisabledV15 = true
            _G.AdaptApplyMobileButtonsHidden = function()
                -- Never disable the whole ScreenGui.
                pcall(function()
                    local g = PlayerGui and PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("AdaptMobileButtons")
                    if g then g.Enabled = true end
                end)
                -- Apply only the individually selected buttons.
                if _G.LonelyApplyPerButtonHide then
                    pcall(_G.LonelyApplyPerButtonHide)
                end
            end
        end
    end

    -- Hide/neutralize legacy global rows so their switch cannot re-enable
    -- "hide all" after a respawn or config load.
    task.defer(function()
        task.wait(1.0)
        pcall(function()
            local settings = pages and (pages.SETTINGS or pages.Settings)
            if not settings then return end
            for _,name in ipairs({"Hide Mobile Buttons","GlobalHideToggle"}) do
                local o = settings:FindFirstChild(name, true)
                if o then
                    if o:IsA("GuiObject") then o.Visible = false end
                end
            end
        end)
    end)

    -- ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 2) PERSISTENT CUSTOM TOOLS
    --    Keep a second small backup as well as the normal Adapt config, then
    --    restore it after CharacterAdded. This prevents death/respawn and
    --    rejoin initialization from falling back to the default skin.
    -- ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    _G.LonelyCTV15 = _G.LonelyCTV15 or {
        Bat = "DiamondSword",
        Medusa = "GoldenDesertEagle"
    }
    local CTFILEV15 = "Lonely_CustomTools_V15.json"

    local function ctSaveV15()
        local skins = _G.AmbitiousCustomToolSkins or {}
        _G.LonelyCTV15.Bat = skins.Bat or _G.LonelyCTV15.Bat
        _G.LonelyCTV15.Medusa = skins.Medusa or _G.LonelyCTV15.Medusa
        pcall(function()
            if writefile then
                writefile(CTFILEV15, HttpServiceV15:JSONEncode(_G.LonelyCTV15))
            end
        end)
        pcall(function()
            if saveAdaptConfig then saveAdaptConfig() end
        end)
    end

    local function ctLoadV15()
        pcall(function()
            if isfile and readfile and isfile(CTFILEV15) then
                local d = HttpServiceV15:JSONDecode(readfile(CTFILEV15))
                if type(d) == "table" then
                    if d.Bat then _G.LonelyCTV15.Bat = tostring(d.Bat) end
                    if d.Medusa then _G.LonelyCTV15.Medusa = tostring(d.Medusa) end
                end
            end
        end)
        _G.AmbitiousCustomToolSkins = _G.AmbitiousCustomToolSkins or {}
        _G.AmbitiousCustomToolSkins.Bat = _G.LonelyCTV15.Bat
        _G.AmbitiousCustomToolSkins.Medusa = _G.LonelyCTV15.Medusa
    end
    ctLoadV15()

    local function ctReapplyV15()
        ctLoadV15()
        pcall(function()
            if _G.AmbitiousCustomToolsRecheck then
                _G.AmbitiousCustomToolsRecheck()
            end
        end)
        pcall(function()
            if _G.AmbitiousCustomTools and _G.AmbitiousCustomTools.isEnabled
                and _G.AmbitiousCustomTools.isEnabled()
                and _G.AmbitiousCustomToolsRecheck then
                _G.AmbitiousCustomToolsRecheck()
            end
        end)
    end

    if not _G.__LonelyCTV15Setter then
        _G.__LonelyCTV15Setter = true
        local oldSetterV15 = _G.AmbitiousSetCustomToolSkin
        if type(oldSetterV15) == "function" then
            _G.AmbitiousSetCustomToolSkin = function(cat,key)
                local ok,res = pcall(oldSetterV15,cat,key)
                if ok then
                    _G.LonelyCTV15[tostring(cat)] = tostring(key)
                    ctSaveV15()
                    task.defer(ctReapplyV15)
                end
                return ok and res
            end
        end
    end

    if not _G.__LonelyCTV15Respawn then
        _G.__LonelyCTV15Respawn = true
        LPV15.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
            task.wait(0.12)
            ctReapplyV15()
            task.delay(0.65, ctReapplyV15)
            task.delay(1.50, ctReapplyV15)
        end)
    end

    -- ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 3) HARD-SAFE PICK FALLBACK
    --    The existing Ambitious picker remains primary. If its Activated event
    --    does not produce a picker within a short time, create a lightweight
    --    picker here. This makes the control work on touch, mouse and gamepad.
    -- ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local function makeFallbackPickerV15()
        local pg = PlayerGui or LPV15:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
        if not pg then return end
        if pg:FindFirstChild("LonelyCustomToolsPickerV15") then
            pg.LonelyCustomToolsPickerV15:Destroy()
            return
        end

        local assets = _G.AmbitiousCustomToolAssets or {}
        local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
        gui.Name = "LonelyCustomToolsPickerV15"
        gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
        gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
        gui.DisplayOrder = 100000
        gui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
        gui.Parent = pg

        local bg = Instance.new("Frame")
        bg.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0)
        bg.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0)
        bg.BackgroundTransparency = .45
        bg.BorderSizePixel = 0
        bg.Parent = gui

        local panel = Instance.new("Frame")
        panel.Size = UDim2.new(0,420,0,360)
        panel.Position = UDim2.new(.5,-210,.5,-180)
        panel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(10,10,13)
        panel.BorderSizePixel = 0
        panel.Parent = gui
        corner(panel,14)
        stroke(panel,Color3.fromRGB(90,90,105),1.3,.2)

        local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        title.Size = UDim2.new(1,-55,0,42)
        title.Position = UDim2.new(0,14,0,0)
        title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        title.Text = "CUSTOM TOOLS SELECTOR"
        title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
        title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
        title.TextSize = 14
        title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        title.Parent = panel

        local close = Instance.new("TextButton")
        close.Size = UDim2.new(0,32,0,30)
        close.Position = UDim2.new(1,-40,0,6)
        close.Text = "X"
        close.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
        close.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25,25,30)
        close.BorderSizePixel = 0
        close.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
        close.Parent = panel
        corner(close,8)
        close.Activated:Connect(function() gui:Destroy() end)

        local body = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
        body.Size = UDim2.new(1,-20,1,-58)
        body.Position = UDim2.new(0,10,0,48)
        body.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        body.BorderSizePixel = 0
        body.ScrollBarThickness = 3
        body.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0,0,0,0)
        body.Parent = panel

        local lay = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
        lay.Padding = UDim.new(0,7)
        lay.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
        lay.Parent = body

        local order = 0
        for key,def in pairs(assets) do
            order += 1
            local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
            b.Name = "Pick_"..tostring(key)
            b.Size = UDim2.new(1,-4,0,48)
            b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(24,24,29)
            b.BorderSizePixel = 0
            b.Text = tostring(def.label or key) .. "   [" .. tostring(def.cat or "?") .. "]"
            b.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
            b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
            b.TextSize = 12
            b.AutoButtonColor = false
            b.LayoutOrder = order
            b.Parent = body
            corner(b,9)
            local bStroke = stroke(b,Color3.fromRGB(80,80,95),1,.35)
            bStroke.Name = "SelectedStroke"
            local function paintV15Selected()
                local selected = (_G.AmbitiousCustomToolSkins and _G.AmbitiousCustomToolSkins[def.cat]) == key
                bStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
                bStroke.Thickness = selected and 2.2 or 1
                bStroke.Transparency = selected and 0 or 0.35
            end
            paintV15Selected()

            b.Activated:Connect(function()
                if _G.AmbitiousSetCustomToolSkin then
                    pcall(_G.AmbitiousSetCustomToolSkin,def.cat,key)
                end
                ctSaveV15()
                for _,child in ipairs(body:GetChildren()) do
                    if child:IsA("TextButton") then
                        child.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(24,24,29)
                        local st = child:FindFirstChild("SelectedStroke")
                        if st and st:IsA("UIStroke") then
                            st.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
                            st.Thickness = (child == b) and 2.2 or 1
                            st.Transparency = (child == b) and 0 or 0.35
                        end
                    end
                end
                b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(235,235,235)
                b.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40,40,45)
                task.delay(.15,function()
                    if gui and gui.Parent then gui:Destroy() end
                end)
            end)
        end
        task.defer(function()
            task.wait()
            body.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0,0,0,lay.AbsoluteContentSize.Y+8)
        end)
    end

    task.defer(function()
        task.wait(1.2)
        pcall(function()
            local utility = pages and (pages.VISUALS or pages.Visuals or pages.UTILITY or pages.Utility)
            if not utility then return end
            local pick = utility:FindFirstChild("CustomToolsPick",true)
            if not pick or not pick:IsA("TextButton") then return end
            if pick:GetAttribute("V15Bound") then return end
            pick:SetAttribute("V15Bound",true)
            pick.Active = true
            pick.Selectable = true

            local busy = false
            local function fire()
                if busy then return end
                busy = true
                task.delay(.18,function() busy=false end)

                -- Let the real Ambitious handler run first.
                pcall(function() pick:Activate() end)

                -- If it failed to create the picker, use the guaranteed fallback.
                task.delay(.18,function()
                    pcall(function()
                        local pg = PlayerGui or LPV15:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
                        local found = pg and (
                            pg:FindFirstChild("AmbitiousCustomToolsPicker")
                            or pg:FindFirstChild("AmbitiousCustomToolsPickerV12")
                            or pg:FindFirstChild("LonelyCustomToolsPickerV15")
                        )
                        if not found then makeFallbackPickerV15() end
                    end)
                end)
            end

            pick.Activated:Connect(fire)
            pick.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
                if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
                    or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
                    or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad1 then
                    fire()
                end
            end)
        end)
    end)

    -- ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 4) UNWALK: restore the saved ON state AFTER loadAdaptConfig has already
    --    populated unwalkEnabled. CharacterAdded alone is not enough because
    --    loadAdaptConfig happens later during startup.
    -- ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    task.defer(function()
        task.wait(1.0)
        if unwalkEnabled == true and _G.AdaptStartUnwalk then
            pcall(_G.AdaptStartUnwalk)
        end
    end)

    -- Re-assert after the rest of the hub has finished initializing.
    task.delay(3.0,function()
        pcall(function()
            if unwalkEnabled == true and _G.AdaptStartUnwalk then
                _G.AdaptStartUnwalk()
            end
        end)
        pcall(ctReapplyV15)
        pcall(function()
            -- Do not overwrite the value restored by loadAdaptConfig.
            if _G.AdaptApplyMobileButtonsHidden then
                _G.AdaptApplyMobileButtonsHidden()
            end
        end)
    end)

    -- ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 5) PER-BUTTON HIDE persistence supervisor.
    --    Never use the old global flag. Only the keys selected in the V list
    --    are hidden. If every key is selected, all buttons are hidden.
    -- ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    task.spawn(function()
        while task.wait(.5) do
            pcall(function()
                if _G.LonelyApplyPerButtonHide then
                    _G.LonelyApplyPerButtonHide()
                end
            end)
        end
    end)

    print("[Lonely v15] persistent Unwalk + Custom Tools PICK/reset + per-button Hide Mobile repaired")
end


-- ============================================================================
-- [V16 FINAL REPAIR]
-- Persistent Motion Blur + Unwalk, persistent ESP Tracker/Color, direct
-- Custom Tools picker, ragdoll detection through actual constraints, and
-- Ambitious Auto Steal StealBar synchronization.
-- ============================================================================
do
    local Players16 = game:GetService("Players")
    local LP16 = Players16.LocalPlayer
    local Http16 = game:GetService("HttpService")
    local STATE16 = "Lonely_PersistentGameplay_V16.json"

    local P16 = {motionBlur=false, unwalk=false, tracker=false, trackerColor={r=235,g=235,b=235}}
    local hasPersistent16=false
    pcall(function()
        if isfile and readfile and isfile(STATE16) then
            hasPersistent16=true
            local d=Http16:JSONDecode(readfile(STATE16))
            if type(d)=="table" then
                if type(d.motionBlur)=="boolean" then P16.motionBlur=d.motionBlur end
                if type(d.unwalk)=="boolean" then P16.unwalk=d.unwalk end
                if type(d.tracker)=="boolean" then P16.tracker=d.tracker end
                if type(d.trackerColor)=="table" then
                    P16.trackerColor={r=tonumber(d.trackerColor.r) or 235,g=tonumber(d.trackerColor.g) or 235,b=tonumber(d.trackerColor.b) or 235}
                end
            end
        end
    end)
    -- If the dedicated persistent file does not exist yet, use the normal
    -- Adapt config loaded earlier. Once V16 has a file, that file is the
    -- source of truth so startup defaults cannot wipe saved ON/OFF states.
    if not hasPersistent16 then
        P16.motionBlur=(motionBlurEnabled==true)
        P16.unwalk=(unwalkEnabled==true)
        if _G.AdaptSavedTrackerEnabled~=nil then P16.tracker=_G.AdaptSavedTrackerEnabled==true end
        P16.trackerColor={r=255,g=80,b=175}
    end

    local function saveP16()
        pcall(function()
            if writefile then writefile(STATE16,Http16:JSONEncode(P16)) end
        end)
        pcall(function() if saveAdaptConfig then saveAdaptConfig() end end)
    end

    -- Motion Blur persistence: the existing UI calls saveAmbitiousConfig(), so
    -- wrap that call and expose the real local start/stop functions above.
    if not _G.__LonelyMotionPersistV16 then
        _G.__LonelyMotionPersistV16=true
        local oldAmbSave=saveAmbitiousConfig
        if type(oldAmbSave)=="function" then
            saveAmbitiousConfig=function(...)
                P16.motionBlur=(motionBlurEnabled==true)
                saveP16()
                return oldAmbSave(...)
            end
        end
    end
    motionBlurEnabled=P16.motionBlur==true
    if motionBlurEnabled and _G.LonelyStartMotionBlur then pcall(_G.LonelyStartMotionBlur) end
    if not motionBlurEnabled and _G.LonelyStopMotionBlur then pcall(_G.LonelyStopMotionBlur) end

    -- Unwalk persistence: wrap the actual engine functions so every route that
    -- changes the state (UI, keybind, external call) is saved.
    -- The dedicated V16 state is authoritative after it has been loaded.
    unwalkEnabled=(P16.unwalk==true)

    if not _G.__LonelyUnwalkPersistV16 then
        _G.__LonelyUnwalkPersistV16=true
        local oldEnable=enableUnwalk
        local oldDisable=disableUnwalk
        if type(oldEnable)=="function" then
            enableUnwalk=function(...)
                local r={pcall(oldEnable,...)}
                unwalkEnabled=true; P16.unwalk=true; saveP16()
                return table.unpack(r)
            end
        end
        if type(oldDisable)=="function" then
            disableUnwalk=function(...)
                local r={pcall(oldDisable,...)}
                unwalkEnabled=false; P16.unwalk=false; saveP16()
                return table.unpack(r)
            end
        end
    end
    if P16.unwalk then
        unwalkEnabled=true
        task.defer(function() if _G.AdaptStartUnwalk then pcall(_G.AdaptStartUnwalk) elseif enableUnwalk then pcall(enableUnwalk) end end)
    end

    if not _G.__LonelyV16CharReapply then
        _G.__LonelyV16CharReapply=true
        LP16.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
            task.wait(0.2)
            if P16.unwalk then
                unwalkEnabled=true
                if _G.AdaptStartUnwalk then pcall(_G.AdaptStartUnwalk) elseif enableUnwalk then pcall(enableUnwalk) end
            end
            task.delay(0.45,function()
                if P16.unwalk then
                    unwalkEnabled=true
                    if _G.AdaptStartUnwalk then pcall(_G.AdaptStartUnwalk) end
                end
            end)
        end)
    end

    -- Tracker persistence + final alignment. The tracker itself is also an
    -- active ESP mode; it must keep RenderStepped alive even if box/tracer OFF.
    task.defer(function()
        task.wait(1.0)
        pcall(function()
            if not BoxedESPOptions then BoxedESPOptions={} end
            BoxedESPOptions.tracker=P16.tracker==true
            BoxedESPOptions.trackerColor=Color3.fromRGB(P16.trackerColor.r,P16.trackerColor.g,P16.trackerColor.b)
            if refreshBoxedESP then refreshBoxedESP() end
            local utility=pages and (pages.VISUALS or pages.Visuals or pages.UTILITY or pages.Utility)
            local row=utility and utility:FindFirstChild("ESP")
            local arrow=row and row:FindFirstChild("ESPTrackerArrow")
            if arrow then arrow.Position=UDim2.new(1,-100,0.5,-13) end
            local holder=utility and utility:FindFirstChild("ESP Tracker Options")
            if holder then
                local tr=holder:FindFirstChild("Tracker Color")
                local pv=tr and tr:FindFirstChild("ColorPreview")
                if pv then pv.BackgroundColor3=BoxedESPOptions.trackerColor end
                local tb=holder:FindFirstChild("Show Tracker")
                local btn=tb and tb:FindFirstChild("ToggleButton")
                if btn then
                    btn.BackgroundTransparency=P16.tracker and 0.05 or 0.55
                    btn.TextColor3=P16.tracker and Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255) or Color3.fromRGB(180,180,190)
                end
            end
        end)
    end)

    local function saveTracker16()
        if not BoxedESPOptions then return end
        P16.tracker=BoxedESPOptions.tracker==true
        local c=BoxedESPOptions.trackerColor or Color3.fromRGB(235,235,235)
        P16.trackerColor={r=math.floor(c.R*255+0.5),g=math.floor(c.G*255+0.5),b=math.floor(c.B*255+0.5)}
        saveP16()
    end
    _G.LonelySaveTrackerV16=saveTracker16

    -- Direct Custom Tools picker. Do not depend on TextButton:Activate() or on
    -- the legacy picker event chain.
    local function openCT16()
        local pg=PlayerGui or LP16:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
        if not pg then return end
        local old=pg:FindFirstChild("LonelyCustomToolsPickerV16")
        if old then old:Destroy(); return end
        local assets=_G.AmbitiousCustomToolAssets or {}
        local gui=Instance.new("ScreenGui")
        gui.Name="LonelyCustomToolsPickerV16"; gui.ResetOnSpawn=false; gui.IgnoreGuiInset=true; gui.DisplayOrder=100000; gui.ZIndexBehavior=Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling; gui.Parent=pg
        local shade=Instance.new("TextButton"); shade.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1); shade.BackgroundColor3=Color3.new(0,0,0); shade.BackgroundTransparency=.45; shade.Text=""; shade.AutoButtonColor=false; shade.Parent=gui
        local panel=Instance.new("Frame"); panel.Size=UDim2.new(0,400,0,330); panel.Position=UDim2.new(.5,-200,.5,-165); panel.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(10,10,13); panel.BorderSizePixel=0; panel.Parent=gui; corner(panel,14); stroke(panel,Color3.fromRGB(90,90,105),1.2,.2)
        local title=Instance.new("TextLabel"); title.Size=UDim2.new(1,-60,0,40); title.Position=UDim2.new(0,14,0,0); title.BackgroundTransparency=1; title.Text="CUSTOM TOOLS SELECTOR"; title.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255); title.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBlack; title.TextSize=14; title.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left; title.Parent=panel
        local close=Instance.new("TextButton"); close.Size=UDim2.new(0,32,0,30); close.Position=UDim2.new(1,-40,0,5); close.Text="X"; close.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBlack; close.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255); close.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(25,25,30); close.BorderSizePixel=0; close.Parent=panel; corner(close,8); close.Activated:Connect(function() gui:Destroy() end)
        local body=Instance.new("ScrollingFrame"); body.Size=UDim2.new(1,-20,1,-55); body.Position=UDim2.new(0,10,0,46); body.BackgroundTransparency=1; body.BorderSizePixel=0; body.ScrollBarThickness=3; body.AutomaticCanvasSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.Y; body.CanvasSize=UDim2.new(); body.Parent=panel
        local lay=Instance.new("UIListLayout"); lay.Padding=UDim.new(0,7); lay.SortOrder=Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder; lay.Parent=body
        local keys={}; for key,def in pairs(assets) do table.insert(keys,{key=key,def=def}) end
        table.sort(keys,function(a,b) return tostring(a.def.label or a.key)<tostring(b.def.label or b.key) end)
        for i,item in ipairs(keys) do
            local def=item.def; local key=item.key
            local b=Instance.new("TextButton"); b:SetAttribute("CustomToolKey", key); b:SetAttribute("CustomToolCat", def.cat); b.Size=UDim2.new(1,-4,0,46); b.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(24,24,29); b.BorderSizePixel=0; b.Text=tostring(def.label or key).."   ["..tostring(def.cat or "?").."]"; b.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255); b.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold; b.TextSize=12; b.AutoButtonColor=false; b.LayoutOrder=i; b.Parent=body; corner(b,9); local bStroke=stroke(b,Color3.fromRGB(80,80,95),1,.35); bStroke.Name="SelectedStroke"
            local cat=def.cat
            local function paintSelected()
                local selected = (_G.AmbitiousCustomToolSkins and _G.AmbitiousCustomToolSkins[cat]) == key
                bStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
                bStroke.Thickness = selected and 2.2 or 1
                bStroke.Transparency = selected and 0 or 0.35
            end
            paintSelected()
            b.Activated:Connect(function()
                if _G.AmbitiousSetCustomToolSkin then pcall(_G.AmbitiousSetCustomToolSkin,cat,key) end
                paintSelected()
                P16.customToolSkinBat=_G.AmbitiousCustomToolSkins and _G.AmbitiousCustomToolSkins.Bat
                P16.customToolSkinMedusa=_G.AmbitiousCustomToolSkins and _G.AmbitiousCustomToolSkins.Medusa
                saveP16()
                if _G.AmbitiousCustomToolsRecheck then task.defer(function() pcall(_G.AmbitiousCustomToolsRecheck) end) end
                task.delay(.12,function() if gui.Parent then gui:Destroy() end end)
            end)
        end
        shade.Activated:Connect(function() gui:Destroy() end)
    end
    _G.LonelyOpenCustomToolPickerV16=openCT16

    -- Selected custom tool always has a clear WHITE outline. This is refreshed
    -- continuously so it stays correct after rejoin, picker rebuilds and respawn.
    task.spawn(function()
        while task.wait(0.25) do
            pcall(function()
                local selected = _G.AmbitiousCustomToolSkins or {}
                for _, guiName in ipairs({"LonelyCustomToolsPickerV16","LonelyCustomToolsPickerV15","AmbitiousCustomToolsPicker"}) do
                    local g = PlayerGui and PlayerGui:FindFirstChild(guiName)
                    if g then
                        for _, d in ipairs(g:GetDescendants()) do
                            if d:IsA("TextButton") then
                                local key = d:GetAttribute("CustomToolKey")
                                local cat = d:GetAttribute("CustomToolCat")
                                if key and cat then
                                    local st = d:FindFirstChild("SelectedStroke")
                                    if st and st:IsA("UIStroke") then
                                        local on = selected[cat] == key
                                        st.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
                                        st.Thickness = on and 2.2 or 1
                                        st.Transparency = on and 0 or 0.35
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)
        end
    end)

    task.defer(function()
        task.wait(.8)
        pcall(function()
            local utility=pages and (pages.VISUALS or pages.Visuals or pages.UTILITY or pages.Utility)
            if not utility then return end
            for _,obj in ipairs(utility:GetDescendants()) do
                if obj:IsA("TextButton") and obj.Name=="CustomToolsPick" and not obj:GetAttribute("V16DirectPick") then
                    obj:SetAttribute("V16DirectPick",true); obj.Active=true; obj.Selectable=true
                    -- Capture on a topmost transparent overlay so the legacy
                    -- Ambitious Activated handler cannot race the V16 picker.
                    local overlay=Instance.new("TextButton")
                    overlay.Name="CustomToolsPickV16Overlay"
                    overlay.BackgroundTransparency=1
                    overlay.BorderSizePixel=0
                    overlay.Text=""
                    overlay.AutoButtonColor=false
                    overlay.Active=true
                    overlay.Selectable=true
                    overlay.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
                    overlay.Position=UDim2.fromScale(0,0)
                    overlay.ZIndex=(obj.ZIndex or 1)+50
                    overlay.Parent=obj
                    overlay.Activated:Connect(openCT16)
                end
            end
        end)
    end)

    -- Save tracker state whenever the user changes it through the UI.
    task.spawn(function()
        while task.wait(.25) do
            pcall(function()
                if BoxedESPOptions then
                    local c=BoxedESPOptions.trackerColor
                    if c then
                        local r,g,b=math.floor(c.R*255+0.5),math.floor(c.G*255+0.5),math.floor(c.B*255+0.5)
                        if P16.tracker ~= (BoxedESPOptions.tracker==true) or P16.trackerColor.r~=r or P16.trackerColor.g~=g or P16.trackerColor.b~=b then saveTracker16() end
                    elseif P16.tracker ~= (BoxedESPOptions.tracker==true) then saveTracker16() end
                end
            end)
        end
    end)

    -- Ragdoll Sync: FULL Ambitious Synchronize After Hit logic.
    -- Mapping:
    -- Normal V1 = Ambitious Normal engine
    -- Normal V2 = Ambitious percentage/pause engine
    -- Semi V1   = Ambitious Semi V1 engine
    -- Semi V2   = Ambitious Semi V2 engine
    task.defer(function()
        task.wait(.25)
        pcall(function()
            local S = _G._AmbitiousSyncAfterHit
            if not S then return end
            if S.conn then pcall(function() S.conn:Disconnect() end) end
            S.wasRagdoll = false
            S.gen = tonumber(S.gen) or 0

            local function isMedusaHit()
                if _G._AmbitiousIsMedusaHit then
                    local ok,v = pcall(_G._AmbitiousIsMedusaHit)
                    if ok then return v == true end
                end
                return (tick() - (_G._AmbitiousMedusaHitTime or 0)) < 4
            end
            _G._AmbitiousIsMedusaHit = _G._AmbitiousIsMedusaHit or isMedusaHit

            local function stopSyncEngine()
                -- Ambitious-style immediate stop/reset of the CURRENT engine.
                if selectedStealMode == "Normal" then
                    if selectedNormalMode == "V1" then
                        local A = _G.AmbitiousNormalSteal
                        if A then
                            A.enabled = false
                            A.isStealing = false
                            if A.stealConn then pcall(function() A.stealConn:Disconnect() end); A.stealConn=nil end
                            for _,d in pairs(A.internalCache or {}) do d.ready=true end
                        end
                        if _G.AdaptNormalAutoStealStop then pcall(_G.AdaptNormalAutoStealStop) end
                    else
                        local A = _G.AmbitiousSemiSteal
                        if A then
                            A.enabled=false
                            if A.conn then pcall(function() A.conn:Disconnect() end); A.conn=nil end
                            if A.state then A.state.active=false; A.state.phase="idle" end
                            for _,d in pairs(A.internalCache or {}) do d.ready=true end
                        end
                        if _G.AdaptSemiAutoStealStop then pcall(_G.AdaptSemiAutoStealStop) end
                    end
                elseif selectedStealMode == "Semi" then
                    if selectedSemiMode == "V2" then
                        local B = _G.AmbitiousSemiV2Steal
                        if B then
                            B.enabled=false
                            if B.conn then pcall(function() B.conn:Disconnect() end); B.conn=nil end
                            if B.state then B.state.active=false; B.state.phase="idle" end
                            for _,d in pairs(B.internalCache or {}) do d.ready=true end
                        end
                        if _G.AdaptSemiV2AutoStealStop then pcall(_G.AdaptSemiV2AutoStealStop) end
                    else
                        local A = _G.AmbitiousSemiSteal
                        if A then
                            A.enabled=false
                            if A.conn then pcall(function() A.conn:Disconnect() end); A.conn=nil end
                            if A.state then A.state.active=false; A.state.phase="idle" end
                            for _,d in pairs(A.internalCache or {}) do d.ready=true end
                        end
                        if _G.AdaptSemiAutoStealStop then pcall(_G.AdaptSemiAutoStealStop) end
                    end
                end
                pcall(function() if _G.StealBar then _G.StealBar.Reset() end end)
            end

            local function startSyncEngine()
                if not autoStealEnabled then return end
                if _G.AdaptSemiSteal then
                    _G.AdaptSemiSteal.autoGrabStopPercent = tonumber(_G.AdaptStealPausePreset) or 80
                    _G.AdaptSemiSteal.autoGrabStopEnabled = true
                end
                if selectedStealMode == "Normal" then
                    if selectedNormalMode == "V1" then
                        if _G.AdaptNormalAutoStealStart then pcall(_G.AdaptNormalAutoStealStart) end
                    else
                        if _G.AdaptSemiAutoStealStart then pcall(_G.AdaptSemiAutoStealStart) end
                    end
                elseif selectedStealMode == "Semi" then
                    if selectedSemiMode == "V2" then
                        if _G.AdaptSemiV2AutoStealStart then pcall(_G.AdaptSemiV2AutoStealStart) end
                    else
                        if _G.AdaptSemiAutoStealStart then pcall(_G.AdaptSemiAutoStealStart) end
                    end
                end
            end

            local function doSyncAfterHit()
                -- Bat/Medusa can be independently disabled while remaining
                -- inside the single Auto Steal expansion.
                local medusa = isMedusaHit()
                if medusa and S.medusaPauseSteal == false then return end
                if (not medusa) and S.batPauseSteal == false then return end
                -- 1) Stop immediately and fully reset the selected engine.
                stopSyncEngine()

                -- 2) Ambitious generation token: only the newest hit may restart.
                local myGen = S.gen
                local syncDelay = medusa and (tonumber(S.medusaDelay) or 2.45) or (tonumber(S.batDelay) or 1.45)
                task.delay(syncDelay, function()
                    if myGen ~= S.gen then return end
                    S.wasRagdoll = false
                    if S.enabled and autoStealEnabled then
                        startSyncEngine()
                    end
                end)
            end

            local function startSyncWatcher()
                if S.conn then pcall(function() S.conn:Disconnect() end); S.conn=nil end
                S.wasRagdoll=false
                S.conn=RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
                    if not S.enabled then return end
                    if not autoStealEnabled then return end
                    local char=LP.Character
                    if not char then return end
                    local hum=char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    if not hum or hum.Health<=0 then return end
                    local state=hum:GetState()
                    -- Exact Ambitious detection: Physics/Ragdoll only.
                    -- FallingDown is intentionally excluded.
                    local isRagdolled=(state==Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics or state==Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll)
                    if isRagdolled and not S.wasRagdoll then
                        S.wasRagdoll=true
                        S.gen=S.gen+1
                        doSyncAfterHit()
                    elseif not isRagdolled then
                        S.wasRagdoll=false
                    end
                end)
            end

            local function stopSyncWatcher()
                if S.conn then pcall(function() S.conn:Disconnect() end); S.conn=nil end
                S.wasRagdoll=false
            end

            -- Keep the functions available to the actual toggle below.
            _G._LonelyStartSyncAfterHit = startSyncWatcher
            _G._LonelyStopSyncAfterHit = stopSyncWatcher
            _G._LonelySyncAfterHitNow = doSyncAfterHit

            -- Watcher is dormant unless the Auto Steal + Synchronize toggles are ON.
            startSyncWatcher()
        end)
    end)

    -- Remove every leftover Kick Warning UI/connection from older patches.
    _G.AdaptKickWarningEnabled=false
    pcall(function() if _G._LonelyKickHeartbeat then _G._LonelyKickHeartbeat:Disconnect(); _G._LonelyKickHeartbeat=nil end end)
    pcall(function() if _G._LonelyKickWarn and _G._LonelyKickWarn.gui then _G._LonelyKickWarn.gui:Destroy(); _G._LonelyKickWarn.gui=nil end end)
    task.defer(function()
        task.wait(.4)
        pcall(function()
            for _,page in pairs(pages or {}) do
                local row=page:FindFirstChild("Kick Warning")
                if row then row.Visible=false end
            end
        end)
    end)

    task.defer(function()
        task.wait(0.75)
        pcall(function()
            local S = _G._AmbitiousSyncAfterHit
            if S and S.enabled and _G._LonelyStartSyncAfterHit then
                _G._LonelyStartSyncAfterHit()
            end
        end)
    end)

    print("[Lonely v16] persistent Motion Blur/Unwalk + tracker save + direct Custom Tools PICK + constraint ragdoll sync + kick warning removed")
end

do
    local okPatch = pcall(function()
        -- 1) ESP mode arrow: keep the mode control on the same horizontal row
        -- as the ESP toggle, without covering the toggle itself.
        task.defer(function()

            pcall(function()

                local espRow = utility and utility:FindFirstChild("ESP")

                    arrow.Size = UDim2.new(0, 38, 0, 26)
                    arrow.Position = UDim2.new(1, -100, 0.5, -13)
                    arrow.ZIndex = 50
                    arrow.Visible = true
                end
            end)
        end)

        -- 2) Tracker state + tracker color are part of the normal ALL config.
        -- Mirror the dedicated tracker state into the normal config whenever
        -- it changes, so either save path keeps the same values.
        local function saveTrackerAllV20()
            pcall(function()
                if BoxedESPOptions then
                    local c = BoxedESPOptions.trackerColor or Color3.fromRGB(235,235,235)
                    _G.AdaptSavedTrackerEnabled = BoxedESPOptions.tracker == true
                    _G.AdaptSavedTrackerColor = {
                        r = math.floor(c.R * 255 + 0.5),
                        g = math.floor(c.G * 255 + 0.5),
                        b = math.floor(c.B * 255 + 0.5)
                    }
                end
                if _G.LonelySaveTrackerV16 then
                    pcall(_G.LonelySaveTrackerV16)
                elseif saveAdaptConfig then
                    pcall(saveAdaptConfig)
                end
            end)
        end
        _G.LonelySaveTrackerAllV20 = saveTrackerAllV20

        -- Re-apply the persisted tracker state after every startup/UI rebuild.
        task.defer(function()
            task.wait(1.6)
            pcall(function()
                if not BoxedESPOptions then BoxedESPOptions = {} end
                if _G.AdaptSavedTrackerEnabled ~= nil then
                    BoxedESPOptions.tracker = _G.AdaptSavedTrackerEnabled == true
                end
                BoxedESPOptions.trackerColor = Color3.fromRGB(255,80,175)
                if refreshBoxedESP then pcall(refreshBoxedESP) end
            end)
        end)

        -- 3) Music: selecting/pressing next/previous is a single-song action.
        -- Do not automatically chain through the playlist after a track ends.
        musicAutoPlayNext = false
        if saveAmbitiousConfig then pcall(saveAmbitiousConfig) end
        if saveAdaptConfig then pcall(saveAdaptConfig) end

        task.defer(function()
            task.wait(1.0)
            pcall(function()
                local pg = PlayerGui
                local musicGui = pg and (pg:FindFirstChild("AmbitiousMusicPlayer", true) or pg:FindFirstChild("LonelyMusicPlayer", true))
                if not musicGui then return end
                for _, d in ipairs(musicGui:GetDescendants()) do
                    if d:IsA("TextLabel") and tostring(d.Text):lower():find("auto play next", 1, true) then
                        local row = d.Parent
                        local btn = row and row:FindFirstChild("ToggleButton")
                        if btn then
                            pcall(function() btn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.55 end)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)
        end)

        -- 4) Save ALL current settings after the above normalization.
        task.defer(function()
            task.wait(1.8)
            pcall(function()
                if saveAdaptConfig then saveAdaptConfig() end
                if saveAmbitiousConfig then saveAmbitiousConfig() end
            end)
        end)

        -- 5) Custom Tools / Bat: if the saved config had Custom Tools ON,
        -- enable the real Ambitious module after the hub is fully initialized,
        -- then recheck the actual Backpack/Character tools.
        local function reapplyBatV20()
            pcall(function()
                local shouldRun = (_G.AmbitiousCustomToolsEnabled == true)
                    or (savedConfig and savedConfig.customToolsEnabled == true)

                if not shouldRun then return end

                _G.AmbitiousCustomToolsEnabled = true
                if _G.AmbitiousCustomTools and _G.AmbitiousCustomTools.setEnabled then
                    if not _G.AmbitiousCustomTools.isEnabled
                        or not _G.AmbitiousCustomTools.isEnabled() then
                        _G.AmbitiousCustomTools.setEnabled(true)
                    end
                end

                -- Restore the saved Bat skin before rebuilding the replica.
                _G.AmbitiousCustomToolSkins = _G.AmbitiousCustomToolSkins or {}
                if savedConfig and savedConfig.customToolSkinBat then
                    _G.AmbitiousCustomToolSkins.Bat = tostring(savedConfig.customToolSkinBat)
                end

                if _G.AmbitiousCustomToolsRecheck then
                    _G.AmbitiousCustomToolsRecheck()
                end
            end)
        end

        _G.LonelyReapplyBatToolV20 = reapplyBatV20

        -- One startup recheck only. Older versions used several delayed passes
        -- on every execution, which accumulated after script re-runs and caused
        -- FPS drops/freezes.
        task.defer(function()
            task.wait(1.0)
            reapplyBatV20()
        end)

        if _G.__LonelyV20BatRespawnConn then
            pcall(function() _G.__LonelyV20BatRespawnConn:Disconnect() end)
            _G.__LonelyV20BatRespawnConn = nil
        end
        _G.__LonelyV20BatRespawnConn = LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
            task.delay(0.45, reapplyBatV20)
        end)

        -- 6) If the Bat skin is changed, immediately save ALL config and
        -- rebuild the selected replica.
        if type(_G.AmbitiousSetCustomToolSkin) == "function"
            and not _G.__LonelyV20BatSetter then
            _G.__LonelyV20BatSetter = true
            local oldSet = _G.AmbitiousSetCustomToolSkin
            _G.AmbitiousSetCustomToolSkin = function(cat, key)
                local ok, result = pcall(oldSet, cat, key)
                if ok then
                    pcall(function()
                        if cat == "Bat" then
                            _G.AmbitiousCustomToolSkins = _G.AmbitiousCustomToolSkins or {}
                            _G.AmbitiousCustomToolSkins.Bat = key
                        end
                        if saveAdaptConfig then saveAdaptConfig() end
                        if saveAmbitiousConfig then saveAmbitiousConfig() end
                    end)
                    task.defer(reapplyBatV20)
                end
                return ok and result
            end
        end
    end)

    if not okPatch then
        warn("[Lonely v20] User fix patch failed during initialization")
    end
end

    if type(tween) ~= "function" then

        end)
      end
    end
    if type(stroke) ~= "function" then

      end
    end
    if type(corner) ~= "function" then

        c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, r or 8)

    if type(baseRow) ~= "function" then
      function baseRow(parent, name, order)

        lab.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        lab.TextSize = 12
        lab.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        lab.Size = UDim2.new(1, -50, 1, 0)
        lab.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 0)
        lab.ZIndex = 6

        pcall(function()
          local c = Instance.new("UICorner"); c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,9); c.Parent = row

    end
    -- Avoid double-init
    
    if type(_G._AmbitiousExpandAuto) ~= "function" then
      _G._AmbitiousExpandAuto = function(holder, open, layout, arrow)
        if not holder or not holder.Parent then return end
        holder.ClipsDescendants = true
        if open then
          holder.Visible = true

          if layout and layout.AbsoluteContentSize then

          holder.Visible = false

    if Settings:FindFirstChild("Avatar Changer") then return end


-- ===== AVATAR CHANGER =====
  do
    -- ---- Stato persistente ----
    _G._AmbitiousAvatarChanger = {
      Hair     = { enabled=false, savedId=nil, savedName="" },
      Hats     = { enabled=false, savedId=nil, savedName="" },
      Face     = { enabled=false, savedId=nil, savedName="" },
      Neck     = { enabled=false, savedId=nil, savedName="" },
      Shoulder = { enabled=false, savedId=nil, savedName="" },
      Front    = { enabled=false, savedId=nil, savedName="" },
      Back     = { enabled=false, savedId=nil, savedName="" },
      Waist    = { enabled=false, savedId=nil, savedName="" },
      Shirts   = { enabled=false, savedId=nil, savedName="" },
      Pants    = { enabled=false, savedId=nil, savedName="" },
      ["T-Shirts"] = { enabled=false, savedId=nil, savedName="" },
      Jackets  = { enabled=false, savedId=nil, savedName="" },
      Sweaters = { enabled=false, savedId=nil, savedName="" },
      Bottoms  = { enabled=false, savedId=nil, savedName="" },
    }
    -- Applica i dati caricati dal config se presenti
    if type(_G._AmbitiousAvatarChangerPending) == "table" then
      for k,v in pairs(_G._AmbitiousAvatarChangerPending) do
        if _G._AmbitiousAvatarChanger[k] then
          _G._AmbitiousAvatarChanger[k].enabled   = v.enabled == true
          _G._AmbitiousAvatarChanger[k].savedId   = tonumber(v.savedId)
          _G._AmbitiousAvatarChanger[k].savedName = tostring(v.savedName or "")
        end
      end
      _G._AmbitiousAvatarChangerPending = nil
    end

    local AC_CATEGORIES = {
      { Name="Hair",     AssetTypes={Enum.AvatarAssetType.HairAccessory} },
      { Name="Hats",     AssetTypes={Enum.AvatarAssetType.Hat} },
      { Name="Face",     AssetTypes={Enum.AvatarAssetType.FaceAccessory} },
      { Name="Neck",     AssetTypes={Enum.AvatarAssetType.NeckAccessory} },
      { Name="Shoulder", AssetTypes={Enum.AvatarAssetType.ShoulderAccessory} },
      { Name="Front",    AssetTypes={Enum.AvatarAssetType.FrontAccessory} },
      { Name="Back",     AssetTypes={Enum.AvatarAssetType.BackAccessory} },
      { Name="Waist",    AssetTypes={Enum.AvatarAssetType.WaistAccessory} },
      { Name="Shirts",   AssetTypes={Enum.AvatarAssetType.Shirt} },
      { Name="Pants",    AssetTypes={Enum.AvatarAssetType.Pants} },
      { Name="T-Shirts", AssetTypes={Enum.AvatarAssetType.TShirt} },
      { Name="Jackets",  AssetTypes={Enum.AvatarAssetType.JacketAccessory} },
      { Name="Sweaters", AssetTypes={Enum.AvatarAssetType.SweaterAccessory} },
      { Name="Bottoms",  AssetTypes={Enum.AvatarAssetType.ShortsAccessory} },
    }

    -- ---- Equip ----
    -- Generazione: cresce ad ogni respawn. Serve ad abortire gli equip
    -- rimasti in sospeso su un character ormai vecchio.
    local _acGen = 0
    -- Cache dei template scaricati: il watcher puo' riapplicare un item
    -- molte volte, senza cache ogni volta sarebbe una richiesta di rete.
    local _acAssetCache = {}

    -- Usa l'helper condiviso definito in cima allo script
    local _acWaitCharReady = _G._AmbitiousWaitCharReady

    -- Ritorna true solo se l'item e' stato davvero applicato.
    local function _acEquipItem(itemId, itemType, itemName, gen)
      if not itemId then return false end
      if gen == nil then gen = _acGen end
      local ok, applied = pcall(function()
        local objects
        local cached = _acAssetCache[itemId]
        if cached then
          objects = { cached:Clone() }
        else
          objects = game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://"..tostring(itemId))
          if objects and objects[1] then
            _acAssetCache[itemId] = objects[1]:Clone()
          end
        end
        -- GetObjects fa una richiesta di rete: nel frattempo il character
        -- puo' essere cambiato, quindi si rilegge adesso e non prima.
        if gen ~= _acGen then return false end
        local character = LP.Character
        if not character or not character.Parent then return false end
        if not _acWaitCharReady(character, 5) then return false end
        if gen ~= _acGen then return false end
        if not objects or #objects==0 then return false end
          local item = objects[1]
          if item:IsA("Folder") or item:IsA("Model") then
            local core = item:FindFirstChildOfClass("Accessory")
              or item:FindFirstChildOfClass("Shirt")
              or item:FindFirstChildOfClass("Pants")
              or item:FindFirstChildOfClass("ShirtGraphic")
            if core then item=core end
          end
          if item:IsA("Shirt") then
            for _,c in pairs(character:GetChildren()) do if c:IsA("Shirt") then c:Destroy() end end
            item.Name="ACShirt"; item.Parent=character; return true
          elseif item:IsA("Pants") then
            for _,c in pairs(character:GetChildren()) do if c:IsA("Pants") then c:Destroy() end end
            item.Name="ACPants"; item.Parent=character; return true
          elseif item:IsA("ShirtGraphic") then
            for _,c in pairs(character:GetChildren()) do if c:IsA("ShirtGraphic") then c:Destroy() end end
            item.Name="ACTShirt"; item.Parent=character; return true
          end
          if item:IsA("Accessory") then
            local handle=item:FindFirstChild("Handle")
            if handle then
              if itemType==Enum.AvatarAssetType.HairAccessory then
                for _,c in pairs(character:GetChildren()) do
                  if c:IsA("Accessory") and (c.Name:lower():find("hair") or (c:FindFirstChild("Handle") and c.Handle:FindFirstChild("HairAttachment"))) then c:Destroy() end
                end
              else
                for _,c in pairs(character:GetChildren()) do
                  if c:IsA("Accessory") and (c.Name==itemName or c.Name=="AC"..itemName) then c:Destroy() end
                end
              end
              local attachment=handle:FindFirstChildOfClass("Attachment")
              local targetPart=character:FindFirstChild("Head")
              local targetAttachment=nil
              if attachment then
                for _,bodyPart in pairs(character:GetChildren()) do
                  if bodyPart:IsA("BasePart") then
                    targetAttachment=bodyPart:FindFirstChild(attachment.Name)
                    if targetAttachment then targetPart=bodyPart; break end
                  end
                end
              end
              -- Senza un punto di aggancio valido il weld esplode: meglio
              -- fallire pulito e lasciare che il retry ci riprovi.
              if not targetPart then
                targetPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
              end
              if not targetPart then return false end
              item.Name="AC"..itemName; item.Parent=character
              handle.CFrame=targetPart.CFrame
              for _,j in pairs(handle:GetChildren()) do
                if j:IsA("Weld") or j:IsA("ManualWeld") or j:IsA("WeldConstraint") then j:Destroy() end
              end
              local w=Instance.new("Weld")
              w.Name="ACManualWeld"; w.Part0=handle; w.Part1=targetPart
              if attachment and targetAttachment then w.C0=attachment.CFrame; w.C1=targetAttachment.CFrame
              else w.C0=CFrame.new(0,0.5,0) end
              w.Parent=handle
              return true
            end
          end
          return false
      end)
      return ok and applied == true
    end

    -- ---- Rimuovi item dal character ----
    local function _acRemoveItem(itemType, itemName)
      local character = LP.Character
      if not character then return end
      pcall(function()
        if itemType == Enum.AvatarAssetType.Shirt then
          for _,c in pairs(character:GetChildren()) do
            if c:IsA("Shirt") and (c.Name=="ACShirt" or c.Name==itemName) then c:Destroy() end
          end
        elseif itemType == Enum.AvatarAssetType.Pants then
          for _,c in pairs(character:GetChildren()) do
            if c:IsA("Pants") and (c.Name=="ACPants" or c.Name==itemName) then c:Destroy() end
          end
        elseif itemType == Enum.AvatarAssetType.TShirt then
          for _,c in pairs(character:GetChildren()) do
            if c:IsA("ShirtGraphic") and (c.Name=="ACTShirt" or c.Name==itemName) then c:Destroy() end
          end
        else
          -- Accessory: rimuovi per nome salvato
          for _,c in pairs(character:GetChildren()) do
            if c:IsA("Accessory") and (c.Name=="AC"..itemName or c.Name==itemName) then c:Destroy() end
          end
        end
      end)
    end

    -- ---- Save/Load separato ----
    local function _acSaveConfig()
      pcall(saveAmbitiousConfig)
    end

    -- (load avviene in loadAmbitiousConfig, già eseguita prima di questo blocco)

    -- Applica tutti gli item con toggle ON
    local function _acApplyAll(gen)
      if gen == nil then gen = _acGen end
      -- Si aspetta che il character sia completo PRIMA di iniziare:
      -- l'attesa a tempo fisso era la causa degli item saltati al reset.
      local character = LP.Character
      if not character then return end
      if not _acWaitCharReady(character, 10) then return end
      if gen ~= _acGen then return end

      for _,cat in ipairs(AC_CATEGORIES) do
        if gen ~= _acGen then return end   -- respawn nel frattempo: si abortisce
        local entry=_G._AmbitiousAvatarChanger[cat.Name]
        if entry and entry.enabled and entry.savedId then
          -- Fino a 3 tentativi: se l'asset tarda o il weld non trova
          -- l'attachment, si riprova invece di perdere l'item.
          for attempt = 1, 3 do
            if gen ~= _acGen then return end
            if _acEquipItem(entry.savedId, cat.AssetTypes[1], entry.savedName, gen) then
              break
            end
            task.wait(0.25 * attempt)
          end
          task.wait(0.05)
        end
      end
    end

    -- Applica subito al personaggio esistente se c'e' un char e toggle ON
    task.spawn(function()
      if not LP.Character then return end
      _acApplyAll(_acGen)
    end)

    -- Applica al respawn
    LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
      _acGen = _acGen + 1          -- invalida gli equip del character precedente
      local gen = _acGen
      task.spawn(function()
        _acApplyAll(gen)
      end)
    end)

    -- ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- WATCHER RE-EQUIP
    -- Gli item dell'Avatar Changer sono locali: quando un altro giocatore
    -- ti colpisce (o il gioco risincronizza il character) il server li
    -- cancella e restavi senza capelli. Qui vengono rimessi subito,
    -- sia per evento (ChildRemoved / HealthChanged) sia con un poll di
    -- sicurezza ogni secondo.
    -- ------------------------------------------------------------
    ;(function()
      local lastTry   = {}
      local fails     = {}
      local charConns = {}
      local pendingCheck = false

      -- Gli eventi (HealthChanged soprattutto) possono arrivare a raffica:
      -- qui vengono compattati in un solo controllo.
      local runCheck
      local function requestCheck(delaySec)
        if pendingCheck then return end
        pendingCheck = true
        task.delay(delaySec or 0.1, function()
          pendingCheck = false
          pcall(runCheck)
        end)
      end

      local function expectedFor(cat, entry)
        local at = cat.AssetTypes[1]
        if at == Enum.AvatarAssetType.Shirt then
          return "ACShirt", "Shirt"
        elseif at == Enum.AvatarAssetType.Pants then
          return "ACPants", "Pants"
        elseif at == Enum.AvatarAssetType.TShirt then
          return "ACTShirt", "ShirtGraphic"
        end
        return "AC"..tostring(entry.savedName or ""), "Accessory"
      end

      local function isPresent(character, cat, entry)
        local nm, cls = expectedFor(cat, entry)
        for _, c in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
          if c:IsA(cls) and (c.Name == nm or c.Name == entry.savedName) then
            return true
          end
        end
        return false
      end

      function runCheck()
        local character = LP.Character
        if not character or not character.Parent then return end
        local hum = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum and hum.Health <= 0 then return end
        local now = tick()
        for _, cat in ipairs(AC_CATEGORIES) do
          local entry = _G._AmbitiousAvatarChanger[cat.Name]
          if entry and entry.enabled and entry.savedId then
            if isPresent(character, cat, entry) then
              fails[cat.Name] = nil
            else
              -- Backoff: se un asset non si applica (id rotto, attachment
              -- assente) non si riprova all'infinito ogni 0.6s.
              local n = fails[cat.Name] or 0
              local wait = math.min(0.6 * (2 ^ math.min(n, 5)), 20)
              if (now - (lastTry[cat.Name] or 0)) > wait then
                lastTry[cat.Name] = now
                local gen = _acGen
                local _cn = cat.Name
                local _id, _at, _nm = entry.savedId, cat.AssetTypes[1], entry.savedName
                task.spawn(function()
                  if gen ~= _acGen then return end
                  if _acEquipItem(_id, _at, _nm, gen) then
                    fails[_cn] = nil
                  else
                    fails[_cn] = (fails[_cn] or 0) + 1
                  end
                end)
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
      _G._AmbitiousAvatarChangerRecheck = function() fails = {}; pcall(runCheck) end

      local function hookCharacter(character)
        for _, c in ipairs(charConns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
        charConns = {}
        if not character then return end
        table.insert(charConns, character.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(child)
          if child:IsA("Accessory") or child:IsA("Shirt")
          or child:IsA("Pants") or child:IsA("ShirtGraphic") then
            requestCheck(0.05)
          end
        end))
        local hum = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum then
          -- Il caso segnalato: colpito da un altro player -> accessori persi
          table.insert(charConns, hum.HealthChanged:Connect(function()
            requestCheck(0.15)
          end))
        end
      end

      hookCharacter(LP.Character)
      LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(c)
        task.delay(0.6, function() hookCharacter(c) end)
      end)

      task.spawn(function()
        while true do
          task.wait(1)
          pcall(runCheck)
        end
      end)
    end)()

    -- ---- Visual callbacks sub-toggle ----
    local _acSubSetVisuals = {}

    -- ---- Unico popup condiviso ----
    local _acPickerGui = nil
    -- Categoria del popup attualmente aperto: serve per il toggle sul riclick
    local _acPickerCat = nil
    -- Il backdrop e' un Frame e non assorbe il click, quindi cliccando un PICK
    -- mentre il popup e' aperto arrivano DUE eventi in quest'ordine:
    --   1) backdrop.InputBegan -> chiude il popup
    --   2) pickBtn.Activated   -> lo trovava gia' chiuso e lo riapriva
    -- Ricordiamo cosa e' stato appena chiuso per ignorare il secondo evento.
    local _acPickerJustClosedCat = nil
    local _acPickerJustClosedAt = 0

    local function _acClosePicker()
      if _acPickerGui and _acPickerGui.Parent then
        _acPickerGui:Destroy()
        _acPickerJustClosedCat = _acPickerCat
        _acPickerJustClosedAt = tick()
      end
      _acPickerGui = nil
      _acPickerCat = nil
    end

    local function _acOpenPicker(catName, assetTypes)
      -- Riclick sullo stesso PICK: chiude, come fanno gli altri picker.
      -- Click su un PICK diverso: passa a quella categoria.
      if _acPickerGui and _acPickerGui.Parent and _acPickerCat == catName then
        _acClosePicker()
        return
      end
      -- Il backdrop ha appena chiuso questo stesso popup: non riaprirlo.
      if _acPickerJustClosedCat == catName and (tick() - _acPickerJustClosedAt) < 0.25 then
        _acPickerJustClosedCat = nil
        return
      end
      _acClosePicker()
      _acPickerJustClosedCat = nil
      _acPickerCat = catName

      _acPickerGui=Instance.new("ScreenGui")
      _acPickerGui.Name="AmbitiousHubAVChanger"
      _acPickerGui.ResetOnSpawn=false
      _acPickerGui.IgnoreGuiInset=true
      _acPickerGui.ZIndexBehavior=Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
      _acPickerGui.DisplayOrder=9998
      _acPickerGui.Parent=HubGui

      -- Frame (non TextButton) come tutti gli altri picker: un TextButton
      -- catturerebbe l'input e i bottoni sotto smetterebbero di ricevere
      -- MouseLeave, restando bloccati nello stato hover.

      backdrop.Name="Backdrop"
      backdrop.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,1,0)
      backdrop.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0)
      backdrop.BackgroundTransparency=0.45
      backdrop.BorderSizePixel=0
      backdrop.ZIndex=1
      backdrop.Parent=_acPickerGui

      pickerFrame.Size=UDim2.new(0,370,0,510)
      pickerFrame.Position=UDim2.new(0.5,-185,0.5,-255)

      closeBtn.Text="X"
      closeBtn.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)

      closeBtn.TextSize=14
      closeBtn.AutoButtonColor=false
      closeBtn.ZIndex=4
      closeBtn.Parent=titleBar

      stroke(closeBtn,Color3.fromRGB(90,90,105),1,0.4)
      closeBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function() tween(closeBtn,{BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(180,50,50)},0.12) end)
      closeBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function() tween(closeBtn,{BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(25,25,28)},0.12) end)

      local function makeItemCard(item)
        itemOrder=itemOrder+1
        local card=Instance.new("TextButton")
        card.Name="AC_Item_"..tostring(item.Id)
        card.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(16,16,20)
        card.BackgroundTransparency=0.05

        nameLabel.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
        nameLabel.TextYAlignment=Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
        nameLabel.ZIndex=5
        nameLabel.Parent=card

        card.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
          tween(card,{BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(30,30,38)},0.1)
          tween(cardStroke,{Color=Color3.fromRGB(200,200,210),Transparency=0.15},0.1)
        end)
        card.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
          -- ripristina colore normale (verde=selezionato gia' equipaggiato)
          local entry=_G._AmbitiousAvatarChanger[catName]
          local isSaved = entry and entry.savedId == item.Id
          tween(card,{BackgroundColor3=isSaved and Color3.fromRGB(20,36,20) or Color3.fromRGB(16,16,20)},0.1)
          tween(cardStroke,{Color=isSaved and Color3.fromRGB(120,220,120) or Color3.fromRGB(50,50,62),Transparency=isSaved and 0.15 or 0.5},0.1)
        end)

        -- Evidenzia se gia' salvato
        local entry=_G._AmbitiousAvatarChanger[catName]
        if entry and entry.savedId == item.Id then
          card.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(20,36,20)
          cardStroke.Color=Color3.fromRGB(120,220,120)
          cardStroke.Transparency=0.15
        end

        card.Activated:Connect(function()
          local ent=_G._AmbitiousAvatarChanger[catName]
          if not ent then return end
          -- Se toggle ON e c'era un vecchio item, rimuovilo prima
          if ent.enabled and ent.savedId and ent.savedName ~= "" then
            _acRemoveItem(assetTypes[1], ent.savedName)
          end
          ent.savedId=item.Id
          ent.savedName=item.Name or ""
          if ent.enabled then
            local _id, _at, _nm = item.Id, assetTypes[1], item.Name or ""
            task.spawn(function() _acEquipItem(_id,_at,_nm) end)
          end

              tween(ch,{BackgroundColor3=isThis and Color3.fromRGB(20,36,20) or Color3.fromRGB(16,16,20)},0.14)
              if st2 then tween(st2,{Color=isThis and Color3.fromRGB(120,220,120) or Color3.fromRGB(50,50,62),Transparency=isThis and 0.15 or 0.5},0.14) end
            end
          end
        end)
      end

      local function loadItems(keyword)
        for _,c in ipairs(scrollFrame:GetChildren()) do if c:IsA("TextButton") then c:Destroy() end end
        itemOrder=0
        currentCatalogPage=nil
        loadingMore=false
        statusLabel.Text="Loading..."
        statusLabel.Visible=true
        task.spawn(function()
          local ok,pages2=pcall(function()
            local params=CatalogSearchParams.new()
            params.AssetTypes=assetTypes
            if keyword and keyword~="" then params.SearchKeyword=keyword end
            return game:GetService("AvatarEditorService"):SearchCatalog(params)
          end)
          if not ok or not pages2 then statusLabel.Text="Error loading."; return end
          currentCatalogPage=pages2
          local firstPage=pages2:GetCurrentPage()
          statusLabel.Visible=#firstPage==0
          statusLabel.Text=#firstPage==0 and "No results." or ""
          for _,item in ipairs(firstPage) do makeItemCard(item) end
        end)
      end

      scrollFrame:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CanvasPosition"):Connect(function()
        if loadingMore or not currentCatalogPage then return end
        local posY=scrollFrame.CanvasPosition.Y
        local canvasH=scrollFrame.CanvasSize.Y.Offset
        local viewH=scrollFrame.AbsoluteSize.Y
        if canvasH>0 and posY+viewH>=canvasH-100 and not currentCatalogPage.IsFinished then
          loadingMore=true
          task.spawn(function()
            local ok2=pcall(function() currentCatalogPage:AdvanceToNextPageAsync() end)
            if ok2 then
              for _,item in ipairs(currentCatalogPage:GetCurrentPage()) do makeItemCard(item) end
            end
            loadingMore=false
          end)
        end
      end)

      local searchDebounce=nil
      searchBar:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
        if searchDebounce then task.cancel(searchDebounce) end
        searchDebounce=task.delay(0.5,function() loadItems(searchBar.Text) end)
      end)

      backdrop.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
          _acClosePicker()
        end
      end)

      pickerFrame.Position=UDim2.new(0.5,0,0.5,0)

        Size=UDim2.new(0,370,0,510),
        Position=UDim2.new(0.5,-185,0.5,-255)
      }):Play()

      loadItems("")
    end

      knob.Size=UDim2.new(0,16,0,16)

      knob.ZIndex=7

      corner(knob,999)
      local knobStroke=Instance.new("UIStroke")
      knobStroke.ApplyStrokeMode=Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
      knobStroke.Color=entry.enabled and Color3.fromRGB(216, 180, 254) or Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 135)

          Color=on and _onEdge or Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 135)
        })
        tween(trackStroke,{
          Color=on and _onEdge or COLORS.strokeSoft,
          Transparency=on and 0 or 0.4,
          Thickness=1.4
        })
        tween(subRowStroke,{
          Color=on and _onBg or COLORS.strokeSoft,
          Transparency=on and 0.08 or 0.38,
          Thickness=1.25
        })
      end
      _acSubSetVisuals[catName]=subSetVisual
      subSetVisual(entry.enabled)

      -- ToggleButton invisibile sopra la track (esattamente come toggleRow)
      local toggleBtn=Instance.new("TextButton")
      toggleBtn.Name="ToggleButton"
      toggleBtn.BackgroundTransparency=1
      toggleBtn.Text=""
      toggleBtn.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,1,0)
      toggleBtn.Position=UDim2.new(0,0,0,0)
      toggleBtn.AutoButtonColor=false
      toggleBtn.ZIndex=7
      toggleBtn.Parent=subRow

      do
        local _cn=catName
        local _cat=catAssetTypes
        toggleBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
          local ent=_G._AmbitiousAvatarChanger[_cn]
          if not ent then return end
          ent.enabled=not ent.enabled
          subSetVisual(ent.enabled)
          if ent.enabled and ent.savedId then
            local _id, _at, _nm = ent.savedId, _cat[1], ent.savedName
            task.spawn(function() _acEquipItem(_id,_at,_nm) end)
          else
            -- Toggle OFF: rimuovi item dal personaggio
            if ent.savedId then
              _acRemoveItem(_cat[1],ent.savedName)
            end
          end
          _acSaveConfig()
        end)
      end

      -- PICK button stile Tracker Color (holder scuro + testo bianco)
      local pickHolder=Instance.new("Frame")
      pickHolder.Name="PickHolder"
      pickHolder.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(147, 51, 234)
      pickHolder.BackgroundTransparency=0.28
      pickHolder.BorderSizePixel=0
      pickHolder.Size=UDim2.new(0,48,0,26)
      pickHolder.Position=UDim2.new(1,-118,0.5,-13)
      pickHolder.ClipsDescendants=true
      pickHolder.ZIndex=8
      pickHolder.Parent=subRow
      corner(pickHolder,13)
      stroke(pickHolder,Color3.fromRGB(216, 180, 254),1.5,0.15)

      local pickGradAc = Instance.new("UIGradient")
      pickGradAc.Color = ColorSequence.new({
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(202, 148, 255)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(147, 51, 234)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(101, 31, 190)),
      })
      pickGradAc.Rotation = 18
      pickGradAc.Parent = pickHolder
      _G._AmbitiousRegAccent(pickHolder, pickGradAc, "pick")

      local pickBtn=Instance.new("TextButton")
      pickBtn.Name="PickBtn"
      pickBtn.BackgroundTransparency=1
      pickBtn.Text="PICK"
      pickBtn.TextColor3=COLORS.white
      pickBtn.TextStrokeColor3=Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0)
      pickBtn.TextStrokeTransparency=0.3
      pickBtn.TextSize=11
      pickBtn.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBlack
      pickBtn.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
      pickBtn.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,1,0)
      pickBtn.Position=UDim2.new(0,0,0,0)
      pickBtn.BorderSizePixel=0
      pickBtn.ZIndex=9
      pickBtn.AutoButtonColor=false
      pickBtn.Parent=pickHolder

      pickBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        tween(pickHolder, {Size = UDim2.new(0, 54, 0, 28), Position = UDim2.new(1, -121, 0.5, -14)}, 0.12)
      end)
      pickBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        tween(pickHolder, {Size = UDim2.new(0, 48, 0, 26), Position = UDim2.new(1, -118, 0.5, -13)}, 0.12)
      end)

      do
        local _cn2=catName
        local _cat2=catAssetTypes
        pickBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
          _acOpenPicker(_cn2,_cat2)
        end)
      end
    end

    -- ---- Toggle espansione freccia ----
    local acExpanded=false
    local function acSetExpanded(on)
      acExpanded=on
      -- Animazione a tendina + freccia che ruota, come Infinite Jump / Anti Ragdoll.
      -- Usa la variante Auto perche' il sub holder ha AutomaticSize.Y (14 sub-righe).
      _G._AmbitiousExpandAuto(acSubHolder, on, acSubLayout, acArrowBtn)
      _G._AmbitiousClampCanvas(Utility)
    end
    acArrowBtn.Activated:Connect(function() acSetExpanded(not acExpanded) end)

    -- ---- Hook Reset All Settings ----
    _G._AmbitiousAvatarChangerReset=function()
      for _,cat in ipairs(AC_CATEGORIES) do
        local entry=_G._AmbitiousAvatarChanger[cat.Name]
        if entry then
          -- Rimuovi subito dal personaggio se era attivo
          if entry.enabled and entry.savedId then
            _acRemoveItem(cat.AssetTypes[1], entry.savedName)
          end
          entry.enabled=false; entry.savedId=nil; entry.savedName=""
          if _acSubSetVisuals[cat.Name] then _acSubSetVisuals[cat.Name](false) end
        end
      end
      _acSaveConfig()
    end
  end -- fine Avatar Changer

  do
    local rowH, setVisualH = toggleRow(Utility, "Enable Headless", headlessEnabled, 12)
    _SV.setHeadlessVisual = setVisualH
    local _headlessBtn = rowH and rowH:FindFirstChild("ToggleButton")
    if _headlessBtn then
      _headlessBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
        if headlessEnabled then disableHeadless() else enableHeadless() end
        if setVisualH then setVisualH(headlessEnabled) end
        saveAmbitiousConfig()
      end)
    end
  end
  do
    local rowK, setVisualK = toggleRow(Utility, "Enable Korblox", korbloxEnabled, 12)
    _SV.setKorbloxVisual = setVisualK
    local _korbloxBtn = rowK and rowK:FindFirstChild("ToggleButton")
    if _korbloxBtn then
      _korbloxBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
        if korbloxEnabled then disableKorblox() else enableKorblox() end
        if setVisualK then setVisualK(korbloxEnabled) end
        saveAmbitiousConfig()
      end)
    end
  end

  -- ===== TOOLS (TRANSPARENT, CUSTOM) =====
  -- section skipped (Settings)
-- section(Utility, "TOOLS", 12)

  

  end)
  if not okAll then
    warn("[Lonely Avatar Changer] init failed: ", errAll)
  end
end)


-- ============================================================
-- [v21.1] OPEN labels + picker parent fix
-- Isolated; does not rewrite other menu/button logic.
-- ============================================================
task.defer(function()
  pcall(function()
    -- Force remaining PICK labels on Settings-related pick holders to OPEN (white)
    local pg = LP and LP:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
    local function relabel(root)
      if not root then return end
      for _,d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
        if d:IsA("TextButton") then
          local n = tostring(d.Name or ""):lower()
          if d.Text == "PICK" or (n:find("pick") and d.Text == "PICK") then
            d.Text = "OPEN"
            d.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
          end
        end
      end
    end
    task.wait(1.5)
    if pages and pages.SETTINGS then relabel(pages.SETTINGS) end
    if pg then relabel(pg) end
  end)
end)

-- LONELY / AMBITIOUS FINAL REQUEST PATCH v23
-- Ragdoll -> Ambitious Bat/Body-Lock bridge -> one bat activation -> release.
-- No standalone "Look At My Base" feature is created.
do
    -- Ambitious Vivid state + full local lighting effect bridge.
    _G._AmbitiousVivid = _G._AmbitiousVivid or {
        saturation=0.6,
        bloomIntensity=0.8,
        bloomSize=24,
        sunIntensity=0.2,
        dofFocus=25,
    }
    vividGraphicsEnabled = vividGraphicsEnabled == true
    local vividContrastTask=nil
    function enableVividGraphics()
        vividGraphicsEnabled=true
        for _,e in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
            if e:GetAttribute("_AmbitiousVivid") then pcall(function() e:Destroy() end) end
        end
        local c=Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect")
        c:SetAttribute("_AmbitiousVivid",true); c.Saturation=_G._AmbitiousVivid.saturation; c.Contrast=0.4; c.Brightness=0.05; c.TintColor=Color3.fromRGB(255,240,220); c.Parent=Lighting
        local b=Instance.new("BloomEffect")
        b:SetAttribute("_AmbitiousVivid",true); b.Intensity=_G._AmbitiousVivid.bloomIntensity; b.Size=_G._AmbitiousVivid.bloomSize; b.Threshold=1; b.Parent=Lighting
        local a=Instance.new("Atmosphere")
        a:SetAttribute("_AmbitiousVivid",true); a.Density=0.3; a.Offset=0.25; a.Color=Color3.fromRGB(199,199,255); a.Decay=Color3.fromRGB(106,112,125); a.Glare=0.2; a.Haze=1; a.Parent=Lighting
        local sun=Instance.new("SunRaysEffect")
        sun:SetAttribute("_AmbitiousVivid",true); sun.Intensity=_G._AmbitiousVivid.sunIntensity; sun.Spread=0.8; sun.Parent=Lighting
        local dof=Instance.new("DepthOfFieldEffect")
        dof:SetAttribute("_AmbitiousVivid",true); dof.FocusDistance=_G._AmbitiousVivid.dofFocus; dof.InFocusRadius=10; dof.NearIntensity=0.2; dof.FarIntensity=0.4; dof.Parent=Lighting
        if vividContrastTask then pcall(function() task.cancel(vividContrastTask) end) end
        vividContrastTask=task.spawn(function()
            while vividGraphicsEnabled do
                if c.Parent then c.Contrast=0.35+math.sin(tick()*2)*0.05 end
                task.wait(0.03)
            end
        end)
    end
    function disableVividGraphics()
        vividGraphicsEnabled=false
        if vividContrastTask then pcall(function() task.cancel(vividContrastTask) end); vividContrastTask=nil end
        for _,e in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
            if e:GetAttribute("_AmbitiousVivid") then pcall(function() e:Destroy() end) end
        end
    end

    local vividRow = Utility and Utility:FindFirstChild("Vivid Graphics")
    if not vividRow and Utility then
        vividRow = toggleRow(Utility,"Vivid Graphics",vividGraphicsEnabled,8)
    end
    local vividToggle = vividRow and vividRow:FindFirstChild("ToggleButton")
    if vividToggle then
        vividToggle.Activated:Connect(function()
            if vividGraphicsEnabled then disableVividGraphics() else enableVividGraphics() end
            local setter=vividRow and vividRow:FindFirstChild("_SetVisual")
            if setter and setter:IsA("BindableFunction") then pcall(function() setter:Invoke(vividGraphicsEnabled) end) end
            if saveAmbitiousConfig then pcall(saveAmbitiousConfig) end
        end)
    end
    if vividGraphicsEnabled then pcall(enableVividGraphics) end

    -- ================================================================
    -- 1) VIVID GRAPHICS: V selector, straight mode strip + rotate tween
    -- ================================================================
    task.defer(function()
        task.wait(0.8)
        pcall(function()
            local row = Utility and Utility:FindFirstChild("Vivid Graphics")
            if not row then return end

            local old = row:FindFirstChild("VividChangerArrow", true)
            if old then old:Destroy() end
            local oldHolder = Utility:FindFirstChild("Vivid Graphics Changer")
            if oldHolder then oldHolder:Destroy() end

            local arrow = Instance.new("TextButton")
            arrow.Name = "VividChangerArrow"
            arrow.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(8,8,12)
            arrow.BackgroundTransparency = 0.18
            arrow.BorderSizePixel = 0
            arrow.Size = UDim2.new(0,38,0,26)
            arrow.Position = UDim2.new(1,-155,0.5,-13)
            arrow.Text = "V"
            arrow.TextColor3 = COLORS.white
            arrow.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0)
            arrow.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.3
            arrow.TextSize = 15
            arrow.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
            arrow.AutoButtonColor = false
            arrow.ZIndex = 30
            arrow.Parent = row
            corner(arrow,7)
            stroke(arrow,COLORS.strokeSoft,1,0.35)

            local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
            holder.Name = "Vivid Graphics Changer"
            holder.BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.row
            holder.BackgroundTransparency = 0.28
            holder.BorderSizePixel = 0
