            holder.Size = UDim2.new(1,-4,0,0)
            holder.ClipsDescendants = true
            holder.Visible = false
            holder.LayoutOrder = (row.LayoutOrder or 8) + 0.1
            holder.ZIndex = 4
            holder.Parent = Utility
            corner(holder,14)
            stroke(holder,Color3.fromRGB(126,71,190),1.4,0.32)

            local strip = Instance.new("Frame")
            strip.Name = "VividModeStrip"
            strip.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            strip.Size = UDim2.new(1,-12,1,-8)
            strip.Position = UDim2.new(0,6,0,4)
            strip.ZIndex = 5
            strip.Parent = holder
            local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
            layout.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
            layout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
            layout.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center
            layout.Padding = UDim.new(0,5)
            layout.Parent = strip

            local modes = {
                {"SOFT",0.35,0.45,0.10},
                {"VIVID",0.60,0.80,0.20},
                {"MAX",1.00,1.20,0.35},
            }
            local expanded=false
            local busy=false
            local function setMode(i)
                local m=modes[i]
                if _G._AmbitiousVivid then
                    _G._AmbitiousVivid.saturation=m[2]
                    _G._AmbitiousVivid.bloomIntensity=m[3]
                    _G._AmbitiousVivid.sunIntensity=m[4]
                end
                if vividGraphicsEnabled and typeof(Lighting) == "Instance" then
                    for _,e in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
                        if e:GetAttribute("_AmbitiousVivid") then
                            if e:IsA("ColorCorrectionEffect") then e.Saturation=m[2]
                            elseif e:IsA("BloomEffect") then e.Intensity=m[3]
                            elseif e:IsA("SunRaysEffect") then e.Intensity=m[4] end
                        end
                    end
                end
                if saveAmbitiousConfig then pcall(saveAmbitiousConfig) end
            end
            for i,m in ipairs(modes) do
                local b=Instance.new("TextButton")
                b.Name="Mode_"..m[1]
                b.Size=UDim2.new(1/3,-4,1,0)
                b.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(147,51,234)
                b.BackgroundTransparency=0.28
                b.BorderSizePixel=0
                b.Text=m[1]
                b.TextColor3=COLORS.white
                b.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBlack
                b.TextSize=10
                b.AutoButtonColor=false
                b.ZIndex=8
                b.Parent=strip
                corner(b,9)
                stroke(b,Color3.fromRGB(216,180,254),1,0.2)
                b.Activated:Connect(function() setMode(i) end)
            end

            local function expand(on)
                expanded=on
                arrow.Text = "V"
                local target=expanded and 42 or 0
                tween(holder,{Size=UDim2.new(1,-4,0,target)},0.18)
                tween(arrow,{Rotation=expanded and 180 or 0},0.18)
                if expanded then holder.Visible=true
                else task.delay(0.2,function() if not expanded then holder.Visible=false end end) end
            end
            arrow.Activated:Connect(function()
                if busy then return end
                busy=true
                expand(not expanded)
                task.delay(0.2,function() busy=false end)
            end)
            arrow.Rotation=0
        end)
    end)

    -- ================================================================
    -- 2) RAGDOLL BAT 1X
    --    Uses Ambitious ragdoll detection + existing bat finder. If an
    --    Ambitious Body Lock bridge exists, it is used; otherwise the
    --    one-frame facing lock is only a compatibility fallback.
    -- ================================================================
    _G.AdaptRagdollBat1X = _G.AdaptRagdollBat1X or {running=false,was=false,conn=nil}
    local R=_G.AdaptRagdollBat1X

    local function releaseBodyLock()
        if _G.AmbitiousBodyLockStop then pcall(_G.AmbitiousBodyLockStop)
        elseif _G.AdaptBodyLockStop then pcall(_G.AdaptBodyLockStop)
        elseif _G._AmbitiousSetBodyLock then pcall(_G._AmbitiousSetBodyLock,false) end
    end
    local function startBodyLock(target)
        if _G.AmbitiousBodyLockStart then
            pcall(_G.AmbitiousBodyLockStart,target)
            return true
        elseif _G.AdaptBodyLockStart then
            pcall(_G.AdaptBodyLockStart,target)
            return true
        elseif _G._AmbitiousSetBodyLock then
            pcall(_G._AmbitiousSetBodyLock,true,target)
            return true
        end
        return false
    end

    local function activateOne()
        if R.running then return end
        R.running=true
        local char=LP.Character
        local root=char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local hum=char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local target=_G.AdaptGetNearestEnemy and _G.AdaptGetNearestEnemy() or nil
        local tr=target and target.Character and target.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not root or not hum or not target or not tr then R.running=false return end

        -- Ambitious Body Lock first; target has no distance limit.
        local usedAmbitiousLock=startBodyLock(target)
        if not usedAmbitiousLock then
            pcall(function()
                root.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(root.Position,Vector3.new(tr.Position.X,root.Position.Y,tr.Position.Z))
            end)
        end
        task.wait()

        local bat=_G.AdaptFindBatForCounter and _G.AdaptFindBatForCounter() or nil
        if bat and bat.Parent~=char then pcall(function() hum:EquipTool(bat) end); task.wait(0.05) end
        if bat then
            -- EXACTLY ONE activation. Do not call the existing double-swing helper.
            pcall(function() bat:Activate() end)
        end
        task.wait(0.10)
        releaseBodyLock()
        R.running=false
    end

    local function hookRagdoll(char)
        if R.conn then pcall(function() R.conn:Disconnect() end); R.conn=nil end
        R.was=false
        if not char then return end
        R.conn=RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            if not char.Parent then return end
            local hum=char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if not hum or hum.Health<=0 then R.was=false return end
            local rag=_G.AdaptCounterIsRagdollForBat and _G.AdaptCounterIsRagdollForBat(hum) or false
            if rag and not R.was then
                R.was=true
                task.spawn(activateOne)
            elseif not rag then
                R.was=false
            end
        end)
    end
    hookRagdoll(LP.Character)
    LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
        if R.running then R.running=false end
        releaseBodyLock()
        task.defer(function() hookRagdoll(char) end)
    end)

    LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
        task.wait(0.15)
        -- Rebind all currently-active character-dependent logic.
        if _G.AdaptNormalAimbotOn then
            pcall(_G.AdaptStartNormalAimbot)
        elseif _G.AdaptAntiDesyncAimbotOn and _G.AdaptStartAntiDesyncAimbot then
            pcall(_G.AdaptStartAntiDesyncAimbot)
        end

        if autoStealEnabled and _G.AdaptAutoStealSync then
            task.defer(function() pcall(_G.AdaptAutoStealSync) end)
        end
        if autoLeftEnabled and _G.AdaptStartAutoLeft then
            task.defer(function() pcall(_G.AdaptStartAutoLeft) end)
        end
        if autoRightEnabled and _G.AdaptStartAutoRight then
            task.defer(function() pcall(_G.AdaptStartAutoRight) end)
        end
        if medCounterEnabled and _G.AdaptStartMedCounter then
            task.defer(function() pcall(_G.AdaptStartMedCounter, char) end)
        end
        if batCounterEnabled and _G.AdaptStartBatCounter then
            task.defer(function() pcall(_G.AdaptStartBatCounter) end)
        end
        if hardHitEnabled and _G.AdaptStartHardHit then
            task.defer(function() pcall(_G.AdaptStartHardHit) end)
        end
        if _G.AdaptAntiResetEnabled and _G.AdaptSetAntiReset then
            task.defer(function() pcall(_G.AdaptSetAntiReset, true) end)
        end

        if _G.AdaptRefreshAimbotVisual then pcall(_G.AdaptRefreshAimbotVisual) end
        if _G.AdaptRefreshMobileButtonStates then pcall(_G.AdaptRefreshMobileButtonStates) end
        if _G.AdaptSyncToggleVisuals then pcall(_G.AdaptSyncToggleVisuals) end
    end)
end

-- ============================================================
-- V32 RESPAWN REBIND / EXTERNAL BUTTON WATCHDOG
-- Keeps external mobile buttons usable after Instant Reset.
-- Restores only the features that were already ON before reset.
-- ============================================================
task.spawn(function()
    local lastCharacter = LP.Character
    while task.wait(0.35) do
        local char = LP.Character
        if char ~= lastCharacter then
            lastCharacter = char
            if char then
                task.delay(0.55, function()
                    if LP.Character ~= char then return end

                    -- AUTO LEFT / RIGHT
                    if autoLeftEnabled == true and _G.AdaptStartAutoLeft then
                        pcall(_G.AdaptStartAutoLeft)
                    elseif autoRightEnabled == true and _G.AdaptStartAutoRight then
                        pcall(_G.AdaptStartAutoRight)
                    end

                    
                    if _G.AdaptAntiDesyncAimbotOn == true and _G.AdaptStartAntiDesyncAimbot then
                        pcall(_G.AdaptStartAntiDesyncAimbot)
                    end

                    -- ANTI ANTI TP
                    if _G.AdaptAntiTPBatEnabled == true and _G.AdaptAntiTPBat and _G.AdaptAntiTPBat.setEnabled then
                        pcall(_G.AdaptAntiTPBat.setEnabled, true, true)
                    end

                    -- INSTANT RESET: clear transient state only.
                    AdaptResetCooldown = false
                    AdaptResetThread = nil
                    AdaptResetCharacter = nil
                    AdaptCameraLocked = false
                    AdaptStopResetSequence = false

                    -- Re-sync the external buttons themselves.
                    pcall(function()
                        if mobileButtons then
                            if mobileButtons.autoLeft then mobileButtons.autoLeft.setActive(autoLeftEnabled == true) end
                            if mobileButtons.autoRight then mobileButtons.autoRight.setActive(autoRightEnabled == true) end
                            if mobileButtons.antiDesync then mobileButtons.antiDesync.setActive(_G.AdaptAntiDesyncAimbotOn == true) end
                            if mobileButtons.antiAntiTP then mobileButtons.antiAntiTP.setActive(_G.AdaptAntiTPBatEnabled == true) end
                            if mobileButtons.instaReset then mobileButtons.instaReset.setActive(false) end
                        end
                    end)
                end)
            end
        end

        -- If the executor/UI holder was recreated, restore the external GUI.
        if not mobileGui or not mobileGui.Parent then
            pcall(function()
                local pg = LP:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
                local existing = pg and pg:FindFirstChild("AdaptMobileButtons")
                if existing then
                    mobileGui = existing
                end
            end)
        end
    end
end)


-- ============================================================================
-- FINAL V-ARROW STYLE / EXPAND ANIMATION FIX
-- Copy the Aimbot arrow visual exactly, but DO NOT force all arrows into
-- one screen coordinate. Each arrow stays attached to its original row.
task.defer(function()
    task.wait(1.0)
    pcall(function()
        local all = {}

        local function addFrom(root)
            if not root then return end
            for _, d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
                if d:IsA("TextButton") then
                    local n = tostring(d.Name or ""):lower()
                    local tx = tostring(d.Text or "")
                    local likely =
                        (tx == "V" or tx == "v" or tx == "^")
                        and (
                            n:find("arrow", 1, true)
                            or n:find("expand", 1, true)
                            or n == "arrowbutton"
                            or n == "hidemobilearrow"
                            or n:find("modearrow", 1, true)
                        )
                    if likely then
                        table.insert(all, d)
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        addFrom(pages and pages.COMBAT)
        addFrom(pages and pages.MOVEMENT)
        addFrom(pages and (pages.SETTINGS or pages.Settings))
        addFrom(pages and (pages.VISUALS or pages.Visuals or pages.UTILITY or pages.Utility))
        addFrom(PlayerGui)

        local seen = {}
        for _, arrow in ipairs(all) do
            if not seen[arrow] then
                seen[arrow] = true

                -- EXACT Aimbot arrow visual.
                arrow.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(8, 8, 12)
                arrow.BackgroundTransparency = 0.18
                arrow.BorderSizePixel = 0
                arrow.TextColor3 = COLORS.white
                arrow.TextSize = 15
                arrow.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
                arrow.AutoButtonColor = false
                arrow.Size = UDim2.new(0, 38, 0, 26)
                arrow.ZIndex = math.max(arrow.ZIndex, 20)

                local c = arrow:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
                if not c then
                    c = Instance.new("UICorner")
                    c.Parent = arrow
                end
                c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 7)

                local st = arrow:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
                if not st then
                    st = Instance.new("UIStroke")
                    st.Parent = arrow
                end
                st.Color = COLORS.strokeSoft
                st.Thickness = 1.2
                st.Transparency = 0.25
                st.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border

                -- Keep every accordion arrow aligned to Auto Steal.
                -- Bat Aimbot is an inline accordion: its parent row grows when
                -- expanded, so the arrow MUST stay in the fixed 34px header
                -- instead of being vertically centered in the expanded row.
                local isInlineBatAim = false
                local parent = arrow.Parent
                if parent and parent.Name == "Aimbot" and parent:FindFirstChild("Bat Aimbot Mode Inline") then
                    isInlineBatAim = true
                end
                if isInlineBatAim then
                    arrow.Position = UDim2.new(1, -100, 0, 4)
                elseif arrow.Name == "ESPTrackerArrow" then
                    -- Show Tracker uses the same x-column as Auto Steal.
                    arrow.Position = UDim2.new(1, -100, 0.5, -13)
                else
                    arrow.Position = UDim2.new(1, -100, 0.5, -13)
                end

                local isOpen = (arrow.Text == "^")
                arrow.Rotation = isOpen and 180 or 0

                if not arrow:GetAttribute("LonelyAimbotVVisualBound") then
                    arrow:SetAttribute("LonelyAimbotVVisualBound", true)

                    arrow:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
                        local open = arrow.Text == "^"
                        TS:Create(
                            arrow,
                            TweenInfo.new(0.16, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                            {Rotation = open and 180 or 0}
                        ):Play()
                    end)

                    -- Bat Aim style press feedback: tiny dark/bright pulse.
                    arrow.Activated:Connect(function()
                        TS:Create(
                            arrow,
                            TweenInfo.new(0.07, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                            {
                                BackgroundTransparency = 0.02,
                                TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
                            }
                        ):Play()
                        task.delay(0.08, function()
                            if arrow and arrow.Parent then
                                TS:Create(
                                    arrow,
                                    TweenInfo.new(0.12, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                                    {BackgroundTransparency = 0.18}
                                ):Play()
                            end
                        end)
                    end)
                end
            end
        end
    end)
end)

-- Hide Button Mobile: exact Aimbot arrow style + Bat Aim open/close animation.
task.defer(function()
    task.wait(3.1)
    pcall(function()
        local settings = pages and (pages.SETTINGS or pages.Settings)
        local wrap = settings and settings:FindFirstChild("Hide Button Mobile Ambitious")
        if not wrap then return end

        local arrow = wrap:FindFirstChild("HideMobileArrow")
        local list = wrap:FindFirstChild("HideMobileOptions")
        if not arrow or not list then return end

        arrow.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(8,8,12)
        arrow.BackgroundTransparency = 0.18
        arrow.TextColor3 = COLORS.white
        arrow.TextSize = 15
        arrow.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
        arrow.Size = UDim2.new(0,38,0,26)
        arrow.AutoButtonColor = false
        arrow.Position = UDim2.new(1,-48,0.5,-13)

        local c = arrow:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
        if not c then c = Instance.new("UICorner"); c.Parent = arrow end
        c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,7)

        local st = arrow:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
        if not st then st = Instance.new("UIStroke"); st.Parent = arrow end
        st.Color = COLORS.strokeSoft
        st.Thickness = 1.2
        st.Transparency = 0.25

        local expanded = false
        local busy = false

        -- Disconnecting the old callback is not safe, so this visual controller
        -- only mirrors the existing state and provides the missing animation.
        -- The actual existing callback remains the owner of list contents.
        local function visual(open)
            arrow.Text = open and "^" or "V"
            TS:Create(
                arrow,
                TweenInfo.new(0.16, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                {Rotation = open and 180 or 0}
            ):Play()
        end

        visual(false)

        -- Keep the Hide row itself fixed; only its list expands below it.
        wrap.ClipsDescendants = true
        list.ClipsDescendants = true
        list.Position = UDim2.new(0,4,0,42)

        -- The existing callback controls actual expansion. This watcher reads
        -- the list height and mirrors it smoothly without moving the arrow.
        local lastHeight = 0
        RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            if not wrap.Parent or not list.Parent then return end
            local h = list.Size.Y.Offset
            local open = h > 1
            if open ~= expanded then
                expanded = open
                visual(open)
            end
            if math.abs(h - lastHeight) > 0.5 then
                lastHeight = h
                local target = 42 + h + 4
                if math.abs(wrap.Size.Y.Offset - target) > 2 then
                    TS:Create(
                        wrap,
                        TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                        {Size = UDim2.new(1,-4,0,target)}
                    ):Play()
                end
            elseif not open and wrap.Size.Y.Offset ~= 42 then
                TS:Create(
                    wrap,
                    TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                    {Size = UDim2.new(1,-4,0,42)}
                ):Play()
            end
        end)
    end)
end)


-- ============================================================================
-- V13 FINAL: Hide Button Mobile collapsible panel with Bat Aim-style V animation.
-- Per-button hide/show logic remains unchanged; the list is clipped until expanded.
do
    task.defer(function()
        task.wait(3.2)
        pcall(function()
            local settings = pages and (pages.SETTINGS or pages.Settings)
            if not settings then return end

            -- Remove old versions, including this panel from a previous run.
            local removeNames = {
                "Hide Button Mobile Ambitious", "Hide Mobile Buttons", "Hide MB Expand",
                "LonelyHideButtonsRow", "LonelyHideList", "VX7HideButtonMobile",
                "HideMobileOptions", "HideMobileArrow", "GlobalHideToggle",
                "VX7HideButtonMobileFixed"
            }
            for _, obj in ipairs(settings:GetDescendants()) do
                if obj:IsA("GuiObject") then
                    for _, name in ipairs(removeNames) do
                        if obj.Name == name then
                            pcall(function() obj:Destroy() end)
                            break
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

            _G.AdaptMobileButtonHiddenKeys = _G.AdaptMobileButtonHiddenKeys or {}
            _G.AdaptPerButtonHidden = _G.AdaptPerButtonHidden or {}

            local panel = Instance.new("Frame")
            panel.Name = "VX7HideButtonMobileFixed"
            panel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 46)
            panel.BackgroundColor3 = vx7ThemePalette().panel
            panel.BackgroundTransparency = 0.12
            panel.BorderSizePixel = 0
            panel.ClipsDescendants = true
            panel.LayoutOrder = 8
            panel.Parent = settings
            corner(panel, 10)
            stroke(panel, vx7ThemePalette().border, 1.15, 0.15)

            local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
            title.Name = "PanelTitle"
            title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            title.Text = "HIDE BUTTON MOBILE"
            title.TextColor3 = vx7ThemePalette().statsAccent
            title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
            title.TextSize = 11
            title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
            title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 2)
            title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -70, 0, 20)
            title.ZIndex = 5
            title.Parent = panel

            local sub = Instance.new("TextLabel")
            sub.Name = "PanelDescription"
            sub.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            sub.Text = "Tap V to expand; choose which mobile buttons to hide."
            sub.TextColor3 = vx7ThemePalette().muted
            sub.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
            sub.TextSize = 8
            sub.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
            sub.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 23)
            sub.Size = UDim2.new(1, -70, 0, 14)
            sub.ZIndex = 5
            sub.Parent = panel

            -- Large V arrow, fixed in the header and rotated like Bat Aim.
            -- Keep the glyph and button size constant: only its rotation changes.
            local arrow = Instance.new("TextButton")
            arrow.Name = "HideMobileExpandArrow"
            arrow.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(8, 8, 12)
            arrow.BackgroundTransparency = 0.18
            arrow.BorderSizePixel = 0
            arrow.Size = UDim2.new(0, 38, 0, 26)
            arrow.Position = UDim2.new(1, -48, 0, 10)
            arrow.Text = "V"
            arrow.TextColor3 = COLORS.white
            arrow.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            arrow.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.72
            arrow.TextSize = 18
            arrow.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
            arrow.AutoButtonColor = false
            arrow.ZIndex = 20
            arrow.Parent = panel
            corner(arrow, 7)
            stroke(arrow, COLORS.strokeSoft, 1.2, 0.25)

            local list = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
            list.Name = "ButtonList"
            list.Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 276)
            list.Position = UDim2.new(0, 6, 0, 50)
            list.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            list.BorderSizePixel = 0
            list.ScrollBarThickness = 2
            list.ScrollBarImageTransparency = 0.45
            list.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
            list.CanvasSize = UDim2.new()
            list.ClipsDescendants = true
            list.Parent = panel

            local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
            layout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
            layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 4)
            layout.Parent = list

            local expanded = false
            local animating = false
            local function setExpanded(open)
                if animating then return end
                expanded = open == true
                animating = true
                TS:Create(
                    panel,
                    TweenInfo.new(0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                    {Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, expanded and 332 or 46)}
                ):Play()
                TS:Create(
                    arrow,
                    TweenInfo.new(0.16, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                    {Rotation = expanded and 180 or 0}
                ):Play()
                task.delay(0.24, function()
                    animating = false
                end)
            end

            local function labelFor(key, entry)
                local value = entry and entry.btn and tostring(entry.btn.Text or "") or ""
                value = value:gsub("\n", " "):gsub("%s+", " "):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
                return value ~= "" and value or tostring(key):gsub("([a-z])([A-Z])", "%1 %2"):upper()
            end

            local function rebuild()
                for _, child in ipairs(list:GetChildren()) do
                    if not child:IsA("UIListLayout") then child:Destroy() end
                end
                local items = {}
                for key, entry in pairs(mobileButtons or {}) do
                    if type(entry) == "table" and entry.holder and entry.holder.Parent then
                        items[#items + 1] = {key = tostring(key), entry = entry}
                    end
                end
                table.sort(items, function(a, b) return a.key:lower() < b.key:lower() end)

                for index, item in ipairs(items) do
                    local key, entry = item.key, item.entry
                    local row = Instance.new("Frame")
                    row.Name = "Hide_" .. key
                    row.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 34)
                    row.BackgroundColor3 = vx7ThemePalette().top
                    row.BackgroundTransparency = 0.12
                    row.BorderSizePixel = 0
                    row.LayoutOrder = index
                    row.Parent = list
                    corner(row, 8)

                    local name = Instance.new("TextLabel")
                    name.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                    name.Text = labelFor(key, entry)
                    name.TextColor3 = vx7ThemePalette().text
                    name.Font = Enum.Font.GothamSemibold
                    name.TextSize = 10
                    name.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
                    name.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 0)
                    name.Size = UDim2.new(1, -78, 1, 0)
                    name.Parent = row

                    local toggle = Instance.new("TextButton")
                    toggle.Name = "Toggle"
                    toggle.Size = UDim2.new(0, 54, 0, 24)
                    toggle.Position = UDim2.new(1, -60, 0.5, -12)
                    toggle.BorderSizePixel = 0
                    toggle.AutoButtonColor = false
                    toggle.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
                    toggle.TextSize = 9
                    toggle.Parent = row
                    corner(toggle, 8)

                    local function paint()
                        local hidden = (_G.AdaptMobileButtonHiddenKeys[key] == true)
                            or (_G.AdaptPerButtonHidden[key] == true)
                        toggle.Text = hidden and "HIDDEN" or "SHOW"
                        toggle.BackgroundColor3 = hidden and vx7ThemePalette().accent2 or vx7ThemePalette().panel
                        toggle.TextColor3 = hidden and vx7ThemePalette().contrast or vx7ThemePalette().statsAccent
                        local border = toggle:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke") or Instance.new("UIStroke")
                        border.Color = vx7ThemePalette().border
                        border.Thickness = 1
                        border.Parent = toggle
                    end

                    paint()
                    toggle.Activated:Connect(function()
                        local hidden = not (
                            (_G.AdaptMobileButtonHiddenKeys[key] == true)
                            or (_G.AdaptPerButtonHidden[key] == true)
                        )
                        if _G.LonelySetButtonHidden then
                            _G.LonelySetButtonHidden(key, hidden)
                        end
                        paint()
                    end)
                end
            end

            arrow.Activated:Connect(function()
                setExpanded(not expanded)
                -- Bat Aim press feedback; arrow remains large and fixed in place.
                TS:Create(arrow, TweenInfo.new(0.07, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
                    BackgroundTransparency = 0.02,
                    TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                }):Play()
                task.delay(0.08, function()
                    if arrow and arrow.Parent then
                        TS:Create(arrow, TweenInfo.new(0.12, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
                            BackgroundTransparency = 0.18
                        }):Play()
                    end
                end)
            end)

            rebuild()
            _G.AdaptRebuildFixedHideButtons = rebuild
            if _G.LonelyApplyPerButtonHide then pcall(_G.LonelyApplyPerButtonHide) end
            applyVX7FullGuiTheme()
        end)
    end)

    -- Auto Left/Right: bold while active, remains bold through every waypoint,
    -- automatically turns off only after the route reaches its final point.
    -- A second press calls the existing setter and stops immediately.
    local function refreshAutoVisuals()
        pcall(function()
            if mobileButtons and mobileButtons.autoLeft then mobileButtons.autoLeft.setActive(autoLeftEnabled == true) end
            if mobileButtons and mobileButtons.autoRight then mobileButtons.autoRight.setActive(autoRightEnabled == true) end
        end)
        pcall(function()
            if pages then
                local combat=pages.COMBAT or pages.Combat
                for _,name in ipairs({"Auto Left","Auto Right"}) do
                    local row=combat and combat:FindFirstChild(name)
                    if row then
                        local b=row:FindFirstChild("Toggle",true) or row:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextButton",true)
                        if b then
                            local on=(name=="Auto Left" and autoLeftEnabled) or (name=="Auto Right" and autoRightEnabled)
                            b.Font=on and Enum.Font.GothamBlack or Enum.Font.GothamMedium
                            b.TextColor3=on and vx7ThemePalette().accent or vx7ThemePalette().text
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
    end
    _G.AdaptSetAutoLeftVisual = function(state) refreshAutoVisuals() end
    _G.AdaptSetAutoRightVisual = function(state) refreshAutoVisuals() end

    -- Keep the current Auto Left/Right engine, but make toggling deterministic:
    -- on = start; second press = immediate stop; endpoint = automatic off.
    local oldLeft=_G.AdaptSetAutoLeft
    local oldRight=_G.AdaptSetAutoRight
    _G.AdaptSetAutoLeft=function(on,skipSave)
        on=on==true
        if on and _G.AdaptSafeModeTryStart and not _G.AdaptSafeModeTryStart() then on=false end
        autoLeftEnabled=on
        if on then
            autoRightEnabled=false
            if _G.AdaptStopAutoRight then pcall(_G.AdaptStopAutoRight) end
            if _G.AdaptStartAutoLeft then pcall(_G.AdaptStartAutoLeft) end
        else
            if _G.AdaptStopAutoLeft then pcall(_G.AdaptStopAutoLeft) end
        end
        refreshAutoVisuals()
        if not skipSave and saveAdaptConfig then pcall(saveAdaptConfig) end
    end
    _G.AdaptSetAutoRight=function(on,skipSave)
        on=on==true
        if on and _G.AdaptSafeModeTryStart and not _G.AdaptSafeModeTryStart() then on=false end
        autoRightEnabled=on
        if on then
            autoLeftEnabled=false
            if _G.AdaptStopAutoLeft then pcall(_G.AdaptStopAutoLeft) end
            if _G.AdaptStartAutoRight then pcall(_G.AdaptStartAutoRight) end
        else
            if _G.AdaptStopAutoRight then pcall(_G.AdaptStopAutoRight) end
        end
        refreshAutoVisuals()
        if not skipSave and saveAdaptConfig then pcall(saveAdaptConfig) end
    end
    task.defer(function() task.wait(.5); refreshAutoVisuals() end)

    -- Explicitly remove any Auto Play UI/keybind remnants from earlier builds.
    task.defer(function()
        task.wait(3.4)
        pcall(function()
            if pages then
                for _,root in pairs(pages) do
                    if typeof(root)=="Instance" then
                        for _,obj in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
                            if obj:IsA("GuiObject") and (obj.Name=="Auto Play" or tostring(obj:GetAttribute("FeatureKey"))=="AutoPlay") then
                                obj.Visible=false
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            speedKeybinds.AutoPlay=nil
        end)
    end)
end

-- Apply the currently selected full VX7 palette once all late UI patches exist.
task.defer(function()
    task.wait(3.6)
    pcall(applyVX7FullGuiTheme)
    pcall(bindVX7ThemeLive)
end)


-- ============================================================
-- VANTA MOBILE BUTTON ENGINE — FULL REBUILD
-- Recreates the mobile buttons from scratch using Vanta's exact default
-- positions/sizes while keeping this hub's existing feature callbacks.
-- Anti Anti TP mobile button is intentionally NOT created; its feature/content
-- remains in the hub unchanged.
-- ============================================================
task.defer(function()
    task.wait(1.0)
    pcall(function()
        local pg = PlayerGui
        local cg = game:GetService("CoreGui")

        -- Remove every previous mobile-button runtime before rebuilding.
        for _, parent in ipairs({pg, cg}) do
            if parent then
                for _, name in ipairs({"AdaptMobileButtons", "VX7MobileQuickButtons", "VantaMobileButtons"}) do
                    local old = parent:FindFirstChild(name)
                    if old then pcall(function() old:Destroy() end) end
                end
            end
        end

        local refs = _G.AdaptMobileButtonRefs or {}
        _G.AdaptMobileButtonRefs = refs
        for k in pairs(refs) do refs[k] = nil end

        -- Keep saved mobile coordinates. If none exist, the Vanta defaults below
        -- are used. Dragging then persists through saveAdaptConfig.
        _G.AdaptMobileButtonPositions = _G.AdaptMobileButtonPositions or {}
        _G.VX7QuickButtonPositions = _G.VX7QuickButtonPositions or {}

        local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
        gui.Name = "VantaMobileButtons"
        gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
        gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
        gui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
        gui.DisplayOrder = 1005
        safeParentGui(gui)
        _G._VantaMobileGui = gui
        _G._VX7MobileQuickGui = gui
        _G._VX7MobileButtonFrames = refs

        local UIS = UserInputService
        local Run = RunService

        local function hidden(key)
            local h = _G.AdaptPerButtonHidden or _G.AdaptMobileButtonHiddenKeys
            return type(h) == "table" and h[key] == true
        end

        local positions

        local function currentShape()
            local sh = tostring(_G.AdaptMobileButtonShape or "FOUNDED"):upper()
            if sh ~= "FOUNDED" and sh ~= "CIRCLE" and sh ~= "SQUARE" then sh = "FOUNDED" end
            _G.AdaptMobileButtonShape = sh
            return sh
        end

        local function getButtonPosition(key, fallback)
            if type(_G.AdaptMobileButtonPositions) == "table" then
                local t = _G.AdaptMobileButtonPositions[key]
                if type(t) == "table" then
                    return tableToUDim2(t, fallback)
                end
            end
            return fallback
        end

        -- VX7-style position persistence: when a button is dragged and released,
        -- save its exact current position immediately. Lock GUI is NOT required.
        local function savePosition(key, pos)
            if not key or not pos then return end
            local data = {
                xs = pos.X.Scale, xo = pos.X.Offset,
                ys = pos.Y.Scale, yo = pos.Y.Offset
            }
            _G.AdaptMobileButtonPositions = _G.AdaptMobileButtonPositions or {}
            _G.AdaptMobileButtonPositions[tostring(key)] = data
            _G.VX7QuickButtonPositions = _G.VX7QuickButtonPositions or {}
            _G.VX7QuickButtonPositions[tostring(key)] = {
                sx=pos.X.Scale, ox=pos.X.Offset,
                sy=pos.Y.Scale, oy=pos.Y.Offset,
                shape=currentShape()
            }
            -- Persist immediately on drag release, matching VX7's quick-button behavior.
            if type(saveAdaptConfig) == "function" then pcall(saveAdaptConfig) end
        end

        local function stateFor(key)
            if key == "drop" then return false end
            if key == "autoLeft" then return autoLeftEnabled == true end
            if key == "autoRight" then return autoRightEnabled == true end
            if key == "aimbot" then
                -- The outside mobile Aimbot button follows the selected engine:
                -- Normal -> Normal Aimbot, Bypass -> Bat Bypass.
                if _G.AdaptAimbotMode == "Bypass" then
                    return _G.AceAntiBypassAimbotOn == true
                end
                return _G.AdaptNormalAimbotOn == true
            end
            if key == "tpBat" or key == "antiDesync" then
                if _G.AdaptTPBatMode == "V2" then
                    return _G.__LaPeakTPBatCleanV2 and _G.__LaPeakTPBatCleanV2.enabled == true
                end
                return _G.AdaptTPBatV1 and _G.AdaptTPBatV1.enabled == true
            end
            if key == "carry" then return currentSpeedMode == "Carry" end
            if key == "laggerNormal" then return currentSpeedMode == "Lagger" end
            if key == "laggerCarry" then return currentSpeedMode == "Lagger Carry" end
            if key == "customSpeed" then return currentSpeedMode == "Custom" end
            if key == "customCarry" then return currentSpeedMode == "Custom Carry" end
            return false
        end

        local function paint(entry, active, pressed)
            if not entry or not entry.frame or not entry.frame.Parent then return end
            local frame, tb, stroke = entry.frame, entry.textButton, entry.stroke
            local on = active == true or pressed == true
            local shape = currentShape()

            -- Yout rounded visual contract: white / grey / black only.
            -- Idle = white rounded button with grey edge. Active/pressed = darker grey/black body,
            -- white text and bold font.
            frame.BackgroundColor3 = on and Color3.fromRGB(48,48,54) or Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
            -- Active = bold, inactive = normal for the retained TP BAT V1 state.
            -- Aimbot Normal/Bypass keeps the same visual contract.
            -- to the wrong mode after a toggle.
            tb.TextColor3 = on and Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255) or Color3.fromRGB(25,25,30)
            tb.Font = on and Enum.Font.GothamBlack or Enum.Font.GothamMedium
            stroke.Color = on and Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255) or Color3.fromRGB(105,105,112)
            stroke.Thickness = on and 1.8 or 1.15
            stroke.Transparency = 0.05

            local grad = frame:FindFirstChild("YoutRoundedGradient")
            if not grad then
                grad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
                grad.Name = "YoutRoundedGradient"
                grad.Rotation = 90
                grad.Parent = frame
            end
            if on then
                grad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
                    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.00, Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)),
                    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.28, Color3.fromRGB(185,185,190)),
                    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.62, Color3.fromRGB(72,72,78)),
                    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1.00, Color3.fromRGB(8,8,10)),
                })
            else
                grad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
                    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.00, Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)),
                    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.45, Color3.fromRGB(235,235,238)),
                    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1.00, Color3.fromRGB(170,170,178)),
                })
            end
            grad.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0)

            -- Shape-specific corner: all rounded like Yout, with Square retaining its Vanta footprint.
            local c = frame:FindFirstChild("VantaButtonCorner")
            if c then
                if shape == "CIRCLE" then c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1,0)
                elseif shape == "SQUARE" then c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,12)
                else c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,12) end
            end
            entry.state = active == true
            tb:SetAttribute("AdaptMobileVisualState", on and "on" or "off")
            frame:SetAttribute("AdaptMobileVisualState", on and "on" or "off")
        end

        positions = {
            tpBat       = UDim2.new(1,-220,0.5,-118),
            drop        = UDim2.new(1,-220,0.5,-57),
            autoLeft    = UDim2.new(1,-150,0.5,-57),
            autoRight   = UDim2.new(1,-80, 0.5,-57),
            instaReset  = UDim2.new(1,-220,0.5,4),
            aimbot      = UDim2.new(1,-150,0.5,4),
            customSpeed = UDim2.new(1,-80, 0.5,4),
            tp          = UDim2.new(1,-220,0.5,65),
            carry       = UDim2.new(1,-150,0.5,65),
            customCarry = UDim2.new(1,-80, 0.5,65),
            laggerCarry = UDim2.new(1,-220,0.5,126),
            laggerNormal= UDim2.new(1,-150,0.5,126),
        }

        local function makeButton(def)
            local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
            frame.Name = "Vanta_" .. def.key
            -- Vanta uses 62x53; VX7 FOUNDED/CIRCLE use the original 58x58 quick-button footprint.
            local initialShape = tostring(_G.AdaptMobileButtonShape or "FOUNDED"):upper()
            frame.Size = (initialShape == "SQUARE") and UDim2.fromOffset(62,53) or UDim2.fromOffset(58,58)
            frame.Position = getButtonPosition(def.key, positions[def.key])
            frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(12,12,15)
            frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
            frame.ZIndex = 100
            frame.Visible = not hidden(def.key)
            frame.Active = true
            frame.Parent = gui

            local corner = Instance.new("UICorner", frame)
            corner.Name = "VantaButtonCorner"
            corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,16)

            local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", frame)
            stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(70,70,78)
            stroke.Thickness = 1.35
            stroke.Transparency = 0.12
            stroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border

            local tb = Instance.new("TextButton", frame)
            tb.Name = "VantaButton"
            tb.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
            tb.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            tb.BorderSizePixel = 0
            tb.Text = def.text
            tb.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(185,185,192)
            tb.TextWrapped = true
            tb.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
            tb.TextSize = 10
            tb.AutoButtonColor = false
            tb.ZIndex = 106

            local entry = {frame=frame, textButton=tb, stroke=stroke, state=false, setActive=nil, key=def.key}
            function entry.setActive(active)
                paint(entry, active == true, tb:GetAttribute("AdaptMobilePressed") == true)
            end
            refs[def.key] = entry

            local down = false
            local dragging = false
            local dragInput = nil
            local inputStart = nil
            local startPos = nil
            local moved = false
            local suppressActivated = false
            local pressScale = Instance.new("UIScale", frame)
            pressScale.Name = "VantaPressScale"
            pressScale.Scale = 1

            local function animatePress(on)
                pcall(function()
                    TS:Create(pressScale, TweenInfo.new(0.08, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
                        Scale = on and 0.92 or 1
                    }):Play()
                end)
            end

            tb.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
                if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
                if _G.AdaptGuiLocked == true or _G.AdaptMobileButtonsLocked == true then return end
                down = true
                dragging = false
                moved = false
                inputStart = input.Position
                startPos = frame.Position
                tb:SetAttribute("AdaptMobilePressed", true)
                if def.key == "drop" then
                    -- DROP is a one-shot action, never a persistent/bold toggle.
                    paint(entry, false, false)
                else
                    paint(entry, stateFor(def.key), true)
                end
                animatePress(true)
            end)

            tb.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
                if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                    dragInput = input
                end
            end)

            UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
                if not down or _G.AdaptGuiLocked == true or _G.AdaptMobileButtonsLocked == true then return end
                if input ~= dragInput and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
                local delta = input.Position - inputStart
                if delta.Magnitude > 6 then dragging = true; moved = true; suppressActivated = true end
                if dragging then
                    frame.Position = UDim2.new(
                        startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
                        startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
                    )
                end
            end)

            local function finish(input)
                if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
                if not down then return end
                local wasDrag = dragging
                down = false
                dragging = false
                dragInput = nil
                tb:SetAttribute("AdaptMobilePressed", false)
                animatePress(false)
                if wasDrag then
                    -- Save exactly where the user dropped this button.
                    savePosition(def.key, frame.Position)
                end
            end
            UIS.InputEnded:Connect(finish)

            tb.Activated:Connect(function()
                if suppressActivated then
                    suppressActivated = false
                    moved = false
                    return
                end
                if dragging or down then return end
                moved = false
                pcall(def.fn)
                if def.key == "drop" then
                    local frameStroke = stroke
                    local gradient = frame:FindFirstChild("YoutRoundedGradient")
                    if gradient then
                        pcall(function() gradient.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0)) end)
                        pcall(function() gradient.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0) end)
                    end
                    frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0)
                    frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.02
                    tb.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
                    tb.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
                    frameStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
                    frameStroke.Thickness = 1.8
                    frameStroke.Transparency = 0.05
                    task.delay(0.12, function()
                        if frame.Parent then
                            paint(entry, false, false)
                        end
                    end)
                    return
                end
                if def.key == "tp" then
                    
                    paint(entry, true, false)
                    task.delay(0.22, function()
                        if frame.Parent and not tb:GetAttribute("AdaptMobilePressed") then
                            paint(entry, stateFor(def.key), false)
                        end
                    end)
                else
                    task.defer(function()
                        if frame.Parent then paint(entry, stateFor(def.key), false) end
                    end)
                end
            end)

            paint(entry, stateFor(def.key), false)
            return entry
        end

        local defs = {
            {key="tpBat", text="TP BAT", fn=function()
                if _G.AdaptSafeModeIsLocked and _G.AdaptSafeModeIsLocked() then
                    if _G.AdaptSafeModeForceStop then pcall(_G.AdaptSafeModeForceStop, "SAFE MODE LOCK") end
                    return
                end
                if _G.AdaptToggleTPBatV1 then pcall(_G.AdaptToggleTPBatV1) end
            end},
            {key="drop", text="DROP BR", fn=function()
                if _G.AdaptRunDropBR then
                    pcall(_G.AdaptRunDropBR)
                end
            end},
            {key="autoLeft", text="AUTO\nLEFT", fn=function()
                if _G.AdaptSetAutoLeft then _G.AdaptSetAutoLeft(not autoLeftEnabled) end
            end},
            {key="instaReset", text="INSTA\nRESET", fn=function()
                if _G.AdaptInstantReset then _G.AdaptInstantReset() end
            end},
            {key="aimbot", text="AIMBOT", fn=function()
                if _G.AdaptSafeModeIsLocked and _G.AdaptSafeModeIsLocked() then return end
                if _G.AdaptToggleAimbot then
                    _G.AdaptToggleAimbot()
                end
            end},
            {key="autoRight", text="AUTO\nRIGHT", fn=function()
                if _G.AdaptSetAutoRight then _G.AdaptSetAutoRight(not autoRightEnabled) end
            end},
            {key="customSpeed", text="CUSTOM\nSPEED", fn=function()
                if setSpeedMode then setSpeedMode(currentSpeedMode == "Custom" and "Normal" or "Custom") end
            end},
            {key="tp", text="TP DOWN", fn=function()
                if runTPFloor then runTPFloor() end
            end},
            {key="carry", text="CARRY\nSPEED", fn=function()
                if setSpeedMode then setSpeedMode(currentSpeedMode == "Carry" and "Normal" or "Carry") end
            end},
            {key="customCarry", text="CUSTOM\nCARRY", fn=function()
                if setSpeedMode then setSpeedMode(currentSpeedMode == "Custom Carry" and "Normal" or "Custom Carry") end
            end},
            {key="laggerCarry", text="LAGGER\nCARRY", fn=function()
                if setSpeedMode then setSpeedMode(currentSpeedMode == "Lagger Carry" and "Normal" or "Lagger Carry") end
            end},
            {key="laggerNormal", text="LAGGER\nSPEED", fn=function()
                if setSpeedMode then setSpeedMode(currentSpeedMode == "Lagger" and "Normal" or "Lagger") end
            end},
        }

        for _, def in ipairs(defs) do makeButton(def) end

        function _G.AdaptApplyMobileButtonsHidden()
            for key, entry in pairs(refs) do
                if entry and entry.frame then
                    entry.frame.Visible = not hidden(key)
                end
            end
        end

        function _G.AdaptApplyMobileButtonSize()
            local sc = math.clamp(tonumber(_G.AdaptMobileButtonScale) or 1, 0.30, 1.35)
            _G.AdaptMobileButtonScale = sc
            for _, entry in pairs(refs) do
                if entry and entry.frame then
                    local u = entry.frame:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale") or Instance.new("UIScale", entry.frame)
                    u.Scale = sc
                end
            end
        end

        function _G.AdaptApplyMobileButtonShape()
            local shape = tostring(_G.AdaptMobileButtonShape or "FOUNDED"):upper()
            if shape ~= "FOUNDED" and shape ~= "CIRCLE" and shape ~= "SQUARE" then shape = "FOUNDED" end
            _G.AdaptMobileButtonShape = shape

            -- Exact shape contract:
            -- FOUNDED = VX7 quick button (58x58, 14px corner).
            -- CIRCLE  = VX7 Circle (58x58, fully round).
            -- SQUARE  = Vanta mobile button (62x53, 16px corner).
            local radius = UDim.new(0,12)
            local w,h = 60,60
            if shape == "CIRCLE" then
                radius = UDim.new(1,0)
                w,h = 60,60
            elseif shape == "SQUARE" then
                -- Vanta footprint, but rounded exactly like the Yout button surface.
                radius = UDim.new(0,12)
                w,h = 62,53
            else
                -- FOUNDED = Yout/VX7 rounded button.
                radius = UDim.new(0,12)
                w,h = 60,60
            end

            for key, entry in pairs(refs) do
                local frame = entry and entry.frame
                if frame then
                    frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w,h)
                    local c = frame:FindFirstChild("VantaButtonCorner")
                    if c then c.CornerRadius = radius end
                    -- Shape changes never restore or create a separate saved coordinate set.
                    -- Keep the button exactly where the user currently placed it.
                end
            end
            if _G.AdaptRefreshMobileButtonStates then pcall(_G.AdaptRefreshMobileButtonStates) end
        end

        function _G.AdaptApplyMobileButtonImage() end

        function _G.AdaptRefreshMobileButtonStates()
            for key, entry in pairs(refs) do
                if entry and entry.frame and entry.frame.Parent then
                    entry.setActive(stateFor(key))
                end
            end
        end
        _G._VX7RecolorMobileButtons = _G.AdaptRefreshMobileButtonStates
        _G._VX7SyncMobileButtonStates = _G.AdaptRefreshMobileButtonStates

        -- Only the selected shape is persisted as shape state. Button coordinates use one shared
        -- position table across FOUNDED/CIRCLE/SQUARE and are persisted on drag release.
        _G.AdaptMobileButtonPositions = _G.AdaptMobileButtonPositions or {}
        _G.VX7QuickButtonPositions = _G.VX7QuickButtonPositions or {}
        _G.AdaptApplyMobileButtonSize()
        _G.AdaptApplyMobileButtonsHidden()
        _G.AdaptApplyMobileButtonShape()
        _G.AdaptRefreshMobileButtonStates()

        local last = 0
        Run.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            if not gui.Parent then return end
            if os.clock() - last >= 0.2 then
                last = os.clock()
                pcall(_G.AdaptRefreshMobileButtonStates)
                pcall(_G.AdaptApplyMobileButtonsHidden)
                local isV2 = _G.AdaptSpeedMethod == "V2"
                for _, key in ipairs({"carry","laggerCarry","laggerNormal","customSpeed","customCarry"}) do
                    local e = refs[key]
                    if e and e.frame then
                        e.frame.Visible = (not isV2) and (not hidden(key))
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
    end)
end)


-- [v25] Final shape/visual contract. New Vanta runtime is authoritative.
task.defer(function()
    task.wait(1.6)
    pcall(function()
        local sh = tostring(_G.AdaptMobileButtonShape or "FOUNDED"):upper()
        if sh ~= "FOUNDED" and sh ~= "CIRCLE" and sh ~= "SQUARE" then sh = "FOUNDED" end
        _G.AdaptMobileButtonShape = sh
        if _G.AdaptApplyMobileButtonShape then _G.AdaptApplyMobileButtonShape() end
        if _G.AdaptRefreshMobileButtonStates then _G.AdaptRefreshMobileButtonStates() end
    end)
end)

-- [v22] Final 3-shape mobile contract: FOUNDED=VX7, CIRCLE=round, SQUARE=Vanta.
task.defer(function()
    task.wait(0.7)
    pcall(function()
        local sh=tostring(_G.AdaptMobileButtonShape or "FOUNDED"):upper()
        if sh~="FOUNDED" and sh~="CIRCLE" and sh~="SQUARE" then sh="FOUNDED" end
        _G.AdaptMobileButtonShape=sh
        if _G.AdaptApplyMobileButtonShape then _G.AdaptApplyMobileButtonShape() end
        if _G.LonelyRefreshSpeedV2Visibility then _G.LonelyRefreshSpeedV2Visibility() end
    end)
end)


-- [v30] Shared mobile positions + VX7-style immediate save + segmented Speed Method selector.
task.defer(function()
    task.wait(1.0)
    pcall(function()
        local sh = tostring(_G.AdaptMobileButtonShape or "FOUNDED"):upper()
        if sh ~= "FOUNDED" and sh ~= "CIRCLE" and sh ~= "SQUARE" then sh = "FOUNDED" end
        _G.AdaptMobileButtonShape = sh
        if _G.AdaptApplyMobileButtonShape then _G.AdaptApplyMobileButtonShape() end
        if _G.AdaptRefreshMobileButtonStates then _G.AdaptRefreshMobileButtonStates() end
        if _G.AdaptRepaintStealBar then _G.AdaptRepaintStealBar() end
        if saveAdaptConfig then pcall(saveAdaptConfig) end
    end)
end)

-- ============================================================================
-- [VX7 FINAL PATCH] TP BAT compact 50/50 selector + Bat Aimbot Normal/Bypass.
-- Bat Bypass runtime is transplanted from Clean by _printed's BatBypass engine.
-- UI mode selectors use the same V position/animation contract as Auto Steal.
-- ============================================================================
do
    -- ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 1) Clean Bat Bypass engine compatibility surface.
    -- ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    _G.AdaptAimbotMode = (_G.AdaptAimbotPendingMode == "Normal") and "Normal" or "Bypass"
    selectedAimbotMode = (_G.AdaptAimbotMode == "Normal") and "Normal" or "Bat Bypass"
    _G.AceAntiBypassAimbotSpeed = tonumber(_G.AceAntiBypassAimbotSpeed) or 60
    _G.AceAntiBypassLaggerAimbotSpeed = tonumber(_G.AceAntiBypassLaggerAimbotSpeed) or 40
    _G.AceAntiBypassAimbotOn = false

    _G.AceGetAntiBypassAimbotSpeed = function()
        local aimMode = tostring(_G.AdaptAimbotMode or "Bypass")
        if aimMode == "Normal" then
            if _G.AdaptGetNormalAimbotSpeed then
                return tonumber(_G.AdaptGetNormalAimbotSpeed()) or 58
            end
            local speedMode = tostring(currentSpeedMode or "Normal")
            if speedMode == "Lagger" or speedMode == "Lagger Carry" then
                return tonumber(LAGGER_AIMBOT_SPEED) or 40
            end
            return tonumber(AIMBOT_SPEED) or 58
        end
        local mode = tostring(currentSpeedMode or "Normal")
        if mode == "Lagger" or mode == "Lagger Carry" then
            return tonumber(_G.AceAntiBypassLaggerAimbotSpeed) or 40
        end
        return tonumber(_G.AceAntiBypassAimbotSpeed) or 60
    end

    _G.AceSafeModeTryStart = _G.AdaptSafeModeTryStart
    _G.AceStopAutoTPForAction = _G.AdaptStopAutoTPForAction
    _G.AceStopNormalAimbot = _G.AdaptStopNormalAimbot

BAT_V2_SPEED = BAT_V2_SPEED or 55
BAT_V2_HIT_DIST = BAT_V2_HIT_DIST or 13
BAT_V2_LEAD_STUDS = BAT_V2_LEAD_STUDS or 3
BAT_V2_BODY_LOCK_RANGE = BAT_V2_BODY_LOCK_RANGE or 60
snowVS = _G.SnowVS or {}
_G.SnowVS = snowVS
snowVS.BatBypass = snowVS.BatBypass or {}
snowVS.AimbotBypassV2 = snowVS.BatBypass
do
    local batBypass = snowVS.BatBypass
    batBypass.Enabled = batBypass.Enabled or false
    batBypass.Connection = batBypass.Connection or nil
    batBypass.Z = batBypass.Z
        or {
            targetPlayer = nil,
            lastTargetPos = nil,
            targetVelocity = Vector3.zero,
            smoothedVelocity = Vector3.zero,
            velocityHistory = {},
            accelerationHistory = {},
            aerialVelocityHistory = {},
            previousDirection = nil,
            lastDirectionChangeTime = 0,
            airborneTime = 0,
            lastActivationTime = 0,
            currentPing = 0.1,
            realPingMs = 0,
        }
    batBypass.ZCFG = batBypass.ZCFG
        or {
            FOLLOW_SPEED = BAT_V2_SPEED,
            ACTIVATE_DISTANCE = BAT_V2_HIT_DIST,
            MIN_FOLLOW_DISTANCE = 1,
            PREDICTION_TIME = 0.22,
            PREDICT_AHEAD = BAT_V2_LEAD_STUDS,
            MAX_VELOCITY_CHANGE = 150,
            VELOCITY_SMOOTHING = 0.2,
            MAX_HORIZONTAL_VELOCITY = 80,
            SERVER_TICKRATE = 0.016666666666666666,
            MIN_PING_COMPENSATION = 0.03,
            MAX_PING_COMPENSATION = 0.25,
            ACCELERATION_PREDICTION_WEIGHT = 0.3,
            DIRECTION_CHANGE_DETECTION_TIME = 0.12,
            QUICK_DIRECTION_CHANGE_MULTIPLIER = 1.5,
            GRAVITY = 196.2,
            AIR_CONTROL_FACTOR = 0.8,
            MIN_AIRBORNE_TIME = 0.08,
        }
    local function averageVectors(vectors)
        if #vectors == 0 then
            return Vector3.zero
        end
        local sum = Vector3.zero
        for _, entry in ipairs(vectors) do
            sum += entry
        end
        return sum / #vectors
    end
    local function pushBounded(history, entry, maxEntries)
        table.insert(history, entry)
        if #history > maxEntries then
            table.remove(history, 1)
        end
    end
    batBypass.FindBat = function()
        local character = LP.Character
        if not character then
            return nil
        end
        local tool = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
        if tool then
            local lowercaseText = tool.Name:lower()
            if lowercaseText:find("bat", 1, true) or lowercaseText:find("slap", 1, true) then
                return tool
            end
        end
        local backpack = LP:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
        if backpack then
            for _, child in ipairs(backpack:GetChildren()) do
                if child:IsA("Tool") then
                    local lowercaseText = child.Name:lower()
                    if lowercaseText:find("bat", 1, true) or lowercaseText:find("slap", 1, true) then
                        return child
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return nil
    end
    local function resetPredictionState()
        local z = batBypass.Z
        z.targetPlayer = nil
        z.lastTargetPos = nil
        z.targetVelocity = Vector3.zero
        z.smoothedVelocity = Vector3.zero
        z.velocityHistory = {}
        z.accelerationHistory = {}
        z.aerialVelocityHistory = {}
        z.previousDirection = nil
        z.airborneTime = 0
    end
    -- Performance cache: target selection is refreshed periodically instead
    -- of scanning every player on every RenderStepped.
    local _batTargetCache = nil
    local _batTargetCacheAt = 0
    local _batTargetScanInterval = 0.08

    local function findClosestPlayer(rootPart, force)
        local now = os.clock()
        if not force and _batTargetCache
            and (now - _batTargetCacheAt) < _batTargetScanInterval then
            local c = _batTargetCache.Character
            local h = c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local r = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if r and h and h.Health > 0 then
                return _batTargetCache
            end
        end

        local closestDistanceSq = math.huge
        local closestPlayer = nil
        local origin = rootPart.Position

        for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if player ~= LP and player.Character then
                local humanoidRootPart = player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local humanoid = player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if humanoidRootPart and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
                    local offset = origin - humanoidRootPart.Position
                    local distanceSq = offset.X*offset.X + offset.Y*offset.Y + offset.Z*offset.Z
                    if distanceSq < closestDistanceSq then
                        closestDistanceSq = distanceSq
                        closestPlayer = player
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        _batTargetCache = closestPlayer
        _batTargetCacheAt = now
        return closestPlayer
    end
    local function applyAngularAim(rootPart, direction)
        if direction.Magnitude < 0.01 then
            return
        end
        local crossVector = rootPart.CFrame.LookVector:Cross(direction.Unit)
        local angle = math.asin(math.clamp(crossVector.Magnitude, -1, 1))
        rootPart.AssemblyAngularVelocity = crossVector.Magnitude > 0.1 and crossVector.Unit * angle * 80
            or Vector3.zero
    end
    local function updatePing()
        local ok, result = pcall(function()
            return game:GetService("Stats").Network.ServerStatsItem["Data Ping"]:GetValue()
        end)
        local z = batBypass.Z
        if ok and type(result) == "number" then
            z.realPingMs = math.floor(result)
        end
        z.currentPing = math.clamp(
            z.realPingMs / 1000,
            batBypass.ZCFG.MIN_PING_COMPENSATION,
            batBypass.ZCFG.MAX_PING_COMPENSATION
        )
    end
    local _batToolCache = nil
    local _batToolCacheAt = 0
    local _batToolCacheInterval = 0.35

    local function getCachedBat()
        local character = LP.Character
        if not character then
            _batToolCache = nil
            return nil
        end

        if _batToolCache and _batToolCache.Parent
            and (os.clock() - _batToolCacheAt) < _batToolCacheInterval then
            local n = tostring(_batToolCache.Name):lower()
            if n:find("bat", 1, true) or n:find("slap", 1, true) then
                return _batToolCache
            end
        end

        _batToolCache = batBypass.FindBat()
        _batToolCacheAt = os.clock()
        return _batToolCache
    end

    batBypass.PingLoopStarted = batBypass.PingLoopStarted or false
    if not batBypass.PingLoopStarted then
        batBypass.PingLoopStarted = true
        task.spawn(function()
            while true do
                pcall(updatePing)
                task.wait(0.5)
            end
        end)
    end
    batBypass.StartBodyLock = function() end
    batBypass.StopBodyLock = function() end
    batBypass.Stop = function()
        local z = batBypass.Z
        batBypass.Enabled = false
        if batBypass.Connection then
            batBypass.Connection:Disconnect()
            batBypass.Connection = nil
        end
        local character = LP.Character
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        character = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if humanoid then
            humanoid.AutoRotate = true
        end
        if character then
            character.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
        end
        resetPredictionState()
        z.lastActivationTime = 0
        _batTargetCache = nil
        _batTargetCacheAt = 0
    end
    batBypass.Start = function()
        if batBypass.Connection then
            return
        end
        local character = LP.Character
        local humanoid1387 = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local rootPart = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not humanoid1387 or not rootPart then
            return
        end
        _G.__AdaptAimbotEngineGeneration = (tonumber(_G.__AdaptAimbotEngineGeneration) or 0) + 1
        local engineGeneration = _G.__AdaptAimbotEngineGeneration
        batBypass.Enabled = true
        humanoid1387.AutoRotate = false
        local tool = getCachedBat()
        if tool and tool.Parent ~= character then
            pcall(function()
                humanoid1387:EquipTool(tool)
            end)
        end
        batBypass.Connection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(deltaTime)
            -- Ignore any already-queued callback after the mode handoff.
            if engineGeneration ~= (tonumber(_G.__AdaptAimbotEngineGeneration) or 0) then
                return
            end
            if not batBypass.Enabled
                or _G.AdaptAimbotMode ~= "Bypass"
                or _G.AceAntiBypassAimbotOn ~= true then
                batBypass.Stop()
                return
            end
            local z = batBypass.Z
            local zcfg = batBypass.ZCFG
            if _G.AceGetAntiBypassAimbotSpeed then
                zcfg.FOLLOW_SPEED = _G.AceGetAntiBypassAimbotSpeed()
            end
            local character2 = LP.Character
            local rootPart1394 = character2 and character2:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local humanoid = character2 and character2:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if not rootPart1394 or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
                return
            end
            humanoid.AutoRotate = false
            local rootPart = rootPart1394
            local humanoid1387 = humanoid
            if not tool or tool.Parent ~= character2 then
                tool = getCachedBat()
            end
            if tool and tool.Parent ~= character2 then
                pcall(humanoid.EquipTool, humanoid, tool)
            end
            z.targetPlayer = findClosestPlayer(rootPart)
            local character3 = z.targetPlayer and z.targetPlayer.Character
            local rootPart1442 = character3 and character3:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            character3 = character3 and character3:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if not rootPart1442 or not character3 or character3.Health <= 0 then
                resetPredictionState()
                return
            end
            local position = rootPart1442.Position
            local sampleDeltaTime = math.max(deltaTime, 0.0041666666666666666)
            if z.lastTargetPos then
                local targetVelocity = (position - z.lastTargetPos) / sampleDeltaTime
                local vector = targetVelocity - z.targetVelocity
                if zcfg.MAX_VELOCITY_CHANGE < vector.Magnitude then
                    targetVelocity = z.targetVelocity + vector.Unit * zcfg.MAX_VELOCITY_CHANGE
                end
                local vector3 = Vector3.new(targetVelocity.X, 0, targetVelocity.Z)
                if vector3.Magnitude > zcfg.MAX_HORIZONTAL_VELOCITY then
                    local vector = vector3.Unit * zcfg.MAX_HORIZONTAL_VELOCITY
                    targetVelocity = Vector3.new(vector.X, targetVelocity.Y, vector.Z)
                end
                pushBounded(z.accelerationHistory, (targetVelocity - z.targetVelocity) / sampleDeltaTime, 4)
                pushBounded(z.velocityHistory, targetVelocity, 8)
                z.targetVelocity = targetVelocity
                z.smoothedVelocity = z.smoothedVelocity:Lerp(targetVelocity, zcfg.VELOCITY_SMOOTHING)
            end
            z.lastTargetPos = position
            local isAirborne = character3.FloorMaterial == Enum.Material.Air
            z.airborneTime = isAirborne and z.airborneTime + sampleDeltaTime or 0
            if isAirborne and z.airborneTime >= zcfg.MIN_AIRBORNE_TIME then
                pushBounded(z.aerialVelocityHistory, z.targetVelocity, 6)
            elseif not isAirborne then
                z.aerialVelocityHistory = {}
            end
            local smoothedVelocity = z.smoothedVelocity
            if isAirborne and #z.aerialVelocityHistory > 0 then
                local vector = averageVectors(z.aerialVelocityHistory)
                smoothedVelocity = Vector3.new(vector.X, z.targetVelocity.Y, vector.Z) * zcfg.AIR_CONTROL_FACTOR
            end
            local changedDirectionQuickly = false
            local vector3 = Vector3.new(z.targetVelocity.X, 0, z.targetVelocity.Z)
            if vector3.Magnitude > 5 then
                local unit = vector3.Unit
                if z.previousDirection and z.previousDirection:Dot(unit) < 0.5 then
                    local lastDirectionChangeTime = z.lastDirectionChangeTime
                    changedDirectionQuickly = tick() - lastDirectionChangeTime
                        < zcfg.DIRECTION_CHANGE_DETECTION_TIME
                    z.lastDirectionChangeTime = tick()
                end
                z.previousDirection = unit
            end
            local predictionTime = z.currentPing + zcfg.SERVER_TICKRATE
            if changedDirectionQuickly then
                predictionTime *= zcfg.QUICK_DIRECTION_CHANGE_MULTIPLIER
            end
            local accelerationPredictionWeight = zcfg.ACCELERATION_PREDICTION_WEIGHT
            local predictedPosition = position
                + smoothedVelocity * predictionTime
                + averageVectors(z.accelerationHistory)
                    * accelerationPredictionWeight
                    * predictionTime
                    * predictionTime
                    * 0.5
            local leadTime = zcfg.PREDICTION_TIME * 1.1
            local leadPosition
            if isAirborne then
                leadPosition = predictedPosition
                    + smoothedVelocity * leadTime
                    + Vector3.new(0, -0.5 * zcfg.GRAVITY * leadTime * leadTime, 0)
            else
                leadPosition = predictedPosition + smoothedVelocity * leadTime
            end
            local vector4 = Vector3.new(smoothedVelocity.X, 0, smoothedVelocity.Z)
            if vector4.Magnitude > 1 then
                leadPosition += vector4.Unit * zcfg.PREDICT_AHEAD
            end
            local targetDirection = leadPosition - rootPart.Position
            applyAngularAim(rootPart, targetDirection)
            local withinActivationRange = (position - rootPart.Position).Magnitude <= zcfg.ACTIVATE_DISTANCE
            if withinActivationRange then
                local lastActivationTime = z.lastActivationTime
                withinActivationRange = tick() - lastActivationTime >= 0.3
            end
            if withinActivationRange then
                if tool then
                    pcall(tool.Activate, tool)
                end
                z.lastActivationTime = tick()
            end
            if zcfg.MIN_FOLLOW_DISTANCE < targetDirection.Magnitude then
                rootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = targetDirection.Unit * zcfg.FOLLOW_SPEED
            else
                rootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, rootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y * 0.5, 0)
            end
        end)
    end
    batBypass.Toggle = function()
        if batBypass.Enabled then
            batBypass.Stop()
        else
            batBypass.Start()
        end
    end
end


    -- ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 2) Normal / Bypass controller. Selection changes immediately while the
    -- aimbot is running; default selection is always Bypass.
    -- ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    _G.AdaptAimbotMode = (_G.AdaptAimbotMode == "Normal") and "Normal" or "Bypass"
    selectedAimbotMode = (_G.AdaptAimbotMode == "Normal") and "Normal" or "Bat Bypass"

    local function _adaptHardStopAimbotEngines(clearMotion)
        -- Invalidate both RenderStepped callbacks before disconnecting either engine.
        _G.__AdaptAimbotEngineGeneration = (tonumber(_G.__AdaptAimbotEngineGeneration) or 0) + 1
        local normalState = _G.__BubbleAceNormalAimbot or _G.AdaptNormalAimbot
        local bypassState = (_G.SnowVS and _G.SnowVS.BatBypass) or snowVS.BatBypass
        local adapterState = _G.AdaptNormalAimbot
        local normalWasRunning = _G.AdaptNormalAimbotOn == true
            or (normalState and normalState.conn ~= nil)
            or (adapterState and adapterState.conn ~= nil)
        local bypassWasRunning = _G.AceAntiBypassAimbotOn == true
            or (bypassState and (bypassState.Connection ~= nil or bypassState.Enabled == true))
        local anyWasRunning = normalWasRunning or bypassWasRunning

        -- Flip the public flags first, so callbacks cannot keep controlling the character.
        _G.AdaptNormalAimbotOn = false
        _G.AceAntiBypassAimbotOn = false

        if type(_G.AdaptStopNormalAimbot) == "function" then
            pcall(_G.AdaptStopNormalAimbot)
        end
        if type(_G.AceStopAntiBypassAimbot) == "function" then
            pcall(_G.AceStopAntiBypassAimbot, false)
        elseif bypassState and type(bypassState.Stop) == "function" then
            pcall(function() bypassState.Stop() end)
        end

        -- Safety fallback for a stale public handle left by an earlier toggle.
        normalState = _G.__BubbleAceNormalAimbot or _G.AdaptNormalAimbot
        if normalState and normalState.conn then
            pcall(function() normalState.conn:Disconnect() end)
            normalState.conn = nil
        end
        local adapterState = _G.AdaptNormalAimbot
        if adapterState and adapterState.conn then
            pcall(function() adapterState.conn:Disconnect() end)
            adapterState.conn = nil
        end
        bypassState = (_G.SnowVS and _G.SnowVS.BatBypass) or snowVS.BatBypass
        if bypassState then
            if bypassState.Connection then
                pcall(function() bypassState.Connection:Disconnect() end)
                bypassState.Connection = nil
            end
            if bypassState.conn then
                pcall(function() bypassState.conn:Disconnect() end)
                bypassState.conn = nil
            end
            bypassState.Enabled = false
        end

        local character = LP.Character
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
