        local rootPart = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if humanoid then pcall(function() humanoid.AutoRotate = true end) end
        if rootPart then
            pcall(function() rootPart.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero end)
            if clearMotion and anyWasRunning then
                pcall(function() rootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero end)
            end
        end
        return anyWasRunning
    end

    _G.AceStartAntiBypassAimbot = function()
        if _G.AdaptSafeModeTryStart and not _G.AdaptSafeModeTryStart() then
            return false
        end
        if _G.AdaptStopAutoTPForAction then
            pcall(_G.AdaptStopAutoTPForAction)
        end
        if type(_G.__stopSpeedBoost) == "function" then
            pcall(_G.__stopSpeedBoost)
        end

        _adaptHardStopAimbotEngines(true)
        selectedAimbotMode = "Bat Bypass"
        _G.AdaptAimbotMode = "Bypass"
        _G.AdaptAimbotPendingMode = "Bypass"
        _G.AdaptNormalAimbotOn = false
        _G.AceAntiBypassAimbotOn = true

        local bypassEngine = (_G.SnowVS and _G.SnowVS.BatBypass) or snowVS.BatBypass
        if not bypassEngine then
            _G.AceAntiBypassAimbotOn = false
            return false
        end
        bypassEngine.ZCFG = bypassEngine.ZCFG or {}
        bypassEngine.ZCFG.FOLLOW_SPEED = _G.AceGetAntiBypassAimbotSpeed()
        local started, startError = pcall(function() bypassEngine.Start() end)
        if not started or not bypassEngine.Connection then
            pcall(function() bypassEngine.Stop() end)
            _G.AceAntiBypassAimbotOn = false
            if startError then warn("[12Hub] Bat Bypass start failed:", startError) end
            if _G.AdaptRefreshAimbotVisual then pcall(_G.AdaptRefreshAimbotVisual) end
            if saveAdaptConfig then pcall(saveAdaptConfig) end
            return false
        end

        if _G.AdaptAimbotModeSetVisual then
            pcall(_G.AdaptAimbotModeSetVisual, "Bypass")
        end
        if _G.AdaptAimbotSetVisual then
            pcall(_G.AdaptAimbotSetVisual, true)
        end
        if _G.AdaptRefreshAimbotVisual then pcall(_G.AdaptRefreshAimbotVisual) end
        if _G.AdaptRefreshMobileButtonStates then pcall(_G.AdaptRefreshMobileButtonStates) end
        if saveAdaptConfig then pcall(saveAdaptConfig) end
        return true
    end

    _G.AceStopAntiBypassAimbot = function(updateVisual)
        local bypassEngine = (_G.SnowVS and _G.SnowVS.BatBypass) or snowVS.BatBypass
        if bypassEngine then
            if type(bypassEngine.Stop) == "function" then
                pcall(function() bypassEngine.Stop() end)
            end
            if bypassEngine.Connection then
                pcall(function() bypassEngine.Connection:Disconnect() end)
                bypassEngine.Connection = nil
            end
            if bypassEngine.conn then
                pcall(function() bypassEngine.conn:Disconnect() end)
                bypassEngine.conn = nil
            end
            bypassEngine.Enabled = false
        end
        _G.AceAntiBypassAimbotOn = false
        if updateVisual ~= false and _G.AdaptAimbotSetVisual then
            pcall(_G.AdaptAimbotSetVisual, false)
        end
        if _G.AdaptRefreshMobileButtonStates then pcall(_G.AdaptRefreshMobileButtonStates) end
        if saveAdaptConfig then pcall(saveAdaptConfig) end
        return true
    end

    _G.AdaptStartAimbotBypass = _G.AceStartAntiBypassAimbot
    _G.AdaptStopAimbotBypass = _G.AceStopAntiBypassAimbot

    _G.AdaptSetAimbotMode = function(mode)
        mode = (mode == "Normal") and "Normal" or "Bypass"
        local normalState = _G.__BubbleAceNormalAimbot or _G.AdaptNormalAimbot
        local bypassState = (_G.SnowVS and _G.SnowVS.BatBypass) or snowVS.BatBypass
        local wasActive = _G.AdaptNormalAimbotOn == true
            or _G.AceAntiBypassAimbotOn == true
            or (normalState and normalState.conn ~= nil)
            or (bypassState and (bypassState.Connection ~= nil or bypassState.Enabled == true))

        -- Always disconnect both engines first; after that only the selected one may start.
        _adaptHardStopAimbotEngines(true)
        _G.AdaptAimbotMode = mode
        _G.AdaptAimbotPendingMode = mode
        selectedAimbotMode = (mode == "Normal") and "Normal" or "Bat Bypass"
        _G.AdaptNormalAimbotOn = false
        _G.AceAntiBypassAimbotOn = false

        if wasActive then
            if mode == "Normal" then
                if type(_G.AdaptStartNormalAimbot) == "function" then
                    pcall(_G.AdaptStartNormalAimbot)
                end
            else
                pcall(_G.AceStartAntiBypassAimbot)
            end
        end

        if _G.AdaptAimbotModeSetVisual then
            pcall(_G.AdaptAimbotModeSetVisual, mode, true)
        end
        if _G.AdaptRefreshAimbotVisual then pcall(_G.AdaptRefreshAimbotVisual) end
        if _G.AdaptRefreshMobileButtonStates then pcall(_G.AdaptRefreshMobileButtonStates) end
        if saveAdaptConfig then pcall(saveAdaptConfig) end
        return mode
    end

    _G.AdaptToggleAimbot = function()
        local mode = (_G.AdaptAimbotMode == "Normal") and "Normal" or "Bypass"
        if mode == "Normal" then
            if _G.AdaptNormalAimbotOn == true then
                pcall(_G.AdaptStopNormalAimbot)
                if _G.AdaptRefreshAimbotVisual then pcall(_G.AdaptRefreshAimbotVisual) end
                return false
            end
            return _G.AdaptStartNormalAimbot and _G.AdaptStartNormalAimbot() or false
        end
        if _G.AceAntiBypassAimbotOn == true then
            pcall(_G.AceStopAntiBypassAimbot)
            if _G.AdaptRefreshAimbotVisual then pcall(_G.AdaptRefreshAimbotVisual) end
            return false
        end
        return _G.AceStartAntiBypassAimbot() ~= false
    end

    _G.AdaptRefreshAimbotVisual = function()
        local on = (_G.AdaptNormalAimbotOn == true) or (_G.AceAntiBypassAimbotOn == true)
        if _G.AdaptAimbotSetVisual then
            pcall(_G.AdaptAimbotSetVisual, on)
        end
        if _G.AdaptRefreshMobileButtonStates then
            pcall(_G.AdaptRefreshMobileButtonStates)
        end
    end

    -- ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 3) TP Bat selector: full-width content, true 50/50 split, directly below TP Bat.
    -- ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    do
        local tpModeRow = Combat and Combat:FindFirstChild("TP Bat Mode")
        local tpRow = _G.AdaptTPButtonRow or (Combat and Combat:FindFirstChild("TP Bat"))
        if tpModeRow and tpRow then
            local oldArrow = tpRow:FindFirstChild("TPBatArrow") or tpRow:FindFirstChild("ArrowButton")
            if oldArrow then oldArrow:Destroy() end

            tpModeRow.LayoutOrder = (tpRow.LayoutOrder or 10.1) + 0.01
            tpModeRow.Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 0)
            tpModeRow.Visible = false
            tpModeRow.ClipsDescendants = true

            local modeHolder = tpModeRow:FindFirstChild("TPBatModeHolder")
            local modeSlide = modeHolder and modeHolder:FindFirstChild("TPBatModeSlide")
            if modeHolder then
                -- Full-width selector: two exact halves, directly under TP Bat.
                modeHolder.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 40)
                modeHolder.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 3)
            end
            if modeSlide then
                modeSlide.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -8, 1, -8)
                modeSlide.Position = UDim2.new((_G.AdaptTPBatMode == "V2") and 0.75 or 0.25, 0, 0.5, 0)
            end

            local arrow = Instance.new("TextButton")
            arrow.Name = "TPBatArrow"
            arrow.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(8,8,12)
            arrow.BackgroundTransparency = 0.18
            arrow.BorderSizePixel = 0
            arrow.Size = UDim2.new(0,38,0,26)
            arrow.Position = UDim2.new(1,-100,0.5,-13)
            arrow.Text = "V"
            arrow.TextColor3 = COLORS.white
            arrow.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
            arrow.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.72
            arrow.TextSize = 18
            arrow.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
            arrow.AutoButtonColor = false
            arrow.ZIndex = 30
            arrow.Parent = tpRow
            corner(arrow,7)
            stroke(arrow,COLORS.strokeSoft,1,0.35)

            local expanded = false
            local function setExpanded(on)
                expanded = on == true
                if expanded then
                    tpModeRow.Visible = true
                    tween(tpModeRow, {Size = UDim2.new(1,-4,0,46)}, 0.22)
                    arrow.Text = "V"
                    arrow.TextSize = 18
                    tween(arrow, {Rotation = expanded and 180 or 0, TextTransparency = 0}, 0.18)
                else
                    tween(tpModeRow, {Size = UDim2.new(1,-4,0,0)}, 0.22)
                    arrow.Text = "V"
                    arrow.TextSize = 18
                    tween(arrow, {Rotation = expanded and 180 or 0, TextTransparency = 0}, 0.18)
                    task.delay(0.23, function()
                        if not expanded and tpModeRow and tpModeRow.Parent then
                            tpModeRow.Visible = false
                        end
                    end)
                end
            end

            arrow.Activated:Connect(function()
                setExpanded(not expanded)
            end)
            _G.AdaptTPBatCompactExpanded = function(on)
                setExpanded(on)
            end
            setExpanded(false)
        end
    end

    -- ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 4) Bat Aimbot mode selector: full-width Normal | Bypass, same V/^ alignment and animation.
    -- ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    do
        local aRow = aimbotMainRow or (Combat and Combat:FindFirstChild("Aimbot"))
        if aRow and Combat then
            local old = aRow:FindFirstChild("AimbotModeArrow")
            if old then old:Destroy() end
            old = Combat:FindFirstChild("Bat Aimbot Mode")
            if old then old:Destroy() end

            local arrow = Instance.new("TextButton")
            arrow.Name = "AimbotModeArrow"
            arrow.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(8,8,12)
            arrow.BackgroundTransparency = 0.18
            arrow.BorderSizePixel = 0
            arrow.Size = UDim2.new(0,38,0,26)
            arrow.Position = UDim2.new(1,-100,0.5,-13)
            arrow.Text = "V"
            arrow.TextColor3 = COLORS.white
            arrow.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
            arrow.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.72
            arrow.TextSize = 18
            arrow.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
            arrow.AutoButtonColor = false
            arrow.ZIndex = 30
            arrow.Parent = aRow
            corner(arrow,7)
            stroke(arrow,COLORS.strokeSoft,1,0.35)

            local modeRow = Instance.new("Frame")
            modeRow.Name = "Bat Aimbot Mode"
            modeRow.BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.row
            modeRow.BackgroundTransparency = 0.28
            modeRow.BorderSizePixel = 0
            modeRow.Size = UDim2.new(1,-4,0,0)
            modeRow.ClipsDescendants = true
            modeRow.Visible = false
            modeRow.LayoutOrder = (aRow.LayoutOrder or 5) + 0.01
            modeRow.ZIndex = 4
            modeRow.Parent = Combat
            corner(modeRow,9)
            stroke(modeRow,COLORS.strokeSoft,1.15,0.38)

            local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
            holder.Name = "BatAimbotModeHolder"
            holder.BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.row
            holder.BackgroundTransparency = 0.18
            holder.BorderSizePixel = 0
            -- Full-width 50/50 selector, exactly like Auto Steal.
            holder.Size = UDim2.new(1,-8,0,40)
            holder.Position = UDim2.new(0,4,0,3)
            holder.ZIndex = 5
            holder.Parent = modeRow
            corner(holder,9)
            stroke(holder,Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255),1.2,0.24)

            local slide = Instance.new("Frame")
            slide.Name = "BatAimbotModeSlide"
            slide.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(238,238,244)
            slide.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
            slide.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5,0.5)
            slide.Size = UDim2.new(0.5,-4,1,-8)
            slide.Position = UDim2.new(0.25,0,0.5,0)
            slide.ZIndex = 6
            slide.Parent = holder
            corner(slide,8)
            stroke(slide,Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255),1.4,0.05)

            local buttons = {}
            local function paint(mode)
                local isNormal = mode == "Normal"
                tween(slide, {
                    Position = UDim2.new(isNormal and 0.25 or 0.75, 0, 0.5, 0)
                }, 0.16)
                for name, btn in pairs(buttons) do
                    local selected = name == mode
                    btn.TextColor3 = selected and Color3.fromRGB(18,18,22) or COLORS.white
                    btn.TextStrokeTransparency = selected and 1 or 0.45
                    btn.Font = selected and Enum.Font.GothamBlack or Enum.Font.GothamMedium
                    btn.TextSize = selected and 12 or 11
                end
            end
            _G.AdaptAimbotModeSetVisual = paint

            for i, mode in ipairs({"Normal","Bypass"}) do
                local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
                btn.Name = "Mode_"..mode
                btn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
                btn.Size = UDim2.new(0.5,0,1,0)
                btn.Position = UDim2.new((i-1)*0.5,0,0,0)
                btn.Text = mode
                btn.TextColor3 = COLORS.white
                btn.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0)
                btn.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.45
                btn.TextSize = 11
                btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
                btn.AutoButtonColor = false
                btn.ZIndex = 10
                btn.Parent = holder
                buttons[mode] = btn
                btn.Activated:Connect(function()
                    _G.AdaptSetAimbotMode(mode)
                    paint(mode)
                    tween(btn, {TextTransparency = 0}, 0.06)
                end)
            end

            local expanded = false
            arrow.Activated:Connect(function()
                expanded = not expanded
                if expanded then
                    modeRow.Visible = true
                    tween(modeRow, {Size = UDim2.new(1,-4,0,46)}, 0.22)
                    arrow.Text = "V"
                    arrow.TextSize = 18
                    tween(arrow, {Rotation = expanded and 180 or 0, TextTransparency = 0}, 0.18)
                else
                    tween(modeRow, {Size = UDim2.new(1,-4,0,0)}, 0.22)
                    arrow.Text = "V"
                    arrow.TextSize = 18
                    tween(arrow, {Rotation = expanded and 180 or 0, TextTransparency = 0}, 0.18)
                    task.delay(0.23, function()
                        if not expanded and modeRow and modeRow.Parent then modeRow.Visible = false end
                    end)
                end
            end)

            -- Default = Bypass; a previously saved Normal selection is restored.
            local initialMode = (_G.AdaptAimbotMode == "Normal") and "Normal" or "Bypass"
            _G.AdaptSetAimbotMode(initialMode)
            paint(initialMode)
        end
    end

    -- ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 5) Keep the existing final Combat layout and mobile Aimbot button wired
    -- to whichever mode is currently selected.
    -- ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    if _G.AdaptRefreshMobileButtonStates then
        pcall(_G.AdaptRefreshMobileButtonStates)
    end
    if saveAdaptConfig then pcall(saveAdaptConfig) end
end

-- [VX7 FINAL PATCH 2] Bat Aimbot inline mode panel + persistent Anti Ragdoll
-- The mode panel belongs to the Aimbot row itself, so it can never be pushed
-- away from the Aimbot row by Combat's UIListLayout.
-- ============================================================================
do
    -- ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 1) Persistent Anti Ragdoll across character reset / respawn.
    -- ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    if _G._Vx7AntiRagdollPersistent == nil then
        _G._Vx7AntiRagdollPersistent = antiRagdollEnabled == true
    end

    local _vx7OldSetAntiRagdoll = setAntiRagdoll
    setAntiRagdoll = function(on)
        _G._Vx7AntiRagdollPersistent = on == true
        return _vx7OldSetAntiRagdoll(on)
    end

    if not _G._Vx7AntiRagdollPersistentWatch then
        _G._Vx7AntiRagdollPersistentWatch = true

        local function _vx7RestoreAntiRagdoll()
            if _G._Vx7AntiRagdollPersistent ~= true then
                return
            end
            antiRagdollEnabled = true
            if type(startAntiRagdoll) == "function" then
                pcall(startAntiRagdoll)
            end
            if setAntiRagdollVisual then
                pcall(setAntiRagdollVisual, true)
            end
        end

        LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
            task.spawn(function()
                local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 3)
                local root = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 3)
                if not hum or not root or LP.Character ~= char then return end
                task.wait(0.15)
                _vx7RestoreAntiRagdoll()
            end)
        end)

        task.spawn(function()
            while task.wait(0.3) do
                if _G._Vx7AntiRagdollPersistent == true then
                    if not antiRagdollEnabled then
                        _vx7RestoreAntiRagdoll()
                    else
                        local alive = false
                        local S = _G.__LaPeakVX7AR
                        alive = S and S.conn and S.conn.Connected == true
                        if not alive then
                            _vx7RestoreAntiRagdoll()
                        end
                    end
                    if setAntiRagdollVisual then
                        pcall(setAntiRagdollVisual, true)
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
    end

    -- ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 2) Replace the previous Bat Aimbot sibling mode row with an INLINE panel.
    --    This makes the content appear immediately below the Aimbot row.
    -- ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local aRow = aimbotMainRow or (Combat and Combat:FindFirstChild("Aimbot"))
    if aRow and Combat then
        local oldSibling = Combat:FindFirstChild("Bat Aimbot Mode")
        if oldSibling then
            oldSibling:Destroy()
        end

        local oldArrow = aRow:FindFirstChild("AimbotModeArrow")
        if oldArrow then
            oldArrow:Destroy()
        end

        -- Keep the original toggle clickable only in the top 34px of the row.
        local mainToggle = aRow:FindFirstChild("ToggleButton")
        if mainToggle then
            mainToggle.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 34)
            mainToggle.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
            mainToggle.ZIndex = 12
        end

        aRow.ClipsDescendants = true
        aRow.Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 34)

        local arrow = Instance.new("TextButton")
        arrow.Name = "AimbotModeArrow"
        arrow.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(8,8,12)
        arrow.BackgroundTransparency = 0.18
        arrow.BorderSizePixel = 0
        arrow.Size = UDim2.new(0,38,0,26)
        arrow.Position = UDim2.new(1,-100,0,4)
        arrow.Text = "V"
        arrow.TextColor3 = COLORS.white
        arrow.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
        arrow.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.72
        arrow.TextSize = 18
        arrow.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
        arrow.AutoButtonColor = false
        arrow.ZIndex = 30
        arrow.Parent = aRow
        corner(arrow,7)
        stroke(arrow,COLORS.strokeSoft,1,0.35)

        local modeRow = Instance.new("Frame")
        modeRow.Name = "Bat Aimbot Mode Inline"
        modeRow.BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.row
        modeRow.BackgroundTransparency = 0.28
        modeRow.BorderSizePixel = 0
        modeRow.Position = UDim2.new(0,0,0,34)
        modeRow.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,0)
        modeRow.ClipsDescendants = true
        modeRow.ZIndex = 20
        modeRow.Parent = aRow
        corner(modeRow,9)
        stroke(modeRow,COLORS.strokeSoft,1.15,0.38)

        local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
        holder.Name = "BatAimbotModeHolder"
        holder.BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.row
        holder.BackgroundTransparency = 0.18
        holder.BorderSizePixel = 0
        holder.Size = UDim2.new(1,-8,0,40)
        holder.Position = UDim2.new(0,4,0,3)
        holder.ZIndex = 21
        holder.Parent = modeRow
        corner(holder,9)
        stroke(holder,Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255),1.2,0.24)

        local slide = Instance.new("Frame")
        slide.Name = "BatAimbotModeSlide"
        slide.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(238,238,244)
        slide.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
        slide.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5,0.5)
        slide.Size = UDim2.new(0.5,-4,1,-8)
        slide.Position = UDim2.new(0.25,0,0.5,0)
        slide.ZIndex = 22
        slide.Parent = holder
        corner(slide,8)
        stroke(slide,Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255),1.4,0.05)

        local buttons = {}
        local selectedMode = (_G.AdaptAimbotMode == "Normal") and "Normal" or "Bypass"

        local function paint(mode, active)
            selectedMode = (mode == "Normal") and "Normal" or "Bypass"
            local isNormal = selectedMode == "Normal"
            tween(slide, {
                Position = UDim2.new(isNormal and 0.25 or 0.75,0,0.5,0),
                BackgroundTransparency = active == false and 0.22 or 0.1
            }, 0.16)

            for name, btn in pairs(buttons) do
                local selected = name == selectedMode
                btn.TextColor3 = selected and Color3.fromRGB(18,18,22) or COLORS.white
                btn.TextTransparency = selected and 0 or 0.35
                btn.TextStrokeTransparency = selected and 1 or 0.48
                -- Both Normal and Bypass use the EXACT same selected/bold state.
                btn.Font = selected and Enum.Font.GothamBlack or Enum.Font.GothamMedium
                btn.TextSize = selected and 12 or 11
            end
        end
        _G.AdaptAimbotModeSetVisual = paint

        for i, mode in ipairs({"Normal","Bypass"}) do
            local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
            btn.Name = "Mode_"..mode
            btn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
            btn.Size = UDim2.new(0.5,0,1,0)
            btn.Position = UDim2.new((i-1)*0.5,0,0,0)
            btn.Text = mode
            btn.TextColor3 = COLORS.white
            btn.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0)
            btn.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.48
            btn.TextTransparency = 0.35
            btn.TextSize = 11
            btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
            btn.AutoButtonColor = false
            btn.ZIndex = 25
            btn.Parent = holder
            buttons[mode] = btn

            btn.Activated:Connect(function()
                _G.AdaptSetAimbotMode(mode)
                paint(mode, true)
                -- Keep the chosen mode visually bold immediately after the click,
                -- including Bypass while its runtime is active.
                task.defer(function()
                    paint((_G.AdaptAimbotMode == "Normal") and "Normal" or "Bypass", true)
                end)
            end)
        end

        local expanded = false
        local function setExpanded(on)
            expanded = on == true
            if expanded then
                tween(modeRow, {Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,46)}, 0.22)
                tween(aRow, {Size = UDim2.new(1,-4,0,82)}, 0.22)
                -- V -> upside-down V with the same large glyph/rotation style.
                arrow.Text = "V"
                tween(arrow, {Rotation = 180, TextTransparency = 0}, 0.18)
            else
                tween(modeRow, {Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,0)}, 0.22)
                tween(aRow, {Size = UDim2.new(1,-4,0,34)}, 0.22)
                arrow.Text = "V"
                tween(arrow, {Rotation = expanded and 180 or 0, TextTransparency = 0}, 0.18)
            end
        end

        arrow.Activated:Connect(function()
            setExpanded(not expanded)
        end)

        _G.AdaptAimbotModeExpanded = function(on)
            setExpanded(on)
        end

        -- Main Aimbot row also uses the same bold selected-active presentation.
        local oldAimbotVisual = _G.AdaptAimbotSetVisual
        if oldAimbotVisual and not _G._Vx7AimbotVisualWrapped then
            _G._Vx7AimbotVisualWrapped = true
            _G.AdaptAimbotSetVisual = function(on)
                oldAimbotVisual(on == true)
                local label = aRow:FindFirstChild("Label")
                if label then
                    label.Font = on and Enum.Font.GothamBlack or Enum.Font.GothamMedium
                end
                paint((_G.AdaptAimbotMode == "Normal") and "Normal" or "Bypass", on == true)
            end
        end

        paint(selectedMode, (_G.AdaptNormalAimbotOn == true) or (_G.AceAntiBypassAimbotOn == true))
        setExpanded(false)
    end
end

-- ============================================================
-- LAPEAK FINAL PATCH: STABLE MAIN MENU + SAFE CLEAN BAT LASER
-- ============================================================
do
    task.defer(function()
        task.wait(1.25)
        pcall(function()
            local UIS = UserInputService
            local TS = TweenService
            if not Main or not Gui then return end

            -- One authoritative floating toggle. Old menu controllers may remain
            -- in the file, but every public open/close entry point is redirected here.
            local toggle = Gui:FindFirstChild("LaPeakMainToggle")
            if not toggle then
                toggle = Instance.new("TextButton")
                toggle.Name = "LaPeakMainToggle"
                toggle.Parent = Gui
            end
            toggle.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(164, 50)
            toggle.Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 76)
            toggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(165, 166, 169)
            toggle.BackgroundTransparency = 0.08
            toggle.BorderSizePixel = 0
            toggle.Text = "12HUB\nOPEN MENU"
            toggle.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(12, 12, 15)
            toggle.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
            toggle.TextSize = 10
            toggle.TextWrapped = true
            toggle.AutoButtonColor = false
            toggle.Active = true
            toggle.Selectable = false
            toggle.ZIndex = 500
            local tc = toggle:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner") or Instance.new("UICorner", toggle)
            tc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 15)
            local tsStroke = toggle:FindFirstChild("LaPeakToggleStroke") or Instance.new("UIStroke", toggle)
            tsStroke.Name = "LaPeakToggleStroke"
            tsStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            tsStroke.Thickness = 1.2
            tsStroke.Transparency = 0.25

            -- Disable competing direct handlers on the old main close/minimize buttons.
            pcall(function()
                if getconnections and Close then
                    for _, c in ipairs(getconnections(Close.Activated) or {}) do pcall(function() c:Disable() end) end
                    for _, c in ipairs(getconnections(Close.MouseButton1Click) or {}) do pcall(function() c:Disable() end) end
                end
                if getconnections and MiniButton then
                    for _, c in ipairs(getconnections(MiniButton.Activated) or {}) do pcall(function() c:Disable() end) end
                    for _, c in ipairs(getconnections(MiniButton.MouseButton1Click) or {}) do pcall(function() c:Disable() end) end
                end
            end)

            local restingPos = _G.LonelyMainRestPosition or Main.Position
            local menuBusy = false
            local menuToken = 0

            -- Ambitious position contract: derive the nearest screen edge from
            -- the resting center position, and clamp the menu so it stays reachable.
            local function menuViewport()
                local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
                local vp = (cam and cam.ViewportSize) or Vector2.new(1920, 1080)
                if vp.X < 1 or vp.Y < 1 then vp = Vector2.new(1920, 1080) end
                return vp
            end

            local function restoreRestingPosition()
                local pos = _G.LonelyMainRestPosition
                if not pos then
                    pcall(function()
                        if savedMainPositionTable and tableToUDim2 then
                            pos = tableToUDim2(savedMainPositionTable, Main.Position)
                        end
                    end)
                end
                pos = pos or restingPos or UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
                local vp = menuViewport()
                local size = Main.AbsoluteSize
                local sw = (size.X > 1) and size.X or (FULL_MAIN_SIZE.X.Offset or 356)
                local sh = (size.Y > 1) and size.Y or (FULL_MAIN_SIZE.Y.Offset or 536)
                local cx = pos.X.Scale * vp.X + pos.X.Offset
                local cy = pos.Y.Scale * vp.Y + pos.Y.Offset
                local ncx = math.clamp(cx, sw * 0.25, math.max(vp.X - sw * 0.25, sw * 0.25))
                local ncy = math.clamp(cy, sh * 0.15, math.max(vp.Y - sh * 0.15, sh * 0.15))
                if math.abs(ncx - cx) > 0.5 or math.abs(ncy - cy) > 0.5 then
                    pos = UDim2.new(pos.X.Scale, pos.X.Offset + (ncx - cx), pos.Y.Scale, pos.Y.Offset + (ncy - cy))
                end
                restingPos = pos
                _G.LonelyMainRestPosition = pos
                savedMainPositionTable = udim2ToTable(pos)
                return pos
            end

            local function nearestMenuEdge(pos)
                local vp = menuViewport()
                local cx = pos.X.Scale * vp.X + pos.X.Offset
                local cy = pos.Y.Scale * vp.Y + pos.Y.Offset
                local left, right = cx / vp.X, 1 - (cx / vp.X)
                local top, bottom = cy / vp.Y, 1 - (cy / vp.Y)
                local best, edge = left, "Left"
                if right < best then best, edge = right, "Right" end
                if top < best then best, edge = top, "Top" end
                if bottom < best then best, edge = bottom, "Bottom" end
                return edge
            end

            local function hiddenPosition(pos, edge)
                local vp = menuViewport()
                local size = Main.AbsoluteSize
                local sw = (size.X > 1) and size.X or (FULL_MAIN_SIZE.X.Offset or 356)
                local sh = (size.Y > 1) and size.Y or (FULL_MAIN_SIZE.Y.Offset or 536)
                local cx = pos.X.Scale * vp.X + pos.X.Offset
                local cy = pos.Y.Scale * vp.Y + pos.Y.Offset
                local dx, dy = 0, 0
                if edge == "Left" then
                    dx = -(cx + sw * 0.8)
                elseif edge == "Right" then
                    dx = (vp.X - cx) + sw * 0.8
                elseif edge == "Top" then
                    dy = -(cy + sh * 0.8)
                else
                    dy = (vp.Y - cy) + sh * 0.8
                end
                return UDim2.new(pos.X.Scale, pos.X.Offset + dx, pos.Y.Scale, pos.Y.Offset + dy)
            end

            local function setToggleVisible(state)
                toggle.Visible = state
                pcall(function() MiniFrame.Visible = state end)
            end

            local function openMenu(immediate)
                menuToken = menuToken + 1
                local my = menuToken
                restingPos = restoreRestingPosition()
                local edge = nearestMenuEdge(restingPos)
                setToggleVisible(false)
                Main.Size = FULL_MAIN_SIZE
                Main.Rotation = 0
                if immediate then
                    _G.LonelyMainMenuAnimating = true
                    Main.Position = restingPos
                    Main.Visible = true
                    _G.LonelyMainMenuAnimating = false
                    menuBusy = false
                    return
                end
                _G.LonelyMainMenuAnimating = true
                Main.Position = hiddenPosition(restingPos, edge)
                Main.Visible = true
                menuBusy = true
                TS:Create(Main, TweenInfo.new(0.52, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
                    Position = restingPos,
                }):Play()
                task.delay(0.6, function()
                    if my ~= menuToken then return end
                    Main.Position = restingPos
                    Main.Rotation = 0
                    _G.LonelyMainMenuAnimating = false
                    menuBusy = false
                end)
            end

            local function closeMenu(immediate)
                menuToken = menuToken + 1
                local my = menuToken
                restingPos = restoreRestingPosition()
                local edge = nearestMenuEdge(restingPos)
                if immediate then
                    _G.LonelyMainMenuAnimating = true
                    Main.Position = restingPos
                    Main.Size = FULL_MAIN_SIZE
                    Main.Visible = false
                    _G.LonelyMainMenuAnimating = false
                    setToggleVisible(true)
                    menuBusy = false
                    return
                end
                Main.Visible = true
                Main.Size = FULL_MAIN_SIZE
                menuBusy = true
                _G.LonelyMainMenuAnimating = true
                local tw = TS:Create(Main, TweenInfo.new(0.38, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {
                    Position = hiddenPosition(restingPos, edge),
                })
                tw:Play()
                task.delay(0.2, function()
                    if my == menuToken then setToggleVisible(true) end
                end)
                task.delay(0.4, function()
                    if my ~= menuToken then return end
                    Main.Visible = false
                    Main.Position = restingPos
                    Main.Size = FULL_MAIN_SIZE
                    Main.Rotation = 0
                    _G.LonelyMainMenuAnimating = false
                    menuBusy = false
                end)
            end

            _G.LonelyOpenMainMenu = function()
                if Main.Visible and not menuBusy then
                    setToggleVisible(false)
                    return
                end
                openMenu(false)
            end
            _G.LonelyCloseMainMenu = function()
                if not Main.Visible and not menuBusy then
                    setToggleVisible(true)
                    return
                end
                closeMenu(false)
            end
            _G.LonelyToggleMainMenu = function()
                if Main.Visible then
                    _G.LonelyCloseMainMenu()
                else
                    _G.LonelyOpenMainMenu()
                end
            end
            _G.AdaptHubOpen = _G.LonelyOpenMainMenu
            _G.CokeShowMainUI = _G.LonelyOpenMainMenu
            _G.CokeHideMainUI = _G.LonelyCloseMainMenu
            _G.CokeToggleMainUI = _G.LonelyToggleMainMenu

            local dragging = false
            local dragStart = nil
            local toggleStart = nil
            local moved = false
            local heldTouch = nil
            local DEADZONE = 7

            toggle.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
                if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
                    and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                    return
                end
                dragging = true
                moved = false
                heldTouch = input
                dragStart = input.Position
                toggleStart = toggle.Position
            end)
            UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
                if not dragging then return end
                if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
                    and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                    return
                end
                local delta = input.Position - dragStart
                if math.abs(delta.X) > DEADZONE or math.abs(delta.Y) > DEADZONE then
                    moved = true
                end
                if not moved then return end
                if _G.AdaptGuiLocked == true or _G.AdaptMobileButtonsLocked == true then
                    return
                end
                toggle.Position = UDim2.new(
                    toggleStart.X.Scale,
                    toggleStart.X.Offset + delta.X,
                    toggleStart.Y.Scale,
                    toggleStart.Y.Offset + delta.Y
                )
            end)
            UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
                if input ~= heldTouch then return end
                local wasMoved = moved
                dragging = false
                heldTouch = nil
                dragStart = nil
                toggleStart = nil
                moved = false
                if not wasMoved then
                    -- Never hide the toggle first on a tap: open is atomic.
                    _G.LonelyOpenMainMenu()
                else
                    pcall(function()
                        if saveAdaptConfig then saveAdaptConfig() end
                    end)
                end
            end)
            toggle.Activated:Connect(function()
                -- Activated is intentionally ignored during a drag. InputEnded handles touch/mouse taps.
                if dragging or menuBusy then return end
                _G.LonelyOpenMainMenu()
            end)

            if Close then
                Close.Active = true
                Close.AutoButtonColor = false
                Close.ZIndex = 450
                Close.Text = "—"
                Close.Activated:Connect(function()
                    if not menuBusy then _G.LonelyCloseMainMenu() end
                end)
            end

            -- Keep the new toggle authoritative without allowing other legacy code
            -- to make it disappear when the user has just tapped it.
            task.spawn(function()
                while Gui and Gui.Parent do
                    task.wait(0.12)
                    if not menuBusy then
                        if Main.Visible then
                            toggle.Visible = false
                            pcall(function() MiniFrame.Visible = false end)
                        else
                            toggle.Visible = true
                            pcall(function() MiniFrame.Visible = false end)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)

            -- Start in the same state as the old menu: main open, toggle hidden.
            openMenu(true)
        end)
    end)
end

-- ============================================================
-- LAPEAK FINAL BAT SANITIZER
-- Makes the Clean Bat skin visual-only and removes all inherited
-- physics/joint objects that can contribute to fling on equip.
-- Also prevents Transparent Tools from hiding Clean Bat visual parts.
-- ============================================================
do
    pcall(function()
        -- Shared transparency helper: never claim the Clean Bat visuals.
        if type(isReplicaStuff) == "function" then
            -- local helper exists only inside the Custom Tools engine; this branch is kept
            -- for compatibility with executors that expose the helper globally.
        end
    end)
end

-- Patch the existing Clean Bat controller by continuously sanitizing its generated visual model.
do
    -- One lightweight sanitizer per script generation. It also gives the user
    -- the requested instant-reset safety net if the Bat skin produces a real
    -- physics spike.
    if _G.__LaPeakCleanBatSafetyConn then
        pcall(function() _G.__LaPeakCleanBatSafetyConn:Disconnect() end)
        _G.__LaPeakCleanBatSafetyConn = nil
    end
    _G.__LaPeakCleanBatSafetyConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        pcall(function()
            if not katanaSkinEnabled then return end
            local character = localPlayer and localPlayer.Character
            local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local bat = character and character:FindFirstChild("Bat")
            if not root or not bat or not bat:IsA("Tool") then return end
            local folder = bat:FindFirstChild("FlowerSkin_KatanaRealistic")
            if folder then
                for _, d in ipairs(folder:GetDescendants()) do
                    if d:IsA("JointInstance") or d:IsA("Constraint") or d:IsA("BodyMover") then
                        local keep = d:IsA("WeldConstraint") and d.Name == "FlowerSkin_AssetWeld"
                        if not keep then pcall(function() d:Destroy() end) end
                    elseif d:IsA("BasePart") then
                        d.Anchored = false
                        d.CanCollide = false
                        d.CanTouch = false
                        d.CanQuery = false
                        d.Massless = true
                        pcall(function() d.CustomPhysicalProperties = PhysicalProperties.new(0.01,0,0,0,0) end)
                        pcall(function() d.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero end)
                        pcall(function() d.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero end)
                    end
                end
            end

            -- If the equipped visual causes an abnormal physics spike, use the
            -- existing VX7 Instant Reset core rather than leaving the player stuck.
            local linear = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
            local angular = root.AssemblyAngularVelocity
            if not (_G.AdaptInstantResetInProgress == true)
                and (linear.Magnitude > 220 or angular.Magnitude > 1400)
                and type(_G.AdaptInstantReset) == "function" then
                _G.AdaptInstantReset()
            end
        end)
    end)
end

-- ============================================================
-- TP BAT V2 — CLEAN TP CORE
-- V1 remains the retained VX7 core above. V2 is an isolated Clean-style TP core.
-- The high-volume TP_LAG remote-payload repeater is intentionally excluded.
-- ============================================================
do
    local CleanTPV2 = _G.__LaPeakTPBatCleanV2 or {}
    if CleanTPV2.conn then pcall(function() CleanTPV2.conn:Disconnect() end) end
    CleanTPV2.enabled = false
    CleanTPV2.conn = nil
    CleanTPV2.nextHitAt = 0
    CleanTPV2.maxRange = 100
    CleanTPV2.originalCollisions = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
    _G.__LaPeakTPBatCleanV2 = CleanTPV2

    local function cleanV2FindBat(character)
        character = character or LP.Character
        if not character then return nil end
        local function isBat(tool)
            if not tool or not tool:IsA("Tool") then return false end
            local name = string.lower(tool.Name)
            return string.find(name, "bat", 1, true) ~= nil
                or string.find(name, "slap", 1, true) ~= nil
        end
        local equipped = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
        if isBat(equipped) then return equipped end
        local backpack = LP:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
        if backpack then
            for _, tool in ipairs(backpack:GetChildren()) do
                if isBat(tool) then return tool end
            end
        end
        return nil
    end

    local function cleanV2Nearest(root)
        local closest, bestDistance = nil, math.huge
        for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if player ~= LP and player.Character then
                local character = player.Character
                local targetRoot = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local hum = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if targetRoot and hum and hum.Health > 0 then
                    local distance = (root.Position - targetRoot.Position).Magnitude
                    if distance < bestDistance then
                        closest, bestDistance = player, distance
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return closest, bestDistance
    end

    local function cleanV2RestoreCollisions()
        for part, original in pairs(CleanTPV2.originalCollisions) do
            if part and part.Parent then
                pcall(function() part.CanCollide = original end)
            end
            CleanTPV2.originalCollisions[part] = nil
        end
    end

    local function cleanV2Stop()
        CleanTPV2.enabled = false
        CleanTPV2.target = nil
        if CleanTPV2.conn then
            pcall(function() CleanTPV2.conn:Disconnect() end)
            CleanTPV2.conn = nil
        end
        CleanTPV2.nextHitAt = 0
        cleanV2RestoreCollisions()
        local character = LP.Character
        local hum = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if hum then pcall(function() hum.AutoRotate = true end) end
        if root then
            pcall(function()
                if root.SetNetworkOwner then root:SetNetworkOwner(LP) end
            end)
        end
        if _G.AdaptTPButtonSetVisual then pcall(_G.AdaptTPButtonSetVisual, false) end
        if _G.AdaptRefreshMobileButtonStates then pcall(_G.AdaptRefreshMobileButtonStates) end
        if saveAdaptConfig then pcall(saveAdaptConfig) end
        return true
    end

    local function cleanV2Start()
        if CleanTPV2.enabled and CleanTPV2.conn then return true end
        if _G.AdaptSafeModeTryStart and not _G.AdaptSafeModeTryStart() then return false end
        local character = LP.Character
        local hum = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not character or not hum or not root or hum.Health <= 0 then return false end
        if CleanTPV2.conn then pcall(function() CleanTPV2.conn:Disconnect() end) end
        CleanTPV2.conn = nil
        CleanTPV2.enabled = true
        CleanTPV2.nextHitAt = 0
        CleanTPV2.originalCollisions = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

        if _G.AdaptNormalAimbotOn == true and type(_G.AdaptStopNormalAimbot) == "function" then
            pcall(_G.AdaptStopNormalAimbot)
        end
        if _G.AceAntiBypassAimbotOn == true and type(_G.AceStopAntiBypassAimbot) == "function" then
            pcall(_G.AceStopAntiBypassAimbot)
        end

        CleanTPV2.conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            if not CleanTPV2.enabled then return end
            local currentCharacter = LP.Character
            local currentRoot = currentCharacter and currentCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local currentHumanoid = currentCharacter and currentCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if not currentCharacter or not currentRoot or not currentHumanoid then return end

            -- Clean Anti-Die behavior, integrated without the separate network-lagger module.
            pcall(function()
                if currentHumanoid.Health <= 0 then
                    currentHumanoid.Health = currentHumanoid.MaxHealth
                end
                if currentHumanoid.PlatformStand then currentHumanoid.PlatformStand = false end
                if currentHumanoid.Sit then currentHumanoid.Sit = false end
                local state = currentHumanoid:GetState()
                if state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics
                    or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll
                    or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown then
                    currentHumanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
                    currentHumanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running)
                end
                if type(sethiddenproperty) == "function" then
                    pcall(sethiddenproperty, currentRoot, "PhysicsRepRootPart", nil)
                end
            end)

            local animator = currentHumanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
            if animator then
                pcall(function()
                    for _, track in ipairs(animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do track:Stop() end
                end)
            end

            local bat = cleanV2FindBat(currentCharacter)
            if bat and bat.Parent ~= currentCharacter then
                pcall(function() currentHumanoid:EquipTool(bat) end)
            end

            local target, distance = cleanV2Nearest(currentRoot)
            CleanTPV2.target = target
            if target and distance <= CleanTPV2.maxRange then
                local targetCharacter = target.Character
                local targetRoot = targetCharacter and targetCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if targetRoot then
                    pcall(function()
                        if currentRoot.SetNetworkOwner then currentRoot:SetNetworkOwner(nil) end
                    end)
                    currentRoot.CFrame = CFrame.new(targetRoot.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.9, 0))
                    currentRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = targetRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity
                    pcall(function()
                        if currentRoot.SetNetworkOwner then currentRoot:SetNetworkOwner(LP) end
                    end)
                    local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
                    if camera then
                        pcall(function()
                            camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(camera.CFrame.Position, targetRoot.Position)
                        end)
                    end
                    local now = tick()
                    if bat and now >= (CleanTPV2.nextHitAt or 0) then
                        CleanTPV2.nextHitAt = now + 0.08
                        pcall(function() bat:Activate() end)
                        local remote = bat:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("RemoteEvent")
                        if remote then pcall(function() remote:FireServer() end) end
                    end
                end
            end

            for _, part in ipairs(currentCharacter:GetDescendants()) do
                if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                    if CleanTPV2.originalCollisions[part] == nil then
                        CleanTPV2.originalCollisions[part] = part.CanCollide
                    end
                    if part.CanCollide then part.CanCollide = false end
                end
            end
        end)

        if _G.AdaptTPButtonSetVisual then pcall(_G.AdaptTPButtonSetVisual, true) end
        if _G.AdaptRefreshMobileButtonStates then pcall(_G.AdaptRefreshMobileButtonStates) end
        if saveAdaptConfig then pcall(saveAdaptConfig) end
        return true
    end

    local function cleanV1IsOn()
        local core = _G.__LaPeakTPBatV1Core
        if not core or type(core.isOn) ~= "function" then return false end
        local ok, value = pcall(core.isOn)
        return ok and value == true
    end

    local function stopSelectedTPBat()
        if CleanTPV2.enabled then cleanV2Stop() end
        if cleanV1IsOn() then
            local core = _G.__LaPeakTPBatV1Core
            if core and type(core.stop) == "function" then pcall(core.stop) end
        end
        if _G.AdaptTPBatV1 then _G.AdaptTPBatV1.enabled = false end
        if _G.AdaptTPButtonSetVisual then pcall(_G.AdaptTPButtonSetVisual, false) end
        if _G.AdaptRefreshMobileButtonStates then pcall(_G.AdaptRefreshMobileButtonStates) end
    end

    local function startSelectedTPBat()
        if _G.AdaptTPBatMode == "V2" then
            local enabled = cleanV2Start()
            if enabled and _G.AdaptSyncCameraLockConnection then
                pcall(_G.AdaptSyncCameraLockConnection)
            end
            return enabled
        end
        local core = _G.__LaPeakTPBatV1Core
        if not core or type(core.start) ~= "function" then return false end
        local ok, result = pcall(core.start)
        local enabled = ok and result ~= false
        if enabled and _G.AdaptTPBatV1 then _G.AdaptTPBatV1.enabled = true end
        if _G.AdaptTPButtonSetVisual then pcall(_G.AdaptTPButtonSetVisual, enabled) end
        if _G.AdaptRefreshMobileButtonStates then pcall(_G.AdaptRefreshMobileButtonStates) end
        if enabled and _G.AdaptSyncCameraLockConnection then
            pcall(_G.AdaptSyncCameraLockConnection)
        end
        return enabled
    end

    local function selectedTPBatIsOn()
        if _G.AdaptTPBatMode == "V2" then return CleanTPV2.enabled == true end
        return cleanV1IsOn()
    end

    function _G.AdaptSetTPBatMode(mode)
        mode = (mode == "V2") and "V2" or "V1"
        local oldMode = (_G.AdaptTPBatMode == "V2") and "V2" or "V1"
        if oldMode == mode then
            if _G.AdaptTPBatModeSetVisual then pcall(_G.AdaptTPBatModeSetVisual, mode) end
            if saveAdaptConfig then pcall(saveAdaptConfig) end
            return mode
        end
        local wasOn = selectedTPBatIsOn()
        if wasOn then stopSelectedTPBat() end
        _G.AdaptTPBatMode = mode
        if _G.AdaptTPBatV1 then _G.AdaptTPBatV1.target = nil end
        if _G.AdaptTPBatModeSetVisual then pcall(_G.AdaptTPBatModeSetVisual, mode) end
        if saveAdaptConfig then pcall(saveAdaptConfig) end
        if wasOn then startSelectedTPBat() end
        return mode
    end

    function _G.AdaptStartTPBatV1()
        if _G.AdaptTPBatMode ~= "V1" then
            local wasOn = selectedTPBatIsOn()
            _G.AdaptSetTPBatMode("V1")
            if wasOn and selectedTPBatIsOn() then return true end
        end
        return startSelectedTPBat()
    end

    function _G.AdaptStopTPBatV1()
        local core = _G.__LaPeakTPBatV1Core
        if core and type(core.stop) == "function" then
            local ok, result = pcall(core.stop)
            if _G.AdaptTPBatV1 then _G.AdaptTPBatV1.enabled = false end
            if _G.AdaptTPButtonSetVisual then pcall(_G.AdaptTPButtonSetVisual, false) end
            if _G.AdaptRefreshMobileButtonStates then pcall(_G.AdaptRefreshMobileButtonStates) end
            return ok and result ~= false
        end
        return false
    end

    function _G.AdaptStartTPBatV2()
        if _G.AdaptTPBatMode ~= "V2" then
            local wasOn = selectedTPBatIsOn()
            _G.AdaptSetTPBatMode("V2")
            if wasOn and selectedTPBatIsOn() then return true end
        end
        return cleanV2Start()
    end

    function _G.AdaptStopTPBatV2()
        return cleanV2Stop()
    end

    function _G.AdaptToggleTPBatV1()
        if selectedTPBatIsOn() then
            stopSelectedTPBat()
            if saveAdaptConfig then pcall(saveAdaptConfig) end
            return false
        end
        return startSelectedTPBat()
    end

    function _G.AdaptToggleTPBatV2()
        if _G.AdaptTPBatMode ~= "V2" then
            local wasOn = selectedTPBatIsOn()
            _G.AdaptSetTPBatMode("V2")
            if wasOn and selectedTPBatIsOn() then return true end
        end
        return _G.AdaptToggleTPBatV1()
    end

    -- Keep legacy Anti-Desync aliases routed to the currently selected version.
    _G.AdaptStartAntiDesyncAimbot = function() return startSelectedTPBat() end
    _G.AdaptStopAntiDesyncAimbot = function() stopSelectedTPBat(); return true end
    _G.AdaptToggleAntiDesyncAimbot = _G.AdaptToggleTPBatV1
end



-- ============================================================================
-- FINAL HIDE BUTTON MOBILE REPAIR
-- Build after legacy Settings patches so no old deferred panel can replace it.
-- Uses _G.AdaptMobileButtonRefs, and keeps the per-button hide behavior only.
-- ============================================================================
task.spawn(function()
    local settings
    local refs
    for _ = 1, 60 do
        settings = pages and (pages.SETTINGS or pages.Settings)
        refs = _G.AdaptMobileButtonRefs
        if settings and type(refs) == "table" and next(refs) ~= nil then break end
        task.wait(0.25)
    end
    -- Let the asynchronous mobile-button builder finish filling the shared table.
    task.wait(0.8)
    refs = _G.AdaptMobileButtonRefs or refs
    if not settings then
        warn("[12hub] Hide Button Mobile: Settings page not found")
        return
    end

    pcall(function()
        local removeNames = {
            ["Hide Button Mobile Ambitious"] = true,
            ["Hide Mobile Buttons"] = true,
            ["Hide MB Expand"] = true,
            ["LonelyHideButtonsRow"] = true,
            ["LonelyHideList"] = true,
            ["VX7HideButtonMobile"] = true,
            ["VX7HideButtonMobileFixed"] = true,
        }
        local oldItems = settings:GetDescendants()
        for _, obj in ipairs(oldItems) do
            if obj:IsA("GuiObject") and removeNames[obj.Name] then
                pcall(function() obj:Destroy() end)
            end
        end

        local palette = {
            panel = Color3.fromRGB(24, 19, 31),
            row = Color3.fromRGB(39, 31, 48),
            text = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
            muted = Color3.fromRGB(202, 190, 211),
            accent = Color3.fromRGB(255, 95, 190),
            border = Color3.fromRGB(230, 170, 220),
        }
        local function addCorner(obj, radius)
            local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
            c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius)
            c.Parent = obj
        end
        local function addStroke(obj)
            local s = Instance.new("UIStroke")
            s.Color = palette.border
            s.Thickness = 1
            s.Transparency = 0.3
            s.Parent = obj
        end

        local panel = Instance.new("Frame")
        panel.Name = "VX7HideButtonMobileFixed"
        panel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 46)
        panel.BackgroundColor3 = palette.panel
        panel.BackgroundTransparency = 0.12
        panel.BorderSizePixel = 0
        panel.ClipsDescendants = true
        panel.Visible = true
        panel.LayoutOrder = 10 -- immediately after Lock GUI and before Mobile Buttons Size
        panel.Parent = settings
        addCorner(panel, 10)
        addStroke(panel)

        local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        title.Name = "PanelTitle"
        title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        title.Text = "HIDE BUTTON MOBILE"
        title.TextColor3 = palette.accent
        title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
        title.TextSize = 12
        title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 2)
        title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -110, 0, 20)
        title.ZIndex = 5
        title.Parent = panel

        local sub = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        sub.Name = "PanelDescription"
        sub.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        sub.Text = "Open V and choose the mobile buttons to hide."
        sub.TextColor3 = palette.muted
        sub.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
        sub.TextSize = 8
        sub.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        sub.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 23)
        sub.Size = UDim2.new(1, -110, 0, 14)
        sub.ZIndex = 5
        sub.Parent = panel

        local arrow = Instance.new("TextButton")
        arrow.Name = "HideMobileExpandArrow"
        arrow.Size = UDim2.new(0, 38, 0, 28)
        arrow.Position = UDim2.new(1, -48, 0, 9)
        arrow.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(9, 8, 13)
        arrow.BackgroundTransparency = 0.08
        arrow.BorderSizePixel = 0
        arrow.Text = "V"
        arrow.TextColor3 = palette.text
        arrow.TextSize = 18
        arrow.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
        arrow.AutoButtonColor = false
        arrow.ZIndex = 20
        arrow.Parent = panel
        addCorner(arrow, 7)
        addStroke(arrow)

        local list = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
        list.Name = "ButtonList"
        list.Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 0)
        list.Position = UDim2.new(0, 6, 0, 50)
        list.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        list.BorderSizePixel = 0
        list.ScrollBarThickness = 3
        list.ScrollBarImageColor3 = palette.accent
        list.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
        list.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
        list.Visible = false
        list.Parent = panel
        local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
        layout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
        layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 4)
        layout.Parent = list

        local Tween = game:GetService("TweenService")
        local expanded = false
        local busy = false
        local function labelFor(key, entry)
            local btn = entry and entry.btn
            local value = btn and tostring(btn.Text or "") or ""
            value = value:gsub("\n", " "):gsub("%s+", " "):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
            if value ~= "" then return value end
            return tostring(key):gsub("([a-z])([A-Z])", "%1 %2"):upper()
        end
        local function toggleValue(key)
            return (_G.AdaptPerButtonHidden and _G.AdaptPerButtonHidden[key] == true)
                or (_G.AdaptMobileButtonHiddenKeys and _G.AdaptMobileButtonHiddenKeys[key] == true)
        end
        local function rebuild()
            for _, child in ipairs(list:GetChildren()) do
                if not child:IsA("UIListLayout") then child:Destroy() end
            end
            refs = _G.AdaptMobileButtonRefs or refs or {}
            local items = {}
            for key, entry in pairs(refs) do
                if type(entry) == "table" and entry.holder and entry.holder.Parent then
                    items[#items + 1] = { key = key, entry = entry }
                end
            end
            table.sort(items, function(a, b)
                return tostring(a.key):lower() < tostring(b.key):lower()
            end)
            for index, item in ipairs(items) do
                local key, entry = item.key, item.entry
                local row = Instance.new("Frame")
                row.Name = "HideMobile_" .. tostring(key)
                row.Size = UDim2.new(1, -2, 0, 34)
                row.BackgroundColor3 = palette.row
                row.BackgroundTransparency = 0.08
                row.BorderSizePixel = 0
                row.LayoutOrder = index
                row.Parent = list
                addCorner(row, 8)

                local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
                label.Name = "ButtonLabel"
                label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                label.Text = labelFor(key, entry)
                label.TextColor3 = palette.text
                label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamSemibold
                label.TextSize = 10
                label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
                label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 0)
                label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -84, 1, 0)
                label.Parent = row

                local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
                button.Name = "Toggle"
                button.Size = UDim2.new(0, 60, 0, 24)
                button.Position = UDim2.new(1, -66, 0.5, -12)
                button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 56)
                button.BorderSizePixel = 0
                button.TextColor3 = palette.text
                button.TextSize = 9
                button.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
                button.AutoButtonColor = false
                button.Parent = row
                addCorner(button, 7)
                local function paint()
                    local hidden = toggleValue(key)
                    button.Text = hidden and "HIDDEN" or "SHOW"
                    button.BackgroundColor3 = hidden and palette.accent or Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 56)
                end
                paint()
                button.Activated:Connect(function()
                    if button:GetAttribute("Busy") then return end
                    button:SetAttribute("Busy", true)
                    local hidden = not toggleValue(key)
                    _G.AdaptPerButtonHidden = _G.AdaptPerButtonHidden or {}
                    _G.AdaptMobileButtonHiddenKeys = _G.AdaptMobileButtonHiddenKeys or {}
                    _G.AdaptPerButtonHidden[key] = hidden
                    _G.AdaptMobileButtonHiddenKeys[key] = hidden
                    if type(_G.LonelySetButtonHidden) == "function" then
                        pcall(_G.LonelySetButtonHidden, key, hidden)
                    else
                        pcall(function() entry.holder.Visible = not hidden end)
                    end
                    paint()
                    if type(saveAdaptConfig) == "function" then pcall(saveAdaptConfig) end
                    task.delay(0.12, function()
                        if button and button.Parent then button:SetAttribute("Busy", false) end
                    end)
                end)
            end
        end

        local function setExpanded(on)
            expanded = on == true
            list.Visible = true
            local count = 0
            refs = _G.AdaptMobileButtonRefs or refs or {}
            for _, entry in pairs(refs) do
                if type(entry) == "table" and entry.holder and entry.holder.Parent then count = count + 1 end
            end
            local listHeight = expanded and math.min(math.max(count * 38, 42), 260) or 0
            Tween:Create(panel, TweenInfo.new(0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
                Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, expanded and (54 + listHeight) or 46)
            }):Play()
            Tween:Create(list, TweenInfo.new(0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
                Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, listHeight)
            }):Play()
            Tween:Create(arrow, TweenInfo.new(0.16, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
                Rotation = expanded and 180 or 0
            }):Play()
            if not expanded then
                task.delay(0.24, function()
                    if not expanded and list.Parent then list.Visible = false end
                end)
            end
        end
        arrow.Activated:Connect(function()
            if busy then return end
            busy = true
            rebuild()
            setExpanded(not expanded)
            task.delay(0.26, function() busy = false end)
        end)
        title.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                -- Header remains readable; V is the only expansion control.
            end
        end)
        rebuild()
        if #list:GetChildren() <= 1 then
            sub.Text = "No mobile buttons found yet. Reopen Settings to refresh."
        end
        print("[12hub] Hide Button Mobile panel built", #list:GetChildren() - 1)
    end)
end)


-- ============================================================
-- CAMERA LOCK FINAL SYNC (V1 / V2 + persisted toggle)
-- ============================================================
do
    local function syncCameraLockConnection()
        local lock = _G.AdaptAmbitiousCameraLock
        if not lock then return end
        if lock.enabled == true then
            if not lock.conn then
                lock.conn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(_tpbatCameraLockFrame)
            end
        elseif lock.conn then
            pcall(function() lock.conn:Disconnect() end)
            lock.conn = nil
        end
    end

    _G.AdaptSyncCameraLockConnection = syncCameraLockConnection

    local previousSetCameraLock = _G.AdaptSetAmbitiousCameraLock
    _G.AdaptSetAmbitiousCameraLock = function(on)
        on = on == true
        if type(previousSetCameraLock) == "function" then
            pcall(previousSetCameraLock, on)
        else
            local lock = _G.AdaptAmbitiousCameraLock
            if not lock then return end
            lock.enabled = on
            lock.target = nil
            if saveAdaptConfig then pcall(saveAdaptConfig) end
            if _G.AdaptCameraLockSetVisual then pcall(_G.AdaptCameraLockSetVisual, on) end
        end
        syncCameraLockConnection()
        if saveAdaptConfig then pcall(saveAdaptConfig) end
    end

    _G.AdaptToggleAmbitiousCameraLock = function()
        local lock = _G.AdaptAmbitiousCameraLock
        _G.AdaptSetAmbitiousCameraLock(not (lock and lock.enabled == true))
    end
    _G.AdaptSetVX7CameraLock = _G.AdaptSetAmbitiousCameraLock
    _G.AdaptToggleVX7CameraLock = _G.AdaptToggleAmbitiousCameraLock

    -- Saved Camera Lock starts enabled when the loaded config says true.
    if _G.AdaptAmbitiousCameraLock and _G.AdaptAmbitiousCameraLock.enabled == true then
        syncCameraLockConnection()
    end
end
